hypothesis: Ukwakha ingxenye yoHlelo lweZimo eziphuthumayo zeZempilo zeWHO, iWHO Hub yePandemic ne-Epidemic Intelligence (iWHO Pandemic Hub), yenza kube lula ukubambisana komhlaba wonke kwabalingani abavela emikhakheni eminingi esekela amazwe nababambiqhaza ukubhekana nobhubhane oluzayo kanye nezingozi zobhubhane ngokufinyelela okungcono kudatha, amandla okuhlaziya angcono, namathuluzi angcono nokuqonda kokuthatha izinqumo. Ngokusekelwa nguHulumeni weFederal Republic of Germany, iWHO Pandemic Hub yasungulwa ngoMandulo wezi-2021 eBerlin, ekuphenduleni ubhubhane lweCOVID-19, olubonise ubuthakathaka emhlabeni wonke ngendlela amazwe athola ngayo, aqaphe futhi alawule izinsongo zezempilo yomphakathi. IWHO Pandemic Hub isebenza ngokubambisana namazwe angamalungu kanye namahhovisi esifunda kanye nezwe leWHO ukuze kuqiniswe amandla awo okwabelana ngemininingo futhi anike amandla abalingani abavela emhlabeni wonke ukuthi babambisane futhi bakhe amathuluzi okuqoqa nokuhlaziya imininingo yokubhekwa kokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi. Ngokuba khona emazweni angaphezu kwe-150, amahhovisi esifunda ayisithupha, kanye nendlunkulu yayo yaseGeneva, ukufinyelela kweWHO kusinika amandla okwelapha ubhubhane, ubhubhane kanye nezingozi zezempilo yomphakathi ngokuphuthuma okulinganayo kanye nokukhuthala emhlabeni wonke. Ngokuxhumanisa imizamo yasendaweni, yesifunda, kanye neyomhlaba wonke, iWHO Pandemic Hub ikhuthaza indawo yokubambisana yabasungula izinto ezintsha, ososayensi kanye nochwepheshe abavela kuyo yonke imikhakha ehlukene, okusivumela ukuthi sisebenzise futhi sabelane ngobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu futhi siqinise umsebenzi wethu ezidingweni zababambiqhaza emhlabeni wonke.

Ekupheleni kuka-2022, amazwe amaningi abike izimpawu eziyingxenye zokululama kwezinsizakalo, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zocansi, ukuzala, umama, abasanda kuzalwa, impilo yezingane kanye nentsha; ukudla okunomsoco; ukugoma; izifo ezithathelanayo (okuhlanganisa umalaleveva, iHIV, iTB, nezinye izifo ezithathelana ngocansi); izifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo; izifo ezingathathelani; ukuphathwa kwezifo zengqondo, zezinzwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa; ukunakekelwa kwabantu asebekhulile; kanye nokunakekelwa kwendabuko kanye/noma okwengeziwe. Inani lamazwe abika ukuphazamiseka ohlelweni lwawo lokuhlinzeka kuzwelonke lwezinga lokunikezwa kwezinsizakalo lancipha lisuka cishe engxenyeni (ama-29 kumazwe angama-59 aphendulile) laya cishe engxenyeni yesine (ama-18 kumazwe angama-66 aphendulile) phakathi nonyaka odlule. Naphezu kwezimpawu zokululama, ukuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo kuyaqhubeka emazweni kuzo zonke izifunda kanye namazinga emali engenayo, nakuzo zonke izilungiselelo zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nezindawo zezinsizakalo zokulandelela. Amazwe abuye abhekane nokwanda kwezinsizakalo ezibuyayo - ngokuvamile ezinsizeni zokuhlola, ukuxilonga kanye nokwelashwa kwezifo ezingathathelani - okungaholela emiphumeleni emibi njengoba abantu bebedindwa ukuthola ukunakekelwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukubuyisela ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile kubalulekile ngoba ukuphazamiseka - okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokugqugquzela impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukuxilonga, ukwelashwa, ukubuyisela esimweni kanye nokudambisa - kungase kube nemiphumela emibi kakhulu empilweni yabantu kanye nasezingeni lomuntu ngamunye kunobhubhane ngokwalo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasengozini.

Lokhu kubandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokwelapha ngocingo, ukukhuthazwa kokunakekelwa kwasekhaya noma ukungenelela kokuzinakekela, izindlela zokuqinisa ukutholakala kwabasebenzi bezempilo, amakhono kanye nezindlela zokusekela, izinto ezintsha ekuthengeni nasekuletheni imithi kanye nezinsiza, ukuxhumana komphakathi okuvamile, kanye nokubambisana nabahlinzeki bomkhakha ozimele. Izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zamazwe zibike ukwabiwa kwezimali okwengeziwe ekululameni kwesistimu yesikhathi eside, ukuqina kanye nokuzilungiselela. Amazwe abonise isidingo sokwesekwa kweWHO ukubhekana nezinselelo ezisele kumongo weCOVID-19 nangale kwawo, ngokuvamile okuhlobene nokuqiniswa kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ukwakha amandla okuqapha izinsizakalo zezempilo, ukuklama ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo - amamodeli okunakekelwa, ukubusa, inqubomgomo kanye nokuhlela kanye nokuhlela kwezezimali kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali. Inothi kubahleli: Emzuliswaneni wesine wocwaningo lweWHO lomhlaba wonke, amazwe angama-222, izindawo nezindawo zamenywa ukuthi ziphendule inhlolovo ejwayelekile esekelwe kuwebhu phakathi kukaLwezi 2022 noMasingana 2023. Ucwaningo lwesine lulandele ucwaningo lwangaphambilini lweWHO lwango-2020 no-2021: Umzuliswano 1 (Meyi-September 2020), Umzuliswano 2 (Januwari-Mashi 2021), kanye noMzuliswano 3 (Novemba-Disemba 2021) okubonise izinga ubhubhane obelithinta ngalo ukuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile nokuthi amazwe athatha kanjani izinyathelo.

I-UAE igxile kakhulu ekuhlinzekeni amaqembu asengozini kakhulu athintwe yisimo saseSudan, ikakhulukazi abagulayo, izingane, asebekhulile, nabesifazane abasengozini enkulu ngenxa yezingxabano eziqhubekayo ezikhathazayo - futhi lezi zindiza zosizo zizobhekana ngokuqondile nezikhala eziphuthumayo kakhulu ekuhlinzekweni kwezokwelapha nokudla. Izindinganiso zobuntu ezijulile ze-UAE zisho ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi iqhubekile nokuxhumana nomhlaba wonke ngokuzinikela kwayo okuqinile nokungayeki ukuqinisa ukuthula, ukuphepha kanye nokuzinza, hhayi esifundeni kuphela, kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke, kuyilapho kanye nabalingani bayo kanye nomphakathi wamazwe ngamazwe, izwe liyaqhubeka nokusiza abantu baseSudan ngezikhathi zobunzima. Izinsiza zezempilo zihlanganisa ukuhlukumezeka okwanele, izinsiza zokuhlinzwa eziphuthumayo, kanye nemithi ebalulekile ukuze kufinyelelwe ngokushesha kubantu abayi-165 000 abadinga usizo lwabantu. Izikhungo zezempilo ezweni lonke zibika ukuthi ziphelelwe izinsiza zezempilo eziyisisekelo nokuthi izitolo zezokwelapha zikazwelonke azisafinyeleleki ngenxa yesimo sezokuphepha. Phakathi kokunye ukwesekwa, iWHO ithumela olojistikhi ababili bezimo eziphuthumayo abahamba nomthwalo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisatshalaliswa ngokushesha ezikhungweni zezempilo ezinkulu eziyi-13 ukuze kusekelwe abasebenzi bezempilo futhi kunikezwe ukunakekelwa kulabo abadingayo.

Manje, esikhundleni sokuthi impilo yabo bonke ibonakale njengenceku yokukhula komnotho, sinemephu yendlela yokwakha umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ezosivumela ukuthi sifinyelele umgomo wokubona bonke abantu bethola izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile ngokushesha ngemiphumela engcono,” kusho uDkt Tedros. “Eminyakeni emibili edlule, iWHO Council on the Economics of Health for All isebenzele ukwenza indaba entsha yezomnotho – eguqula ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwezempilo kusuka ekusetshenzisweni kuya ekutshalweni kwemali,” kusho uSihlalo woMkhandlu, uProfesa Mariana Mazzucato. “Sihlole izinguquko ezidingekayo – okuhlanganisa ukwakheka kwamalungelo obunikazi, ukubambisana komphakathi nezizimele, kanye nezabelomali – ukuklama umnotho oletha Impilo Yabo Bonke. Embikweni wethu wokugcina, sicela inqubomgomo entsha yezomnotho engakhulumi ngokulungiswa kwemakethe kodwa ngokubumba ngokuzimisela nangokubambisana izimakethe ezibeka phambili impilo yabantu kanye neyomhlaba.” Yethulwe namuhla ngokubambisana ne-76th World Health Assembly, umbiko, onesihloko esithi Impilo Yabo Bonke: Ukuguqula umnotho ukuze ulethe okubalulekile (https://www.who.int/groups/who-council-on-the-economics-of-health-for-all), unikeza uhlaka olusha olwakhelwe ezinsikeni ezine ezingenhla, nezincomo ezithile ngaphansi kwesinye nesinye – okuthathwa emsebenzini wangaphambilini woMkhandlu.

Uhlelo lwe-INTERSUN ukubambisana phakathi kweWHO, i-United Nations Environment Programme, iWorld Meteorological Organization, i-International Agency on Cancer Research kanye ne-International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection. Ikhuthaza futhi ihlola ucwaningo ngemiphumela yezempilo yemisebe ye-UV, futhi ithuthukise impendulo efanele ngeziqondiso, izincomo kanye nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi. Imigomo yohlelo okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngeseluleko esisebenzayo nesinengqondo ngemithelela yezempilo kanye nemvelo yokuchayeka ku-UV, ukukhuthaza amazwe ukuthi athathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa izingozi zezempilo ezibangelwa yi-UV kanye nokuhlinzeka ngesiqondiso kuziphathimandla zikazwelonke mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngelanga. Ngale njongo, uhlelo lusebenzisana nochwepheshe kanye nama-ejensi akhethekile ukuze asebenzise imisebenzi ebalulekile yocwaningo, aqonde futhi alinganise izingozi zezempilo ezivela emisebeni ye-UV, athuthukise izibikezelo ezithembekile zezempilo kanye nemiphumela yezemvelo yezinguquko ekuchayekeni ku-UV ngokuncipha kwe-ozone stratospheric, futhi athuthukise izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuqapha ushintsho emiphumeleni yezempilo ebangelwa yi-UV ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uhlelo lunikeza amathuluzi kanye nemihlahlandlela ehlobene nenkomba ye-UV, ukuvikelwa kwelanga kwezingane, izibhedlela zokwenziwa, ezokuvakasha kanye nezempilo yomsebenzi.

Lo mzamo we-multilateral nezinye izinhlelo zakamuva zokukhiqiza kwasendaweni zifuna amasu okuthuthukisa abasebenzi abanentshisekelo yokuqasha, ukuthuthukisa amakhono kanye nokugcina abasebenzi abasebenza kulezi zikhungo, abanamakhono ahlukile adingekayo ekukhiqizeni okuphilayo. Ukuze kubhekwane naleli gesi, iWHO neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea bahlanganyele ekubambisaneni okuvaliwe isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka futhi manje sebeqinisa ukuzibophezela kwabo ekusungulweni kwesikhungo sokuqeqesha somhlaba wonke ekukhiqizeni okuphilayo. "Sijabule kakhulu ukusayina le Memorandum of Understanding ukuze siphakamise ubudlelwano bethu ezingeni elilandelayo futhi sibambisane ekuthuthukiseni uhlelo lwezifundo lokuqeqesha olunzulu. Sithemba ukuthi leli zingxenyekazi lokuqeqesha elisezingeni lomhlaba wonke lizosiza ekwakheni abasebenzi abanamakhono futhi liqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yezempilo esezingeni eliphezulu ingakhiqizwa emhlabeni wonke," kusho uDkt Yukiko Nakatani, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, Ukufinyelela Kumithi kanye Nemikhiqizo Yezempilo. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea unikeza uhla olukhulu lwezikhungo zokuqeqesha zikazwelonke nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa uhla oluphelele lokukhiqiza okuphilayo futhi ukwandisa imisebenzi yayo ukuze kuhlaliswe abaqeqeshwayo abaningi abavela kwamanye amazwe ngokwakhiwa kweGlobal Bio Education Campus ezokwethulwa ngo-2025.

Umhlangano wasungula i-MSM ngo-2012 ukuze ubhekane nemikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe ngokombono wezempilo yomphakathi nangendlela esobala nebandakanya wonke umuntu. Umgomo weMSM ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi kanye nokukhuthaza ukufinyelela emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha engabizi, ephephile, esebenza ngendlela efanele kanye nekhwalithi. Ngokuqaphela izehlakalo zakamuva zemithi engcolisiwe etholakala ezimakethe ezihlukahlukene kanye nokufa okuhlobene nokugwenywa, Amazwe Angamalungu agcizelele ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla awo okuvimbela, ukuthola kanye nokusabela emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe ngokufinyelela kubuchwepheshe obufanele, okuhlanganisa izindawo zokuhlola zaselabhorethri, kanye nokwengamela okuthuthukisiwe ezimakethe ezingekho emthethweni kanye nokukhangisa, kanye nokuthengiswa kwe-inthanethi kwemikhiqizo yezokwelapha. Amazwe Angamalungu acela ukuthi amukele futhi asebenzise ubuchwepheshe bokulandelela nokulandelela ukulawula imakethe kanye nokubhekwa, kanye nesidingo sokubambisana okusemthethweni ngabalingani bendawo kanye nomhlaba wonke abafanele njengokuphoqelelwa komthetho kanye nokuphathwa kwamasiko. Amazwe Angamalungu akhuthazwa ukuthi ahambisane nemihlangano ehlose ukwenza ngcono umthetho kanye nokubeka izijeziso ezivimbela ukuthengiselana okungafanele emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe.

Umbiko womhlangano weWHO Technical Advisory Group on COVID-19 Vaccine Composition (TAG-CO-VAC) owabanjwa ngomhlaka-16-17 Mashi 2023 NgoNhlangulana 2022, iTAG-CO-VAC yashicilela isitatimende sesikhashana esiqokomisa ukuthi imithi yokugoma esekelwe kuvidiwe iyaqhubeka nokunikeza amazinga aphezulu okuvikela izifo ezinzima ezibangelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo zeSARS-CoV-2 Variants of Concern (amaVOC), okuhlanganisa ne-Omicron. Kodwa-ke, uma kubhekwa ibanga le-antigenic kanye nokungaqiniseki ngokuqhubeka kokuguquka kwegciwane, iTAG-CO-VAC yaqaphela ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ukusebenza kwemithi yokugoma esekelwe kuvidiwe igciwane kuzokwehlisa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. I-TAG-CO-VAC yeluleka abakhiqizi bemigomo kanye neziphathimandla ezilawulayo ukuthi bacabangele ukubuyekezwa kokwakhiwa kwe-antigen yemigomo ngokufaka i-Omicron, njengenguquko yeSARS-CoV-2 ehlukile kakhulu kuze kube manje, ukuze iphathwe njengomthamo wokugqugquzela. Abakhiqizi bemigomo eminingi baye basungula imithi yokugomela iCOVID-19 enokwakheka okubuyekeziwe kwe-antigenic; lokhu kuhlanganisa imithi eminingana yokugoma esekelwe ku-mRNA equkethe izinhlobo zangaphambili ze-Omicron, ngaphezu kwegciwane lenkomba (okungukuthi, igciwane lenkomba + BA.1 noma BA.4/5), eligunyazwe ukusetshenziswa okuphuthumayo yiziphathimandla ezilawulayo.

Umhlangano Wabalingani Bohlelo Lomhlaba Wonke Lwezifo Ezishiyiwe Zasezindaweni Ezishisayo, 12-13 Juni 2023 Abamele umphakathi we-NTD womhlaba wonke bazohlangana eGeneva ngesonto elizayo ukuze babambe iqhaza eMhlanganweni Wabalingani Bohlelo Lomhlaba Wonke Lwezifo Ezishiyiwe Zasezindaweni Ezishisayo, ozokwenzeka ehholo lendlunkulu ngomhlaka-12-13 kuNhlangulana 2023. Izinhloso zomhlangano ukubuyekeza inqubekelaphambili ebalazweni le-WHO lezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe 2021-2030 kanye nokwakha ukuqonda okungcono ngokusebenza kwe-NTD yomhlaba wonke kusuka kokubili imibono eqondene nezifo kanye neyokunqamula, kanye nokuzibandakanya ezingxoxweni ezibanzi ezizungeze umbono weWHO Eyodwa yokuletha uhlelo olulodwa lweGlobal NTD. Ngesikhathi imihlangano yangaphambilini yomhlaba wonke yabalingani be-NTD yayihlanganiswe yiWHO ngo-2007 nango-2017, lo mcimbi wesithathu ozayo ungowokuqala selokhu kwethulwa ibalazwe lomzila ngoMasingana 2021. Ibalazwe le-WHO lezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe 2021-2030 lihlaka elibanzi elichaza okuhlosiwe, izindlela zokuvumelanisa neMigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme kanye nezinye izinhlelo zomhlaba wonke futhi lifuna ukushintshwa kwamasu ezindleleni zeNTD ngenhloso yokuqeda ubhubhane lwezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe ngo-2030.

Abacimi bomlilo nabasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo nabo bathinteka kakhulu ngenxa yokulimala, ukusha kanye nokuphefumula intuthu, ikakhulukazi lapho kukhona abantu abaningi. Ucwaningo olwengeziwe oluhlanganisa imikhakha eminingi luyadingeka ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela yezempilo efihlekile neyesikhathi eside yokuchayeka emlilweni wasendle kubantu abasengozini (izingane, abantu asebekhulile, abantu abakhulelwe, abantu abanezifo ezingamahlalakhona), ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibhekene nokuchayeka ngokuphindaphindiwe nangokuphindaphindiwe kulezi zehlakalo zomlilo wasendle. Impendulo yeWHO: Ubukhulu bezindleko ezingokomzimba nezomuntu ezivela emlilweni wasendle bungehliswa uma izinyathelo ezanele zokuvimbela izimo eziphuthumayo, ukulungela, ukusabela kanye nokululama zisetshenziswa ngendlela esimeme futhi ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukusebenza namazwe angamalungu, iWHO isiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zezempilo eziqinile nezisebenzayo ezingalindela izidingo nezinselele ngesikhathi sezimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa izingozi futhi sisabele ngempumelelo lapho kudingeka. I-WHO isebenza nozakwethu ekulungiseleleni, ekuvimbeleni, ekutholeni, ekuphenduleni nasekululameni ezimweni eziphuthumayo kanye nezinhlekelele, okuhlanganisa ukuchayeka kwemvelo, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi kanye nokukhipha izeluleko zezempilo kanye nekhwalithi yomoya;

Iletha izinhlobo eziningi zezinhlelo nemisebenzi eqhubekisela phambili ukukhuthazwa kwezempilo kubantu asebekhulile, kusukela ekuqondeni kangcono izimbangela zokugula kanye nokushona kwabantu ngokubhekwa kukazwelonke kwezifo ezingathathelani, ucwaningo, ukubhaliswa kwabantu abashonile kanye nocwaningo, kuya ezinhlelweni ezenziwe ngokwezifiso zokukhuthaza ulwazi lwezempilo kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini. Izinyathelo zihlanganisa ithuluzi lokuzikhandla labantu asebekhulile, ukwakhiwa kwamandla kwabasebenzi bezokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo abangu-2000, isonto lokukhulumela ezempilo elizinikezele kubantu asebekhulile, kanye nephrojekthi entsha yokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo kanye nengqondo yabantu asebekhulile abangaphezu kwengxenye yesigidi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye nasemaphandleni. UDkt Abla Mehio Sibai unguSolwazi we-Epidemiology kanye noDekan we-Faculty of Health Sciences e-American University of Beirut eLebanon. Wenze umnikelo omuhle kakhulu empilweni yabantu asebekhulile eLebanon kanye nasesifundeni, ukuthuthukisa indlela ephelele yokukhuthaza ukuguga okunempilo. Uhola isinyathelo esisha sokubhalisa abantu asebekhulile abacishe babe ngama-600 unyaka ngamunye e-University for Seniors e-American University of Beirut, ngaphezu kokuqeqesha ochwepheshe bezempilo yomphakathi.

Isitatimende somkhosi weminyaka engama-50 yeHRP: iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain neNorthern Ireland Ukubamba umoya weKomidi leNqubomgomo Nokuxhumanisa (PCC) amalungu abungaza iminyaka engama-50 yeHRP kanye nempumelelo yayo eminingi, iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain neNorthern Ireland bafunde inothi elilandelayo lokwazisa kanye nokuhalalisela emhlanganweni wama-36 weHRP PCC. Isizukulwane sethu sibone inqubekelaphambili enkulu kwezesayensi nakwezobuchwepheshe kunazo zonke izizukulwane ezidlule ndawonye futhi sabona izinguquko eziningana ezingokwengqondo, ezobuchwepheshe, ezokwelapha nezenhlalo eziholwa inguquko yokuvimbela inzalo futhi zilandelwa intuthuko kwezempilo yokuzala, izinto ezintsha zezempilo kanye namalungelo kanye nokulingana ngokobulili. Nokho, izinselele ezinkulu emkhakheni weSRHR ziyaqhubeka, futhi, ngokusobala, okunye ukuthuthuka kuphinde kwaphakanyiswa namuhla. Siyayincoma iHRP-abasebenzi, abalingani nabasekeli ngempumelelo eminingi kuze kube manje futhi siqaphela ukuqhubekela phambili okukhulu okwenziwe phakathi nengxenye yekhulu leminyaka ekukhiqizeni ubufakazi obusekela ukufinyelela okugcwele nokulinganayo kwezempilo kanye namalungelo ezocansi nokuzala.

Isinqumo sokuqala ngqa kwezesayensi yokuziphatha ukuze kube nempilo engcono samukelwa Namuhla Amazwe Angamalungu amukele isayensi yokuziphatha ukuze kube nesisombululo esingcono sezempilo namaZwe Angamalungu abonisa ukuvumelana okubanzi mayelana nesidingo sokuhlanganisa imfundiso yesayensi yokuziphatha ngendlela ehlelekile, izindlela kanye nezindlela ezihlokweni zezempilo kanye nemisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi. Isinqumo sinxusa Amazwe Angamalungu ukuthi aqaphele indima yesayensi yokuziphatha ekuzuzeni imiphumela engcono yezempilo, ukuhlonza amathuba okwengeza ukusetshenziswa futhi, ukusungula imisebenzi namayunithi okukhiqiza nokuhumusha ubufakazi ukuze kwaziswe izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo. Iphinde icele uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi ahlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwesayensi yokuziphatha ngaphakathi kwenhlangano futhi ahlinzeke ukwesekwa kuMazwe Angamalungu ngokuthuthukiswa kwesiqondiso kanye nokuhlinzekwa kosizo lwezobuchwepheshe. Amazwe Angamalungu aqaphele ukuzuzwa kwe-Behavioural Sciences for Better Health Initiative eholwa yisikhwama, ancoma iMalaysia, umxhasi wesinqumo, kanye namanye amazwe ayi-19 ajoyine njengabaxhasi, futhi abonga uMqondisi-Jikelele ngombiko.

Njengengxenye yemizamo yokuqinisa ukwakhiwa komhlaba wonke kokulungela ukuphuthumayo kwezempilo, ukusabela, kanye nokuqina i-UAE, iWHO, kanye nabalingani basebenza ngokubambisana ukuletha izinsiza ukuze kufinyelelwe abasengozini enkulu emhlabeni ngesikhathi sabo sokudinga kakhulu. Ngokwabo, uDkt Ahmed Al-Mandhari, uMqondisi Wesifunda seWHO eMpumalanga Mediterranean, uthe, “Inhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba iyaqhubeka nokuxhumana neziphathimandla zezempilo zaseSudan ukuletha izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile ngazo zonke izindlela ezitholakalayo. Ngenxa yezingxabano, izibhedlela, amakhemisi kanye nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo zibeke imithi ebalulekile, esindisa impilo. Ukufika kwamamethrikhi amathani angu-30 engeziwe okuhlukumezeka kanye nezinsiza zokuhlinzwa eziphuthumayo kanye nemithi ebalulekile kuzovumela iWHO ukuthi isekele izikhungo zezempilo ezinkulu eziyi-13 futhi isungule kabusha izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo abadinga usizo. Ihabhu lethu lokuthutha impahla emhlabeni wonke eDubai lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuhlinzekwa okungaphazamiseki kwezimpahla zezempilo futhi sibonga ngokusekelwa okuhlinzekwa yi-United Arab Emirates ukuze kube lula indiza yethu yokuqala yezinsiza ezidingeka kakhulu.

Izobuyekeza inqubekelaphambili yonyaka odlule, impumelelo kanye nezinselelo kanye nezinto eziza kuqala esikhathini esizayo kuzo zonke izinsika ezibalulekile zomsebenzi weWHO: Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Emhlabeni Wonke, Izimo Eziphuthumayo, Ukukhuthaza Impilo Nokuphila Kahle. I-WHA76 izohlanganisa abantu abangama-21-30 kuNhlaba ePalais des Nations eGeneva. “Njengoba sigubha iminyaka engama-75 yeWHO, singaziqhenya ngempumelelo yethu yangaphambilini, kodwa kufanele siqaphele izifundo esizifundile, njengoba sishintsha sisuka esigabeni sezimo eziphuthumayo zeCOVID-19, futhi sakhe ikusasa lapho wonke umuntu ezothola khona izinsiza zezempilo azidingayo,” kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. “Lokhu kusho ukuqinisa ukwakhiwa komhlaba wonke kokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo, ukusabela kanye nokuqina, ukusekela amazwe endleleni eya ekufinyeleleni kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke, kanye nokwakha iWHO enamandla, exhaswa ngezimali ngendlela esimeme futhi enokwethenjelwa. "Ukuqala i-WHA76 ngeSonto zingama-21 kuNhlaba, uhlelo lwesine lweWalk the Talk: Impilo Yabo Bonke lizoba yinselele lizoqala ePlace des Nations ngo-8:30 ekuseni ngeCEST (ukufudumala kuqala ngo-7:30 ekuseni ngeCEST), ukuze kukhuthazwe impilo yomzimba nengqondo kanye nokugubha ukubaluleka kobambiswano ngesikhathi sokugubha iminyaka engama-75 yeWHO.

I-WHO inamanye amamethrikhi angu-30 amathani ezinsiza zikamalaleveva nezifo ezingathathelani njengesifo sikashukela kanye nomfutho wegazi ophakeme, izimo ezingabulala uma zingelashwa. Lezi kanye nezikhwama zegazi ezingaba ngu-23 000 zilungiswa ngaphakathi kweWHO global logistics hub e-International Humanitarian City, futhi iWHO njengamanje ihlola konke okungenzeka ngokuletha lezi zinsiza eSudan ngokushesha okukhulu ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo waseSudan. UDkt Michael Ryan, uMqondisi Omkhulu, weWHO Health Emergencies Programme, uthe, “I-WHO Global Logistics Hub e-UAE isibe yindawo ebalulekile yokusabela ngokushesha kokunikezwa kwezigameko ezibucayi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukusekela amazwe angaphezu kwe-140 kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisi-6 zeWHO, ihabhu linikeza umzila wokuphila kumaZwe angamaLungu abhekana nezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo ezivela ekuqubukeni kwezifo, izinhlekelele ezifana nezikhukhula kanye nokuzamazama komhlaba, kanye nomthelela wezingxabano ezinhlelweni zezempilo. Ukusekelwa okuhlinzekwa yi-UAE kwenza iWHO ibe phambili kulokhu kusabela kwezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo - ukuletha usizo lwezokwelapha olukhethekile kulabo abaludingayo noma kuphi noma nini lapho ludingeka khona.

Lokhu kudikibale ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa ngenxa yenani labalimele. Ukuthunyelwa kwezindiza kuza njengengxenye yemizamo eqhubekayo yokusiza ye-UAE yokusekela abantu baseSudan futhi kubonisa ubudlelwane bayo obujulile neSudan, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yesimo izwe elibhekene naso. Usizo luphinde lube ukunwetshwa kombono wobuntu we-UAE futhi lugcizelela ubudlelwane balo namanye amazwe ngokusekelwe ebuzalwaneni babantu kanye nokuzibophezela kwalo ekusizeni abanye ngesikhathi sezinhlekelele nezimo eziphuthumayo. UDkt Reem bint Ebrahim Al Hashimy, uNgqongqoshe Wezwe Wezokubambisana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe, uthe i-UAE "iyaqhubeka nokusebenzisana eduze neNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba ukuze iqinisekise ukuthunyelwa ngempumelelo kwemisebenzi ebalulekile yokuthumela usizo lwezokwelapha kanye nokudla ukuze kusizwe ukubhekana nenkinga yamanje eSudan. Ngokuhambisana nezicelo zokuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezingqubuzanayo zomzabalazo wamanje ziyeke ukulwa ngokushesha futhi zinciphise isimo esibangela ukuhlupheka okungachazeki kubantu baseSudan, i-UAE iqinile ekuzibophezeleni kwayo ukuhlinzeka usizo kanye nosizo emazweni ngezikhathi zokudingeka.

Imigomo yazisa amaphrojekthi nezinqubomgomo kuyo yonke iNhlangano, okuhlanganisa imihlahlandlela ephathelene nezindlu, ukuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha, izinhlelo zezokuthutha kanye nokulethwa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Isibonelo, iziqondiso zeWHO zezindlu nezempilo, ezanyatheliswa okokuqala ngo-2018, ziqokomisa umthelela okhulayo wezimo zezindlu empilweni yabantu ngenxa yokukhula kwamadolobha, isimo sezulu kanye nezinguquko zenani labantu. Imihlahlandlela inikeza Amazwe Angamalungu, abalingani kanye nomphakathi ngezincomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini ezihambisana nendawo yokuhlala enganele (ukugcwala), amazinga okushisa aphansi kanye aphezulu endlini, izingozi zokulimala ekhaya, kanye nokufinyeleleka kwezindlu kubantu abanokukhubazeka okuthile. I-Urban Health Initiative (UHI) iphinde igxile ezindleleni zamadolobha zokuvumela impilo enhle ngokushayela phambili isenzo esiphumelelayo mayelana nokunukubezeka komoya emadolobheni kanye nokunukubezeka kwesimo sezulu okuhlala isikhashana (amaSLCP) - ukusindisa izimpilo ngokuxhumanisa ezempilo, imvelo kanye nentuthuko esimeme. I-WHO iphinde ibambisane ne-Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) emkhankasweni weBreathe Life, okuhloswe ngawo ukunciphisa ukunukubezeka komoya kanye nokunciphisa ukufa kwabantu abayizigidi ezingu-7 ngaphambi kwesikhathi minyaka yonke okubangelwa yiyo.

Bathatha izinkomba zabo ekushintsheni kwamasu amathathu abalulekile akhuthazwe kumephu yomgwaqo - ubunikazi bezwe obukhulu, ukukala imithelela hhayi inqubo, nokuzibophezela emisebenzini ehlanganisa konke kanye nokubambisana ukuze kusebenze kangcono - izingxoxo bezilungile, zibonakala ngokucacile futhi zigcwele nesidingo sokulingana kwezempilo kanye nobulungiswa ukuze kubhekwane namaNTD. Yindlela enjalo kuphela, umhlangano owawuzwa, engaletha ushintsho oludingwa eminye yemiphakathi empofu kakhulu emhlabeni ukuze kuzuzwe Izinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Okusimeme Zenhlangano Yezizwe Zango-2030. Emhlanganweni wokuqala onjalo womhlaba wonke kusukela kwethulwa i-roadmap ngoMasingana 2021, izihambeli zizwe futhi kuMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Abahlanganyeli abamukelekile ekuqaleni kwesimpongi sezinsuku ezimbili, uDkt Tedros uthe, “Lo mhlangano ubonisa lokho okushiwo yiWHO - abalingani abahlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzise amandla abo ahlangene ukuze babhekane nezinselele zezempilo zomhlaba wonke okungekho noyedwa kithi ongabhekana nazo eyedwa. “Inselele enezici eziningi njengezifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo ithatha indlela enezici eziningi, futhi yilokho esikuletha, ndawonye.”

Umnikelo: Iminikelo evela kubantu abashonile kufanele ithuthukiswe ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla ayo okwelapha ngokuphelele, kugwenywe, noma nini lapho kungenzeka khona, izingozi ezikhona kubahlinzeki abaphilayo, njengoba kushiwo kuMgomo Oqondisayo 3 weWHO. Kunesidingo esiqashelwayo sokuthi imiphakathi, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo, bafundiswe kangcono mayelana nokunikela nokufakelwa futhi lokho kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo yezinhlelo zokunikela ngabashonile. Nokho, naphezu kokusetshenziswa njalo kwezinto ezinikelwe ngabanikelayo abashonile, iminikelo evela kubanikelayo abaphilayo iyadingeka kwezinye izinhlobo zokufakelwa noma ukunxephezela ukunikezwa okulinganiselwe kwezinto ezitholakala kubanikelayo abashonile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zesiguli. Ukunikela okuphilayo kwenziwa ngakho naphezu kweqiniso lokuthi kuhilela izingozi kumnikelayo ezingase zingabonakali. Njengoba ukuthengwa kwezinto zabantu zokufakelwa ezivela kubanikelayo abashonile noma abasaphilayo kanye nokufakelwa okulandelayo kwe-allogeneic kungase kubangele izingozi zokuziphatha kanye nezokuphepha kubo bobabili abamukelayo kanye nomnikelayo, ukulawula okuqinile kanye nokwengamela okusebenzayo kufanele kwenziwe yiziphathimandla zezempilo ukuze zibavikele.

Ngalolu lwazi, ososayensi nezikhulu zezempilo zomphakathi bangakwazi ukuhlonza nokulandelela izifo ukuze kuvinjelwe futhi kusabelwe ekuqubukeni njengengxenye yohlelo olubanzi lokuqapha izifo, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa nemithi yokugoma. I-IPSN, noNobhala obungunyamekelwa yiWHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ihlanganisa ndawonye ochwepheshe emhlabeni wonke abasezingeni eliphezulu kwezofiziksi yezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha, okuvela kohulumeni, izisekelo zosizo, izinhlangano zamazwe amaningi, umphakathi, izifundiswa kanye nomkhakha ozimele. Bonke bahlanganyela umgomo ofanayo: ukuthola nokusabela ezinsongweni zezifo ngaphambi kokuba zibe izifo eziwumshayabhuqe kanye nezifo eziwumshayabhuqe, kanye nokwenza ngcono ukuqapha izifo okujwayelekile. Umgomo wale nethiwekhi entsha unesifiso esikhulu, kodwa futhi ungadlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikelekeni kwezempilo: ukunikeza wonke amazwe ukufinyelela ekulandelaneni kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlaziya njengengxenye yohlelo lwawo lwezempilo yomphakathi, "kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Njengoba kwaboniswa ngokucacile kithi ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19, umhlaba unamandla lapho umi ndawonye ukulwa nezinsongo zezempilo ezihlanganyelwe."

Inqubekelaphambili iyashabalala ngokuphathelene nempilo kamama kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kanye nokuvimbela ukubeletha, futhi manje sekubuyiselwa emuva ngokuhlanganiswa okubhubhisayo kweCOVID-19, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukwanda kwezingxabano kanye nokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. “Ngokusebenza ngokubambisana – ohulumeni, abanikelayo, umkhakha ozimele, umphakathi, abazali, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo – singakhuphula i-alamu mayelana nalokhu “kuphuthuma okuthulile”, futhi silethe imizamo yokuvimbela nokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi ekuqaleni kwemizamo kazwelonke yezempilo kanye nentuthuko, ukwakha ingcebo yabantu ngokusekela imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nezomnotho yonke indawo. ”UGabriela noJerome Foster, eLas Vegas, e-United States: abazali bakaJalen Foster, nabasunguli beJalen’s Gift Foundation “Isisekelo sethu sasungulwa ngemva kokushona kwendodana yethu, uJalen Foster, owabelethwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi emasontweni angama-27 ngenxa yokuqala kokubeletha kwebhaktheriya eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-group B streptococcus. Ukulahlekelwa yindodana yethu kwakubuhlungu, futhi kwakungekho ukwesekwa emphakathini futhi yilapho sinquma khona ukuhlinzeka indawo yokududuza nethemba emindenini elahlekelwe yingane.

Njengengxenye yokuvumelana neSimemezelo, iSIDS isayine ukuze yenze uchungechunge lwezenzo, ezihlanganisa izindawo ezinjengokubandakanya wonke umphakathi, ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa, ukuqinisekisa ukutshalwa kwezimali, ukuvumelanisa ohulumeni kanye nokubala inqubekelaphambili. Ingqungquthela iphinde yabonisa ukuzibophezela okuqondile kweSIDS kumaNCD kanye nempilo yengqondo, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo yengqondo ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo, ukubuyekeza umthetho wokulawula ugwayi ukuze kuhlanganiswe ugwayi we-elekthronikhi kanye nokubhema ugwayi, kanye nokunciphisa usawoti kanye noshukela odliwa abantu. Lezi zibopho zihambisana ne-WHO ‘ezokuthenga okuhle kakhulu’ - iqoqo lokungenelela okungabizi, okusekelwe ebufakazini ukuze kubhekwane namaNCD. Uhlu lokuthenga okuhle kakhulu lwabuyekezwa muva nje eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba Wonke ngoNhlaba ukuze kufakwe ukuvimbela kwesibili kwe-rheumatic fever, ukulawulwa okunamandla nesikhathi eside kwesifuba somoya kanye nesifo esingamahlalakhona sokuvimbela amaphaphu kanye nokungenelela okuningana kwesibeletho, ibele, i-colorectal, isibindi kanye nomdlavuza wezingane, kanye nokwelashwa okuphelele komdlavuza kulabo abaphila neHIV. “I-SIDS emazweni aseMelika isalokhu isengozini enkulu yamaNCD.

Ngijabule kakhulu ukubona inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe ngesikhathi esifushane kangaka futhi ngiyakwamukela ukwesekwa okuvela emazweni amaningi ahlukene - amazwe afana neNingizimu Afrika anekhono elinamandla lokukhiqiza i-biomanufacturing futhi azimisele ukusebenza ndawonye, afunde futhi abelane ngawo.” uNgqongqoshe weMfundo Ephakeme neSayensi uBlade Nzimande, uthe: “Umbono wethu yi-mRNA Technology Transfer Hub ngaphezu kweCOVID-19 nje. Amakhono esiwakhayo abheke ukusenza sikwazi ukubhekana nezinye izifo zesikhathi esizayo ezinemigomo engase isebenzise ipulatifomu efanayo yobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Umbono obheke ezifweni ezivame ezindaweni zethu ezifana neMalaria, Isifo Sohlangothi kanye neHIV nengculazi.” Lo mcimbi uphinde ube yingqophamlando ebalulekile yoHlelo ngokwethulwa kwesikhungo se-mRNA technology Hub e-Afrigen eKapa lapho kwakukhona uDkt Tedros noDkt Matshidiso Moeti uMqondisi Wesifunda seWHO e-Afrika, uCharles Gore uMqondisi Omkhulu weMPP kanye noNgqongqoshe Abahloniphekile ababambe iqhaza emcimbini wokunquma iribhoni e-Afrigen.

UProfesa Tienthavorn uphinde wadlala indima ebalulekile ekubhekaneni nenselele yokusatshalaliswa okungalingani kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ikakhulukazi emingceleni nasezindaweni zasemakhaya zaseThailand. Uhola ukusungulwa kobambiswano nezikole zasemaphandleni ukuze kuqashwe abafundi besikole samabanga aphezulu, babaqeqeshe futhi babasize babuyele endaweni ngemva kokufeza uhlelo lwezifundo lwezokwelapha olusheshayo. Umklomelo we-United Arab Emirates Health Foundation Prize2023: uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre wasePhilippinesNgaphezu kokuba udokotela odumile nomcwaningi, uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre ungummeli oshisekayo wokuncelisa ibele kuphela kanye nomsunguli weKalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Impilo KaMama Nengane) - inhlangano yasePhilippines engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni. UDkt Silvestre usebenzise isipiliyoni sakhe njengomsebenzi womphakathi ukuze enze ucwaningo futhi aklame inqubo yokusiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yomama kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Inqubo yokuphayona ayidala ichaza isethi elula yezenzo okufanele zenziwe ngabasebenzi bezempilo abahambela umama ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nengane yakhe esanda kuzalwa ngemva kokuzalwa.

“Ngijabule kakhulu ukuba lapha eKapa kanye nozakwethu ukuze sisekele imodeli esimeme yokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA ukuze sinikeze amazwe anemali engenayo ephansi kanye naphakathi nendawo ukufinyelela okulinganayo emithini yokugoma kanye neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo esindisa ukuphila,” kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. “Ngiziqhenya kakhulu ngempumelelo yabo bonke ababambe iqhaza kulo msebenzi; eminyakeni engaphansi kwemibili sikhombisile ukuthi uma sisebenza ngokubambisana, siphumelela ngokuhlanganyela.” Abahlanganyeli bomhlangano bahlanganisa abalingani be-biomanufacturing abavela emazweni ayi-15 ohlelweni, ochwepheshe abahamba phambili, imboni, abamele imiphakathi, nabaxhasi. Phakathi nomhlangano wezinsuku ezinhlanu, ababambiqhaza bazokwabelana ngenqubekelaphambili futhi baxoxe ngabagqugquzeli ababalulekile bokusimama koHlelo njengezinkinga zempahla yengqondo kanye nezici zokulawula, kanye nesayensi yezobuchwepheshe be-mRNA kanye nezicelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana namaLMICs kwezinye izindawo zezifo ezifana neHIV nesifo sofuba. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 lugcizelele ukuthi ukungalingani okukhulu kukhona ekufinyeleleni emikhiqizweni yezempilo, ikakhulukazi imithi yokugoma.

Ukwehliswa kwamazinga okuzibulala emazweni kuyinkomba ku-UN Sustainable Development Goals (ukuphela kwesibonakaliso sempilo yengqondo), iWHO General Programme of Work kanye neWHO Comprehensive Mental Health Action Plan 2013-2030. Umbiko wokuqala weWHO wokuzibulala emhlabeni, ukuvimbela ukuzibulala: isidingo somhlaba wonke, esanyatheliswa ngo-2014, okuhloswe ngaso ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokuzibulala kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye nokuzama ukuzibulala nokwenza ukuvimbela ukuzibulala kube yinto ephambili kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ohulumeni bakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise iphakheji yeWHO LIVE LIFE yokungenelela okusebenzayo nokusekelwe ebufakazini ekuvimbeleni ukuzibulala, kanye nokuthuthukisa noma ukuqinisa amasu okuvimbela ukuzibulala kazwelonke ahlanganisa imikhakha eminingi ngendlela yezempilo yomphakathi. Ubuholi kanye nokuxhumana kuzwelonke mayelana nokuvimbela ukuzibulala kusekelwa ngokuqhubekayo ukushicilelwa kwezindlela zokuvimbela ukuzibulala zikazwelonke: inqubekelaphambili, izibonelo kanye nezinkomba. Ukuqaphela ukuthi idatha nezibalo ziyadingeka ekumemezeleni nasekuthathweni kwezinqumo, iWHO yanyathelisa iSuicide emhlabeni wonke ngo-2019: Izilinganiso Zempilo Yomhlaba Wonke.

Umhlangano Wabalingani Bohlelo LweWHO Lwezifo Ezishiyiwe Zomhlaba Wonke uphela ngesimemo esivusa intukuthelo sokuthatha isinyathelo emhlabeni wonke Izihambeli nabamele bashiye Umhlangano Wabalingani Bohlelo Lwezifo Ezishiyiwe Zomhlaba Wonke ngesimemo esivusa intukuthelo sokuthatha isinyathelo esivela kumqondisi wawo uDkt Ibrahima Socé Fall. Njengoba umhlangano wamazwe amaningi, owawuhanjelwe abalingani abayizinhloko abangaba ngu-300, waphela eGeneva ngoLwesibili mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlangulana, uDkt Fall unxuse ababambiqhaza ukuthi bathathe umyalezo othi, “uma singaziphonsela inselelo, asikwazi ukuziveza futhi sithuthuke.” Emcimbini obanzi owawubanjelwe ukubuyekeza inqubekelaphambili ngokumelene nebalazwe le-WHO lezifo ezishiyiwe zasemahlathini zango-2021-2030 futhi ukhiqize ukuqonda okungcono kokusebenza kweNTD yomhlaba wonke kusuka kokubili imibono eqondene nezifo, abalingani, abanikelayo, abalingani bezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo kanye nabamele amazwe baqinise ukuzibophezela kwabo ekufinyeleleni umgomo onamandla: umhlaba ongenazo izifo ezishiyiwe zasemahlathini ngo-2030. Isihloko esiyinhloko somhlangano besigxile embonweni “Womphakathi owodwa ohambisa Uhlelo Olulodwa Lomhlaba Wonke lweNTD.”

Izihambeli nababambiqhaza bachitha izinsuku ezimbili ezilandelayo behlonza izikhala ezinkulu nezinselele zokufinyelela imigomo yezinga eliphezulu kanye nezinselele zendawo, ezisendaweni. Lezo zinselele zendawo zihlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathintwe ngokuqondile amaNTD, kanye nalabo ababhekele ngokuqondile ukuphatha ukungenelela ngokumelene namaNTD, bayacelwa futhi bayavunywa, ikakhulukazi ngokuphathelene nokuxhumana kanye nokuzibandakanya komphakathi. Umhlangano uphinde waqaphela ukubaluleka kokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yokusebenza, ukuze kwakhiwe amandla nokuzethemba kwabasebenzi beNTD yomhlaba wonke. Ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo, izihambeli zavumelana ngezimiso kanye nezinyathelo ezingokoqobo zokwenza isenzo maqondana nemigomo ebekiwe futhi ehlelwe ndawonye uHlelo Lokusebenza Lomhlaba Wonke lwango-2025-2030. Izinyathelo ezibalulekile nezinqumo ezivela emhlanganweni zihlanganisa izincomo zokuqinisa nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumanisa zikazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana ngokuhlela okuhlangene kanye nokuqapha nokuhlola, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwekhebula lokuhlinzeka ngendlela efanele ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke.

Izinsana ezilinganiselwa ezigidini eziyi-13.4 zazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngo-2020, cishe isigidi esisodwa sibulawa yizinkinga zangaphambi kwesikhathi, ngokombiko omusha okhishwe ama-ejensi eNhlangano Yezizwe kanye nabalingani namuhla. Lokhu kulingana nengane eyodwa kweziyishumi ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi (ngaphambi kwamasonto angama-37 okukhulelwa) emhlabeni wonke. Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi: iminyaka eyishumi yesenzo sokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ekhiqizwa yiNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) kanye ne-United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) ndawonye nePMNCH - umfelandawonye omkhulu kunayo yonke emhlabeni wabesifazane, izingane, kanye nentsha, yenza umsindo “wokuphuthuma okuthulile” kokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okungakaqashelwa isikali nokuba nzima, okuvimbela inqubekelaphambili ekuthuthukiseni impilo nokusinda kwezingane. Lo mbiko uhlanganisa izilinganiso ezibuyekeziwe ezivela ku-WHO kanye ne-UNICEF, ezilungiselelwe yiLondon School of Hygiene kanye neTropical Medicine, mayelana nokwanda kokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Sekukonke, ithola ukuthi amazinga okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi awashintshile kunoma yisiphi isifunda emhlabeni eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, njengoba kuzalwe izingane eziyizigidi eziyi-152 ezisengozini ngaphambi kwesikhathi kusukela ngo-2010 kuya ku-2020.

Izizathu zokungafani Ukufinyelela ku-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha kunomthelela ezicini eziningi ezisebenzisanayo ezihlanganisa abagqugquzeli abahlobene nokubusa okuhle, ukuthengwa okuthembekile/okusebenzayo kanye nezinqubo zokuhlinzeka, ukutholakala kwezinsiza kanye nemisebenzi yokwakha amandla, kanye nezithiyo ezihlobene nomthetho nezinqubomgomo ezivimbela ngokweqile, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okunganele, kanye nezimo zengqondo kanye nokuqonda okungalungile. Uma kucatshangelwa izimo ezahlukene zezwe, abagqugquzeli, izithiyo kanye nezinto eziza kuqala zesenzo ziyahlukahluka; ucwaningo lwababambiqhaza olwethulwe kulo mbiko, nabaphenduli abavela ku-105 WHO Member States, luqinisekisa lokhu kuhlukana. Isibonelo, ukuhlinzekwa okungajwayelekile kwe-morphine kanye namanye ama-opioid anamandla ezikhungweni zezempilo ngenxa yokuncishiswa kwezimali kwakuphawulwa njengesithiyo emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi kanye naphakathi nendawo uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe anemali engenayo ephezulu. Ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu yabaphenduli kuzo zonke izifunda baphawule nezithiyo ezivela ezicini zomthetho kanye nezokulawula ngesikhathi beqaphela ukubaluleka kohlaka lomthetho kanye nokulawula ekuzuzeni ukufinyelela okuphephile.

Ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo kubangelwa kokubili izici zokufuna kanye nokuhlinzeka, okuhlanganisa amazinga aphansi okufuna ukunakekelwa kwezempilo emiphakathini kanye nokutholakala okulinganiselwe kwabasebenzi bezempilo nezinye izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo njengemitholampilo evulekile noma izinqolobane ezitholakalayo zemithi nemikhiqizo. "Kuyizindaba ezimnandi ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni amaningi seziqala ukubuyisela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ezigidini zabantu abaziphuthelwe ngesikhathi sobhubhane," kusho uDkt Rudi Eggers, uMqondisi weWHO wezinsizakalo zezempilo ezihlanganisiwe. "Kodwa kudingeka siqinisekise ukuthi wonke amazwe ayaqhubeka nokuvala leli gesi ukuze athole izinsizakalo zezempilo, futhi asebenzise izifundo azifundile ukuze akhe izinhlelo zezempilo ezilungele futhi eziqinile zesikhathi esizayo." Izimpawu zokuqala eziphawulekayo zokululama Kule nhlolovo entsha, amazwe ambalwa abike ukunciphisa ngamabomu ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amapulatifomu okulethwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nemisebenzi ebalulekile yezempilo yomphakathi kusukela ngo-2020-2021, okubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokubuyela emazingeni angaphambi kobhubhane okulethwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nokusebenza kohlelo olubanzi.

Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zeCOVID-19 ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibalulekile Kwesinye isinyathelo esibalulekile sokululama kwesistimu kanye noshintsho, amazwe amaningi enze inqubekelaphambili ekuhlanganiseni izinsiza zeCOVID-19 ekulethweni kwezinsiza zezempilo ezijwayelekile. Cishe ama-80-90% amazwe ahlanganise ngokugcwele ukugonywa kweCOVID-19, ukuxilongwa kanye nezinsizakalo zokwenganyelwa kwamacala kanye nezinsizakalo zangemva kweCOVID-19 ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo ezijwayelekile. Noma kunjalo, amazwe amaningi (ama-80% amazwe angama-83 aphendulile) abike okungenani isithiyo esisodwa ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kumathuluzi abalulekile eCOVID-19 (isb. Ukuxilongwa kweCOVID-19, ukwelashwa, imithi yokugoma kanye nemishini yokuzivikela - PPE), nezinkinga zabasebenzi bezempilo kanye nokuntuleka kwezimali okumelela izithiyo ezivame kakhulu. Ukusekela okwengeziwe okudingekayo ukuze kululame, ukuqina kanye nokulungela Amazwe amaningi aseqalile ukusebenzisa lokho akufundile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19, okuhlanganisa ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo eziningi zokunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezijwayelekile.

Ngomhla zingama-26 kuNhlaba iMember States yagunyaza isinqumo sokuqinisa amandla okuxilonga emazweni kanye nokwenza ngcono ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuxilonga. Isinqumo esibanzi siyaqaphela ukuthi izinsiza zokuxilonga zibalulekile ekuvimbeleni, ekubhekweni, ekuxilongweni, ekuphathweni kwamacala, ekuqapheni nasekwelashweni kwezifo ezithathelanayo, ezingathathelani, ezinganakiwe ezifweni zasezindaweni ezishisayo nezingavamile, ukulimala, nokukhubazeka. Ukuxilonga kuvumela ukuhlonza okuqondile kwezifo, ngakho-ke ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi sokwelashwa okulungile kwemiphumela engcono yezempilo. Isinqumo sicabangela uhla oluphelele “lokuxilonga”, ngaleyo ndlela sihlanganisa kokubili ukuhlolwa kwelabhorethri “kwe-in vitro” isb. ukuhlolwa okusheshayo kokuxilonga kanye ne-polymerase chain reaction (PCR) kanye nokuxilongwa “okungekhona kwe-in vitro” isb. amadivayisi okuthatha izithombe noma okukala umfutho wegazi. Ihlanganisa izenzo zocwaningo nentuthuko, ukukhiqiza (okuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwasendaweni kanye nokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe), ukulawula, ukukhetha kanye nokuthenga, ukuqwashisa, ukukhulumela kanye nokubhekelela izithiyo zokufinyelela ngokujwayelekile.

Umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba kumele usebenzise wonke la mathuluzi ukuze ufinyelele Imigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme ekupheleni kwaleli shumi leminyaka. " UFatih Birol, uMqondisi Omkhulu, we-International Energy Agency " Amandla avuselelekayo ancintisanayo ngezindleko asephephule ukuzimisela okumangalisayo, kodwa abantu abampofu kakhulu emhlabeni basahluleka ukuzuza ngokugcwele kuwo. Ukuze sifeze iSDG7 ngaphandle kokuyekethisa kuzinhloso zesimo sezulu, kufanele senze ushintsho lwesistimu endleleni ukubambisana kwamazwe omhlaba okusebenza ngayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zezimali zamazwe amaningi ziqondise ukuhamba kwezimali ngokulinganayo emhlabeni wonke ukuze zisekele ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo kanye nentuthuko yengqalasizinda ehlobene. " UFrancesco La Camera, uMqondisi-Jikelele, we-International Renewable Energy Agency " Naphezu kwenqubekelaphambili ekufinyeleleni imigomo yamandla esimeme maphakathi ne-Ajenda 2030, iMigomo 7 ibonakala inzima ukuyifinyelela kunango-2015 futhi isinyathelo esengeziwe siyadingeka uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kumandla akhokhelekayo, athembekile, asimeme kanye nesimanjemanje kubo bonke ngo-2030.

Kusukela ngoNdasa wezi-2023, eminyakeni engaphezu kwemithathu ngemuva kokuthi iWHO imemezele iCOVID-19 njengePublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), u-69.7% wabantu bomhlaba wonke bathole okungenani umthamo owodwa womgomo weCOVID-19. Okuphawulekayo ukuthi lesi sibalo sisengaphansi kuka-30% emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi (amaLIC). Lolu Hlelo luhlose ukufaka isandla ekufinyeleleni ngokulinganayo emithini yokugoma ye-mRNA ngokwandisa ukusatshalaliswa kwamandla okukhiqiza asimeme kuLMICs, ukuthuthukisa ukusebenzisana kwesifunda kanye nezifunda, nokuthuthukisa nokunika amandla abasebenzi bendawo ngokuqeqeshwa okwenzelwe futhi okubandakanya bonke kanye nokwesekwa kochwepheshe. Yini eyingqayizivele kumodeli ye-mRNA Technology Transfer inqubo yamazwe amaningi evumela ukwabelana ngobuchwepheshe kubamukeli abaningi ukuze ngokukhiqizwa kwendawo kanye nesifunda labo abadingayo bangafinyelelwa ngokushesha. UDkt Phaahla, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, uthe: “Esikubonayo lapha namuhla, umzuzu emlandweni, uHlelo oluhlose ukunika amandla amaLMIC ngenethiwekhi yokubambisana yomhlaba wonke.

Imithamo eyengeziwe yemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-virus index iyaqhubeka nokunikeza amazinga aphezulu okuvikela izifo ezinzima kanye nokufa okubangelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo zeSARS-CoV-2, okuhlanganisa izinhlobo zesizukulwane se-Omicron yanamuhla. Ukuvikelwa ezifweni ezinzima kanye nokutheleleka ngezimpawu okubangelwa imithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-virus index kanye nemithi yokugoma eneBA.1- noma iBA.4/5 bivalent mRNA kwehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Nokho, ukuvikelwa ezifweni ezinzima kugcinwa isikhathi eside kunokuvikelwa ekuthelelekeni ngezimpawu. Uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-virus index, imithamo eyengeziwe yemithi yokugoma eneBA.1- noma iBA.4/5 i-bivalent mRNA ingase ikhuphule kancane ukusebenza komgomo ngokumelene nezifo ezinezimpawu, kuyilapho inani elincane lezifundo ezihlola imiphumela enzima libonisa izilinganiso ezifanayo zokusebenza komgomo. Yomibili imithi yokugoma eneBA.1- neBA.4/5 i-bivalent mRNA ithuthukisa ubukhulu futhi iveze ububanzi obukhulu bezimpendulo zokuphendula kwezokuvikela ezihlukene kuSARS-CoV-2 lapho isetshenziswa njengomthamo wokugqugquzela, uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-virus index.

I-European Commission kanye neWHO yethula isinyathelo sezempilo esidijithali esiyingqophamlando ukuze kuqiniswe ukuvikeleka kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke Inhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) kanye neKhomishini Yase-Europe bamemezele namuhla ukwethulwa kobambiswano lwezempilo lwedijithali oluyingqophamlando. NgoNhlangulana 2023, iWHO izothatha uhlelo lwe-European Union (EU) lwesitifiketi seCOVID-19 yedijithali ukuze isungule uhlelo lomhlaba wonke oluzosiza ukuhambisa ukuhamba komhlaba wonke futhi luvikele izakhamizi emhlabeni wonke ezinsongweni zezempilo eziqhubekayo nezesikhathi esizayo, okuhlanganisa nobhubhane. Lesi yisisekelo sokuqala seWHO Global Digital Health Certification Network (GDHCN) esizokwakha uhla olubanzi lwemikhiqizo yedijithali ukuze ilethe impilo engcono kubo bonke. "Ngokwakha inethiwekhi yesitifiketi yedijithali ephumelela kakhulu ye-EU, iWHO ihlose ukunikeza wonke amazwe angamalungu eWHO ukufinyelela kuthuluzi lezempilo ledijithali lomthombo ovulekile, olususelwa ezimisweni zokulingana, ukusungula izinto ezintsha, ukwenza izinto obala kanye nokuvikelwa kwedatha kanye nobumfihlo," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO.

Ngo-1987 uMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi amane, ukhathazekile ngokuhwebelana ngenzuzo yezitho zomuntu, waqala ukulungiselela Izimiso Zokuqondisa zokuqala zeWHO ngokufakelwa, okwagunyazwa uMhlangano ngo-1991 esinqumweni iWHA44.25. Lezi Zimiso Zokuqondisa zibe nomthelela omkhulu kumakhodi nezindlela zokwenza zochwepheshe kanye nomthetho emhlabeni wonke cishe amashumi amabili eminyaka. Ngemva kwenqubo yokubonisana eyathatha iminyaka eminingana, iSixty-third World Health Assembly yamukela isinqumo iWHA63.22 ngomhla zingama-21 kuNhlaba 2010, isekela izimiso zeWHO eziqondisayo ezibuyekeziwe futhi ikhomba izindawo zokuthuthuka ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukunikela nokufakelwa. Isimemezelo Sabachwepheshe base-Istanbul sokunikela nokufakelwa kuzo zonke izifunda, ngezinhlangano nezikhungo zabo eziningi, sigunyaza iSimemezelo sase-Istanbul ngokushushumbiswa kwezitho zomzimba kanye nezokuvakasha kokufakelwa okwenziwa ngaphansi kobuholi beTransplantation Society kanye ne-International Society of Nephrology ngoNhlaba 2008.

UDkt Aylward ubehola i-Agenda Yokuguqulwa kweWHO kanye nomsebenzi weNhlangano ku-Access to COVID-19 Tools Accelerator (ACT-A) Hub. Endimeni yakhe entsha, uDkt Aylward uzoshayela i-ajenda yeNhlangano yokuguqula ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo njengokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo komhlaba wonke, kanye nokuqapha umsebenzi weWHO ezinhlelweni zezempilo, ukugoma kanye nokuzala, impilo kamama kanye nengane. UDkt Aylward uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu zobungcweti kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Hanan Balkhy uzoqhubeka njengoMqondisi-Jikelele Wosizi Lokumelana Ne-Antimicrobial. UDkt Balkhy unikeza ubuholi bezobuchwepheshe kanye nezombusazwe ukuze kunqandwe imithwalo yezempilo kanye nezomnotho yokumelana nemithi, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisana kwemikhakha eminingi neNhlangano Yezokudla Nezolimo, iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezempilo Yezilwane, kanye noHlelo Lwezemvelo LweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene. Ngaphambi kokujoyina iWHO, uDkt Balkhy wayenguMqondisi Omkhulu Wokuvimbela Nokulawula Ukutheleleka eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela Kazwelonke waseSaudi Arabia.

Ukumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane (AMR) kuma-antibiotic asetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, ikakhulukazi i-gonorrhoea, kuye kwanda ngokushesha eminyakeni yamuva futhi kwehlise imiphumela yokwelashwa ephumelelayo. Imiphumela evela kuHlelo Lokubhekwa lweGonococcal AMR (GASP) yamanje ikhombisa ukuthambekela kwamazinga aphezulu okumelana ne-quinolone, ukwanda kokumelana ne-azithromycin kanye nokumelana okuvelayo kwama-cephalosporins anespektamu esandisiwe. Ukuvela kokuncipha kokuthambekela kwegonorrhea kuma-cephalosporins anespektamu esandisiwe, kanye namazinga aphezulu asunguliwe okumelana nama-penicillin, ama-sulfonamides, ama-tetracyclines, ama-quinolones kanye nama-macrolides kwenza igonorrhea ibe yinto engamelana nemithi eminingi. I-AMR yezinye izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, nakuba ingavamile, nayo ikhona, okwenza ukuvimbela nokwelashwa ngokushesha kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukuze welaphe ngokwanele izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi kubalulekile ukuthatha ama-antimicrobial afanele, ngomthamo ofanele kanye nesikhathi se-STI ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwelashwa okwanele noma ukwelashwa, kanye nokuvimbela ukwakheka kokumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane.

Ezimweni zohlelo lwezempilo oluqinile, sihambisa umthelela wezempilo yomphakathi ekufinyeleleni kwezempilo kubo bonke ngengxoxo yenqubomgomo yezinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo kanye nokwesekwa kwamasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Lo msebenzi usekelwa umhlahlandlela ojwayelekile kanye nezivumelwano; idatha, ucwaningo kanye nokusungula izinto ezintsha; nobuholi emikhakheni yezokuxhumana, ukumela, ukulingana ngokobulili, ukulingana kwezempilo kanye namalungelo abantu, isinyathelo semikhakha ehlukahlukene, kanye nezimali. I-Ajenda ka-2030 yamaSDG Umsebenzi weWHO uhambisana neMigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme (SDG) okuhlosiwe 3.8, okugxile ekuzuzeni ukufinyelela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke, okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwengozi yezezimali, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezibalulekile kanye nokufinyelela emithini ebalulekile ephephile, esebenza ngendlela efanele, esezingeni eliphezulu kanye nemithi yokugoma kubo bonke. Emhlabeni jikelele, inqubekelaphambili ekufinyeleleni kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke iyinselele. Inqubekelaphambili ekufinyeleleni kwezinsiza kuye kumile ngenkathi ingxenye yenani labantu ebhekene nezinkinga zokukhokhela izindleko zezempilo zangaphandle kwezikhwama zikhuphuka ngokuqhubekayo.

Ngo-2021, amazwe angu-139 anamaholo aphezulu kanye namaholo aphakathi nendawo aphakeme ayehlangabezane nalomgomo, kodwa amazwe angu-56 ngeke ahlangabezane nomgomo we-ENAP ngo-2030 uma kungenziwanga eminye imizamo. Uma izitayela zamanje ziqhubeka, izingane eziyizigidi ezingu-15.9 zizozalwa zingakazalwa; cishe ingxenye yalaba (izigidi ezingu-7.7, 48%) izokwenzeka e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara. Izimbangela: Ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuseqophelweni eliphezulu ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kanye nokubeletha, ukuzalwa kwezingane eziningi kuyagwemeka. Izimbangela eziyinhloko zokuzalwa kwezingane ezifile zihlanganisa izinkinga ezihlobene nokukhulelwa kanye nokubeletha, ukukhulelwa isikhathi eside, izifo zomama ezifana nomalaleveva, isifo sofuba kanye ne-HIV, izifo zomama ikakhulukazi umfutho wegazi ophakeme, nesifo sikashukela, kanye nokuvinjelwa kokukhula kwengane (lapho ingane engakazalwa ingakwazi ukufinyelela amandla ayo okukhula futhi ngenxa yalokho incane kunalokho okufanele ibe yikho). Ukungahambi kahle okuzalwa nakho kubangela ngaphansi kuka-10% wezingane ezizalwa zingakazalwa okubikwe kuzwelonke emazweni anamaholo aphezulu futhi isilinganiso esiqondile ezindaweni ezinamaholo aphansi asaziwa ngenxa yemikhawulo ekuxilongweni.

Udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni lungavinjelwa. Ukuvimbela nokusabela odlameni olubhekiswe ezinganeni kudinga ukuthi imizamo ibhekelele ngokuhlelekile izingozi kanye nezici zokuvikela kuwo wonke amazinga amane ahlobene engozini (umuntu ngamunye, ubuhlobo, umphakathi, umphakathi). Isinqumo soMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba kaMeyi 2016 sigunyaze uhlelo lokuqala lweWHO Global lokuqinisa indima yohlelo lwezempilo ngaphakathi kwempendulo kazwelonke yemikhakha ehlukahlukene yokubhekana nodlame phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi olubhekiswe kwabesifazane namantombazane, kanye nasezinganeni. A Ngokwalolu hlelo, iWHO ngokubambisana namazwe angamalungu kanye nabanye abalingani, izibophezele kulokhu: Ukuqapha ubukhulu bomhlaba wonke kanye nezici zobudlova obubhekiswe ezinganeni kanye nokusekela imizamo yezwe yokubhala kanye nokukala ubudlova obunjalo. Ukugcina uhlelo lolwazi lwe-elekthronikhi olufingqa imininingwane yesayensi ngomthwalo, izici zobungozi kanye nemiphumela yobudlova obubhekiswe ezinganeni, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi buyavinjelwa.

Kuthuthukiswe ngenqubo ehlanganisa wonke umuntu eholwa ‘’kanye’’ neSIDS, isimemezelo siqokomisa ukuthi amaNCD kanye nezimo zempilo yengqondo azikwazi ukubhekelelwa ngendlela efanele ngaphandle kokusabela enkingeni yesimo sezulu. “Isinyathelo esinesibindi sesimo sezulu sethu, impilo enhle, kanye nenhlalakahle incike ekulungiseni nasekuhleleni kabusha ezezimali zomhlaba wonke ukuze kuvulwe izigidigidi zokutshalwa kwezimali, ngenkathi kwenziwa kube nzima kumazwe asathuthuka ukuthi akhokhe izikweletu zawo,” kusho uMhlonishwa uMia Amor Mottley, uNdunankulu waseBarbados. “Ukuxhaswa ngezimali kokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko zesimo sezulu kanye nokunciphisa emazweni asengozini kakhulu nakho kubalulekile, kanye nezifo ezingathathelani kanye nempilo yengqondo.” "Izinselelo ezibhekene namaSmall Island Developing States zixhumene futhi zinezici eziningi. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukucekelwa phansi kwemvelo, ukungalingani kwezenhlalo nezomnotho, kanye nezinqumo zezohwebo zezempilo kubhebhethekisa umthwalo wamaNCD kanye nezimo zempilo yengqondo," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO.

Alikho izwe elingathinteki kulolu daba, futhi iWHO ithole imibiko yemithi yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi noma engamanga, imithi yokugoma kanye nokuxilongwa kwe-in vitro kuzo zonke izifunda zomhlaba. Imithi ejwayelekile kanye neyakhayo ingakhinyazwa, kusukela emikhiqizweni ebiza kakhulu yomdlavuza kuya emikhiqizweni engabizi kakhulu yokwelapha ubuhlungu. Amazwe Angamalungu e-WHO avumelene ngecebo lomhlaba wonke elibanzi eligxile ekuvimbeleni, ekutholeni nasekuphenduleni ukuze kufinyelelwe ekwandeni kokufinyelela emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphakeme, ephephile, esebenza ngendlela efanele kanye nekhwalithi. Umthelela: Imikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhinyiwe idala izinkinga eziningi kubo bobabili umuntu othatha umuthi kanye nasemindenini, umphakathi omkhulu, uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka. Lapho imithi ingasebenzi ngendlela okufanele isebenze ngayo, ingahluleka ukwelapha noma ukuvimbela izifo, ibe nomthelela ekumelaneni nemithi elwa namagciwane, ukuchitha izinsiza eziyigugu futhi kuholele ekulahlekelweni ukuzethemba emithini kanye nokungathembani nabahlinzeki bezempilo.

UProfesa Petro Terblanche, uMqondisi Omkhulu we-Afrigen uthe: "Ithimba lonke le-Afrigen lijabule kakhulu ukufinyelela kulesi sigameko esibalulekile ngokuqedwa kwesikhulumi sobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Lolu hlelo luhlala ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuthuthukiswa nokukhiqizwa komgomo we-mRNA wokuphela kuya kokuphela lapho umgomo we-mRNA Hub Covid 19 we-AfriVac 2121 okwamanje usesigabeni sokukhuphuka. Ezinyangeni eziyi-18 ezedlule, i-Afrigen yenze uguquko olumangalisayo ngokusekelwa kwenethiwekhi yabalingani nabeluleki abanikwe amandla yilolu Hlelo. Sikhulise amandla ethu kanye nomthamo wethu wokuhlangabezana nezindinganiso eziphakeme kakhulu zokuthuthukiswa komgomo we-mRNA, sifeza inhloso yokwakha amandla asimeme kumaLMICs ukuze sikhiqize imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA." I-Afrigen isungule ngempumelelo inqubo yokukhiqiza umgomo weCOVID-19 ngesikali sesivivinyo saselabhorethri futhi okwamanje ikhulisa leyo nqubo ibe sezingeni elifanele lokukhiqiza amaqoqo omgomo azosetshenziswa ezigabeni zokuqala/ezesibili zezivivinyo zomtholampilo kuya kumazinga e-GMP.

Ukubeletha. Uhlolojikelele: Ingane efa ngemva kwamasonto angu-28 ikhulelwe, kodwa ngaphambi noma ngesikhathi ibelethwa, ihlukaniswa njengokubeletha. Cishe kunezingane eziyizigidi ezingu-2 ezizalwa zifile unyaka ngamunye - eyodwa njalo ngemva kwemizuzwana engu-16. Ngaphezu kuka-40% wabo bonke abazalwa befile kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha - ukulahlekelwa okungase kugwenywe ngokunakekelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu nokuhloniphekile ngesikhathi sokubeletha okuhlanganisa ukuqapha okujwayelekile kanye nokufinyelela ngesikhathi ekunakekelweni kwezokubelethisa okuphuthumayo lapho kudingeka. Ukuzalwa kushona ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma lapho kuzalwa kuyinhlekelele engabhekelelwa ngokwanele kuma-ajenda omhlaba, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo ezixhaswe ngezimali. Kunezindleko ezingokwengqondo, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane kanye nemindeni yabo, njengengcindezi yomama, imiphumela yezimali kanye nemiphumela yezomnotho, kanye nokucwaswa kanye nokungavumelekile. Ngo-2014, i-World Health Assembly yagunyaza i-Every Newborn Action Plan (ENAP), ehlanganisa umgomo womhlaba wonke wezingane ezingu-12 noma ngaphansi kwezinyanga ezintathu (ezisalele emuva) zokubeletha ngabanye abangu-1,000 abazalwa ezweni ngalinye ngo-2030.

Kodwa-ke, izilinganiso ze-IRENA zibonisa ukuthi ukugeleza kwezimali zomphakathi emhlabeni wonke ekusekeleni amandla ahlanzekile emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi nendawo kuye kwehla kusukela ngaphambi kobhubhane lweCOVID-19 futhi ukuxhaswa ngezimali kunomkhawulo enanini elincane lamazwe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nemigomo yeSDG 7 futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazuza ngokugcwele ekuzuzeni kwezenhlalo nezomnotho ngokushintshela emandleni avuselelekayo, kuyadingeka ukuthi kuguqulwe ngokuphathelene nezimali zomphakathi zamazwe ngamazwe futhi kuchazwe amathuba amasha okuvula utshalomali. Umbiko uphinde uthole ukuthi ukwanda kwesikweletu kanye nokukhuphuka kwamanani kagesi kwenza kube kubi ukubheka ukufinyelela komhlaba wonke ekuphekeni okuhlanzekile kanye nogesi. Izibikezelo zamanje zilinganisela ukuthi abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-1.9 bazoba ngaphandle kokupheka okuhlanzekile futhi izigidi ezingama-660 zingakwazi ukuthola ugesi ngo-2030 uma singathathi izinyathelo ezengeziwe futhi siqhubeke nemizamo yamanje. Lezi zikhala zizoba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu bethu abasengozini kakhulu futhi zisheshise ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu.

Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule kuye kwaba nokukhula kokusebenza komphakathi ngokuphathelene nokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanye nokuvimbela ukubeletha, okuqhutshwa amanethiwekhi abazali, ochwepheshe bezempilo, izifundiswa, umphakathi, kanye nabanye. Emhlabeni wonke, amaqembu emindeni ethintekile yokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi abelokhu ehamba phambili ekumemezeleni ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni okungcono kanye noshintsho lwenqubomgomo kanye nokusekela eminye imindeni. Okuholela eMhlanganweni Wamazwe Ngamazwe Wezempilo Yomama Osanda Kuzalwa, eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ziyisi-8-11 kuNhlaba, iWHO, i-UNICEF, i-UNFPA kanye nePMNCH bafuna lezi zenzo ezilandelayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa futhi kuncishiswe izingozi ezivela ekuzalweni ngaphambi kwesikhathi: Ukutshalwa kwezimali okwandisiwe: Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezasendlini ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo kamama kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunikezwa ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuqaliswa okusheshayo: Ukuhlangana nemigomo yezwe yokuqhubeka ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezisemthethweni zikazwelonke zokunakekelwa komama kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa.

Umgomo uhlanganisa ukufinyelela kumandla kagesi emhlabeni wonke kanye nokupheka ngendlela ehlanzekile, ukuphinda kabili amazinga omlando okuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kahle, kanye nokwandisa kakhulu ingxenye yamandla avuselelekayo kumxube wamandla omhlaba. Ukufinyelela lo mgomo kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni kanye nenhlalakahle yabantu, kusize ukubavikela ezingozini zendawo kanye nezenhlalo ezifana nokunukubezeka komoya, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye nezinsiza. Uhlelo lwango-2023 lwe-Tracking SDG 7: Umbiko Wenqubekelaphambili Yamandla uxwayisa ngokuthi imizamo yamanje ayanele ukufeza iSDG 7 ngesikhathi. Kube nenqubekelaphambili ethile ezintweni ezithile ze-ajenda yeSDG 7 - isibonelo, izinga elikhuphukile lokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo emkhakheni wamandla kagesi - kodwa inqubekelaphambili ayanele ukufinyelela imigomo ebekwe kumaSDG. Inkinga yamandla omhlaba kulindeleke ukuthi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo futhi ithuthukise ukusebenza kahle kwamandla ngezinqubomgomo eziningana zikahulumeni ezikhomba ekwandeni kokutshalwa kwezimali.

Izwe ngalinye linendlela ehlukile yokuthola i-UHC futhi linqume ukuthi lizohlanganisa ini ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zabantu balo kanye nezinsiza ezikhona. Ukutshala imali kuPHC kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke lezo zidingo ziyabonakala, zibekwa eqhulwini futhi zibhekelelwa ngendlela ehlanganisiwe; ukuthi kunabasebenzi bezempilo abaqinile nabahlomile; nokuthi yonke imikhakha yomphakathi inikela ekubhekaneni nezici zemvelo kanye nezenhlalo-mnotho ezithinta impilo kanye nenhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela, ukusabela kanye nokululama ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Impendulo yeWHO: Njengesisekelo se-UHC, iWHO incoma ukuqondisa kabusha izinhlelo zezempilo kusetshenziswa indlela yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo (PHC). Ukuthola i-UHC kuyinto ehamba phambili yeWHO, ngenhloso yokuthi abantu abengeziwe abayisigidigidi bayazuza ekufinyeleleni kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke ngo-2025. Emazweni anezinhlelo zezempilo ezibuthaka, sigxila ekusizeni kwezobuchwepheshe ukwakha izikhungo zikazwelonke kanye nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ukuze kugcwaliswe izikhala ezibucayi ezimweni eziphuthumayo.

Lona unyaka wesine womkhosi wamafilimu futhi umncintiswano wawunamandla, njengoba amafilimu angama-93 ahlelwe ahlanganisa izinkinga ezisukela ekukhathazekeni kanye nengcindezi kuya emiphumeleni yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu empilweni, kanye nezinselele zezempilo zabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. Amafilimu ahlulelwe yiphaneli labachwepheshe abavelele, abaculi kanye nezishoshovu, okuhlanganisa abalingisi abadumile, uSharon Stone no-Alfonso Herrera, umdansi we-choreographer, uSherrie Silver, isishoshovu sesimo sezulu, uSophia Kianni kanye nomuntu wezindaba, u-Adelle Onyango. Bajoyina izikhulu eziphezulu zeNhlangano Yezizwe kanye nabasebenzi beWHO. "Umkhosi Wefilimu Wempilo Yabo Bonke uletha ubuso bomuntu emsebenzini wesayensi weWHO," kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ukulalela amazwi abantu abathintwe yizinkinga zempilo kuyindlela enamandla yokuqwashisa nokuthuthukisa ukuqonda kwethu okuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu futhi lokhu kungasisiza ukuthi siqhubekele phambili empilweni yabo bonke."

Iziqhingi ezincane zivumelana nohlelo olunesibindi lokwenza ngezifo ezingathathelani kanye nempilo yengqondo Namuhla, kwethulwa iSimemezelo saseBridgetown sika-2023 ngeZifo ezingathathelani (amaNCD) kanye neMpilo Yengqondo, ukubhekana nezifo ezibulala kakhulu emhlabeni eziZiqhingini Ezincane Ezithuthukayo (amaSIDS), ezisengozini ikakhulukazi. Isimemezelo siwumphumela obalulekile weNgqungquthela yoNgqongqoshe beSIDS ngeZifo ezingathathelani (amaNCD) kanye neMpilo Yengqondo, eqala ngomhlaka-14 kuya ku-16 kuNhlangulana, ehlanganiswa yiNhlangano yeZempilo yoMhlaba (WHO), iPan American Health Organization (PAHO) kanye noHulumeni waseBarbados. AmaSIDS athinteka ngokungenakulinganiswa ngamaNCD - abangela u-74% wabo bonke abashona emhlabeni wonke - ngenxa yokuncika kwabo ekudleni okuthengwa kwamanye amazwe, amathonya ezentengiselwano kanye nenkinga yesimo sezulu. Umbiko omusha weWHO ubonisa ukuthi amazwe angu-8 kwangu-15 anobungozi obungaphezu kuka-30% wokushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngenxa yezifo zenhliziyo, umdlavuza, isifo sikashukela, noma isifo sokuphefumula esingamahlalakhona yiSIDS.

Lokhu kuphezulu kunokuthuthuka okungu-1.2% kusukela emashumini eminyaka adlule. Nokho, izinga lokuthuthuka kwamandla kagesi liye lehla eminyakeni yamuva futhi lehla laya ku-0.6% ngo-2020. Lokhu kwenza kube unyaka omubi kakhulu wokuthuthuka kwamandla kagesi kusukela enkingeni yezimali yomhlaba wonke, nakuba kungenxa yemikhawulo ehlobene nobhubhane, engase ikhombise ukubuyela emuva kwesikhashana kuphela. Ukuthuthuka konyaka kuze kube ngu-2030 kufanele manje kube ngokwesilinganiso esingu-3.4% ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nomgomo weSDG 7.3. Ukugeleza kwezimali zomphakathi zamazwe angaphandle ekusekeleni amandla ahlanzekile emazweni asathuthuka kuma-US$ 10.8 billion ngo-2021, okungaphansi ngo-35% kunesilinganiso sika-2010-2019 futhi cishe u-40% kuphela we-2017 peak ye-US$ 26.4 billion. Ngo-2021, amazwe angu-19 athola u-80% wezibopho. Lo mbiko uzokwethulwa kubenzi bezinqumo abaphezulu emcimbini okwethulwa ngawo okukhethekile ngomhla ziyi-11 kuNtulikazi 2023 eHigh-Level Political Forum (HLPF) kuSustainable Development, ngaphambi kwe-SDG Summit yesibili ngoMandulo 2023 eNew York.

Imiphumela yocwaningo olusha ikhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo ziqala ukululama kulolu bhubhane Ngemva kweminyaka emithathu yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni seziqalile ukukhombisa izimpawu zokuqala ezinkulu zokululama kohlelo lwezempilo, ngokombiko wesikhashana weWHO "ngomzuliswano wesine wocwaningo lokushaya kwenhliziyo emhlabeni wonke ngokuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19: Novemba 2022-Januwari 2023". Ngasekuqaleni kuka-2023, amazwe abike ukuthi abhekana nokuphazamiseka okuncishisiwe ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezijwayelekile, kodwa agqamisa isidingo sokutshala imali ekululameni nasekuqineni okuqinile kwesikhathi esizayo. Phakathi kwamazwe ayi-139 aphendule emzuliswaneni wesine wocwaningo lwe-pulse lweWHO, amazwe abike ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo cishe engxenyeni eyodwa kwezine yezinsizakalo ngokwesilinganiso. Emazweni angama-84 lapho ukuhlaziywa kwethrendi kungenzeka khona, amaphesenti ezinsizakalo eziphazamisekile ehle ngesilinganiso sisuka ku-56% ngoNtulikwesithuna kuya ku-23% ngoLwezi 2022-Januwari 2023.

I-WHO, Amazwe Angamalungu, kanye nabalingani basebenza ngokubambisana ukuze babone futhi basebenzise izinyathelo eziza kuqala ukuze baqinise ukuzilungiselela kukazwelonke, esifundeni, nasemhlabeni wonke ngobhubhane kanye nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo ezisafufusa. Siyaqaphela indima yemiphakathi nayo yonke imikhakha, kanye nesidingo sokuvumelanisa kanye nokugqugquzela okusimeme ukuze kuqedwe umjikelezo wokwethuka nokunganakwa okuvame kakhulu ekulungeleni ubhubhane kanye nasekuphenduleni. Sikhumbula izifundo ezivela ezifweni eziwumshayabhuqe nezifo eziwubhubhane ezidlule, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibangelwa amagciwane okuphefumula. Lawa magciwane aye aqhubeka futhi azoqhubeka nokuba yingozi enkulu emhlabeni wonke ngamandla okubangela ukugula okukhulu kanye nokushona kwabantu, ukudlula kwezinhlelo zezempilo, ukuphazamisa umnotho womhlaba, kanye nokwandisa ukungalingani, okukhona ekufinyeleleni kokubili amathuluzi okuvimbela ubhubhane kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabo bonke abantu. Lokhu Kucela Isinyathelo sokusheshisa ukulungela ubhubhane kanye nezinsongo ezivelayo emhlabeni jikelele.

Indlela yokusetshenziswa iyahluka kakhulu emazweni anengcebo efanayo; ayihambisani nesidingo sezokwelapha, njengoba kukhonjisiwe inani elilinganisiwe lezinsuku abantu abazwa ubuhlungu noma abaphethwe ukuphelelwa umoya okunzima kubantu abanezifo ezingalapheki. Le datha iyavumelana neLancet Commission yowezi-2018 echaze ukuntuleka kokuthola imithi yokudambisa izinhlungu ‘njengenye yezinto ezimbi kakhulu, ukungalingani okufihliwe kwezempilo yomhlaba’ ngama-10% acebe kakhulu amazwe ane-90% yama-opioid ahlukanisiwe afana ne-morphine. “Ukushiya abantu bezwa ubuhlungu lapho imithi esebenza ngendlela efanele itholakala ekulawuleni izinhlungu, ikakhulukazi esimweni sokunakekelwa kokuphela kokuphila, kufanele kube yimbangela yokukhathazeka okukhulu kwabenzi benqubomgomo,” kusho uDkt Yukiko Nakatani, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO Wezemithi Nemikhiqizo Yezempilo. “Kufanele sikhulume ngokuphuthumayo ngokufinyelela okuphephile nangesikhathi ku-morphine kulabo abadinga usizo lwezokwelapha ngenqubomgomo elinganayo, yonke indawo.”

Lezi zimali zisekela ukusebenza kweHub eNingizimu Afrika kanye nabalingani benethiwekhi emhlabeni jikelele. Sikholelwa ngokuqinile ekubalulekeni kokwakha amandla ezingeni lendawo kanye nesifunda. "UMartin Seychell, iPhini loMqondisi Omkhulu we-European Commission, uthe. "I-EC isivele inikele ngezigidi ezingama-€40 ekusungulweni kweHub yokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA futhi isanda kusayina esinye isibonelelo ne-EIB sezigidi eziyi-€15,5 ukuze kube lula ukwandiswa kwamandla okukhiqiza imithi yokugoma. Lokhu kuyingxenye yokutshalwa kwezimali okuphelele ngaphansi kwesu le-EU Global Gateway, lapho ngaphezu kwe-€1 Billion iqoqwe ngaphansi kweTeam Europe Initiative on Manufacturing health products. Manje sekubaluleke kakhulu ukubhekana nezingqinamba ezingase zibe khona zokulawula kanye nezidingo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukhiqizwa imithi yokugoma esezingeni eliphakeme kakhulu kuzo zonke izifunda zomhlaba, kodwa futhi nokufinyelela okusheshayo nokulinganayo kuleyo mithi yokugoma. "

Ukusetshenziswa kwebiomass yendabuko kusho nokuthi amakhaya asebenzisa amahora afinyelela kwangu-40 ngesonto eqoqa izinkuni zokubasa nokupheka, okuvimbela abesifazane ukuthi bafune umsebenzi noma babambe iqhaza ezinhlanganweni zokuthatha izinqumo zendawo kanye nezingane ukuthi ziye esikoleni. Ngokwezilinganiso zeWHO zango-2019, ukushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwezigidi ezingu-3.2 unyaka ngamunye kwakubangelwa ukunukubezwa komoya kwasekhaya okwenziwa ngokusebenzisa amafutha anukubezayo kanye nobuchwepheshe bokupheka. Ukusetshenziswa kukagesi ovuselelekayo ekusetshenzisweni komhlaba wonke kukhule kusuka ku-26.3% ngo-2019 kuya ku-28.2% ngo-2020, ukwanda okukhulu konyaka owodwa kusukela ekuqaleni kokulandelela inqubekelaphambili yamaSDG. Imizamo yokwandisa isabelo samandla avuselelekayo ekushiseni nasekuthuthweni, okumelela ngaphezu kwezingxenye ezintathu kwezine zokusetshenziswa kwamandla emhlabeni wonke, isala ingahlosiwe ukufeza izinhloso zesimo sezulu ze-1.5oC. Amandla kagesi - isilinganiso sokuthi umnotho womhlaba wonke usebenzisa amandla amangaki ngedola ngalinye le-GDP - sithuthukiswe kusuka ku-2010-2020 ngo-1.8% minyaka yonke.

Bonke abahambi kufanele balungiselele izinhlobonhlobo zezingozi zempilo abangase babhekane nazo ezindaweni abangazijwayele ngaphambi, ngesikhathi nangemva kokuhamba. Abantu abahlela ukuhamba kufanele bafune iseluleko ngezingozi ezingaba khona ezindaweni abazikhethile futhi baqonde indlela engcono kakhulu yokuvikela impilo yabo futhi banciphise ingozi yokuthola izifo. Ukuhlela kusengaphambili, izinyathelo zokuvimbela ezifanele kanye nokunakekela kungavikela impilo yabahambi, futhi kunciphise izingozi zengozi kanye nokuthola izifo. Nakuba umsebenzi wezokwelapha kanye nomkhakha wezokuvakasha kunganikeza usizo olukhulu kanye nezeluleko ezizwakalayo, kusewumthwalo wemfanelo womhambi ukufuna ulwazi, ukuqonda izingozi ezihilelekile kanye nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokuvikela impilo yakhe ngesikhathi ehamba. Ingozi: Lapho kunqunywa izingozi zempilo zohambo lwamazwe ngamazwe, abahambi kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo kufanele bacabangele lezi zici ezibalulekile ezilandelayo:

Ukwengeza, izikhungo ezimbili ezithole umklomelo wango-2023 ziholwa ngabesifazane. Abanqobile emiklomelweni yango-2023 iSasakawa Health PrizeAbanqobi bango-2023: I-Nick Simons Institute yaseNepal, noSolwazi Vichai Tienthavorn waseThailand I-Nick Simons Institute yinhlangano engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ehlose ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya eNepal. Ukusebenzisana eduze noMnyango Wezempilo kanye Nenani Labantu laseNepal, i-Institute iqeqeshe ochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangu-7000 (njengababelethisi nabasizi bezokulala) ezindaweni zasemakhaya, manje abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yendawo ngenxa yokungabikho kweqoqo elanele labasebenzi bezokwelapha kanye nochwepheshe. Isikhungo sihanjisile imishini ebalulekile futhi sanikeza abasebenzi bezempilo abengeziwe ukuze banciphise ukuntuleka kochwepheshe bezokwelapha ezibhedlela ezingama-44, futhi sasekela ukuklanywa kohlelo lokusebenza lwezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphakeme ezibhedlela zasemakhaya ezingaphezu kwe-100.

Ngo-2019 kuphela, abantu abangama-92 622 bathola ukwelashwa ngokuhlinzwa kwe-trachoma esezingeni eliphezulu futhi abayizigidi ezingama-95.2 belashwa ngemithi elwa namagciwane. Naphezu kwale mpumelelo, lesi sifo sihlala siyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi, nesilinganiso sokulahlekelwa kwemali engama-US$ 8 billion ngonyaka ngenxa yokungaboni kanye nokuphazamiseka kokubona. Izimpawu: Ukutheleleka ngesifo kuhlotshaniswa nezinguquko zokuvuvukala ku-conjunctiva eyaziwa ngokuthi “active trachoma”. Amasosha omzimba womuntu angasusa isiqephu esisodwa sokutheleleka, kodwa emiphakathini ekhona, ukutholwa kabusha kwe-organism kwenzeka njalo. Ngemva kweminyaka yezigameko eziphindaphindwayo ze-trachoma esebenzayo, ingaphakathi le-eyelid lingaba nebalabala kakhulu (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) kangangokuthi liguquke libheke ngaphakathi futhi libangele ukuba izinhloko zamehlo zingqubuzane ne-eyeball (trachomatous trichiasis), okuholela ebuhlungwini obungapheli kanye nokungabekezelelani kokukhanya; lokhu kanye nezinye izinguquko zamehlo kungaholela ekubeni ne-trachoma.

izifo ezingathathelani njengesifo senhliziyo, unhlangothi, isifuba somoya, umdlavuza, isifo sikashukela kanye nengcindezi; kanye nobudlova kanye nokulimala, okuhlanganisa ukulimala emgwaqeni. Impendulo yeWHO: Naphezu kwezinselele zabo, amadolobha angakha amathuba ezempilo ezingcono, izindawo ezihlanzekile kanye nezenzo zesimo sezulu. Izinqubomgomo ezinamandla zasemadolobheni kufanele zibeke impilo eqhulwini, njengoba kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuphila zasemadolobheni ezinhle, ukwakha abasebenzi abakhiqizayo, ukudala imiphakathi eqinile futhi ekhuthele, ukuvumela ukuhamba, ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana nomphakathi kanye nokuvikela abantu abasengozini. Indlela yeWHO ngokuphathelene nempilo yasemadolobheni igxile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lomoya, amanzi kanye nokuthuthwa kwendle, kanye nezinye izinto ezinquma imvelo; ukuhlela okuhle kwasemadolobheni; izindawo ezinempilo kanye nezingabhemi; ukuhamba okuphephile kanye nokunempilo; ukuvimbela ubudlova kanye nokulimala; ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokudla okunempilo kanye nokudla; ukuphathwa kwemvelo kwezifo ezithwalwa yizilwane ezincela igazi; kanye nokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo zasemadolobheni.

Nge-cysticercosis, isikhathi sokufukamela siyahlukahluka, futhi abantu abanaleli gciwane bangase bahlale bengenazimpawu iminyaka. Kwezinye izifunda ezitholakala kakhulu, abantu abanaleli gciwane bangase babe nama-nodules abonakalayo noma abonakalayo (isibazi esincane esiqinile noma i-node eqinile engatholakala ngokuthinta) ngaphansi kwesikhumba. I-Neurocysticercosis ihlotshaniswa nezimpawu ezihlukahlukene kuye ngenani, ubukhulu, isigaba kanye nendawo yezinguquko zokugula kanye nokusabela kwamasosha omzimba kanye nohlobo lwezinto eziphilayo, kodwa futhi kungaba ngaphandle kwezimpawu zokwelapha. Izimpawu zingase zihlanganise ukuphathwa ikhanda okungamahlalakhona, ubumpumputhe, ukuquleka (isithuthwane uma siphindaphindeka), i-hydrocephalus, imeningitis, ukuwohloka kwengqondo kanye nezimpawu ezibangelwa izilonda ezithatha izikhala zesimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko. Ukwelashwa: Ukwelashwa kwe-taeniasis ngeTaenia solium kubalulekile ukuvimbela i-neurocysticercosis futhi njengethuluzi lokusiza ekulawuleni noma ekumiseni umjikelezo wokudluliselwa kwe-parasite.

Le protocol, esebenza kuzo zonke izilungiselelo zezinsiza, isiza ukuvala igebe lokulingana kwezempilo ekunakekelweni komama nezingane. Ngokubambisana nohulumeni kazwelonke wasePhilippines kanye namazwe ayi-17 eWHO Western Pacific Region, uye wadlala indima ebalulekile ekukhuliseni umkhankaso we-First Embrace we-Early Essential Newborn Care - iqoqo lokungenelela okulula okunconywe yiWHO futhi okungabizi.
