Isiqu sakhe esiphakeme uSheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah Umklomelo Wocwaningo Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Kwabadala kanye Nokukhuthazwa Kwezempilo 2023 abawine umklomelo: Isikhungo Sikazwelonke Sokulawula Nokuvimbela Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona Nezingathathelwana esivela eChina; kanye noDkt Abla Mehio Sibai waseLebanon Isikhungo Sikazwelonke Sokulawula Nokuvimbela Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona Nezingathathelwana, ingxenye yeChinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC), isingathe umnyango ogxile empilweni yabantu asebekhulile kusukela ngo-2013.

I-WHO izoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa isiqondiso ngezifo ezithile njengoba kudingeka. Ukwethulwa kwesinyathelo kwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lwemihlangano nabantu abangaphezu kuka-120 abamele Amazwe Angamalungu, abalingani, kanye nonobhala weWHO, ukuze kuchazwe indlela eya phambili yePRET, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa kwemephu yomhlaba wonke yokuqeqeshelwa ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula. Imodyuli yokuqala yePRET Initiative igxile ezifweni zokuphefumula, okuhlanganisa umkhuhlane, amavayirasi e-corona, kanye negciwane le-respiratory syncytial. Ngenxa yobhubhane oluqhubekayo lweCOVID-19 kanye nosongo olungaba khona lomkhuhlane wezinyoni, le modyuli izovumela amazwe ukuthi abuyekeze ngokucophelela, ahlolisise, futhi avuselele imizamo yawo yokuhlela ubhubhane lokuphefumula ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi anamandla okusebenza kanye namakhono akhona. Inqubo iyaqhubeka ukuze kutholakale iqembu elilandelayo lamagciwane, njengama-arboviruses, okuzobhekelelwa ngaphansi kwalesi sinyathelo.

Ngaphezu kwethalente lakhe eliphawulekayo lokucula, uFleming ubengummeli oshisekayo wocwaningo lapho kuhlangana khona ubuciko kanye nezempilo. Izethulo zakhe emhlabeni wonke nososayensi kanye nabasebenzi, indima yakhe ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni ezinkulu, kanye nokuxhumana kwakhe neWHO kubonisa ukuzibophezela kwakhe ekusebenziseni amandla aguqulayo ezobuciko emphakathini ongcono. "Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthi i-ejensi yezempilo ehamba phambili emhlabeni wonke ibona umthelela onamandla wezobuciko kwezempilo, futhi ngizizwa ngihlonipheke kakhulu ukuthi ngiphathiswe ukwabelana ngalo mlayezo," kusho uFleming. "Nsuku zonke, intuthuko kwezesayensi yezinzwa kanye nocwaningo lwezokwelapha yembula okwengeziwe ngezinzuzo zokwelapha ngobuciko, okuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nemfundo, okunomthelela enhlalakahleni kukho konke ukuphila komuntu. Kodwa-ke, sisanda kuqala ukuqaphela amandla amangalisayo alo msebenzi, futhi ngibheke phambili ekwandiseni ukuqwashisa kanye nokufinyelela njengeNxusa Lenhlalakahle leWHO.

Njengoba esekhuthaze ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekunakekelweni kwezibhedlela iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20, uDkt Jorge Francisco Meneses wasungula amakomidi asekelwe emphakathini agxile ekuphepheni nasekwanelisekeni kweziguli, imindeni yazo kanye nomphakathi. Ngenxa yomthelela omuhle womsebenzi wakhe ekuthuthukiseni ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kweziguli, imodeli yokunakekelwa kokuziphatha nokugxile ezigulini ayiyiklame yakhuliswa ezingeni likazwelonke. Namuhla, njengomqondisi kazwelonke wezibhedlela zaseGuatemala, usungule uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo zeziguli zesibhedlela kanye nemindeni yazo. UDkt Meneses usanda kuhlanganisa iphrojekthi yokuhlola entsha eGuatemala South Health Area ukuze kwakhiwe inethiwekhi yokuqala ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zezempilo, egxile kakhulu emiphakathini engakhonzwa kahle. Umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekwamukelweni kwesu likazwelonke lwamanethiwekhi ezinsizakalo zezempilo ahlanganisiwe, okokuqala eMelika Ephakathi.

Le Ngqungquthela yoNgqongqoshe iza ngesikhathi esiyingqayizivele futhi izoba ngukhiye wokukhulisa izwi nezidingo zeSIDS, ukuletha amaNCD kanye nempilo yengqondo phambili ohlwini lwethu olubalulekile, kusho uDkt Jarbas Barbosa, uMqondisi wePAHO, noMqondisi Wesifunda weWHO waseMelika. "Ukuze sakhe kulo mzamo, kufanele senze manje. I-PAHO isilungele ukusekela ukuqaliswa okusheshayo kokungenelela esifundeni sethu, okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwalezi zimo ezinsizeni zezempilo eziyinhloko kanye nokusebenzisa izinto ezintsha ezifana namathuluzi ezempilo edijithali." Amazwe eSIDS anerekhodi lokushayela ukuthatha izinqumo emhlabeni jikelele; iPort of Spain kanye nezivumelwano zomzila weSAMOA zavula indlela yesimemezelo sokuqala sezepolitiki se-UN ngamaNCD ngo-2018. Ingqungquthela kanye neSimemezelo kuzokwazisa futhi kubumbe Imihlangano Yezinga Eliphezulu Yomhlangano Jikelele we-UN ezayo mayelana nokukhavwa kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke ngoMandulo wezi-2023 kanye namaNCD ngo-2025.

Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 kanye nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zikhombisile ukuthi amazwe kudingeka azilungiselele ukubhekana nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo, anezinhlelo zokuzilungiselela ezilungiselelwe futhi nokuxhumana okungcono nokubambisana neminye imikhakha efana nezolimo. "Ukulungela, ukuvimbela, kanye nemisebenzi yokusabela akumele kube yisifundazwe somkhakha wezempilo kuphela," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. "Njengoba nje izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zinomthelela emikhakheni eminingi, kufanele futhi ukulungela kwethu kanye nemizamo yokusabela ihlanganise imikhakha, imikhakha kanye nezifo ezibangela izifo. Kubalulekile futhi, ukuthi ukubandakanyeka komphakathi kanye nokulingana kube yisizinda semizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi kulabo bantu ababekwe eceleni futhi abasengozini enkulu." I-PRET iwukuguquka kwendlela yeWHO yokulungela ubhubhane ngokusebenzisa indlela yokudlulisela ilensi, kunokugxila ezifweni ezithile.

Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-Wellcome ngo-2013 uDkt Farrar wachitha iminyaka eyi-17 njengoMqondisi weClinical Research Unit eSibhedlela seZifo zaseTropical eVietnam lapho izithakazelo zakhe zocwaningo zazikwezempilo yomhlaba wonke ngokugxila ezifweni ezithathelwanayo ezisafufusa. UDkt Farrar ungumcwaningi wezokwelapha oneziqu zobudokotela kanye nePhD. UDkt Ailan Li uzoba nguMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Universal Health Coverage, Healthier Populations kusukela ngomhlaka-8 kuNhlaba 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Li uzobheka imizamo yeNhlangano yokukhuthaza impilo engcono kanye nenhlalakahle ngokungenelela okuhlobene nezimo zemvelo, ezenhlalo, kanye nezomnotho zezempilo, okuhlanganisa ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukulawulwa kukagwayi, ukuphepha kwamakhemikhali, ukuphepha emgwaqeni, izinhlelo zokudla kanye nokudla okunomsoco, ukuvocavoca umzimba, ukunukubezeka komoya kanye nemisebe, ngendlela ye-One Health. UDkt Li ubesebenza njengoMmeleli weWHO eMbusweni waseCambodia kusukela ngomhlaka-15 kuNtulikazi 2019.

Ukuphathwa kabi kwezingane kunemiphumela emikhulu ngokushesha kanye nangesikhathi eside. Ngaphezu kokufa, ukulimala ngokomzimba kanye nokukhubazeka, ubudlova bungaholela ekucindezelekeni okuphazamisa ukukhula kobuchopho futhi kulimaze izinhlelo zezinzwa kanye nezokuzivikela komzimba. Lokhu nakho kuhlotshaniswa nokubambezeleka kokukhula kwengqondo, ukungasebenzi kahle esikoleni kanye nokuyeka isikole, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, imizamo yokuzibulala, ukwanda kokuziphatha okuyingozi empilweni, ukuphinde uhlukunyezwe kanye nokwenziwa kobudlova. Izindaba ezinhle ukuthi ukuphathwa kabi kwezingane kungavinjelwa ngokungenelela okusekela abazali kanye nabanakekeli, ukukhuthaza izindinganiso kanye namagugu okungabi nodlame, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono okuphila, ukuqinisa imali engenayo yemindeni kanye nokuvikeleka kwezomnotho, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphendula ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nokweseka, ukudala nokugcina izindawo eziphephile zezingane, kanye nokusebenzisa kanye nokuphoqelela imithetho emelene nokuphathwa kabi kwezingane. I-WHO, ngokubambisana nabalingani abaningana:

Isibonelo, imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eluhlaza ingakhiqiza izinzuzo zezempilo zesiguli kanye nezisebenzi ngesikhathi futhi isindisa amandla, inciphisa izingozi zesimo sezulu futhi idale ukonga izindleko zesikhathi eside. Inhlangano yeZempilo yoMhlaba izibophezele ekuphishekeleni intuthuko esimeme kuwo wonke umsebenzi wayo wokusiza ukuvikela abantu bakusasa ezingozini zezempilo ezikhulayo zanamuhla. Umthelela: Amasu amaningi entuthuko esimeme anganikeza ukunqoba okuphawulekayo kwezempilo, isimo sezulu kanye nemvelo, futhi izinzuzo zingabonakala cishe ngokushesha. Isibonelo, imigomo eminingi yezempilo kanye nentuthuko ingafinyelelwa ngasikhathi sinye ngokubhekana nokunukubezeka komoya, okubangela ukufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi okulinganiselwa ezigidini eziyi-7 minyaka yonke. Okukhishwa okunukubeza umoya kuhlanganisa izinto ezinamandla ezingcolisa isimo sezulu ezihlala isikhashana (amaSLCP) - ikakhulukazi ikhabhoni emnyama, i-ozone kanye ne-methane - eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni kodwa ezinesikhathi esifushane sokuphila emkhathini.

"Ukubambisana komhlaba wonke ekubhekweni kwezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane sekubucayi njengoba umhlaba ulwa neCOVID-19 ndawonye," kusho uDkt Rajiv J. Shah, uMongameli weRockefeller Foundation. "IPSN yakhela kulokhu okwenzekile ngokwakha isiteji esiqinile sabalingani kuyo yonke imikhakha kanye nemingcele ukuze babelane ngolwazi, amathuluzi, kanye nemikhuba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuvimbela ubhubhane kanye nokusabela kuyinto entsha futhi iqinile esikhathini esizayo." Naphezu kokukhuphuka kwakamuva emandleni e-genomics emazweni ngenxa yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, abaningi basaswele izinhlelo ezisebenza ngendlela efanele zokuqoqa nokuhlaziya amasampula noma ukusebenzisa leyo mininingo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokwenza izinqumo zezempilo yomphakathi. Akukho ukwabelana okwanele kwemininingo, imikhuba, kanye nezinto ezintsha zokwakha ukubhekwa kwezempilo yomhlaba wonke okuqinile. Izabelomali ezinyuke ngesikhathi sobhubhane, ezivumela ukwakhiwa okusheshayo kwamakhono, manje ziyancishiswa, ngisho nasemazweni acebe kakhulu.

Isu libeka umbono ocacile: ngo-2030, wonke umuntu ofinyelela noma ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo uphephile ezifweni ezihlobene. Izinhloso zalo ezintathu ezibalulekile yilezi: ukuvimbela ukutheleleka ekunakekelweni kwezempilo; ukwenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-IPC zikhona futhi ziyasetshenziswa; nokuxhumanisa imisebenzi ye-IPC nezinye izindawo kanye nemikhakha. Isu ligxile kunoma yikuphi ukusetha lapho ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kunikezwa khona, kulo lonke uhlelo lwezempilo; kusekelwe esimisweni sokunakekelwa okuhlanzekile nokuphephile njengengxenye ebalulekile yelungelo lezempilo, eliqhutshwa ngokulingana, futhi okufanele liqinisekise ukuziphendulela kanye nokusimama. Isu le-IPC lomhlaba wonke lizokwengezwa, futhi lisetshenziswe ngokuhlanganyela, nohlelo lokusebenza oluhlobene lomhlaba wonke kanye nohlaka lokuqapha, oluzokwakhiwa ngo-2023-2024. Idokhumenti ehlobene EB152/9 - Uhlaka lwesu lomhlaba wonke mayelana nokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka, Isifinyezo se-Executive Report nguMqondisi-Jikelele

Big Tobacco - kanye nabo bonke abakhiqizi bemikhiqizo kagwayi - balwela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingozi zemikhiqizo yabo ziyafihlwa, kodwa nathi siyalwa: Ngo-2003, iWHO Member States yamukela ngazwi linye iWHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC), okuwukuphela kwesivumelwano sezempilo yomphakathi ngaphansi kokuqondisa kweWHO. Isebenza kusukela ngo-2005, njengamanje inamaQembu ayi-181. Ukusiza amazwe ukuthi asebenzise iWHO FCTC, iWHO yethule iMPOWER, iphakheji yezinyathelo zobuchwepheshe nezinsiza, ngayinye yazo ehambisana okungenani nesimiso esisodwa seWHO FCTC. I-MPOWER yakha amandla amazwe okusebenzisa izinyathelo eziyi-6 zokunciphisa ukufunwa kwemikhiqizo kagwayi: ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi kanye nezinqubomgomo zokuvimbela, ukuvikela abantu ekusebenziseni ugwayi, ukunikeza usizo lokuyeka ukubhema ugwayi, ukuxwayisa ngezingozi zikagwayi, ukuphoqelela ukuvinjelwa kokukhangisa ngogwayi, ukukhuthaza kanye nokuxhaswa kanye nokwenyusa izintela zikagwayi.

I-WHO yethula isinyathelo esisha sokuthuthukisa ukulungela ubhubhane Ukuze isize amazwe alungiselele kangcono ubhubhane oluzayo, iWHO yethule isinyathelo esisha namuhla esinikeza isiqondiso ekuhleleni okuhlanganisiwe sokusabela kunoma iyiphi i-pathogen yokuphefumula efana nomkhuhlane noma ama-coronavirus. I-Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats Initiative, noma i-PRET, ihlanganisa amathuluzi akamuva nezindlela zokufunda okwabelwana ngakho kanye nezenzo ezihlangene ezasungulwa ngesikhathi sobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kanye nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zomphakathi zakamuva. Ngesinyathelo, i-WHO izosebenzisa indlela yokudlulisela indlela yokuqondisa amazwe ekuhleleni ubhubhane, uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi amandla amaningi namakhono ajwayelekile phakathi kwamaqembu ezinto ezibangela izifo. I-PRET iphendula isicelo sesiqondiso sobuchwepheshe nokusekelwa kokukhuthaza nokuqinisa ukulungela nokusabela okuhlanganisiwe, njengoba kuboniswe ezinqumweni zoMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba.

UProfesa Piot uphinde wadlala indima ekutholakaleni kwegciwane le-Ebola, kanye nasekuvimbeleni ukuqubuka kokuqala okwaziwayo, ebambe iqhaza ekuphenyweni kwezifo. Ube ngusihlalo wezinhlelo eziningi ezisezingeni eliphezulu, wasebenza ezikhundleni eziningi zokweluleka ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlanganisa neCOVID-19, futhi uthole imiklomelo eminingi. UProfesa Piot unguMeluleki Okhethekile kuMongameli we-EC, uSolwazi weZempilo yoMhlaba Wonke kanye noMqondisi wangaphambili weLondon School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. "Laba bantu abavelele bafanekisela ukuzinikela impilo yonke, ukumela okungapheli, ukuzibophezela ekulinganeni, kanye nenkonzo engenabugovu yesintu kanye nempilo yabantu," kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ngesikhathi sezimo eziphuthumayo eziningi, izinkinga zezempilo, kanye nezingxabano, siyaqaphela ukuthi ubuholi kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye nesayensi bubaluleke kakhulu kunanini ngaphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomhlaba.

Ngesikhathi esifanayo amahektha angaphezu kwezigidi ezi-3 omhlaba emazweni angaphezu kwe-120 asetshenziselwa ukutshala ugwayi obulalayo, ngisho nasemazweni lapho abantu belambile khona. Umbiko omusha weWHO, othi “Khulisa ukudla, hhayi ugwayi,” uqokomisa ububi bokutshala ugwayi kanye nezinzuzo zokushintshela ezitshalweni zokudla ezisimeme kakhudlwana kubalimi, imiphakathi, umnotho, imvelo, kanye nomhlaba wonke. Lo mbiko uphinde uveze imboni kagwayi ngokubamba abalimi emjikelezweni omubi wesikweletu, ukukhulisa ugwayi ngokweqisa izinzuzo zawo zezomnotho kanye nokunxenxa amaqembu angaphambili ezolimo. Ukulima ugwayi kubangela izifo kubalimi ngokwabo futhi abasebenzi abangaphezu kwesigidi besilinganiselwa ekutheni basebenza emapulazini kagwayi, belahlekelwa ithuba labo lemfundo. “Ugwayi awusona nje usongo olukhulu lokuntuleka kokudla, kodwa impilo iyonke, kuhlanganise nempilo yabalimi bakagwayi.

Singathanda ukuveza izigaba ezintathu ezinkulu zezinto ezifeziwe: Okokuqala, ucwaningo oluseqophelweni eliphezulu olwenziwe yiHRP lube nomthelela obonakalayo kunqubomgomo yezempilo yomphakathi, izindinganiso, kanye nokwenza emhlabeni wonke ukubhekana nezidingo eziguqukayo zabantu abahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, iHRP, ikakhulukazi ngeHRP Alliance, iqinise izikhungo zocwaningo endaweni kanye nasemhlabeni wonke, futhi, yenza abacwaningi abaningi ukuthi bathole amakhono ocwaningo aqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lweSRHR oluseqophelweni eliphezulu lungaqhubeka, futhi lube lukhulu, esikhathini esizayo. Okwesithathu, emhlabeni ogcwele izinkinga, izingxabano kanye nokwanda kokumelana nokulingana ngokobulili, iHRP yenze kwaba lula ukugcinwa kwamalungelo ayisisekelo abesifazane kanye namantombazane kanye nabantu abasengozini. IHRP isalokhu iyithuluzi eliyinhloko ohlelweni lweZizwe Ezihlangene locwaningo ngokuphathelene nokuzala kwabantu futhi iyaqhubeka nokuba umholi ovelele kwezempilo yezocansi kanye nokuzala emhlabeni wonke.

UDkt Jérôme Salomon uzoba nguMqondisi Jikelele Wokufinyelela Kwezempilo Emhlabeni Wonke, Izifo Ezithathelanayo Nezingathathelani kusukela ngomhlaka-17 kuMbasa wezi-2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Salomon uzobheka iphothifoliyo ebanzi yezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezihlanganisa iHIV, i-viral hepatitis, izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, isifo sofuba, umalaleveva, izifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo, impilo yengqondo, ukuphazamiseka kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa, kanye nezifo ezingathathelani njengesifo senhliziyo nemithambo yegazi, isifo sikashukela, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zokuphefumula kanye nomdlavuza. UDkt Salomon ubesebenza njengoMqondisi Jikelele Wezempilo eMnyangweni Wezempilo Nokuvimbela waseFrance. WayeyiLungu leBhodi Eliphethe leWHO ngaphambi kokuqokwa kwakhe futhi unolwazi oluningi ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zezempilo, izifo ezithathelanayo kanye nezempilo yomphakathi yamazwe ngamazwe. UDkt Salomon uneziqu zobudokotela, iziqu ze-master kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye ne-PhD ku-epidemiology.

Imikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe Uhlolojikelele: Abantu abangaba yizigidigidi ezimbili emhlabeni wonke abakwazi ukuthola imithi edingekayo, imigomo, imishini yezokwelapha okuhlanganisa ukuxilongwa kwe-in vitro, kanye neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo, okudala isikhala esivame ukugcwaliswa yimikhiqizo esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe. Le nkinga iyakhula njengoba amaketanga okuhlinzeka emhlabeni wonke eba yinkimbinkimbi ngokwengeziwe, okusho ukuthi imikhiqizo ekhiqizwa ezweni elilodwa ingase ifakwe ezweni lesibili futhi isatshalaliswe emingceleni ukuze idayiswe noma ithengiselwe abathengi ezweni lesithathu. Ukukhula kwe-e-commerce nakho kunomthelela kulokhu kuthambekela ngokwenza kube lula ukuthenga imithi ku-inthanethi, ngokuvamile evela emithonjeni engagunyaziwe. I-WHO ikhombe le nkinga njengenye yezinselele zezempilo eziphuthumayo eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi imithi engaphezu kweyodwa kweyishumi emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi kanye naphakathi nendawo ilinganiselwa ekutheni ingekho ezingeni eliphansi noma ingeyamanga.

“Kumele sivikele isizukulwane esilandelayo ngokwenza manje. Ukutshala imali ezixazululweni ezihlanzekile nezivuselelekayo ukuze kusekelwe ukufinyelela kwamandla emhlabeni wonke kuyindlela esingenza ngayo ushintsho lwangempela. Ubuchwepheshe bokupheka obuhlanzekile emakhaya kanye nogesi onokwethenjelwa ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo kungadlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni impilo yabantu bethu abasengozini enkulu. " UDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, iWorld Health Organization Mayelana nombiko Lo mbiko ushicilelwe ama-ejensi agadile eSDG 7, i-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iWorld Bank, kanye neWorld Health Organization (WHO) futhi ihlose ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wamazwe ngamazwe ngedeshibhodi yomhlaba wonke yokubhalisa inqubekelaphambili ekufinyeleleni amandla, ukusebenza kahle kwamandla, amandla avuselelekayo kanye nokubambisana kwamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe iSDG 7.

Nge-International Trachoma Initiative, i-antibiotic azithromycin inikelwa yi-Pfizer ezinhlelweni zokuqeda ukusebenzisa isu leSAFE. IBenin ihlanganise ukungenelela kokuqeda i-trachoma nalabo abasebenzisa ngokumelene nezinye izifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo (amaNTD), ngaphansi kwesambulela soHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezifo Ezithathelwanayo. I-Trachoma iyi-NTD yesithathu ezosuswa eBenin, ngemva kwe-dracunculiasis (ngo-2009) kanye ne-gambiense human African trypanosomiasis (ngo-2021). IMali yenze ucwaningo lomthelela we-trachoma kanye nokubhekwa futhi yakhipha ukungenelela ukuze kuzuzwe imigomo yokuqeda, naphezu kwezinselele zokuphepha ezifundeni ezisenyakatho yezwe kanye nezinxushunxushu zezenhlalo nezombusazwe eminyakeni yamuva. I-Trachoma iyi-NTD yokuqala ezosuswa eMali, ngakho-ke manje ijoyina iqembu lomhlaba wonke lamazwe angama-47 aseqede okungenani i-NTD eyodwa.

Ukuzinakekela kokungenelela kwezempilo Uhlolojikelele: Ukuzinakekela yikhono labantu ngabanye, imindeni kanye nemiphakathi yokuthuthukisa impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukugcina impilo, nokubhekana nokugula nokukhubazeka ngokusekelwa noma ngaphandle kosizo lwesisebenzi sezempilo. Njengamanje abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.6 - ingxenye yomhlaba - abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibalulekile. I-WHO incoma ukungenelela kokuzinakekela kuwo wonke amazwe kanye nesimo sezomnotho, njengendlela ebalulekile yokufinyelela ekukhavweni kwezempilo komhlaba wonke, ukukhuthaza impilo, ukugcina umhlaba uphephile, nokusiza abasengozini. Ukuzinakekela kuyabona abantu njengabenzeli abakhuthele ekuphatheni ukunakekelwa kwabo kwezempilo, ezindaweni ezihlanganisa ukukhuthazwa kwezempilo; ukuvimbela nokulawula izifo; ukuzelapha; ukuhlinzeka ukunakekelwa kubantu abaxhomekile, nokuvuselelwa, okuhlanganisa nokunakekelwa kwe-palliative. Ukungenelela kokuzinakekela kusekelwe ebufakazini, amathuluzi ekhwalithi asekela ukuzinakekela.

AmaNCD ̶ usongo olukhula njalo kwezempilo ezizukulwaneni ezizayo Naphezu kwenqubekelaphambili yezempilo iyonke, ingxenye yokufa okubangelwa minyaka yonke amaNCD ikhule ngokuqhubekayo futhi manje isifuna cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zazo zonke izimpilo ezilahlekile minyaka yonke. Uma lo mkhuba uqhubeka, amaNCD kulindeleke ukuthi abale cishe u-86% wokufa kwabantu abayizigidi ezingama-90 minyaka yonke maphakathi nekhulu leminyaka; ngenxa yalokho, izigidi ezingama-77 zalezi zizoba ngenxa yamaNCD - ukwanda okucishe kube ngu-90% ezinombolweni eziphelele kusukela ngo-2019. Inqubekelaphambili engenzi nhlobo idinga ukusheshiswa Izitayela zakamuva zibonisa izimpawu zokwehla kwezinga lokwehliswa konyaka (ARR) kuzinkomba eziningi. Isibonelo, isilinganiso sokushona komama emhlabeni wonke sidinga ukwehla ngo-11.6% ngonyaka phakathi kuka-2021 no-2030 ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nomgomo weSDG. Ngokufanayo, ukwehla okuphelele kwezigameko zeTB kusukela ngo-2015 kuya ku-2021 bekuyingxenye eyodwa kuphela kwezinhlanu zendlela eya kumqophelo wango-2025 we-WHO's End TB Strategy.

I-WHO ihalalisela iBenin neMali ngokuqeda i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi I-WHO iqinisekise iBenin neMali njengabaye baqeda i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi, okubenza babe amazwe amahlanu kanye nesithupha esiFundeni sase-Afrika seWHO ukufeza leli phuzu elibalulekile. Amazwe abekade ethole ukuqinisekiswa kweWHO ngokuqedwa kwe-trachoma yiGhana (ngoNhlangulana 2018), iGambia (ngoMfumfu 2021), iTogo (ngoNhlaba 2022) neMalawi (ngoMandulo 2022). “I-WHO ihalalisela iziphathimandla zezempilo zaseBenin naseMali kanye nenethiwekhi yazo yabalingani bomhlaba nabendawo ngalezi zenzakalo ezibalulekile,” kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. “Ngemva kwempumelelo yeBenin neMali, i-trachoma isalokhu igcwele emazweni angu-23 esiFundeni sase-Afrika seWHO, okusisondeza eduze nomgomo wokuqedwa kwe-trachoma obekwe kumephu yomgwaqo yezifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo 2021-2030.”

Umhlangano Wabalingani wabuye waba sekupheleni kwenqubo enkulu yokubuyekezwa kokusebenza ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezokulawula Izifo Ezinganakiwe ZaseTropical weWHO. Phakathi nezinyanga ezine ezedlule, iWHO ibilokhu izwa iminikelo kanye nobufakazi obuvela kubo bonke abalingani bayo kanye nababambiqhaza, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi yona ngokwayo ihlanganisa izindinganiso zokuziphendulela, ukubeka konke obala kanye nokulingana ekukhuthazayo kanye nokufunayo. Lezo zindinganiso zihlanganisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi amaNTD abekwa kabusha ekwakhiweni kwezempilo yomhlaba. Abahlanganyeli bomhlangano bamukele ukugcizelelwa kwezindima ezibalulekile umphakathi weNTD ongakwazi futhi kufanele udlale kuzo ekufakeni isandla ezinseleleni ezibanzi ezifana ne-Universal Health Coverage, i-One Health kanye nengcuphe ekhulayo yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izihambeli ezazikhona ngokwazo nazo zakwazi ukujabulela umbukiso ozinikele ezifweni ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo endlunkulu yeWHO.

Kamuva wasiza ekwakheni enye yezindlela zokuqala zokwelapha ngempumelelo ngokumelene negciwane kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwemithi yokugoma yokuhlola yesifo se-Ebola. Usebenze ngokungakhathali ukwakha amandla esayensi eDemocratic Republic of the Congo, esungula izikhungo eziningi zocwaningo ezweni, futhi wadlala izindima ezibalulekile neWHO ekulweni nezifo ezithathelwanayo. UProfesa Piot waseBelgium uyaqashelwa ngobuholi bakhe obungavamile ekuphenduleni ubhubhane lweHIV/AIDS kanye nezinye izinselele zezempilo ezibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Ube nendima ebalulekile ekusunguleni imizamo emikhulu yezempilo yomhlaba wonke efana ne-UNAIDS, iGlobal Fund, kanye neminye eye yathuthukisa imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni wonke. Ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe, i-UNAIDS yaba ummeli oyinhloko wezinyathelo zomhlaba wonke ngokumelene nengculazi, futhi yahola izinguquko ze-UN ngokuhlanganisa izinhlangano eziyi-10 ezahlukene ze-UN.

Ukufinyelela kugesi kanye nokupheka okuhlanzekile kusabonisa ukungalingani okukhulu kwezifunda futhi kufanele kugxilwe kuzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akekho oshiywa ngemuva. Ukutshalwa kwezimali kudingeka kufinyelele emazweni angathuthuki kakhulu kanye nase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara ukuze kuqinisekiswe inqubekelaphambili elinganayo kuNhloso 7. "UStefan Schweinfest, Umnyango Wezibalo Wezizwe Ezihlangene "Naphezu kokwehla kwakamuva kwejubane lomhlaba lokufakwa kukagesi, inani labantu abangenagesi licishe lafinyelela engxenyeni eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, lisuka ezigidini eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-1.1 ngo-2010 laya ezigidini ezingama-675 ngo-2021. Noma kunjalo, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo eyengeziwe nezinyathelo ngokuphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu kakhulu futhi okunzima ukufinyelela kubo abashiywa ngemuva. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ekufinyeleleni komhlaba wonke ngo-2030, umphakathi wentuthuko kufanele ukhuphule ukutshalwa kwezimali kwamandla ahlanzekile nokusekelwa kwenqubomgomo. "uGuangzhe Chen, iPhini Likamongameli Wezengqalasizinda, iBhange Lomhlaba

Umklomelo uhlonipha impumelelo yabo yokuphila konke kwezempilo yomphakathi. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum waseDemocratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) uqashelwa ngokusungula kwakhe, ubuholi kanye neminikelo yokuqala ekuphathweni nasekwelashweni kwezifo ezifana ne-Ebola virus disease. Ube nendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo eDemocratic Republic of the Congo, esifundeni sase-Afrika, kanye nomphakathi womhlaba wonke. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum unguMqondisi Jikelele weNational Institute of Biomedical Research yaseDRC eKinshasa, uSolwazi ophelele weMicrobiology e-University of Kinshasa Medical School kanye nomongameli wokuqala weCongolese Academy of Science. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum wayeyingxenye yethimba elathola iZaire ebolavirus ngesikhathi sokuqubuka kokuqala okurekhodiwe ngo-1976, esifundazweni sase-Equateur, eCentral DRC.

“Imikhiqizo emisha yezempilo yedijithali esathuthukiswa ihlose ukusiza abantu kuyo yonke indawo ukuthi bathole izinsiza zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngokushesha nangempumelelo.” Ngokusekelwe ku-EU Global Health Strategy kanye neWHO Global strategy kwezempilo yedijithali, lesi sinyathelo silandela isivumelwano sango-30 kuLwezi 2022 phakathi kukaKhomishana uKyriakides noDkt Tedros sokuthuthukisa ukubambisana kwamasu ezindabeni zezempilo zomhlaba. Lokhu kuqhubeka nokuqinisa uhlelo oluqinile lwamazwe amaningi neWHO enhliziyweni yalo, olunikwe amandla yi-EU enamandla. “Lobu budlelwano buyisinyathelo esibalulekile sohlelo lokusebenza lwedijithali lwe-EU Global Health Strategy. Ngokusebenzisa imikhuba emihle yaseYurophu sinikela ezindinganisweni zezempilo zedijithali kanye nokusebenzisana emhlabeni wonke ukuze kuzuze labo abadinga kakhulu. Futhi kuyisibonelo esinamandla sokuthi ukuvumelanisa phakathi kwe-EU neWHO kungaletha kanjani impilo engcono kubo bonke, e-EU nasemhlabeni wonke.

Isinqumo esisha sokusheshisa imizamo yokunezezela izakhamzimba ekudleni Izihambeli zigunyaze isinqumo sokusheshisa imizamo yokuvimbela ukushoda kwezakhamzimba ngokunezezela ukudla okuphephile nokusebenzayo. Ukushoda kwevithamini kanye nezimo zamaminerali, ikakhulukazi i-folate, i-iron, uvithamini A, kanye ne-zinc, kuthinta u-50% wazo zonke izingane ezineminyaka yobudala yangaphambi kwesikole kanye no-67% wabo bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka yobudala yokuzala emhlabeni wonke. Ukushoda kwezakhamzimba kungaba nemiphumela emibi, okuhlanganisa i-spina bifida kanye nokunye ukukhubazeka kweshubhu le-neural. Ukunezezela ukudla okukhulu kuyingxenye yesixazululo. Ngokungeza amavithamini namaminerali abalulekile ekudleni okuyisisekelo kanye nezithako ezinuka kamnandi, njengohlwayo kanye nofulawa wommbila, ilayisi, uwoyela wokupheka kanye nosawoti ngokuvumelana nezindlela zokudla zikazwelonke kanye nokushoda, amazwe angalungisa futhi aqhubeke avimbele ukushoda kwezakhamzimba okubonisiwe.

Ngaphezu komthelela omubi kagwayi empilweni, ingqikithi yezindleko zomnotho zokubhema (kusukela ezindlekweni zezempilo kanye nokulahlekelwa ukukhiqiza ndawonye) kulinganiselwa ekutheni icishe ibe ngu-US$ 1.4 trillion ngonyaka, okulingana nobukhulu obungu-1.8% womkhiqizo wasekhaya wonyaka (GDP). Cishe u-40% wale ndleko wenzeka emazweni asathuthuka, okugqamisa umthwalo omkhulu la mazwe abhekana nawo. Izintela zikagwayi zisetshenziswa ngokwengxenye ukuze kulwiwe nalomphumela futhi zibhekwa njengendlela engabizi kakhulu yokunqanda ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha kanye nabantu abahola kancane. Ukwanda kwentela okwandisa amanani kagwayi ngo-10% kwehlisa ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi cishe ngo-4% emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu kanye nango-5% emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi kanye naphakathi nendawo. Impendulo yeWHO: Isikali sale nhlekelele yabantu kanye nezomnotho siyamangaza, kodwa futhi siyagwemeka.

Emazwini akhe okuvala, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, uqaphele ukuthi “ukwanda kweminikelo ehlolwe kanye nokuqoqwa kokutshalwa kwezimali kuyingqophamlando futhi kuyingqophamlando enkulu.” Ukhulume ngonyaka ozayo, ngemihlangano esezingeni eliphezulu ekuhlinzekeni kwezempilo yonke indawo, isifo sofuba nokulungela ubhubhane kanye nokusabela kuMhlangano Jikelele we-UN walo nyaka. Ukhombe izingxoxo eziqhubekayo ngesivumelwano sobhubhane kanye nezichibiyelo zeMithethonqubo Yezempilo Yamazwe Ngamazwe njengamathuba angakaze abonwe - "izizukulwane" zokufunda emaphutheni obhubhane lweCOVID-19 nokuqinisekisa ukuthi awuphindwaphindwa. Izihambeli nazo zibe nethuba lokuzwa okuvela kwababengabasebenzi beWHO uGwen Carnelley, ogubhe iminyaka eyi-100 kulo nyaka, owaqala ukusebenza neWHO ngo-1949, unyaka nje ngemva kokusungulwa kweWHO eminyakeni engama-75 edlule. Ividiyo Yokuvalwa KoMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba Wama-76.

Izehlakalo zomlilo wasendle ziya ziba zimbi kakhulu ngokuphathelene namahektare ashisayo, ubude besikhathi kanye namandla, futhi zingaphazamisa ezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsizakalo zamandla kanye negesi. Umthelela: Imililo yamahlathi evutha eduze nezindawo ezinabantu abaningi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu endaweni ezungezile, impahla, imfuyo kanye nokufa kwabantu kanye nokugula kuncike ngosayizi, isivinini kanye nokuba seduze komlilo, nokuthi abantu banesixwayiso esithuthukisiwe yini sokuphuma. Intuthu yomlilo wasendle iyinhlanganisela yezinto ezingcolisa umoya lapho izinhlayiya (PM) ziyisongo esiyinhloko sezempilo yomphakathi. I-PM2.5 evela kumusi womlilo wasendle ihlotshaniswa nokushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubantu abavamile, futhi ingabangela futhi ibhebhethekise izifo zamaphaphu, inhliziyo, ubuchopho/uhlelo lwezinzwa, isikhumba, amathumbu, izinso, amehlo, ikhala kanye nesibindi. Kuye kwaboniswa futhi ukuthi kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwengqondo kanye nokulahlekelwa inkumbulo.

Ngaphambi kwalesi sikhundla, uDkt Li ubesebenza njengoMqondisi Wezimo Eziphuthumayo Wesifunda woHlelo Lwezimo Eziphuthumayo Zezempilo lweWHO eHhovisi Lesifunda leWHO eNtshonalanga Pacific. UDkt Li uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu zesayensi yezenhlalo yezempilo. UDkt Yukiko Nakatani uzoba nguMqondisi-Jikelele Wokusiza Ekutholeni Imithi Nemikhiqizo Yezempilo kusukela ngomhlaka-2 kuNhlaba 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Nakatani uzobheka ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuqaliswa kwezindinganiso nezinqubomgomo zeWHO ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela ngokulinganayo emithini esezingeni eliphakeme, imithi yokugoma kanye nokuxilongwa kwazo zonke izakhamuzi yonke indawo, okuhlanganisa nokuvimbela kanye nokusabela ezifweni eziwumshayabhuqe. UDkt Nakatani ubesebenza njengoMqondisi Womhlaba Wonke Wokulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezifo woMnyango Wezempilo, Wezabasebenzi kanye Nezenhlalakahle kanye noMeluleki Wezobuchwepheshe kuNgqongqoshe Wezwe weQembu Lomsebenzi Wokugoma I-COVID-19 eJapan.

Ababhali banxusa umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba nabenzi benqubomgomo ukuthi bavikele okuzuziwe ekuzuzeni iSDG 7, ukuqhubekisela phambili izinguquko zesakhiwo, kanye nokugcina isu lokugxila emazweni asengozini adinga ukwesekwa kakhulu. Izingcaphuno: “Inkinga yamandla ebangelwe ukuhlasela kweRussia e-Ukraine iyaqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu kubantu emhlabeni wonke. Amanani aphezulu kagesi ashaye kanzima kakhulu, ikakhulukazi lawo asathuthuka kwezomnotho. Ngesikhathi ushintsho lwamandla ahlanzekile luhamba ngokushesha kunalokho abaningi abakucabangayo, kusenomsebenzi omningi odingekayo ukuze kulethwe ukufinyelela okusimeme, okuphephile nokungabizi ezinsizeni zamandla zanamuhla zezigidigidi zabantu abaphila ngaphandle kwawo. Izinguquko zamandla eziphumelelayo zithembele ezinqubweni ezisebenza ngempumelelo kanye nasekuthuthukisweni kwezobuchwepheshe kuhlangene nokuhlanganiswa okukhulu kokutshalwa kwezimali.

Njengegunya eliqondisayo nelixhumanisayo emsebenzini wezempilo wamazwe ngamazwe, akekho umlingani ongcono kuneWHO ukuqhubekisela phambili umsebenzi esiwuqale e-EU nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izixazululo zezempilo zedijithali zomhlaba wonke,” kusho uStella Kyriakides, uKhomishana Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kokudla. Lobu budlelwano buzohlanganisa ukusebenzisana eduze ekuthuthukiseni, ekuphathweni nasekusetshenzisweni kohlelo lwe-WHO GDHCN, okuzuzisa ngolwazi oluningi lwezobuchwepheshe lweKhomishini yaseYurophu emkhakheni. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitifiketi zamanje zedijithali ze-EU ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngempumelelo. "Njengoba amazwe angama-80 nezindawo zixhunywe ku-EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate, i-EU isibe yizinga lomhlaba wonke. Isitifiketi se-EU asikabi yithuluzi elibalulekile ekulweni kwethu nobhubhane, kodwa futhi siye sakhuthaza ukuhamba kwamanye amazwe nezokuvakasha.

Ukubambisana endaweni kuyisihluthulelo senqubekelaphambili emhlabeni wonke maqondana namaSDG ahlobene nezempilo Umbiko wenqubekelaphambili omusha ukhishwa ngokuhlanganyela namuhla yizinhlangano eziyi-13 ezisayinile zoHlelo Lokusebenza Lomhlaba Wonke Lokuphila Okunempilo Nokuphila Kahle Kwabo Bonke (SDG3 GAP). Umbiko onesihloko esithi “Yini esebenzayo? Yini engazange isebenze? Yini elandelayo?” ubonisa iminyaka emine yomsebenzi ohlanganyelwe yizinhlangano ezinkulu zamazwe amaningi ezichaza lokho okusebenzayo nokungasebenzanga ekuqiniseni ukubambisana nokusekelwa ukuze kusheshiswe inqubekelaphambili yezwe maqondana neMigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme (amaSDG). Lo nyaka uphawula ingxenye yesigamu seSDGs, kodwa umhlaba usala ngemuva ukuze ufinyelele imigomo yomhlaba. Kusukela yethulwa ngo-2019, iSDG3 GAP yenze kwaba nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokubambisana phakathi kwama-ejensi asayinile ezindaweni ezibalulekile njengokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo phakathi kokunye.

Abantu abanezidingo zezokwelapha “bashiywe ngemuva ebuhlungwini” kuveza umbiko omusha Inhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) ishicilele umbiko omusha mayelana nokufinyelela ku-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha, ochaza indlela ukusatshalaliswa komhlaba wonke kwe-morphine, njengomuthi obalulekile wokwelapha ubuhlungu, okungalingani futhi kungahlangabezani nesidingo sezokwelapha. Lo mbiko, onesihloko esithi “Ushiywe Ngemuva Ebuhlungwini”, uqokomisa izinkinga ekufinyeleleni kulo muthi obalulekile futhi unikeza izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okuphephile ngenqubomgomo elinganiselayo. Naphezu kokuthi i-morphine iyimithi esebenza ngempumelelo futhi engabizi kakhulu yokudambisa ubuhlungu obukhulu, efakwe ohlwini kusukela ngo-1977 kuhlelo lokuqala lohlu lwe-WHO Model of Essential Medicines, umehluko ekufinyeleleni emazweni wonke ubukhulu. Kunomehluko ophindwe izikhathi ezi-5 ukuya kwezingama-63 ekusetshenzisweni okulinganiselwe okulinganiselwe kwe-morphine phakathi kwamazwe anemali engenayo ephezulu kanye namazwe anemali engenayo ephansi.

Izici ezihlobene neminyaka yobudala kamama kanye nokubhema kungase futhi kwandise ingozi yesifo sikamama kanye nokubeletha. Ukubeletha kungavinjelwa ngokuhlela umndeni ukuze kugwenywe ukukhulelwa okungafunwa, impilo enhle kanye nokudla okunomsoco ngaphambi nangesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi kanye nenhlonipho ngaphambi kokubeletha kanye nangesikhathi sokubeletha okuhlanganisa abasebenzi bezempilo abanamakhono abanele kuhlanganise nababelethisi. Ukwelashwa kwesifo sesifo sofuba ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kungase futhi kuvimbele ukubeletha okulinganiselwa ku-200 000, kuyilapho ukuqapha ukushaya kwenhliziyo yengane engakazalwa kanye nokuqapha ukubeletha kanye nokungenelela ngokushesha lapho kudingeka kubalulekile ekuvimbeleni ukubeletha okungu-832 000 ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokunciphisa ukushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ukubeletha okushonile kuhlobene kakhulu nezici ezingezinhle zomphakathi nezomnotho zempilo. Ukuvimbela kanye nokunakekela okuphendulayo kudingeka kuhlanganiswe kulo lonke uchungechunge lokunakekelwa kwezempilo komama, nangale kwalokho.

UNelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion 2023 umklomelo: uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma waseBahrain Ngaphezu kokuba yiChief Executive Officer yeNational Health Regulatory Authority yaseBahrain, uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma ubambe izikhundla ezahlukene zobuholi kuhulumeni nasezikhungweni zemfundo ezweni lakubo. UDkt Al Jalahma ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwamasu nezinhlelo eziningi zikazwelonke nezesifunda emkhakheni wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, impilo yezingane kanye nentsha, izifo ezingamahlalakhona kanye nokulwa nokubhema. Endimeni yakhe yamanje, uDkt Al Jalahma uhole imizamo emikhulu ephumelelayo, efana nohlelo lokugunyazwa kuzwelonke lwezikhungo zezempilo, ukuguqulwa kwedijithali kweNational Health Regulatory Authority, kanye nemizamo eminingana eholela ekusebenzeni kahle kanye nokwenza kahle emkhakheni wezempilo.

Umbiko oyingqophamlando ubala indlela yokuhlela kabusha umnotho ukuze ulethe ezempilo kubo bonke Umbiko wokuqala walolu hlobo, uMkhandlu weWHO wezoMnotho weZempilo Zabo Bonke uye wabeka indlela entsha enesibindi yokuhlela kabusha umnotho ukuze ulethe okubalulekile - ezempilo zabo bonke. UMkhandlu, owasungulwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ngoLwezi 2020 ngenxa yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, futhi owawuholwa nguSolwazi Mariana Mazzucato, uchithe leyo minyaka emibili edlule ecabanga kabusha ngomnotho ngokombono wezempilo yabo bonke, futhi ucindezela ngamandla isimiso sokuthi impilo yabantu kanye neyomhlaba kufanele ibe semqoka endleleni esiklama ngayo izinhlelo zethu zezenhlalo, ezempilo kanye nezomnotho kanye nezinqubomgomo. UMkhandlu uveze indaba entsha enesibindi esekelwe ekuhlakanipheni okusha kwezomnotho ukuze uqondise kabusha umnotho ukuze ulethe ezempilo zabo bonke kuzingqikithi ezine ezihlobene:

(1) okushicilelwe izifundo zokubheka zezifo ezibhubhisayo zezilinganiso zokuphumelela okuphelele nokuhlobene komgomo weBA.1- noma iBA.4/5 equkethe imigomo ye-mRNA ephindwe kabili esetshenziswa njengomthamo wokugqugquzela ngokumelene nezimpawu kanye nesifo esinzima; (2) idatha esekelwe elabhorethri ngobukhulu nobubanzi bezimpendulo zokuphendula okuphambanayo ngokumelene nezinhlobo zangaphambilini kanye nokujikeleza kweSARS-CoV-2 ezibangelwa yiBA.1- noma iBA.4/5- eziqukethe imigomo ye-mRNA, uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe kuvidiyo, esetshenziswa njengomthamo wokugqugquzela; kanye (3) nezifundo ezisekelwe elabhorethri kanye nedatha yokubheka ekuphenduleni kwememori yokugoma ukuze kuhlolwe umthelela wokuchayeka okuphindaphindiwe kwe-antigen ekuvikelweni komgomo kanye nokuvikelwa. Eminye imininingwane ngobufakazi obubuyekezwe yiTAG-CO-VAC ingatholakala kulesi sithasiselo esihambisanayo. Ngokusekelwe ekubuyekezweni kwemininingo echazwe ngenhla, iTAG-CO-VAC iphetha ngokuthi:

Lelisu lihlose ukusekela Amazwe Angamalungu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo kanye nasekusebenziseni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizoqinisa indima edlalwa imithi yesintu ekugcineni abantu bephilile. Ukubhekana nezinselele, ukusabela ezidingweni ezikhonjwe Amazwe Angamalungu kanye nokwakha emsebenzini owenziwe ngaphansi kwesu lokwelapha ngesintu leWHO: 2002-2005, isu elibuyekeziwe lesikhathi sika-2014-2023 linikela ukunaka okwengeziwe kunelandelayo ekubekeni eqhulwini izinsiza zezempilo kanye nezinhlelo, okuhlanganisa imikhiqizo yendabuko kanye nemithi eyengeziwe, imikhuba kanye nabasebenzi. Izinhloso zamasu yilezi: Ukwakha isisekelo solwazi sokwenganyelwa okusebenzayo kweT&CM ngezinqubomgomo ezifanele zikazwelonke; Ukuqinisa ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuphepha, ukusetshenziswa okufanele kanye nokusebenza kweT&CM ngokulawula imikhiqizo, imikhuba kanye nabasebenzi;

Enqubweni efanayo, i-Afrigen izoqhubeka nokwenza ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe kubalingani benethiwekhi. Abaxhasi bezimali badlala indima ebalulekile ekusekeleni uHlelo ngokuxhaswa kwezimali okuphelele kuze kube manje kuma-US$ ayizigidi eziyi-117 kanye neFrance njengabokuqala ukuxhasa umsebenzi wokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Ababekhona emhlanganweni kwakungabameleli beKhomishini yaseYurophu, iBelgium, iGermany, kanye neNorway, iCanada, i-African Union, iNingizimu Afrika, kanye ne-ELMA Foundation. UCaroline Delany, uMqondisi Jikelele weGlobalAffairs Canada eNingizimu kanye neMpumalanga ye-Afrika uthe: “ICanada iqinisekisa ukweseka kwayo okuqhubekayo koHlelo lweMigr Technology Transfer Programme futhi siyajabula ukumemezela umnikelo owengeziwe wamaRandi aseCanada ayizigidi eziyi-15 emhlanganweni wanamuhla. Lokhu kuletha umnikelo ophelele weCanada kuHlelo kuze kufike ezigidini ezingama-45 zamaRandi aseCanada.

Kudingeka isinyathelo esiphuthumayo sokubhekana nenqubekelaphambili emile emigomeni ehlobene nezempilo. I-WHO ikhipha uhlelo lwango-2023 lombiko wayo waminyaka yonke weZibalo Zezempilo Zomhlaba ezinamanani amasha ngomthelela wobhubhane lweCOVID-19 kanye nezibalo zakamuva zenqubekelaphambili eziya emigomeni ehlobene nezempilo (amaSDG). Umbiko onemininingo efinyelela ku-2022 ugcizelela ukumiswa kwenqubekelaphambili yezempilo ezinkombeni ezibalulekile zezempilo eminyakeni yamuva uma kuqhathaniswa nemikhuba ebonwe phakathi kuka-2000-2015. Iphinde isixwayise ngosongo olukhulayo lwezifo ezingathathelani (amaNCD) kanye nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, futhi ifuna ukusabela okuhlanganisiwe nokuqinisiwe. Izindleko zeCOVID-19 ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo kanye nenqubekelaphambili yezempilo Umbiko ubhala izibalo ezibuyekeziwe mayelana nomthelela wobhubhane empilweni yomhlaba, okufaka isandla ekwehleni okuqhubekayo kwenqubekelaphambili eya kumaSDG.

Imiklomelo yeminikelo evelele kwezempilo yomphakathi eyethulwe ngesikhathi soMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisithupha Nesithupha Ngesikhathi somcimbi othinta inhliziyo eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisithupha Nesithupha eGeneva, imiklomelo yanikezwa abantu kanye nezikhungo ezivela emhlabeni wonke ngeminikelo yabo evelele kwezempilo yomphakathi. "Imiklomelo yezempilo yomphakathi yowezi-2023 kanye nemiklomelo igubha abantu abaye baba negalelo elibalulekile kwezempilo yomhlaba, futhi umsebenzi wabo uye wadlulela ngalé kwesimemo somsebenzi ojwayelekile," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. "Ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ubhekene nezinselele eziningi, ngamunye uyisikhuthazo kanye nesikhumbuzo senqubekelaphambili engenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo kanye nenhlalakahle yabo bonke." Isimemo sokuqokwa kwabazongenela umklomelo ngamunye sithunyelwa minyaka yonke ngemva kokuvalwa koMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba.

Ngibonga iWHO ngokuvula indlela yocwaningo olusha kanye nokuhlinzeka ngesikhulumi sabo somhlaba wonke ukuze basabalalise izwi futhi benze ucwaningo mayelana nokuxhumana kwezobuciko kanye nezempilo. "Ngibheke phambili kuwo wonke amathuba okwenza umsebenzi obalulekile ezweni lakithi eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni wonke ukuze kube nekusasa elingcono nelinempilo," kwengeza uYende. Ukuqokwa kukaFleming noYende kugcizelela ukuxhumana okujulile phakathi kwezobuciko kanye nezempilo. Ukuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokudala, njengomculo, ubuciko, kanye nomdanso, kunomthelela omuhle empilweni yomzimba, yengqondo, inhlalakahle yomphakathi, kanye nekhwalithi yokuphila jikelele. Ngezindima zabo njengeNxusa leZinhloso ezihle, uFleming noYende bazokhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuciko ezinhlelweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, bakhuthaze ukufinyelela ekwelashweni kwezobuciko, futhi bagqugquzele ukubaluleka kokuvezwa kobuciko ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni jikelele.

Izincazelo: I-WHO ibilokhu isebenza emkhakheni wezempilo yezocansi kusukela okungenani ngo-1974, lapho ukuxoxisana kwekomidi lochwepheshe kwaholela ekushicilelweni kombiko wezobuchwepheshe onesihloko esithi “Imfundo nokwelashwa ngokuphathelene nocansi lwabantu” (WHO, 1975). Kusukela ngo-2000, iPan American Health Organization (PAHO) kanye neWHO bahlanganisa inqwaba yokubonisana kochwepheshe ukuze babuyekeze amagama kanye nokuhlonza izinketho zohlelo. Ukuphela kwale mihlangano kwaba Ukubonisana Kwezobuchwepheshe ngo-2002, lapho kwakhiwa khona izincazelo ezisebenzayo zamagama abalulekile ahlobene nempilo yezocansi ngezansi. Ubulili: Ubulili bubhekisela ezicini zebhayoloji ezichaza abantu njengabesifazane noma abesilisa. Nakuba lezi zinhlobo zezici zebhayoloji zingahambisani, njengoba kunabantu abanazo zombili, bavame ukuhlukanisa abantu njengabesilisa nabesifazane.

Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha - Ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke: 27 kuNhlaba 2023 Isu lokuqala lomhlaba wonke lokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba uvumile namuhla isu lokuqala lomhlaba wonke lokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka (IPC), elakha cishe eminyakeni engamashumi amabili yemizamo eholwa yiWHO kanye nabalingani. Isu linikeza Amazwe angamaLungu izinkomba zamasu ukuze anciphise kakhulu ingozi eqhubekayo yokutheleleka okuhlobene nokunakekelwa kwezempilo (amaHAIs), okuhlanganisa nalawo abonisa ukumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane. AmaHAIs aphakathi kwezigameko ezimbi ezivame kakhulu ezenzeka kumongo wokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 kanye nokuqubuka kwezifo ezinkulu zakamuva njenge-Ebola virus disease, iMiddle East respiratory syndrome kanye neSudan virus disease ziveze ngokucacile izikhala ezikhona ezinhlelweni ze-IPC kuwo wonke amazwe.

I-tetanus yenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma phakathi namasonto ayi-6 ngemva kokukhulelwa ibizwa ngokuthi i-maternal tetanus, kuyilapho i-tetanus yenzeka phakathi nezinsuku zokuqala ezingama-28 zokuphila ibizwa ngokuthi i-neonatal tetanus. Lesi sifo sihlala siyinkinga ebalulekile yezempilo yomphakathi ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba, kodwa ikakhulukazi emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi noma ezifundeni, lapho ukugonywa kuphansi futhi izindlela zokubeletha ezingahlanzekile zivamile. I-WHO ilinganisela ukuthi ngo-2018 (unyaka wakamuva lapho izilinganiso zitholakala khona), izingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezingama-25 000 zabulawa i-neonatal tetanus, ukwehla okungama-88% kusukela esimweni sango-2000. Izimpawu: Cishe zonke izimo ze-tetanus zenzeka kubantu abangakaze bagonywe noma kubantu abadala abangakagcini ngezikhathi ngokuphathelene nemijovo yabo yokugoma. Izimpawu neziqalo ze-tetanus zivela noma nini kusukela ezinsukwini ezi-3 kuya kwezingama-21 ngemva kokuba amagciwane e-tetanus engene emzimbeni ngesilonda.

Ukuqokwa kwabaholi abasemqoka okwenziwe ukuze kuqhutshwe isu leWHO kanye nezinhlelo. Inhlangano yeZempilo yoMhlaba (WHO) iqoke abantu abaphezulu abasha abahlanu eqenjini labaholi bezinhloko zayo eGeneva. Ukuqokwa okusha kulandela ukuqokwa kabusha kukaDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus esikhathini sakhe sesibili seminyaka emihlanu njengoMqondisi-Jikelele. Ithimba lonke labaholi liye lahlanganiswa ukuze lihambisane nezinto ezibalulekile zoHlelo lweNhlangano zeminyaka emihlanu ezayo futhi lizosebenzisana eduze noMqondisi-Jikelele ukuze liqhubele phambili lezi zinto ezibalulekile kanye ne-ajenda yokuguqula iWHO. Ukuze kusheshiswe inqubekelaphambili ekuqalisweni koHlelo Lomsebenzi Jikelele we-13 weWHO (GPW13), kanye nokuzuzwa kwezinhloso zalo “zizigidigidi ezintathu” kanye Nezinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Okusimeme ezihlobene nezempilo, umsebenzi weWHO weminyaka emihlanu ezayo ugxile ezintweni ezinhlanu ezibalulekile:

Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha uzogxila ekusindiseni izimpilo, ukushayela impilo kubo bonke njengoba iWHO igubha iminyaka engama-75 Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo nezobuntu eziqhubekayo, Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha uzogxila ekushayeleni phambili impilo yabo bonke. Iseshini yalo nyaka yoMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba izonquma ikusasa eliseduze nelide leWHO, ukuqala ngohlelo lohlelomali lweminyaka emibili ezayo, izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme kweNhlangano kanye nezinguquko ezibekwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zeWHO kanye nokuziphendulela. Izihambeli zizophinde zicabange ngendima ebalulekile iWHO enayo kuGlobal Health Emergency Architecture. Isizinda salezi zinkinga yisikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-75 senhlangano, ngokuqokwa kokuhlangene kwezimpumelelo zezempilo zomhlaba wonke kusukela kwasungulwa iWHO ngo-1948.

Kodwa-ke, ubhubhane lubeke izinkomba eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo ngaphandle kwendlela futhi lwaba nomthelela ekungalingani ekufinyeleleni ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuseqophelweni eliphezulu, ukugonywa okujwayelekile kanye nokuvikelwa kwezezimali. Ngenxa yalokho, ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhuba kamalaleveva neTB sekubuyisiwe, futhi bambalwa abantu abelashelwe izifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo (amaNTD). “Izibalo Zezempilo Zomhlaba yi-WHO yokuhlola kwaminyaka yonke ngesimo sezempilo emhlabeni. Umbiko uthumela umyalezo omubi ngosongo lwezifo ezingathathelani, ezithatha inani elikhulu nelikhulayo ezimpilweni, ezindleleni zokuziphilisa, ezinhlelweni zezempilo, emiphakathini, emnothweni nasemiphakathini,” kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. “Umbiko ufuna ukwanda okukhulu kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezempilo kanye nezinhlelo zezempilo ukuze kubuyele endleleni eya eMigomweni Yentuthuko Esimeme.”

ukusekela amazwe ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zikazwelonke noma zesifunda zokuqapha abantu ngokuphathelene namakhemikhali akhathazayo. Idokhumenti ehlobene: A76/A/CONF./2 - Umthelela wamakhemikhali, imfucuza kanye nokunukubeza impilo yabantu Umsebenzi weWHO ngokuphathelene nokuphepha kwamakhemikhali kanye nezempilo Ukuthola inhlalakahle: uhlaka lomhlaba wonkeAmazwe Angamalungu avumile ukwamukela "Uhlaka Lomhlaba Wonke lokuhlanganisa inhlalakahle kwezempilo yomphakathi kusetshenziswa indlela yokugqugquzela impilo", oluzama ukuvumela bonke abantu ukuba bachume futhi bafinyelele amandla abo aphelele ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo kukho konke ukuphila kwabo kanye nasezizukulwaneni. Uhlaka Lomhlaba Wonke luncoma izinkomba eziyisithupha eziyinhloko ezigxile kulokhu: ukufinyelela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke, umnotho onokulingana, ukuvikela iplanethi, izinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi, izinhlelo zedijithali zokuvumela impilo, kanye nokukala kanye nokuqapha inhlalakahle.

Ubulili: Impilo yocansi ayikwazi ukuchazwa, ukuqondwa noma ukwenziwa isebenze ngaphandle kokucatshangelwa kabanzi ngocansi, okuyisisekelo sokuziphatha okubalulekile kanye nemiphumela ehlobene nempilo yocansi. Incazelo esebenzayo yocansi ithi: “…isici esiyinhloko sokuba umuntu impilo yakho yonke sihlanganisa ubulili, ubunikazi bobulili kanye nezindima, ukuthambekela kwezocansi, ukuthambekela kwezocansi, ukuthokozela, ukusondelana kanye nokuzala. Ubulili bukhona futhi buvezwa emicabangweni, emaphusheni, ezifisweni, ezinkolelweni, ezimweni zengqondo, ezimisweni, ekuziphatheni, emikhubeni, ezindimeni kanye nasebuhlotsheni. Nakuba ubulili bungahlanganisa zonke lezi zici, akuzona zonke ezihlala zikhona noma ezivezwayo. Ubulili buthonywa ukusebenzelana kwezinto ezingokwemvelo, ezingokwengqondo, ezenhlalo, ezomnotho, ezombusazwe, ezamasiko, ezomthetho, ezingokomlando, ezingokwenkolo kanye nezingokomoya.” (WHO, 2006a)

"i-Argentina itshale imali enkulu ekwakheni amandla ezwe lethu ku-pathogen genomics kanye namandla amanye amazwe," kusho uJosefina Campos, uMqondisi weNational Genomics and Bioinformatics Center e-ANLIS Malbrán, e-Argentina. "Izifo azihloniphi imingcele: usongo lwesifo ezweni elilodwa lusengozini nakwabanye. Sibheke phambili ekusebenzisaneni namalungu e-IPSN ukuze sifinyelele umgomo wethu ofanayo wokuvimbela ukugula nokusindisa izimpilo." I-IPSN izobhekana nalezi zinselele ngenethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke, ixhumanisa izindawo kanye namanethiwekhi aqondene nezifo, ukuze kwakhiwe uhlelo lokubambisana ukuze kutholakale kangcono, kuvinjelwe futhi kuphendulwe izinsongo zezifo. Amalungu azosebenza ndawonye ngamaqembu azinikele agxile ezinseleleni ezithile, esekelwa ngezimali nge-IPSN ukuze kukhuliswe imibono namaphrojekthi ku-pathogen genomics.

Izincomo ezibalulekile zihlanganisa: Sidinga ukwazisa nokukala izinto ezibaluleke ngempela - ukuchuma kwabantu kanye neplanethi - kunokuphishekela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokwandiswa kweGDP kungakhathaliseki imiphumela. Ukuze kuzuzwe impilo yabo bonke, ohulumeni kufanele bacabange kabusha ukubaluleka futhi bahlele kabusha futhi baqondise kabusha umnotho ngokusekelwe enhlalakahleni yomphakathi kanye neplanethi, beqondiswa amamethrikhi amasha. Ukulungiswa okuyisisekelo kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke nezamazwe ngamazwe zokuxhasa ngezimali ezempilo kuyadingeka, ukuze ukusetshenziswa kwemali kwezempilo kuthathwe njengotshalomali lwesikhathi eside. Ukuletha Ezempilo Kubo Bonke kuzodinga kokubili imali eyengeziwe, kanye nezimali ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Ukuqamba okusha kudinga ubuhlakani obuhlangene - akukaze kube isithelo senkampani eyodwa noma i-ejensi kahulumeni. Kodwa ngaphandle kokuthi ukuqamba okusha kulawulwe ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu, abantu abaningi bahlala bengafakiwe ezinzuzweni zayo.

Ukutheleleka ngezifo okunamandla kakhulu kungabangela ukuvaleka kwamathumbu okufanele kwelashwe ngokuhlinzwa. I-S. stercoralis ingase ibangele ukugula kwesikhumba kanye namathumbu futhi yaziwa nangokuthi ihlotshaniswa nokungondleki okungamahlalakhona ezinganeni. Uma kwenzeka kuncipha ukuvikeleka komzimba, iparasite ingabangela i-hyperinfection/dissemination syndrome ebulalayo njalo uma ingelashwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele futhi ivame ukubulala naphezu kokwelashwa. Ngo-2001, izihambeli eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke zagunyaza ngazwi linye isinqumo (WHA54.19) esikhuthaza amazwe anezifo ukuthi aqale ukubhekana ngokungathí sina nezibungu, ikakhulukazi i-schistosomiasis kanye nama-helminth adluliselwa emhlabathini. Isu lokulawula izifo ezidluliselwa emhlabathini ukulawula ukugula ngokwelashwa ngezikhathi ezithile kwabantu abasengozini abahlala ezindaweni ezivamile.

Amaphothifoliyo amalungu akhona eqembu labaholi endlunkulu: uDkt Samira Asma uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele weDatha, ukuHlaziya kanye Nokuletha Umthelela. UDkt Asma uqondisa iphothifoliyo eqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yezempilo inokwethenjelwa futhi iyatholakala, futhi isetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni wonke, okuhlanganisa ukulandelela nokusheshisa inqubekelaphambili ebheke emigomeni eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezintathu kanye Nemigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme ehlobene nezempilo. Ngaphambi kokujoyina iWHO ngo-2018, uDkt Asma ubambe izikhundla zobuholi eZikhungweni Zokulawula Nokuvimbela Izifo zase-US (CDC) iminyaka engaphezu kwamashumi amabili. Uneziqu zobudokotela ekuhlinzeni amazinyo kanye nesiqu sobungcweti kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Bruce Aylward uqokwe njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Universal Health Coverage, iLife Course Division kusukela ngomhlaka-4 kuNhlaba 2023.

Abaculi abadumile uRenée Fleming noPretty Yende baqokwe njengabaxhumanisi beWHO bezobuciko kanye nezempilo. I-WHO iyajabula ukumemezela ukuqokwa kwabaculi abahlonishwayo emhlabeni wonke uRenée Fleming noPretty Yende njengabaxhumanisi bezobuciko kanye nezempilo. Lesi simemezelo esihloniphekile senziwa njengengxenye yesikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-75 yeWHO ngesikhathi soMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisithupha Nesithupha ngomhla zingama-22 kuNhlaba wezi-2023. URenée Fleming, ongomunye wabaculi abahlonishwa kakhulu besikhathi sethu, noPretty Yende, isoprano engavamile eyaziwa ngemisebenzi yakhe ekhazimulayo, bakhethelwe impumelelo yabo yobuciko kanye nokumela imiphumela yezempilo ethuthukisiwe ngezindlela zokudala. Ngomhla ziyisi-8 kuMbasa wezi-2023, uFleming noYende benza ikhonsathi ekhethekile enesihloko esithi Healing Arts, enikelwe emgubheni wama-75 weWHO eGeneva, eSwitzerland.

ukubuyiselwa esimweni; imithi yesintu, kanye nomsebenzi weWHO ekuphenduleni inqwaba yezimo eziphuthumayo ngenkathi isebenza namazwe angamalungu ukuze ilungele kangcono ukubhekana nezintsha. Ngasekuqaleni kosuku, izihambeli eKomitini A zavuma ukuqaphela uhlelo lokuhlosiwe oluya kuMzamo Wezempilo Nokuthula Womhlaba Wonke (kanye noshintsho oluncane egameni elithi "Global Health for Peace Initiative"), futhi zacela ukuthi uMqondisi-Jikelele abike ngenqubekelaphambili ekuqiniseni uhlelo lokuhlosiwe. Emhlanganweni, njengesinyathelo sokugcina sokugunyaza umhlangano, izihambeli zamukela izinqumo kanye nezinqumo zamakomidi amabili, futhi zamukela imibiko yazo. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa ukugunyazwa kwesabelomali sika-2024-25, kanye nokwenyuka ngo-20% kweminikelo ehlolwe. Osihlalo bekomidi kanye nabamele izifunda ezimbili bakhulume ukuze baqaphele umsebenzi kanye nenqubekelaphambili yalo Mhlangano.

I-IPSN ibona umhlaba lapho wonke amazwe enokufinyelela okulinganayo emandleni aqhubekayo okulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlaziya njengengxenye yohlelo lwayo lokuqapha ezempilo zomphakathi. Ihlose ukudala inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke esekelayo yabalingisi bokuqapha izakhi zofuzo ezikhulisa futhi zisheshise umsebenzi wamalungu ayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kanye nokulingana. I-IPSN iqukethe izinhlangano ezintathu eziyinhloko ezisebenzayo ezihlanganisa amasethi ahlukene ababambiqhaza, esekelwa uNobhala eWHO Pandemic Hub. Abalingani basebenzisana kumaCommunity of Practice (COPs) ukuze baxazulule izinselele ezifanayo, okuhloswe ngazo ukwandisa ukuvumelanisa kanye nokusungula izinto ezintsha ku-pathogen genomics. Ku-Country Scale-Up Accelerator (CSUA), ababambiqhaza basebenza ndawonye ukuze bavumelanise imizamo futhi benze ukushintshana kweSouth-South kukhulise ukwakhiwa kwamandla ezwe.

I-Universal Health Coverage iyilungelo elibaluleke kakhulu, ilungelo labantu kuwo wonke umuntu emhlabeni jikelele. "Imiklomelo emine ekhethekile nayo yanikezwa ngefilimu ekhiqizwe uMfundi, ifilimu ekhuluma Ngokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Nempilo, ifilimu ekhuluma Ngempilo Yezocansi Nokuzala Namalungelo kanye Nefilimu Emfushane Kakhulu. Isihloko sempilo yengqondo sivezwe kakhulu kumafilimu anqobile alo nyaka, okuhlanganisa nefilimu emfushane enamandla neyoshukumisayo evela eSweden ekhuluma ngokukhathazeka kanye nengcindezi. Ifilimu, ebekwe umsindo oshukumisayo, yabonisa uchungechunge lwabalingisi abaveza izigaba ezahlukene zokukhathazeka nokuthi kungazibonakalisa kanjani. Umlayezo uwonke ukuthi awuwedwa ekubeni nemicabango emibi nokuthi kulungile ukuvuma imizwa enjalo. Elinye ifilimu eliwine, elivela eBangladesh, libonisa umfana omncane owachayeka kumthofu ovela efekthri yendawo.

Ngemva kwesikhathi esingezimpawu sezinsuku eziyi-1 ukuya kwezingama-20 kuze kufike ku-15% weziguli zithola isigaba sesibili sesifo esibonakala ngemfiva evame ukudlula u-40 °C kanye nezimpawu zokubandakanyeka kohlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi, njengemeningitis (isib. imfiva, ikhanda elibuhlungu, nentamo eqinile), i-encephalitis (isib., ukozela, ukudideka, nokuphazamiseka kwezinzwa), i-myelitis noma i-radiculitis. I-encephalitis ekhula phakathi nalesi sigaba sesibili ingase iholele ekukhubazekeni, ukulimala unomphela noma ukufa. Cishe u-1% wamacala anezifo zezinzwa angase afe; amazinga aphezulu okushona abikiwe eRussian federation, okungase kuhlobene nohlobo oluhlukile lwegciwane. Ubukhulu bokugula buyanda ngeminyaka yesiguli, kodwa ukufa kuye kwabikwa kuzo zonke izigaba zeminyaka yobudala. Ayikho indlela yokwelapha ethile ye-encephalitis ebangelwa amagundane.

Amazwe Angamalungu anxuswa ukuthi aqinise ukuqaliswa kwamasu akhona eWHO okuhlanganisa ukuqaliswa kweWHO Chemicals Roadmap eveza izindima ezibalulekile zomkhakha wezempilo ekusebenziseni iStrategic Approach to International Chemicals Management. Isinqumo siphinde sikhuthaze oNgqongqoshe Bezempilo ukuthi bahlanganyele emizamweni yokulungiselela iziphakamiso zephaneli yenqubomgomo yesayensi phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nezingxoxo zesivumelwano sokuqeda ukunukubezeka kwepulasitiki. Isinqumo sibize uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi athathe izinyathelo eziningana, okuhlanganisa: ukushicilela umbiko ngemithelela yezempilo yamakhemikhali, imfucuza kanye nokunukubezeka ngombono we-"One Health"; ukubuyekeza idokhumenti yowezi-2012 ngeSimo seSayensi Yamakhemikhali Aphazamisa i-Endocrine ngokuhlanganyela ne-United Nations Environment Programme; kanye

Izinqubomgomo zezokuthutha kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okukhuthaza ezokuthutha zomphakathi ezihlanzekile, kanye nokuhamba ngezinyawo kanye nokuhamba ngamabhayisikili, kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekhwalithi yomoya. Lokhu kunganciphisa izingozi eziningi zempilo ngesikhathi esisodwa, okuhlanganisa ukufa kohlangothi, isifo senhliziyo, isifo samaphaphu kanye neminye imidlavuza. Zingase futhi zinciphise ukufa okulinganiselwa kwesigidi esingu-1.25 minyaka yonke ngenxa yokulimala emgwaqweni, ngesikhathi futhi zithuthukisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi. Izinqubomgomo zezokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu eziqhubekayo zingaqhubeka nokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwezinto ezibomvu ngokucabanga ngokufakwa kwezakhiwo kanye nokusetshenziswa komhlaba, ukukhetha izinto zokwakha, izici zokwakha kanye nokungenisa umoya kanye namandla. Impendulo yeWHO: Umsebenzi weWHO uqondiswa Imigomo Yentuthuko Esimeme, ikakhulukazi iMigomo 3: “Ukuqinisekisa izimpilo ezinempilo kanye nokukhuthaza inhlalakahle yabo bonke abantu kuyo yonke iminyaka yobudala.”

Izidingo ezivimbela ngokungafanele zingaphazamisa ukufinyelela kwesiguli ngoba ziphazamisa ukugeleza kokuhlinzekwa noma zenze ukunikezwa nokukhishwa kube nzima kochwepheshe bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukukhathazeka ngemiphumela eyingozi engaba khona yama-opioid kuyiqiniso, njengamandla awo okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, inani elithile lokuqapha mayelana nokulimala okungase kube khona kokusetshenziswa kwama-opioid (isb. ukusetshenziswa kobuhlungu obungapheli obungeyona umdlavuza) kubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi uma nje ukusetshenziswa kwayo kunolwazi futhi kulingana nezingozi. Ukukhathazeka okunjalo akufanele kunciphise izinzuzo zokusetshenziswa kwama-opioid lapho kukhonjisiwe ngokomtholampilo nalapho kusetshenziswa ngokuphephile ochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe. Amathuba okwenza okuthile Lo mbiko wethula isethi eyengeziwe yezindawo zokwenza ezihlose ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okuphephile ku-morphine.

I-WHO neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea basayine isivumelwano esiyingqophamlando sokukhulisa amandla okukhiqiza ama-biomanufacturing I-WHO kanye neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea basayine iMemorandum of Understanding ukuze kusungulwe isikhungo sokuqeqesha somhlaba wonke ekukhiqizeni ama-biomanufacturing. Lesi sikhungo sokuqeqesha somhlaba wonke sizosebenzela wonke amazwe anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi (amaLMIC) ukukhiqiza ama-biological, njengemithi yokugoma, i-insulin, ama-monoclonal antibodies, nemithi yomdlavuza. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 lwaqokomisa isidingo sokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwendawo nesifunda kwemithi yokugoma neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo ebalulekile kumaLMIC ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela ngokulinganayo. Ukuze kunikezwe amazwe ulwazi lokukhiqiza ngokushesha imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA, iWHO, ngokubambisana nabalingani, yasungula uhlelo lwe-mRNA Technology Transfer, ngokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhungo seHub eNingizimu Afrika ngoMbasa wezi-2023.

Ngokuvamile kusetshenziswa ezilimini eziningi, igama elithi ucansi livame ukusetshenziselwa ukuchaza “umsebenzi wezocansi”, kodwa ngezinhloso zobuchwepheshe kumongo wobulili kanye nezingxoxo zezempilo yocansi, incazelo engenhla iyathandeka. Impilo yezocansi Ngokwencazelo esebenzayo yamanje, impilo yezocansi yilena:“...isimo senhlalakahle ngokomzimba, ngokomzwelo, ngokwengqondo kanye nangokwezenhlalo ngokuphathelene nocansi; akukhona nje ukungabi khona kwezifo, ukungasebenzi kahle noma ukugula. Impilo yezocansi idinga indlela enhle nenenhlonipho ngokuphathelene nocansi kanye nobudlelwano bobulili, kanye nethuba lokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho kocansi okujabulisayo nokuphephile, ngaphandle kokuphoqelelwa, ukucwaswa kanye nobudlova. Ukuze kuzuzwe futhi kugcinwe impilo yezocansi, amalungelo ocansi abo bonke abantu kumele ahlonishwe, avikelwe futhi agcwaliswe.” (WHO, 2006a)

Ukuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa amadokhumenti esiqondiso sobuchwepheshe asekelwe ebufakazini, imithetho kanye nezindinganiso zokuvimbela kanye nokusabela ebudloveni obenziwa ezinganeni. Ukushicilela njalo imibiko yesimo somhlaba wonke ngemizamo yezwe yokubhekana nobudlova obenziwa ezinganeni ngezinqubomgomo zikazwelonke kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza, imithetho, izinhlelo zokuvimbela kanye nezinsizakalo zokusabela. Ukusekela amazwe kanye nabalingani ekusebenziseni amasu okuvimbela kanye nokusabela asekelwe ebufakazini, njengalawo afakiwe ku-INSPIRE: Amasu ayisikhombisa okuqeda udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni. Ukusebenzisana nama-ejensi kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuncishiswe futhi kuqedwe udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni emhlabeni wonke, ngezinhlelo ezinjenge-Global Partnership to End Violence against Children, iGlobal Partnership to End Violence against Children,

Kubantu, ukuchayeka okwandisiwe ku-UV kungabangela umdlavuza wesikhumba, i-cataract kanye nokulimala kwesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ezifweni. Ukuvimbela: Ukukhuphuka kwenani lamacala omdlavuza wesikhumba emashumini eminyaka edlule kuhlobene kakhulu nokuchayeka kakhulu elangeni ngesikhathi semisebenzi yangaphandle kanye nemithombo yokukhanyisa i-UV enjengezibani zelanga kanye nemibhede yokubanda. Ukuchayeka ngokweqile nakho kuyimbangela eyinhloko yemiphumela eyingozi emehlweni nasesimisweni somzimba sokuzivikela ezifweni. Ukuthatha izinyathelo ezimbalwa ezilula zokuqapha kunganciphisa kakhulu ingozi yalezi zimo zempilo: Nciphisa isikhathi osukwini lwemini kusukela ngo-10 ekuseni kuya ku-4 ntambama, ikakhulukazi ngezinsuku lapho inani le-UV liphakeme khona. Lapho imisebe ye-UV inamandla kakhulu futhi kufanele ube ngaphandle, zama ukuthola umthunzi futhi ugqoke izingubo zokuzivikela, kuhlanganise nesigqoko esivikela ikhanda lakho, ubuso kanye nentamo.

ISchistosomiasis ithinta cishe abantu abayizigidi ezingama-240 emhlabeni wonke, futhi abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-700 bahlala ezindaweni ezivamile. Ukutheleleka kuvame ezindaweni ezishisayo kanye nasezindaweni ezingaphansi kwezishisayo, emiphakathini empofu engenamanzi okuphuza kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle okwanele. I-Urogenital schistosomiasis ibangelwa iSchistosoma haematobium kanye ne-intestinal schistosomiasis nganoma yiziphi izinto eziphilayo iS. guineensis, iS. intercalatum, iS. mansoni, iS. japonicum, neS. mekongi. Abantu abayizigidi eziningana emhlabeni wonke bahlushwa ukugula okunzima ngenxa yeschistosomiasis. Isu leWHO lokusebenzisa imithi ye-anthelminthic manje lenza kube nokwenzeka ukulawula ischistosomiasis emiphakathini empofu kanye nehlukanisiwe, ngokuhlanganiswa nokungenelela ngokumelene ne-lymphatic filariasis, onchocerciasis kanye nehelminthiasis edluliselwa enhlabathini.

Naphezu kokuncipha kokuchayeka ezingozini eziningi zezempilo - njengokubhema ugwayi, ukuphuza utshwala, ubudlova, amanzi angaphephile kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle, kanye nokukhula kancane kwezingane - inqubekelaphambili ibinganele futhi ukuchayeka kwezinye izingozi ezinjengokunukubezwa komoya kusalokhu kuphezulu. Ngokushaqisayo, ukwanda kokukhuluphala ngokweqile kuyanda ngaphandle kwesibonakaliso esisheshayo sokuguquka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela okwandisiwe ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibalulekile kuye kwehla uma kuqhathaniswa nokuzuza kwangaphambi kuka-2015, kuhambisana nokungabi khona kwenqubekelaphambili ebonakalayo ekunciphiseni ubunzima bezezimali ngenxa yezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kunciphisa kakhulu ikhono lethu lokuzuza i-Universal Health Coverage ngo-2030. “Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 luyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi inqubekelaphambili ayiqondile futhi ayiqinisekisiwe,” kuxwayisa uDkt Samira Asma, uMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO weDatha, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuletha umthelela.

Isikhungo siphinde siqhube imisebenzi yocwaningo nokumela ukwakha imibono kanye nokuthonya izinqubomgomo ezithinta abasebenzi bezempilo basemaphandleni eNepal. UProfesa Vichai Tienthavorn unguMongameli wePraboromarajchanok Institute eMnyangweni Wezempilo Yomphakathi waseThailand. Omunye wemizamo kazwelonke ayiholile inqubomgomo yokugqugquzela ezempilo ukuze kusize ukubhekana ne-thalassemia, futhi umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekwamukelweni kwenqubomgomo kazwelonke esebenzayo yokuvimbela nokulawula i-thalassemia. Uphinde waklama ithuluzi lokuxhumana elisebenza ngendlela efanele kanye nendlela yokuhlola ukuze asize izakhamizi ukuthi zivumelanise ukuziphatha kwazo ukuze zivimbele futhi zilawule isifo sikashukela kanye nomfutho wegazi ophakeme. Ngenxa yalo msebenzi, inqubomgomo kazwelonke yamukelwa ngomthelela omuhle kakhulu emthwalweni wezifo zezwe.

Ukwelashwa kungenziwa kumuntu ngamunye, noma njengeMass Drug Administration kuye ngezimo zendawo kanye nezindlela zokulawula ezisetshenziswayo. I-Taeniasis ingelashwa kusetshenziswa ama-anthelmintics (Praziquantel, Niclosamide, Albendazole). Ku-neurocysticercosis, njengoba ukubhujiswa kwama-cysts kungaholela ekuphenduleni kokuvuvukala, kudingeka ukwelashwa okukhethekile kwesifo esisebenzayo futhi kungase kuhlanganise izifundo ezinde ezinemithamo ephezulu ye-anthelmintic, kanye nokwelashwa okusekelayo ngama-corticosteroid kanye/noma imithi elwa nesithuthwane, futhi mhlawumbe nokuhlinzwa. Umthamo nesikhathi sokwelashwa kungahluka kakhulu futhi kuncike kakhulu enanini, ubukhulu, indawo kanye nesigaba sokukhula kwama-cysts, ukuvuvukala kwawo okuzungezile, ukuba lukhuni kanye nobunzima bezimpawu zomtholampilo noma izimpawu.

I-Human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) Ngokuvamile ayinazimpawu, uhlobo olungamahlalakhona lweHTLV-1 lungabangela isifo esinzima, okuhlanganisa i-T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma (ATL) yabantu abadala kanye nesimo esiqhubekayo sohlelo lwezinzwa olwaziwa ngokuthi i-HTLV-1-associated myelopathy noma i-tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM/TSP). Ukwelashwa: Ukwelashwa okuphumelelayo kuyatholakala okwamanje kuzifo eziningana ezithathelwana ngocansi. Izifo ezithathelana ngocansi ezintathu ezibangelwa amagciwane (i-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea kanye ne-syphilis) kanye ne-STI eyodwa eyenziwa yizilwane ezincela igazi labanye (trichomoniasis) ngokuvamile ziyelapheka ngemithi ekhona, esebenza ngendlela efanele yomthamo owodwa noma imithamo eminingi yemithi elwa namagciwane. Kuma-STI avela kumavayirasi (i-HIV, i-HSV kanye ne-HTLV-1), imithi esebenza ngempumelelo etholakalayo yimithi elwa namavayirasi noma elwa nomdlavuza (esimweni se-HTLV-1), engashintsha inkambo yezifo, nakuba ingakwazi ukwelapha lezi zifo ezintathu.

Endaweni yokulawula ivektha, kunemikhiqizo emisha engama-28 emgqeni weR&D. Amathuluzi ahlolwayo ahlanganisa, isibonelo, izinhlobo ezintsha zamanethi ezilashwe ngemithi yokubulala izinambuzane, ama-bait aqondiwe aheha omiyane, izinto ezixosha indawo, izinto ezibulalayo zendlu (ama-eaves tubes) kanye nobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo omiyane. Abacwaningi babeka eqhulwini ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha ezingezona ze-ACT emkhakheni wemithi elwa nomalaleveva ngenxa yokuvela nokusabalala kokumelana ne-artemisinin. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithi yesizukulwane esilandelayo, efana ne-"triple ACTs", esebenzisa inhlanganisela ye-artemisinin kanye nemithi emibili yabalingani, kuyaqhubeka ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokumelana nemithi. Amanothi kumhleli: Ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe ngomkhankaso weWHO World Malaria Day, vakashela: https://www.who.int/campaigns/world-malaria-day/2023

Izinkinga ezibalulekile Izingxoxo ezibalulekile nezinqumo kulindeleke ukuthi zenzeke kulokhu: Ukubuyekezwa komsebenzi we-WHO ezimweni eziphuthumayo zezempilo, okuhlanganisa i-International Health Regulations kanye nokuqinisa ukulungela kweWHO kanye nokusabela ezimweni eziphuthumayo zezempilo; Amasu kanye nesenzo somhlaba wonke ezindaweni ezinjengempilo yabesifazane, izingane kanye nentsha, ukubuyiselwa esimweni, ukufinyelela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, imithi yendabuko, ukuvimbela kanye nokulawula ukutheleleka ngezifo, imithi esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhelwe amanga, impilo yabangenandawo kanye nabafuduki, izifo ezingathathelani, impilo yengqondo, izinqumo zomphakathi, ukudla okunomsoco kanye nokukhubazeka; Ukugunyazwa koHlelo loHlelomali lweWHO lwango-2024-2025, okuhlanganisa isinqumo sokwandisa iminikelo ehlolwe kanye nezinye izindaba ezivela kuQembu Lokusebenza kuSizinda seZimali.

Uhlelo lwe-mRNA Technology Transfer Programme ludlulela esigabeni esilandelayo sokuthuthuka kwalo Ukugcotshwa kwesikhungo se-mRNA technology Hub e-Afrigen, eNingizimu Afrika. Ababambisani bahlangana eKapa ukuze baxoxe ngesigaba esilandelayo sokuthuthukiswa komgomo we-mRNA kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi. Abahlanganyeli bamazwe angaphandle abangaphezu kwama-200 abasebenza noHlelo lwe-mRNA Technology Transfer bahlangana eKapa kuleli sonto emhlanganweni wabo wokuqala ubuso nobuso. Ujoyine uMqondisi Jikelele weNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO), uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noDkt Joe Phaahla, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni, uMnuz Ebrahim Patel waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezikhulu ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezivela emazweni axhasayo, lo mhlangano oyingqayizivele ubukeze inqubekelaphambili kusukela iWHO neMedicines Patent Pool (MPP) yiyethula ngoNhlangulana 2021.

Ngiyajabula ukuthi iWHO izokwakha ezimisweni zokulondoloza ubumfihlo kanye nobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu besitifiketi se-EU ukuze idale ithuluzi lomhlaba wonke lokulwa nobhubhane oluzayo,” kwengeza uThierry Breton, uKhomishana Wezimakethe Zangaphakathi. Uhlelo lweWHO lomhlaba wonke olwakha efeni le-EU Olunye lwezinto ezibalulekile emsebenzini we-European Union wokulwa nobhubhane lweCOVID-19 kube yizitifiketi zeCOVID-19 zedijithali. Ukuze kube lula ukuhamba ngokukhululekile ngaphakathi kwemingcele yalo, i-EU isheshe yasungula izitifiketi zeCOVID-19 ezisebenzisanayo (ezibizwa ngokuthi yi-'EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate' noma i-'EU DCC'). Ngokusekelwe kubuchwepheshe obuvulekile kanye nezindinganiso ivumele futhi ukuxhumana kwamazwe angekho e-EU akhipha izitifiketi ngokuvumelana nokucaciswa kwe-EU DCC, okuba yisixazululo esisetshenziswa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke.

AmaSTI avela kumagciwane ahlanganisa iHIV, iherpes simplex virus (HSV), i-viral hepatitis B, i-human papillomavirus (HPV) kanye ne-human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) ayinazo noma anezindlela ezilinganiselwe zokwelapha. Imithi yokugoma iyatholakala ye-hepatitis B ukuze kuvinjelwe ukutheleleka okungaholela kumdlavuza wesibindi kanye ne-HPV ukuze kuvinjelwe umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho. I-HIV, i-HSV kanye neHTLV-1 yizifo ezithathelwana impilo yonke: kuHIV kanye ne-HSV kunezindlela zokwelapha ezingacindezela igciwane, kodwa okwamanje azikho izindlela zokwelapha zanoma iyiphi yalezi STI ezibangelwa amagciwane. Amakhondomu asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele futhi ngokungaguquguquki ayizindlela eziphumelelayo zokuzivikela ezifweni ezithathelwana ngocansi kanye neHIV. Ukuhlola ngokuxilongwa kusenesikhathi kwabantu abane-STI kanye nabalingani babo bobulili kunikeza ithuba elihle kakhulu lokwelashwa ngendlela efanele kanye nokuvimbela izinkinga kanye nokutheleleka okwengeziwe.

Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane Uhlolojikelele: Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane - ikakhulukazi udlame olubhekiswe kubalingani abasondelene kanye nodlame lwezocansi - luyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi kanye neyomtholampilo kanye nokwephulwa kwamalungelo abantu besifazane. Lusekelwe futhi luqhubeka ukungalingani ngokobulili. Emhlabeni wonke owesifazane oyedwa kwabathathu ubhekana nodlame olungokomzimba kanye/noma lwezocansi empilweni yakhe, ikakhulukazi ngomlingani oseduze. Lesi yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sobukhulu bokungalingani ngokobulili kanye nokucwaswa kwabesifazane. I-United Nations ichaza udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokuthi "noma yisiphi isenzo sodlame olusekelwe ebulilini oluholela, noma okungenzeka luholele, ekulimaleni ngokomzimba, ngokocansi, noma ngokwengqondo noma ukuhlupheka kwabesifazane, okuhlanganisa izinsongo zalezo zenzo, ukuphoqelelwa noma ukuncishwa inkululeko ngokungenangqondo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kwenzeka emphakathini noma empilweni yangasese.

Cishe u-20% wokuzibulala emhlabeni wonke kwakungenxa yokuzilimaza ngemithi yokubulala izinambuzane. Nakuba ukuxhumana phakathi kokuzibulala nezimo zempilo yengqondo (ikakhulukazi, ingcindezi kanye nokuphazamiseka kokuphuza utshwala) kanye nokuzama ukuzibulala kwangaphambilini kusungulwe kahle emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu, ukuzibulala okuningi kwenzeka ngokuzenzekelayo ngezikhathi zobunzima. Izici eziyingozi ezengeziwe zokuzibulala zihlanganisa isipiliyoni sokulahlekelwa, isizungu, ukucwaswa, ukuhlukana kobudlelwane, izinkinga zezimali, ubuhlungu obungapheli nokugula, ubudlova, ukuhlukunyezwa, kanye nezingxabano noma ezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zokusiza abantu. Ukucwaswa okuphathelene nezimo zempilo yengqondo kanye nokuzibulala kusho ukuthi abantu abaningi abacabanga ukuzibulala abafuni usizo. Ukuzibulala kanye nokuzama ukuzibulala kunomthelela othinta imindeni, abangane, osebenza nabo, imiphakathi kanye nemiphakathi.

Imililo yasehlathini Uhlolojikelele: Imililo yasehlathini iyanda emhlabeni wonke ngobuningi, ubukhali kanye nobude besikhathi, okwandisa isidingo sokuqonda imiphumela yezempilo yokuchayeka emlilweni wasehlathini. Ingozi yemililo yasehlathini ikhula ezimweni ezomile kakhulu, njengesomiso, amagagasi okushisa kanye nangesikhathi semimoya enamandla. Intuthu yemililo yasehlathini iyinhlanganisela yezinto eziyingozi ezingcolisa umoya, njenge-PM2.5, i-NO2, i-ozone, ama-hydrocarbon anamakha, noma umthofu. Ngaphezu kokunukubeza umoya ngezinto eziyingozi, imililo yasehlathini nayo inomthelela ngesikhathi esifanayo esimweni sezulu ngokukhipha inani elikhulu lekhabhoni diokside namanye amagesi abamba ukushisa emkhathini. Ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu okuholela emazingeni okushisa afudumele nezimo ezomile kanye nokwanda kokuhlala emadolobheni ezindaweni zasemakhaya, inkathi yemililo iqala kusenesikhathi futhi iphele kamuva.

Intuthuko esimeme Uhlolojikelele: Intuthuko esimeme yigama elibanzi lokuchaza izinqubomgomo, amaphrojekthi kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okuhlinzeka ngezinzuzo namuhla ngaphandle kokudela imvelo, inhlalakahle yomphakathi kanye nempilo yomuntu siqu esikhathini esizayo. Lezi zinqubomgomo zivame ukuchazwa ngokuthi ziluhlaza ngoba zigxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wentuthuko emvelweni. Nokho, izinzuzo zentuthuko esimeme zibonakala nasezingxenyeni eziningi zempilo yabantu kanye nenhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukuncishiswa kokungcola kanye nezifo ezihlobene nemvelo, imiphumela yezempilo ethuthukisiwe kanye nokwehla kwengcindezi.
