Njengoba izinsongo zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ziba zibaluleke ngokwengeziwe, amasu okuzuza kokubili okunciphisa, ukuthuthukisa impilo kanye nokonga izindleko anikeza uhla lwezinzuzo kubabambiqhaza abahlukahlukene.

Amazwe ayi-10 anamanani aphezulu kakhulu okukhuluphala emhlabeni wonke yiSIDS ePacific, lapho abantu abadala abangaphezu kuka-45% bephila nokukhuluphala ngokweqile. Izimo zempilo yengqondo zivamile emazweni eSIDS, ezithinta abantu abalinganiselwa ku-15.2% eCaribbean kanye no-11.2% wabantu basePacific. Abantu abanezimo zempilo yengqondo babhekene nengozi enkulu yokushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okuhlanganisa nezimo zempilo ezingabhekelelwa kanye nokuzibulala. Ukucwaswa, ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi abakhethekile kanye nomthelela wokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kunomthelela esimweni esiyinselele kuSIDS esidinga ukunakwa ngokushesha. Isimemezelo sika-2023 saseBridgetown sichaza izinyathelo ezinesibindi zokubhekana nezinkinga eziningi zezenhlalo, ezemvelo, ezomnotho nezentengiselwano eziholela kumaNCD kanye nezimo zempilo yengqondo.

Umsebenzi weWHO ekuvimbeleni nasekulawuleni ukutheleleka ngesifo Isixazululo somlando sivula indlela yokuqinisa ukubuyiselwa esimweni ezinhlelweni zezempilo Namuhla iWorld Health Assembly ivumile isinqumo esiyingqophamlando ngokuqinisa ukubuyiselwa esimweni ezinhlelweni zezempilo. Izinsizakalo zokubuyiselwa esimweni zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukujabulela amalungelo abantu okuhlanganisa izinga eliphakeme kakhulu elingafinyeleleka ngokuphathelene nempilo yomzimba kanye nengqondo. Iphinde ikhuthaze impilo yezocansi kanye nokuzala, futhi ibone ilungelo lokusebenza nelungelo lemfundo. Lesi sinqumo esiyingqophamlando sihlose ukubhekana nezinselele ekubuyiseleni esimweni esinjengesidingo: ukwandisa ukuqwashisa ngokubuyiselwa esimweni lapho kubekwa izinto eziza kuqala kwezempilo kanye nama-ajenda ocwaningo, ukwaba izinsiza, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kanye nokuvumela ukudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe;

Lokhu kuzolandela izinto eziza kuqala ezihlonzwe ngeziphakamiso eziyishumi zokuqinisa ukwakhiwa komhlaba wonke kokulungela ukuphuthumayo kwezempilo, ukusabela, kanye nokuqina (HEPR). I-PRET Initiative iletha inkathi entsha yokulungela ubhubhane futhi imele ukuvela kwemisebenzi eyinhloko yeWHO ukusekela wonke amazwe angamalungu ekuqiniseni ukulungela okuphuthumayo kwezempilo, ukuvimbela, kanye namandla okusabela. Isinyathelo singase futhi sisebenzele ukusebenzisa izinhloso kanye nezinhlinzeko zeSivumelwano Sobhubhane, okwamanje okuxoxiswana ngaso Amazwe Angamalungu eWHO. Ukulandela okufakiwe kanye nezingxoxo phakathi kwabahlanganyeli bomhlangano, iWHO imema ababambiqhaza kulolu cingo lomhlaba wonke lokuthatha isinyathelo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulungela ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula. Shayela ucingo ukuze uthathe isinyathelo

Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi kwezenhlalo-mnotho, kube nomthelela ekulahlekelweni okuhlobene ekukhiqizeni kanye nokwengeza izindleko kumuntu ngamunye kanye nohlelo lwezempilo lukazwelonke. Cishe bazofinyelela iziguli ezimweni lapho kunokufinyelela okunomkhawulo emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphezulu nephephile, ukwenganyelwa kabi kanye namandla obuchwepheshe abuthakathaka. Nakuba le nkinga ithinta wonke amazwe, amazwe lapho kunezinhlelo zokulawula ezibuthakathaka noma ezingekho athwala umthwalo omkhulu wemikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe. Ezweni eliya libumbene ngokwengeziwe, alikho izinsiza kanye namandla anele ezwe elilodwa ukubhekana nalolu daba ngokwahlukaniswa. Ngezinhlelo nezinqubo zomhlaba wonke ezifana ne-WHO Global Surveillance and Monitoring System kanye neWHO Member State Mechanism,

Kusukela kwaqala ubhubhane, iWHO ibambe iqhaza kuzo zonke izifunda zeWHO ukuchaza imihlahlandlela ephelele yezitifiketi ezinjalo. Ukusiza ukuqinisa ukulungela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke lapho kubhekene nezinsongo zezempilo ezikhulayo, iWHO isungula inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke yokuqinisekisa ezempilo yedijithali eyakhela ezisekelweni eziqinile zohlaka lwe-EU DCC, izimiso kanye nobuchwepheshe obuvulekile. Ngalokhu kubambisana, iWHO izosiza le nqubo emhlabeni wonke ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sayo ngenhloso yokuvumela umhlaba wonke ukuthi uzuze ngokuhlangana kwezitifiketi zedijithali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubeka indinganiso kanye nokuqinisekisa amasiginesha edijithali ukuvimbela ukukhwabanisa. Ngokwenza kanjalo, iWHO ngeke ikwazi ukufinyelela kunoma iyiphi idatha yomuntu siqu eyisisekelo, ebingaqhubeka nokuba yindawo ekhethekile yohulumeni.

"Sinezinto zokwenza ukwehlisa umalaleveva, iphakethe lokungenelela okufaka ukulawula izilwane ezithwala igciwane, imithi yokuvimbela, ukuhlola, nokwelashwa," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. "Lokhu kuhlangene nomgomo womalaleveva ophephile futhi osebenza ngendlela efanele, ongagcina izimpilo zamashumi ezinkulungwane zezingane minyaka yonke. Ngokutshalwa kwezimali okuqhubekayo kanye nemizamo eyandisiwe yokufinyelela kulabo abasengozini enkulu, ukuqedwa kukamalaleveva emazweni amaningi kuyafinyeleleka. "Usuku Lomhlaba Lomalaleveva lwango-2023 lugujwa ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi “Isikhathi sokuletha umalaleveva ongekho: tshala imali, yenza kabusha, sebenzisa.” Ngaphakathi kwalesi sihloko, iWHO ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo okwengeziwe kwamathuluzi namasu atholakalayo okuvimbela, ukuxilonga nokwelapha umalaleveva, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abalahliwe.

Isebenza ngendlela efanele, iphephile, futhi ayibizi kakhulu. Ngisho noma ukutheleleka kabusha kungenzeka ngemva kokwelashwa, ingozi yokuba nesifo esibi iyancipha futhi ibuyiselwe emuva lapho ukwelashwa kuqalwa futhi kuphindaphindwa ebuntwaneni. Ukulawulwa kwe-schistosomiasis kusetshenziswe ngempumelelo eminyakeni engu-40 edlule emazweni amaningana, okuhlanganisa iBrazil, iCambodia, iChina, i-Egypt, iMauritius, i-Islamic Republic of Iran, i-Oman, iJordani, iSaudi Arabia, iMorocco, iTunisia, njll. EBurundi, eBurkina Faso, eGhana, eNiger, eRwanda, eSierra Leone, e-United Republic of Tanzania, naseYemen, kuye kwenzeka ukukhuphula ukwelashwa kwe-schistosomiasis ezingeni likazwelonke futhi kube nomthelela kulesi sifo eminyakeni embalwa. Ukuhlolwa kwesimo sokudluliselwa kudingeka emazweni amaningana.

I-WHO inxusa ukuthi kwengezwe ukuqaliswa kwamathuluzi anconyiwe okulwa nomalaleveva Ukugubha uSuku Lomhlaba Lwamalaleveva, iNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) ikhipha isimemo sokuthi kwengezwe ukuqaliswa kokungenelela okusha nokukhona ukuze kusindiswe izimpilo kumalaleveva. Cishe izingane eziyizigidi eziyi-1.5 ezisengozini enkulu yokugula nokufa ngenxa kamalaleveva eGhana, eKenya naseMalawi manje sezithole umthamo wazo wokuqala womuthi wokugomela umalaleveva wokuqala, iRTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S), ngenxa yohlelo oluqhubekayo lokulinganisa oluhlelwe yiWHO. Imishanguzo yokugomela umalaleveva, eyethulwe ngo-2019, yandisa ukulingana ekufinyeleleni ekuvimbeleni umalaleveva kwabasengozini kakhulu futhi isindisa izimpilo. Uma isetshenziswa kabanzi, iWHO ilinganisela ukuthi imithi yokugomela umalaleveva ingasindisa izimpilo zamashumi ezinkulungwane zezingane unyaka ngamunye.

Minyaka yonke uSuku Lomhlaba Lokungabhemi luhlonipha labo abenza umehluko ekulawuleni ugwayi. Kulonyaka omunye wabawinile, uNksz Sprina Robi Chacha, umlimi wesifazane waseKenya, uqashelwa hhayi nje kuphela ngokushintsha ukulima ugwayi ukuya kumabhontshisi anamaprotheni amaningi, kodwa futhi nokuqeqesha amakhulu abanye abalimi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani lokhu ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Amaqembu angu-182 eWHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control azibophezele ekutheni “...ukukhuthaza ezinye izindlela ezisebenzayo ngokomnotho zabasebenzi bakagwayi nabakhiqizi.” Indlela ebalulekile amazwe angagcwalisa ngayo lesi sibopho ukunqamula izibonelelo zokutshala ugwayi nokusekela izitshalo ezinempilo. Ngokukhetha ukutshala ukudla esikhundleni sikagwayi, sibeka impilo phambili, silondoloze imvelo, futhi sandise ukuvikeleka kokudla.

Umbiko uphawula ukuthi ingane eyodwa kuphela kweziyishumi (<28 amasonto) ezelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi (<28 amasonto) ephila emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi, uma kuqhathaniswa nezingaphezu kweziyi-9 kweziyi-10 emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu. Ukungalingani okungalingani okuhlobene nohlanga, ubuzwe, imali engenayo, kanye nokuthola ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi kunquma amathuba okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ukufa, nokukhubazeka, ngisho nasemazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu. I-Southern Asia kanye ne-sub-Saharan Africa inamanani aphezulu kakhulu okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kulezi zifunda zibhekene nengozi enkulu yokushona. Ngokubambisana, lezi zifunda ezimbili zibalela ngaphezu kuka-65% wokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi emhlabeni jikelele. Umbiko uphinde ugcizelele ukuthi imithelela yezingxabano, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kanye nomonakalo wemvelo, iCOVID-19, kanye nokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kwandisa izingozi kwabesifazane kanye nezingane yonke indawo.

Ngo-1996, eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wama-49, Amazwe Angamalungu anquma ukuthi lesi sitoko sichithwe ngoNhlangulana 1999, futhi avumele kuphela amasampula amancane ukuthi agcinwe ngezinjongo zocwaningo kumalabhorethri amabili agunyaziwe - elilodwa e-United States nelinye eRussian Federation. Ukugcinwa kwesikhashana kwamasheya akhona evariola virus kusetshenziselwa ukuqhubeka kocwaningo olubalulekile, olubhekwa yiKomidi Lokweluleka Lokucwaninga NgeVariola Virus. Leli qembu lihlangana minyaka yonke. I-World Health Organization (WHO) Smallpox Secretariat ezinze eNhloko-dolobha yeWHO ixhumanisa yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nokuqedwa kwesifo senhliziyo kanye nangemva kokuqedwa kwayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwengamela ucwaningo olugunyaziwe ngevariola virus ephilayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinyathelo ezinjengomgomo kanye nemithi elwa namagciwane.

Kusukela enkathini yokuqedwa, imithi yokugoma ephephile kanye nokwelashwa okuthile kuye kwasungulwa ngengxibongo kanye nezifo ezihlobene nayo njengengxibongo. UNobhala uphinde abe nesibopho sokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo futhi uphatha ukugcinwa komuthi wokugomela ingxibongo esimweni esingalindelekile sokuthi lesi sifo siphinde sivele. Unobhala ulawula ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kanye nokuvikeleka kwezinto eziphilayo kwezinqolobane zegciwane levariola ezigunyaziwe njengoba kugunyazwe iWorld Health Assembly, futhi uqinisekisa ukubikwa kwaminyaka yonke kuziNhlangano Ezilawulayo zeWHO. Unobhala weSmallpox usekela i-WHO Archives ekulondolozeni umlando womhlaba wonke wengxibongo kanye nokubhala phansi izifundo ezifundwe ekuqedeni ngempumelelo ingxibongo. Izindima nezibopho zamanje ze-Secretariat yeWHO zihlanganisa:

Ukusebenza kuyo yonke imikhakha nokuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwezinqubomgomo ezindaweni ezihlukene kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha izindawo ezisekelayo nezivumelayo zezempilo, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ukucatshangelwa kwezempilo kanye nokulingana kuhlanganiswa kuyo yonke inqubo yokuhlela, ukutshalwa kwezimali kanye nezinqumo zenqubomgomo ezingeni lendawo. Ukusiza Amazwe Angamalungu ukuthi abhekane nalezi zinto ezibalulekile ezingenhla, iWHO isebenzela ukuqinisa isisekelo sobufakazi ukuze isize abenzi bezinqubomgomo bathathe izinqumo ezinolwazi lapho bebhekana nezingozi zezempilo. Inikeza amathuluzi nesiqondiso sokuthi yini esebenzayo, futhi isekela ukuqapha izinkomba ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezempilo. I-WHO ihola futhi ibandakanyeka ekuthuthukiseni ukushintshana kwamadolobha kanye nokusiza ukuthuthukisa izinhlaka zezikhungo kanye nenqubomgomo yokwengamela okuhle kwamadolobha kwezempilo kanye nenhlalakahle emadolobheni.

Ukuqinisa amandla ezwe ezinhlelweni zezempilo nabahlinzeki ukuze kuvinjelwe futhi kubhekwane nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane. Ukukhuthaza ubuholi ezinhlelweni zezempilo kanye nokwakha intando yezepolitiki yokubhekana nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokukhulumela kanye nokubambisana. Uhlelo Lomsebenzi LweWHO 13th General Programme of Work (GPW) lubandakanya udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane njengengxenye yomnikelo walo kuSustainable Development Goal (SDG) 5 mayelana nokulingana ngokobulili kanye nokuhlomisa abesifazane (ikakhulukazi, iSDG 5.2 ngokuqedwa kodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kanye namantombazane). Emhlanganweni weZempilo woMhlaba ngoNhlaba 2016, Amazwe Angamalungu agunyaze uhlelo lomhlaba wonke lokwenza ngokuqinisa indima yezinhlelo zezempilo ekubhekaneni nodlame phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kanye namantombazane kanye nasezinganeni.

Kodwa-ke, iningi labantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-4.2 abahlala emadolobheni bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezindlu kanye nezokuthutha, ukungabhekeleli kahle ukukhucululwa kwendle kanye nokuphathwa kwemfucuza, kanye nekhwalithi yomoya ehluleka ukuhambisana neziqondiso zeWHO. Ezinye izinhlobo zokunukubezeka, njengomsindo, ukunukubezeka kwamanzi kanye nenhlabathi, okubizwa ngokuthi iziqhingi ezishisayo zasemadolobheni, kanye nokuntuleka kwendawo yokuhambahamba, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili kanye nokuphila ngendlela esebenzayo kuhlangana ukuze kwenze amadolobha abe yizikhungo zobhubhane lwezifo ezingathathelani kanye nabashayeli bezinguquko zesimo sezulu. I-WHO Repository on Urban Health Impact: Cishe u-40% wokukhula kwamadolobha usezindaweni ezisemaphandleni ezingenamanzi aphephile kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle, futhi u-91% wabantu abasemadolobheni baphefumula umoya ongcolile. Uma kukhulunywa ngokudla okunempilo, ukufuduka kwabantu kwenyuka ibanga ukusuka epulazini ukuya emafolokini, okushayela isidingo sokudla okungenampilo, okucutshunguliwe.

UDkt Balkhy uneziqu zobudokotela ngokukhethekile ezifweni ezithathelwanayo zezingane. UDkt Catharina Boehme uzoba nguMqondisi Jikelele Wosizi, Ezokuxhumana Ngaphandle kanye Nokwengamela kusukela ngomhlaka-4 kuNhlaba 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Boehme uzohola ukuzibandakanya kwesu leWHO ezindaweni zokwengamela, ukuqoqwa kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nobudlelwano bomlingani. Iphothifoliyo yakhe izofaka izinqubo ezibalulekile zeMember States, njengokuxoxisana kwabo ngesivumelwano sobhubhane, ukuguqulwa kokwengamela kweWHO kanye nokuqaliswa kwezincomo mayelana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme. UDkt Boehme ubesebenza njengoMqondisi-Jikelele weChef de Cabinet phakathi nesikhathi lapho ehola khona umbono wabaholi, eqinisekisa ukuqondanisa kuyo yonke iNhlangano kanye namaZwe angamaLungu kanye nabalingani.

Ujoyine iWHO ngo-2021, ngaphambi kokuba abe yiChief Executive Officer yeFIND, umfelandawonye wamazwe omhlaba wokuxilonga. UDkt Boehme uneziqu zobudokotela kanye namadiploma kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye nokwengamela. UDkt Chikwe Ihekweazu uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele woPhiko lweZokuxilonga kanye Nezinhlelo Zokugada Ezimo Eziphuthumayo kuHlelo lweZimo Eziphuthumayo. Njengengxenye yephothifoliyo yakhe, uDkt Ihekweazu uhola iWHO Hub yePandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ehlanganisa abalingani ukuze babhekane nobhubhane oluzayo kanye nezingozi zobhubhane ngokufinyelela okungcono kudatha, amandla okuhlaziya, namathuluzi okuthatha izinqumo. Ngaphambi kokujoyina iWHO, uDkt Ihekweazu wayenguMqondisi-Jikelele wokuqala weNigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), kusukela ngo-2016 kuya ku-2021.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa ngenhlonipho nokusekela uma kwenzeka kufa. Ukulalela okuhlangenwe nakho namazwi abesifazane kanye nemiphakathi yabo kubalulekile ukuze kusize ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zokucwaswa okuhlobene nokubeletha. Impendulo yeWHO: Kudingeka kwenziwe okwengeziwe ukuze kuhlanganiswe ukuvimbela ukubeletha ngaphakathi kwe-ajenda yomhlaba wonke neyezwe lonke yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okusezingeni eliphezulu kwabesifazane, intsha, kanye nezinsana. NgeGlobal Strategy for Women's, Children's and Adolescents Health 2016–2030 kanye nokusebenzisa izincomo ze-Every Newborn Action Plan (2014), iWHO isebenzela ukuqeda ukubeletha okungavinjelwa, njengengxenye yemizamo yokuthuthukisa impilo kamama, osanda kuzalwa, ingane kanye nentsha. Iningi lokubeletha alitholi isitifiketi sokuzalwa futhi alibhalisiwe.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zesifunda noma zombuso ezincane zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ku-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha ngephakheji yezinsiza ezibalulekile kanye nemikhiqizo yokunakekelwa kwe-palliative eyakhiwe ngokwe-WHO Model List of Essential Medicines kanye ne-WHO Essential Package of Palliative Care. Futhi zihlanganisa ukuthuthukisa ukwengamela, ukwenza lula izinqubo zokuthengwa kwempahla kanye nokuhlinzekwa ukuze kubhekwane nanoma yikuphi ukungasebenzi kahle, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza ezinjengokuxhaswa ngezimali okuzinzile, ukuthuthukisa amakhono anekhono abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nokuqwashisa ngazo zombili izinzuzo kanye nokulimala okungase kube khona kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid. Impumelelo yalezi zenzo izoncika ekubambisaneni nasekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwabo bonke ababambiqhaza kuzwelonke, esifundeni, nasemazingeni omhlaba.

Nakuba amaqanda e-tapeworm athelela izingulube, amaqanda e-T. solium nawo angathelela abantu uma edliwe umuntu (ngendlela yendle, noma ngokudla ukudla noma amanzi angcolile). Ukudla amaqanda e-tapeworm kubangela ukutheleleka nge-parasite yezibungu ezicutshini ezinjengemisipha, isikhumba, amehlo kanye nohlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi (i-cysticercosis yomuntu), okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni. Lapho ama-cyst akhula ebuchosheni, lesi simo sibizwa ngokuthi i-neurocysticercosis. Izimpawu: I-Taeniasis ngokuvamile ibonakala ngezimpawu ezingatheni futhi ezingacacile ezihlobene nokutheleleka kwamathumbu (ubuhlungu besisu, isicanucanu, isifo sohudo, njll.). Lezi zimpawu zingaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho itapeworm isifa ngemva kokwelashwa, kungenjalo ingase iphile iminyaka.

Amalungelo ezocansi: Kukhona ukuvumelana okukhulayo kokuthi impilo yocansi ayikwazi ukutholakala futhi igcinwe ngaphandle kokuhlonipha, nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo athile abantu. Incazelo esebenzayo yamalungelo ocansi enikezwe ngezansi iwumnikelo engxoxweni eqhubekayo ngamalungelo abantu ahlobene nempilo yocansi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamalungelo abantu akhona ocansini kanye nempilo yocansi kwakha amalungelo ocansi. Amalungelo ocansi avikela wonke amalungelo abantu okufeza nokuveza ubulili babo futhi bajabulele impilo yocansi, ngokucabangela ngokufanele amalungelo abanye kanye nohlaka lokuvikelwa ngokumelene nokucwaswa." (WHO, 2006a, kubuyekezwe ngo-2010) "Ukugcwaliseka kwezempilo yocansi kuxhumene nezinga amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa, avikelwe futhi agcwaliseka ngalo.

UDkt Ryan uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu ze-master kwezempilo yomphakathi. UMnuz Raul Thomas uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele Wezokusebenza Kwebhizinisi. UMnuz Thomas unesibopho esiphelele semisebenzi yebhizinisi leWHO, okuhlanganisa isabelomali, ezezimali, izinsiza zabantu, ukuphatha, ukuhlola, ukuphathwa kwengozi, ukuziphendulela kanye nokulandela umthetho, kanye nokwengamela okujwayelekile. Unesibopho sokusebenzisa imizamo eminingi ngaphansi kwe-ajenda yenguquko yeNhlangano kanye nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enenhlonipho, ebandakanya wonke umuntu. Phakathi neminyaka yakhe engama-20 esebenza neWHO, uMnuz Thomas usebenze ezifundeni zase-Afrika, eMelika, eMpumalanga yeMedithera naseNtshonalanga Pacific, kanye ne-International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).

"Lokhu kuyimpumelelo emangalisayo yezempilo yomphakathi," kusho uDkt Ibrahima Socé Fall, uMqondisi woHlelo lwe-NTD yeWHO yomhlaba wonke. "I-Benin neMali zibonisa indlela intando yezepolitiki enamandla, ukuhlanganiswa kwemikhakha ehlukene, ukubhekwa kanye nokuzibandakanya komphakathi kungasebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuqedwe izifo." Inqubekelaphambili ebalulekile yenziwe ekulweni ne-trachoma eminyakeni embalwa edlule. Inani labantu abadinga ukwelashwa ngemithi elwa namagciwane nge-trachoma eSifundeni se-Afrika seWHO lehle ngezigidi ezingama-84, lisuka ezigidini eziyi-189 ngo-2014 laya ezigidini eziyi-105 kusukela ngoNhlangulana 2022. Inothi kumhleli: I-trachoma isalokhu iyinkinga yezempilo yomphakathi emazweni angama-41 (kusukela ngoNhlangulana 2022) nabantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyi-125 abahlala ezindaweni ezidinga ukungenelela ngokumelene nalesi sifo.

ukubandakanya kakhulu umphakathi; futhi usebenze namaZwe angamaLungu ukuqinisa izikhuthazo zokubambisana ngobuholi bezepolitiki, isiqondiso sokubusa kanye nokuxhasa ngezimali ukusekela ukubambisana. Okutholakele okubalulekile kulo mbiko kuzodla ezingxoxweni ze-United Nations General Assembly SDG Summit elandelayo kanye neHigh-Level Meeting on Universal Health Coverage ngoMandulo wezi-2023. Izinyanga eziholela kulezi zehlakalo ezibalulekile zinikeza ithuba lokugqugquzela ngokuhlanganyela ngamazwe angamalungu kanye nama-ejensi amazwe amaningi ukuhlonza izindlela zokusebenzisa iziphakamiso kanye nokulungiselela indawo yokusebenzisa ngokugcwele ukubambisana okunamandla futhi kusheshise inqubekelaphambili maqondana namaSDG ahlobene nezempilo engxenyeni yesibili yesikhathi seSDG. Inothi kumhleli:

Ubudlova bomlingani obuseduze bubhekisela ekuziphatheni komlingani oseduze noma owayengumlingani obangela ukulimala ngokomzimba, ngokocansi noma ngokwengqondo, okuhlanganisa ukucasuka ngokomzimba, ukuphoqelelwa ngokocansi, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo kanye nokuziphatha kokulawula. Udlame lwezocansi "noma yikuphi ukwenza ngokocansi, ukuzama ukuthola isenzo socansi, noma esinye isenzo esiqondiswe ebulilini bomuntu kusetshenziswa ukuphoqelelwa, yinoma yimuphi umuntu kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhlobene kanjani nesisulu, kunoma yisiphi isimo. Kuhlanganisa ukudlwengula, okuchazwa njengokuphoqelelwa ngokomzimba noma ngandlela-thile ukungena ngomlomo noma ngesitho sangasese somuntu, esinye isitho somzimba noma into." Umthelela: Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga yomhlaba wonke yezilinganiso zobhubhane. Kubangela ukulimala okukhulu, ukulimala ezimpilweni zabesifazane kanye nezingane zabo.

Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha - Ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke: 29 kuNhlaba 2023 Isinqumo esiyingqophamlando sokuqinisa impilo Yabantu Bomdabu emhlabeni jikelele Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba namuhla ugunyaze isinqumo esingakaze senziwe ngaphambili ngokuphathelene nempilo Yabantu Bomdabu, esicela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi athuthukise uhlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke ngokuphathelene nempilo yabantu bomdabu futhi alethule kuMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesishiyagalolunye ngo-2026. Abantu Bomdabu, nakuba bemele amaqembu ahlukahlukene abantu nemiphakathi, ngokuvamile banesikhathi sokuphila esiphansi kakhulu kunabantu abangewona abomdabu. Baphinde babe nokwanda okuphezulu kwezifo eziningi nezimo zempilo ezimbi, ezihlanganisa isifo sikashukela, ukushona komama kanye nezinsana kanye nokungondleki.

Emhlabeni jikelele, iBenin neMali bajoyina amanye amazwe ayi-15 aqinisekiswe yiWHO ngokuqeda i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi. Lawa yiCambodia, iChina, iGambia, iGhana, i-Islamic Republic of Iran, iLao People's Democratic Republic, iMalawi, iMexico, iMorocco, iMyanmar, iNepal, i-Oman, iSaudi Arabia, iTogo neVanuatu. Ukuqedwa kwe-trachoma kusetshenziswa isu le-WHO leSAFE Kokubili iBenin neMali basebenzise isu leSAFE elinconywe yiWHO ukuqeda i-trachoma ngokusekelwa yiWHO kanye nabalingani. Isu leSAFE liqukethe ukuhlinzwa ukuze kwelashwe izinkinga ze-trachoma ezibambezelekile; ama-antibiotic ukuze kususwe ukutheleleka; ukuhlanzeka kobuso; kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ezungezile, ikakhulukazi ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela emanzini kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle, ukuze kuncishiswe ukutheleleka.

Kuyimbangela ehamba phambili emhlabeni wonke yokufa kwezingane okuhlobene nokulimala. Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, abantu abayizigidi ezingu-2.5 babulawa ukugwiliza, futhi ngaphezu kuka-90% walokho kwenzeka emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi nendawo. Ngesimemo soMhlangano Jikelele weZizwe Ezihlangene (UN), iWHO izoxhumanisa izenzo ngaphakathi kohlelo lwe-UN mayelana nokuvimbela ukugwiliza futhi yenze kube lula ukugcinwa koSuku Lomhlaba Lokuvimbela Ukugwiliza ngomhla zingama-25 kuNtulikazi minyaka yonke. I-WHO izophinde isungule iGlobal Alliance for Drowning Prevention nezinhlangano zohlelo lwe-UN, abalingani bezentuthuko bamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Ukuze uqonde kangcono umthwalo wangempela nomthelela wokugwiliza, isinqumo sicela iWHO ukuthi ilungiselele umbiko wesimo somhlaba wonke mayelana nokuvimbela ukugwiliza.

Ukuze uvikeleke impilo yakho yonke, iWHO incoma ukuthi umuntu athole imithamo eyi-6 (3 eyinhloko kanye nemithamo emi-3 yokugqugquzela) yeTTCV. Uchungechunge lwemithamo emi-3 kufanele luqale kusukela emasontweni ayi-6 ubudala, nemithamo elandelayo enikezwe ngesikhathi esiphakathi kwamasonto amane phakathi kwemithamo. Imithamo emi-3 yokugqugquzela kufanele inikezwe phakathi nonyaka wesibili wokuphila (izinyanga ezingu-12-23), eminyakeni yobudala engu-4-7, kanye neminyaka yobudala engu-9-15. Ngokufanelekile, kufanele kube okungenani neminyaka emi-4 phakathi kwemithamo yokugqugquzela. Kunezinhlobo eziningi zemithi yokugoma esetshenziselwa ukuvikela i-tetanus: imithi yokugoma ye-diphtheria kanye ne-tetanus (DT) imithi yokugoma ye-diphtheria, tetanus, kanye ne-pertussis (ukukhwehlela) (DTaP) imithi yokugoma ye-tetanus kanye ne-diphtheria (Td) imithi yokugoma ye-tetanus, diphtheria, kanye ne-pertussis (Tdap) imithi yokugoma.

Izici zobungozi bendawo ezihilela ukudluliselwa kwe-trachoma zihlanganisa inhlanzeko embi, imizi egcwele ngokweqile, ukungafinyeleli ngokwanele emanzini noma ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo ezifanele zokukhucululwa kwendle. Ngo-1996, iWHO yethula iWHO Alliance for the Global Elimination of Trachoma ngonyaka wezi-2020 (GET2020). Ngabanye ababambisene ne-Alliance, iWHO isekela ukuqaliswa kwezwe kwesu leSAFE nokuqiniswa kwamandla kazwelonke ngokuhlola ubhubhane, ukuqapha, ukubhekwa, ukuhlolwa kwephrojekthi kanye nokuqoqwa kwezinsiza okufaka isandla ekuqedeni i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi. Ibalazwe lomgwaqo, eligunyazwe iWorld Health Assembly ngo-2020 ngesinqumo sayo 73(33), libeka u-2030 njengosuku olusha okuhloswe ngalo ukuqedwa komhlaba wonke.

"Ngaphandle kwezinsiza zabo ezilinganiselwe kanye nemikhawulo yendawo, lezi zizwe zibonise ukuqina okumangalisayo lapho zibhekene nobunzima. Ngokubambisana, kufanele sakhe indlela esekelwe ekulinganeni, ukuqina, kanye nokusimama. Kufanele siqinise izinhlelo zezempilo, sithuthukise izinyathelo zokuvimbela kanye nokutholwa kusenesikhathi, futhi sibeke eqhulwini ukuhlanganiswa kweNCD kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo yengqondo ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo. "UMqondisi-Jikelele uphinde wathembisa ukuthi iWHO izosebenzela ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezikwazi ukumelana nesimo sezulu, ezisimeme ngokuphathelene nemvelo eSIDS. I-WHO izoqhubeka futhi nokugqugquzela ukufunwa kwezimali ‘zokulahlekelwa kanye nomonakalo’ ukuze kushintshwe isimo sezulu kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali kokunciphisa ezweni elinemali engenayo ephansi.

Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubika ukuzalwa kanye nokushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kuyindaba yamalungelo abantu futhi kuyisidingo sokunciphisa ukuzalwa kwezingane ezifile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunesidingo sokuqinisa izinhlelo zolwazi lwezempilo ezijwayelekile ukuze zibambe ngokunembile futhi zibike ukuzalwa kwezingane ezifile ukuze ziqaphe futhi zithuthukise izinga lokunakekelwa. I-WHO ihlinzeka ngamathuluzi okusiza amazwe ukuthi athuthukise imininingwane yawo ngokuphathelene nokuzalwa kwezingane ezifile kanye nokushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. I-WHO iphinde ibe nesiqondiso sokusiza amazwe ukuthi abuyekeze futhi aphenye ukushona komuntu ngamunye ukuze akwazi ukuncoma futhi asebenzise izixazululo zokuvimbela okufanayo esikhathini esizayo kanye nohlelo olujwayelekile lokuhlukaniswa kokushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa (ICD-PM). I-WHO ne-UNICEF basekela isimemo sokuthatha isinyathelo ngokubambisana ukuze kuqedwe ukuzalwa kwezingane ezifile okungagwemeka ngokuthi:

Ukuchayeka ekubheni ugwayi kanye nakubantu abangabhenywa nabo kuye kwahlotshaniswa nemiphumela emibi yezempilo, okubangela ukufa kwabantu abayizigidi eziyi-1.2 minyaka yonke. Cishe ingxenye yazo zonke izingane iphefumula umoya ongcoliswe intuthu kagwayi futhi izingane ezingama-65 000 ziyafa unyaka ngamunye ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene nokubhema ugwayi. Ukubhema ngesikhathi ukhulelwe kungaholela ezimweni eziningana zempilo eziphila phakade ezinganeni. Imikhiqizo kagwayi efudumele (HTPs) iqukethe ugwayi futhi iveza abasebenzisi ekukhishweni okunobuthi, okuningi kwakho kubangela umdlavuza futhi kuyingozi empilweni. Izinhlelo zokulethwa kwe-nicotine nge-elekthronikhi (ENDS) kanye nezinhlelo zokulethwa kwe-elekthronikhi ezingenayo i-nicotine (ENNDS), ezivame ukubizwa ngokuthi ugwayi we-elekthronikhi, aziqukethe ugwayi futhi zingase zibe noma zingabi ne-nicotine, kodwa ziyingozi empilweni futhi ngokungangabazeki aziphephile.

Ibhulokhi yokuqala yokwakha yohlelo lweWHO lomhlaba wonke lizosebenza ngoNhlangulana 2023 futhi luhlose ukuthuthukiswa kancane kancane ezinyangeni ezizayo. Ukubambisana kwesikhathi eside kwedijithali ukuletha impilo engcono kubo bonke Ukuhlinzeka ukwamukelwa kwe-EU DCC yiWHO futhi kube nomthelela ekusebenzeni kwayo nasekuthuthukisweni okwengeziwe, iWHO kanye neKhomishini yaseYurophu bavumile ukusebenzisana kwezempilo yedijithali. Lokhu kubambisana kuzosebenzela ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bohlelo lweWHO ngendlela enezigaba ukuze kuhlanganiswe izimo zokusetshenziswa ezengeziwe, ezingase zihlanganise, isibonelo, ukudijithalizwa kweSitifiketi Sokugoma Samazwe Ngamazwe noma iProphylaxis. Ukunweba izixazululo ezinjalo zedijithali kuzobalulekile ukuze kulethe impilo engcono yezakhamizi emhlabeni wonke.

Naphezu kwenye inqubekelaphambili, abantu abaningi abasengozini enkulu yokungenwa umalaleveva basaswele ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezingavimbela, zithole futhi zelaphe lesi sifo. Izinselele ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zikamalaleveva ziye zaba nzima, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, ngenxa yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, ukuhlangana kwezinkinga zobuntu, ukuncishiswa kwezimali, izinhlelo zokuqapha ezibuthakathaka, kanye nokwehla kokusebenza kwamathuluzi abalulekile okulwa nomalaleveva. Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinsongo futhi kusekelwe amazwe ekwakheni izinhlelo zikamalaleveva eziqinile, iWHO isanda kushicilela amasu amasha nezinhlaka, okuhlanganisa: isu elisha lokunqanda ukumelana nemithi elwa nomalaleveva e-Afrika; isinyathelo esisha sokumisa ukusabalala kwe-Anopheles stephensi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni;

Abalimi bavezwa emithini yokubulala izinambuzane yamakhemikhali, intuthu kagwayi kanye ne-nicotine eningi njengoba itholakala kugwayi ongu-50 - okuholela ezifweni ezinjengezifo ezingamahlalakhona zamaphaphu kanye nobuthi be-nicotine, "kusho uDkt Ruediger Krech, uMqondisi Wokugqugquzelwa Kwezempilo eWHO. Ukutshala ugwayi kuyinkinga yomhlaba wonke. Ukugxila kuze kube manje bekuse-Asia naseNingizimu Melika, kodwa imininingwane yakamuva ibonisa ukuthi izinkampani zikagwayi ziyanda ziye e-Afrika. Kusukela ngo-2005, kube nokwanda okucishe kube ngu-20% komhlaba wokulima ugwayi kulo lonke elase-Afrika. I-WHO, i-Food and Agriculture Organization kanye neWorld Food Programme isekela isinyathelo seTobacco Free Farms esizonikeza usizo kubalimi abangaphezu kuka-5000 eKenya naseZambia ukuthi batshale izitshalo zokudla ezisimeme esikhundleni sikagwayi.

Amathemba okungenelela okusha Ukuqhubeka nokutshalwa kwezimali ekuthuthukisweni nasekusetshenzisweni kwemithi emisha yokugomela umalaleveva kanye namathuluzi esizukulwane esilandelayo kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokufeza imigomo yomhlaba wonke ka-2030. Umuthi wokugomela umalaleveva wesibili, umuthi wokugomela iR21/Matrix-M (R21), uma uvunyiwe, ungasiza ukuvala igebe elikhulu phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kanye nokufunwa futhi kunciphise ukugula nokushona kwezingane ngenxa kamalaleveva. Kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu kuWHO ukuqhubeka nokubuyekezwa kochwepheshe okuphelele nokusebenza kahle komuthi wokugomela umalaleveva iR21 uma idatha eyengeziwe ebalulekile yokuphepha kanye nokusebenza kahle evela esigabeni 3 esiqhubekayo sokuhlola kutholakala futhi kuhlinzekelwe iWHO. Ukwethulwa ngezigaba zomuthi wokugomela umalaleveva weRTS,S emazweni engeziwe e-Afrika kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ekuqaleni kuka-2024.

Kuhlanganisa izenzo eziningi kusukela ekuhlukumezeni kanye nokulwa ngokomzimba, ukunukubezwa ngokocansi kanye nokulimala ngokomzimba okunzima kakhulu ukubulala. Ubudlova bentsha bukhulisa kakhulu izindleko zezempilo, inhlalakahle kanye nobulungiswa bobugebengu; kunciphisa umkhiqizo; futhi ngokuvamile kubhuntshisa ukwakheka komphakathi. Ngale kokufa, ukulimala kanye nokulimala ngokwengqondo, ubudlova bentsha bungaholela ekukhuphukeni kokuziphatha okuyingozi kwezempilo njengokubhema, ukusebenzisa kabi izidakamizwa, ukuya ocansini ngendlela engaphephile, kanye nobudlova obengeziwe. Lokhu nakho kuhlotshaniswa nezifo ezingamahlalakhona zomgudu wokuphefumula, umdlavuza, izifo zenhliziyo kanye nemithambo yegazi, isifo sikashukela, ukukhulelwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanye nezifo ezithathelana ngocansi. Amasu okuvimbela kanye nokusabela ngempumelelo ahlanganisa lawo akhuthaza ukukhuliswa kanye nokukhula kwezingane ezisencane;

Kusukela ekukhethweni okusemthethweni “iGRAND PRIX” enye ibhekiswe esigabeni ngasinye kweziyisithathu eziyinhloko zomncintiswano: Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Emhlabeni Wonke, Izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo, kanye nempilo engcono kanye nenhlalakahle, okuhambisana ne-Triple Billion Targets yeWHO. USharon Stone, umlingisi owathola iGolden Globe kanye ne-Emmy Award wase-United States of America, umkhiqizi kanye nesishoshovu sezempilo kanye nezimbangela zosizo wathi: "Ngiyajabula ukuba yingxenye ye-Health for All Film Festival. Lokhu kumayelana nokwakha ukuqwashisa okungcono ngezenzo ezibalulekile ezidingekayo ukuze kufinyelelwe ezimweni zokuphila ezinempilo emhlabeni wonke. Izindaba ezikhethiwe zikhuluma nathi ngokubaluleka kwempilo enhle kanye nokufinyelela kwayo, futhi zikhulumela ukufinyelela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke.

Umqondisi Jikelele weWHO umemezela Imiklomelo Yabaholi Bezempilo Bomhlaba Wonke uJean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum noPeter Piot banikezwe imiklomelo ngokuzibophezela impilo yonke kuMqondisi Jikelele weWHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus uzokwethula imiklomelo emibili yokuphila konke ukuze kuhlonishwe iminikelo evelele yokuthuthukisa impilo yomhlaba wonke ngeseshini yokuvula esezingeni eliphezulu ye-76th World Health Assembly. Imiklomelo Yabaholi Bomhlaba Wonke yoMqondisi Jikelele, eyasungulwa ngowezi-2019, izoya kuJean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum noPeter Piot. Bobabili abamukeli bangososayensi abavelele nabaholi bezempilo yomphakathi ababambe iqhaza elikhulu ekutholakaleni kwegciwane le-Ebola ngaphambi kokuthuthukela ezikhundleni zobuholi kwezempilo yomhlaba.

IHRP kanye nabalingani bayo basisondeze esithembisweni seNgqungquthela Yamazwe Ngamazwe ka-1994 ephathelene Nenani Labantu kanye Nentuthuko kanye nesicelo sayo sokubeka amalungelo abantu ngabanye, ikakhulukazi abesifazane kanye namantombazane, enhliziyweni yentuthuko esimeme. Sifuna ukuveza ukwazisa kwethu kanye nokubonga kuNobhala weHRP, abalingani bayo, abaxhasi kanye nenethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke yezikhungo ezisebenzisanayo kanye nochwepheshe abasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo yayo inikela ekwenzeni umehluko kwabesifazane, abesilisa, izingane, intsha kanye nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene iHRP ezibophezele ukuyisebenzela. Egameni lamalungu ePCC, sivumele siqinisekise ukubambisana kwethu nawe ukuze sisekele impumelelo yeHRP, lapho impumelelo ye-Ajenda ka-2030 incike khona.

Izingane ezikhulela emindenini lapho kunodlame kungase kube nezinhlobonhlobo zokuphazamiseka ngokuphathelene nokuziphatha kanye nangokomzwelo. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zengqondo kanye nokukhula futhi kungahlotshaniswa nokwenza noma ukubhekana nobudlova kamuva ekuphileni. Impendulo yeWHO: I-WHO idlala indima ebalulekile ekunikezeni ukunakekela kanye nasekuphenduleni ngokuphathelene nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane njengendaba yezempilo yomphakathi kanye nokulingana ngokobulili ngokusebenzisa: Ucwaningo nokwakha ubufakazi ukuze kugqanyiswe ubukhulu bobudlova obubhekiswe kwabesifazane, izici zayo eziyingozi kanye nemiphumela, kanye nokuhlonza izindlela eziphumelelayo zokungenelela zokuvimbela kanye nokusabela. Ukuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela namathuluzi, ukubeka izinkambiso kanye namazinga okuphendula ngempumelelo ngokuphathelene nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

Cishe ngo-2:00 ntambama ngeCEST, kulandela isithombe somndeni neziNhloko Zezithunywa, i-Assembly yamukela izinga eliphezulu ePalais des Nations lizoba nezinkulumo ezivela kuMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, Izinhloko Zezwe kanye nezivakashi ezikhethekile. Uhlu lwezikhulumi ngezansi). Phakathi nalomhlangano, iDG izokwethula imiklomelo yempumelelo yesikhathi sokuphila kubaholi bezempilo ababili bomhlaba. NgoMsombuluko zingama-22 kuNhlaba, uMqondisi-Jikelele uzonikeza inkulumo yakhe eyinhloko cishe ngo-10:00 ekuseni. NgoLwesihlanu, zingama-26 kuNhlaba, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO uzojoyina abamele izisekelo ezinhlanu zomhlaba, ukwethula imiklomelo emihlanu yezempilo yomphakathi kanye nemiklomelo kwabaphumelele abayisikhombisa ngo-2023. Bavela eBahrain, eChina, eGuatemala, eLebanon, eNepal, eThailand nasePhilippines.

Ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi, ukugula okunzima ngenxa yeschistosomiasis kungavinjelwa ngokwelashwa njalo kwamaqembu asengozini okubhekiswe kuwo ngokusekelwe ekuxilongweni komphakathi okusekelwe emaqenjini aqaphile. IPraziquantel iye yahlanganiswa ngokuphephile ne-albendazole ne-ivermectin, ezindaweni lapho le mithi isetshenziswe ngokwehlukana ukuze kuvinjelwe i-chemotherapy. Izimpawu: Izimpawu zeschistosomiasis zibangelwa ukusabela komzimba emaqandeni ezikelemu. I-schistosomiasis yamathumbu ingabangela ubuhlungu besisu, isifo sohudo, kanye negazi esitheleni. Ukukhuliswa kwesibindi kuvamile ezimweni ezithuthukile, futhi kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nokunqwabelana koketshezi emgodini we-peritoneal kanye nomfutho wegazi ophakeme wemithambo yegazi esiswini.

ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo (PHC) futhi kube nomthelela ekuzuzeni i-UHC Indlela yokusebenza: Indlela egxile kubantu Ukuzinakekela ukungenelela kusekela izidingo namalungelo abantu ngabanye ngendlela egxile kubantu esekelwe emalungelweni abantu kanye nokulingana ngokobulili. Le yindlela ephelele yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomuntu ngamunye, kucatshangelwa izimo, izidingo kanye nezifiso zabo impilo yonke, kanye nendawo abahlala kuyo. Ukuzinakekela kungamandla abantu ngabanye okuvimbela nokwelapha izifo ngokwabo, esimweni sendawo ephephile nesekelayo. Akuthathi indawo yohlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa kunalokho kunikeza ukukhetha okwengeziwe kanye nezinketho zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.

Amagama athi “imithi esezingeni eliphakeme” noma “okunye ukwelapha” abhekisela esethi ebanzi yemikhuba yokunakekelwa kwezempilo engeyona ingxenye yesiko lalelozwe noma imithi evamile futhi engahlanganisiwe ngokuphelele ohlelweni lokunakekelwa kwezempilo olubusayo. Zisetshenziswa ngokufanayo nemithi yesintu kwamanye amazwe. Imithi engamakhambi Imithi engamakhambi ihlanganisa amakhambi, izinto zokwenza amakhambi, amalungiselelo amakhambi kanye nemikhiqizo yamakhambi eqediwe, equkethe izithako ezisebenzayo izingxenye zezitshalo, noma ezinye izinto zezitshalo, noma izinhlanganisela. Umthelela: Isu Lokwelapha Ngesintu leWHO 2014-2023 lakhiwa futhi laqaliswa ngenxa yesinqumo soMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba Wonke ngokuphathelene nemithi yesintu (WHA62.13).

I-ajenda yoMhlangano weZempilo isandulelwa umhlangano wama-30 woHlelo, uHlelomali kanye neKomidi loPhathi leBhodi eliPhethe, elizohlangana ngomhlaka-17-19 kuNhlaba, 2023. Ngemva koMhlangano, umhlangano we-153 weBhodi eliPhethe uzokwenzeka kusukela ngomhlaka-31 kuNhlaba kuya ku-1 kuNhlangulana. Umhlangano weZempilo uvulelekile kuMazwe angamaLungu abhalisiwe nagunyaziwe, Amalungu Ahlangene, Abaqaphi, abameleli abamenyiwe be-UN kanye nezinye izinhlangano ezibamba iqhaza phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabalingisi abangekho kuHulumeni. I-WHA76 izosakazwa bukhoma kuwebhu kusuka kuwebhusayithi yeWHO. I-ajenda yesikhashana, uhlelo lwesikhathi lokuqala, amadokhumenti oMhlangano kanye nephephabhuku lansuku zonke kungatholakala lapha. Ukugunyazwa kwabezindaba kanye nezibuyekezo zoMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba.

Izakhamuzi zasemadolobheni nazo zisengozini enkulu yemiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ngenxa yokuncika kwazo kumafutha ezokuthutha, ukupheka kanye nokushisa. Amadolobha enza ngaphezu kwezingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zamandla omhlaba futhi akhipha u-60% wamagesi abamba ukushisa, futhi lawo asemaphandleni angase abe namazinga okushisa angu-3-5oC aphezulu kunezindawo zasemaphandleni ezizungezile ngenxa yezindawo zawo ezinkulu zikakhonkolo kanye nezindawo ezimbalwa ezivulekile eziluhlaza. Konke lokhu kubeka impilo yabantu basemadolobheni engcupheni. Izimbangela eziyishumi eziyinhloko zokufa zihlobene kakhulu nokwanda okusheshayo nokungahleliwe kwamadolobha, kanye nokuklanywa kanye nokuhlelwa kabi kwamadolobha. Amadolobha abhekana nomthwalo wezempilo ophindwe kathathu wezifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana neHIV/AIDS, isifo sofuba, inyumoniya, i-dengue kanye nesifo sohudo;

ukufakelwa kwamaseli e-haematopoietic kungelapha izifo ezizalwa nazo noma ezitholakele ezihlanganisa amanye ama-leukemia Bheka imininingwane eyengeziwe kuHaematopoeitic Stem Cells ukufakelwa kwevalvu yenhliziyo yomuntu kuvame ukuba yisimo esingcono kakhulu sokushintshwa futhi iziguli ezitholwayo azidingi ukwelashwa kwesikhathi eside okuvimbela ukuma kwegazi. Ukufakelwa kwezinto eziphilayo (Xenotransplantation) Ukufakelwa kwezinto eziphilayo, isilwane kuya kumuntu, kuchazwa njengamaseli aphilayo, izicubu zomzimba noma izitho zemvelaphi yesilwane kanye noketshezi lomzimba womuntu, amaseli, izicubu zomzimba noma izitho ezine-ex vivo ngalezi zinto eziphilayo, izinto ze-xenogeneic, zinamandla okuba yindlela ehlukile yezinto zemvelaphi yomuntu futhi zixazulule ukushoda kwezinto zomuntu zokufakelwa.

ITB iyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa kwabantu abane-HIV futhi inengxenye enkulu ekumelaneni nemithi elwa namagciwane Abantu abaningi abaphethwe iTB bahlala emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi nendawo, kodwa iTB ikhona emhlabeni wonke. Cishe ingxenye yabo bonke abantu abaneTB ingatholakala emazweni ayi-8: eBangladesh, eChina, e-India, e-Indonesia, eNigeria, ePakistan, ePhilippines naseNingizimu Afrika. Cishe ingxenye yesine yabantu emhlabeni wonke kulinganiselwa ekutheni batheleleke ngebhaktheriya yeTB, kodwa abantu abaningi ngeke baqhubeke nokuba nesifo seTB futhi abanye bazosula ukutheleleka.

Ngemva kokuqashelwa kusenesikhathi, ukuxilongwa ukuze kusizwe ukuhlonza okubangela ukutheleleka okuholela ku-sepsis kubalulekile ukuze kuqondiswe ukwelashwa okuhlosiwe kwama-antimicrobial. Ukwelashwa okufanele kwama-antimicrobial (isibonelo, ama-antibiotic kanye nama-antifungal) kufanele kunikezwe kungakapheli ihora elilodwa lokuhlonzwa kwe-sepsis. Ukumelana nama-antimicrobial (AMR) kungabeka engcupheni ukuphathwa komtholampilo kwe-sepsis ngoba ukwelashwa kwama-antibiotic okuvamile kuyadingeka. Ukuvuselelwa kokuqukuqula uketshezi kusenesikhathi kubalulekile esigabeni sokuqala futhi kungase kudingeke ama-vasopressor ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kugcinwe ukugeleza kwezicubu.

I-COVID-19 igqamise indima ebalulekile edlalwa yi-pathogen genomics ekuphenduleni izinsongo zobhubhane. Ngaphandle kokulandelana okusheshayo kwezakhi zofuzo zeSARS-COV-2, imithi yokugoma ibingeke isebenze ngendlela efanele, noma ibingatholakali ngokushesha. Izinhlobo ezintsha, ezithathelwanayo zaleli gciwane bezingeke zikhonjwe ngokushesha. I-Genomics isenkabeni yobhubhane olusebenzayo nokulungela ubhubhane kanye nokusabela, kanye nengxenye yokuqapha okuqhubekayo kwezifo eziningi, kusukela ezifweni ezibangelwa ukudla kanye nomkhuhlane kuya esifweni sofuba kanye ne-HIV. Ukusetshenziswa kwayo ekuqapheni ukusabalala kokumelana nemithi ye-HIV, isibonelo, kuye kwaholela ezinhlelweni zokulwa ne-antiretroviral eziye zasindisa izimpilo eziningi.

Ukuzinakekela okutholakalayo, okufinyelelekayo, okungabizi, okwamukelekayo kanye nekhwalithi enhle kuyizinto eziyinhloko zokugqugquzela kanye nokuvikela ilungelo labantu kwezempilo. Ukuzinakekela kungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokulethwa kwezinsiza zezempilo, ukufinyelela kanye nokukhavwa. Lokhu kudinga imithetho kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo, ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwezempilo, imikhiqizo esezingeni elilawulwayo kanye nokungenelela, kanye nemfundo ekhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu ngabanye, kanye nobumfihlo kanye nokugcinwa kwemfihlo. Ukucatshangelwa kwamalungelo abantu kusiza ekunciphiseni ubudlova, ukuphoqelelwa, ukucwaswa kanye nokucwaswa ngokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa komuntu ngamunye kwelungelo lakhe kwezempilo, ulwazi, kanye nokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimela. I-syphilis efihlekile ayinazo izimpawu zomtholampilo noma izimpawu futhi ukwelashwa kuhlukile esigabeni sokuqala. Ngemva kweminyaka noma amashumi eminyaka ngaphandle kokwelashwa, izifo zezinzwa kanye nezenhliziyo phakathi kwezinye zingenzeka. Ukwelashwa: Ukuxilongwa kwesifo sesifo sofuba kusekelwe emlandweni womuntu, ukuhlolwa ngokomzimba, ukuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri futhi ngezinye izikhathi i-radiology, njengoba izimpawu zingavamile noma zingabonakali. Ukuhlonza ukutheleleka okungabonakali ngokuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri kanye nokwelashwa kwamacala amahle kuzovimbela ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kanye nemiphumela emibi yokukhulelwa, okuhlanganisa nesayphilisi esizalwa nayo. Ukuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri kwesayphilisi kuhlanganisa ukutholwa okuqondile kwe-T. pallidum noma izindlela ezingaqondile ezifana ne-serology.

Isepsis Uhlolojikelele: Isepsis yisimo esisongela impilo esivela lapho ukusabela komzimba ekuthelelekeni kubangela ukulimala kwezicubu zomzimba kanye nezitho zomzimba. Ngokuvamile kuyindlela yokugcina evamile yokufa kwezifo eziningi ezithathelwanayo emhlabeni wonke. Kuhlanganisa ukungasebenzi kahle kwezitho ezithile okubangelwa ukusabela okungalawuleki komzimba ekuthelelekeni futhi uma kungatholakali kusenesikhathi futhi kungenganyelwa ngokushesha, kungaholela ekushaqekeni kwesepetiki, ukwehluleka kwezitho eziningi kanye nokufa. Nakuba kunzima ukuqinisekisa ukulinganisa okuqondile komthwalo womhlaba wonke we-sepsis, ukushicilelwa kwesayensi kwakamuva kubike ukuthi isepsis ithinta abantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini ezingama-49 futhi ibangele ukufa kwabantu abayizigidi eziyi-11 emhlabeni wonke minyaka yonke.

Ukufinyelela kwamandla okuyisisekelo kuyalibala phakathi kwamathuba avuselelekayo, umbiko omusha ubonisa igebe lokufinyelela kwamandla omhlaba liyaqhubeka: abantu abayizigidi ezingama-675 abangenagesi, abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.3 abathembele kumafutha okupheka ayingozi Umbiko omusha we-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iBhange Lomhlaba, kanye ne-World Health Organization (WHO), ekhishwe namuhla, uthola ukuthi umhlaba awusekho endleleni yokufinyelela iSifiso Senqubekelaphambili Esisimeme (SDG) 7 ngamandla ngo-2030. Lo nyaka uphawula ingxenye yesigamu sokufinyelela kumaSDG ngo-2030. I-SDG 7 ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kumandla akhokhelekayo, athembekile, asimeme kanye nesimanjemanje.

Ku-neonatal tetanus, izimpawu zihlanganisa ukudlikiza kwemisipha, okuvame ukuqala ngokungakwazi kwengane esanda kuzalwa ukuncela noma ukuncelisa ibele, kanye nokukhala ngokweqile. I-Tetanus itholakala ngesisekelo sezici zomtholampilo futhi ayidingi ukuqinisekiswa kwelabhorethri. I-Tetanus idinga ukwelashwa esikhungweni sezokwelapha, ngokuvamile esibhedlela sokudlulisela. Abantu abasinde ku-tetanus abanawo amasosha omzimba angokwemvelo futhi bangaphinde batheleleke futhi ngenxa yalokho kudingeka bagonywe. Ukuvimbela: I-Tetanus ingavinjelwa ngokugonywa ngemithi yokugoma equkethe i-tetanus-toxoid (TTCV), efakiwe ezinhlelweni zokugoma ezijwayelekile emhlabeni wonke futhi enikezwa ngesikhathi sokuxhumana nokunakekelwa ngaphambi kokubeletha.

I-WHO yethula inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke ukuze ithole futhi ivimbele izinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo I-WHO kanye nabalingani bayethula inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke ukuze basize ukuvikela abantu ezinsongweni zezifo ezithathelwanayo ngamandla e-pathogen genomics. I-International Pathogen Surveillance Network (IPSN) izohlinzeka ngesikhulumi sokuxhuma amazwe kanye nezifunda, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqoqa kanye nokuhlaziya amasampula, ukusebenzisa le mininingo ukuqhuba ukuthathwa kwezinqumo zezempilo yomphakathi, kanye nokwabelana ngalolo lwazi kabanzi. I-Pathogen genomics ihlaziya ikhodi yofuzo yamavayirasi, amagciwane kanye nezinye izidalasihlungu ezibangela izifo ukuze iqonde ukuthi zithathelana kangakanani, zibulala kangakanani, nokuthi zisakazeka kanjani.

I-Tick-borne encephalitis Uhlolojikelele: I-Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) iyimbangela ebalulekile yokutheleleka ngegciwane lesimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko emazweni asempumalanga, maphakathi, enyakatho kanye nasentshonalanga yeYurophu, nasenyakatho yeChina, eMongolia, naseRussian Federation. Igciwane le-Tick-borne encephalitis liyilungu lomndeni weFlaviviridae. Cishe izimo zezokwelapha eziyi-10 000-12 000 ze-tick-borne encephalitis zibikwa minyaka yonke, kodwa lesi sibalo kukholakala ukuthi siphansi kakhulu kunenani langempela leziguli. Iningi lokutheleleka ngegciwane libangelwa amagundane athelelekile, avame ukuhlala enamathele ngokuqinile esikhunjeni izinsuku eziningi.

Kudingeka uhlelo olusha lwezempilo oluqala ekuqaleni luye ekugcineni olubeka phambili inhlalakahle yomphakathi. Njengoba ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 lwenze kwacaca, ikhwalithi kanye namandla kahulumeni abalulekile. Ohulumeni abasebenza ngempumelelo akubona abancane kunabo bonke, kodwa yilabo abaklanywe kahle futhi abanemithombo efanele, kokubili ngokwezezimali nangokuphathelene nabantu babo kanye nengqalasizinda. Ukutshala kabusha emandleni kahulumeni kubalulekile ekuletheni Ezempilo Kubo Bonke. Umbiko uphinde unikeze iziphakamiso ngalokho okungenziwa ngokoqobo ukuze kusetshenziswe izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqondiswe kabusha izinyathelo zenani lezomnotho, ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwezempilo, ukuqamba kanye nokwakha amandla emkhakheni womphakathi enkonzweni yezempilo yabo bonke.

Ubhubhane nezinkinga zosizo kubantu Ezimweni lapho izinhlelo zezempilo ezikhona zicindezelekile, kuvame ukuba nesidingo esingakaze sibe khona kubantu ngabanye kanye nasemiphakathini sokuphatha impilo yabo. Amasu amasha adlulela ngalé kwempendulo yomkhakha wezempilo evamile ayadingeka ngokushesha uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi: abantu abayizigidi ezingama-274 badinga usizo nosizo lokuvikelwa futhi ukuqubuka kwezifo kuyisongo esiqhubekayo emhlabeni wonke okungenani abantu abayizigidi ezingama-400 emhlabeni wonke abakwazi ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezibaluleke kakhulu.
