Isifo sofuba Uhlolojikelele: Isifo sofuba yisifo esithathelwana ngocansi (STI) esibangelwa iTreponema pallidum esiholela ekuguleni okukhulu kanye nokushona kwabantu, futhi siyalapheka. Isifo sofuba sidluliselwa ngokuthintana ngokocansi nezilonda ezithathelwanayo, ngokufakelwa igazi noma kumama okhulelwe kuya enganeni. Ukudluliselwa kwesifo sofuba kusuka kumama kuya enganeni kuvame ukulimaza kakhulu enganeni ezimweni ezingatholakalanga noma ezingelashwanga ngokwanele ekuqaleni kokukhulelwa. Isifo sofuba sikamama, uma singelashwa, siphathwa sekwephuzile noma singelashwa nge-penicillin, sibangela imiphumela emibi yokuzalwa (ama-ABO) elinganiselwa ku-50-80% wamacala, kuye ngesigaba sesifo sofuba.

Uma ingelashwa, lesi simo siholela ekwakhekeni kwe-opacities engenakuguqulwa, okuholela ekuthikamezekeni kokubona noma ubumpumputhe. Iminyaka lapho lokhu kwenzeka khona incike ezicini eziningana ezihlanganisa amandla okudluliselwa kwasendaweni. Emiphakathini egcwele kakhulu, kungenzeka ebuntwaneni, nakuba ukuqala kokuthikamezeka kokubona phakathi kweminyaka yobudala engama-30 kanye nengama-40 kuvame kakhulu. Abesifazane bayimpumputhe ngokuphindwe kane kunabesilisa, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokuthintana njalo nezingane ezithelelekile. Abantu abahlala emiphakathini empofu kakhulu futhi ekude kakhulu yase-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australia, eMiddle East, eCentral naseNingizimu Melika kanye nasePacific Islands basengozini.

UProfesa Leo Yee Sin, uMqondisi Omkhulu weNational Centre for Infectious Diseases; eSingapore; uDkt Mario Moreira, uMongameli, Fiocruz, eBrazil; noDkt Josefina Campos, uMqondisi weNational Genomics and Bioinformatics Center e-ANLIS Malbrán, e-Argentina. Umcimbi uzokwenzeka ngendlela ehlanganisiwe, enikeza ithuba lamalungu e-IPSN kanye nezithameli ezibanzi ukuthi zihlanganyele ne-IPSN kanye nemisebenzi yayo. Mayelana ne-IPSNI-IPSN iyinethiwekhi entsha yomhlaba wonke yabalingisi be-pathogen genomic, ebanjwe yiWHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ukuze kusheshiswe inqubekelaphambili ekuthumeleni i-pathogen genomics kanye nokwenza ngcono ukuthathwa kwezinqumo zezempilo zomphakathi.

Lawa ma-ABO avame ukuba nzima futhi ahlanganisa ukubeletha (okuvame kakhulu), ukushona kwengane esanda kuzalwa, ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, isisindo esiphansi sokuzalwa, kanye nezinsana ezitheleleke ngesifo. Isifo sesifibe singavinjelwa ngemikhuba yocansi ephephile ehlanganisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele nokungaguquguquki kwamakhondomu. Abantu abaningi abanesifo sesifo sohudo abanazo izimpawu noma banezimpawu ezincane kuphela ezingaqashelwa. Ukuhlonza ukutheleleka ngokuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri kanye nokwelashwa kwamacala anegciwane kuzovimbela ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kanye nemiphumela emibi yokukhulelwa okuhlanganisa isifo sesifo sohudo esizalwa naso. Ukuhlunga kungenziwa kusetshenziswa ukuhlolwa okusheshayo okungase kunikeze imiphumela ngaphansi kwemizuzu engu-20, okuvumela ukwelashwa ngokushesha.

Phakathi no-2020-2021, iCOVID-19 yabangela iminyaka eyizigidi ezingama-336.8 yokuphila okulahlekile emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kulingana nesilinganiso seminyaka engama-22 yokuphila okulahlekile ngokufa okweqile, okusheshayo futhi okudabukisayo okunciphisa ukuphila kwezigidi zabantu. Kusukela ngo-2000, sibone ukuthuthuka okuphawulekayo empilweni kamama nengane ngokufa okwehla ngengxenye yesithathu nengxenye, ngokulandelana. Izigameko zezifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana neHIV, isifo sofuba (TB) kanye nomalaleveva nazo zehle, kanye nengozi encishisiwe yokushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi okuvela kumaNCD kanye nokulimala. Ngokubambisana, lokhu kube nomthelela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuphila emhlabeni wonke kusukela eminyakeni engama-67 ngo-2000 kuya eminyakeni engama-73 ngo-2019.

Ukwelashwa: Izidakamizwa zezinyoka ziwukwelashwa okusebenzayo ukuvimbela noma ukubuyisela emuva imiphumela eminingi elimazayo yokulunywa yinyoka futhi zifakiwe ohlwini lweWHO lwemithi ebalulekile. Ukutholakala nokufinyeleleka kwalezi zidakamizwa, kanye nokuqwashisa ngezindlela zokuvimbela eziyinhloko phakathi kwemiphakathi nabasebenzi bezempilo, kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokunciphisa imiphumela emibi kanye nokufa ngenxa yokulunywa yinyoka. Ngemva kokulunywa yinyoka okusolwa ukuthi inobuthi, landela lezi zinyathelo: Hambela kude ngokushesha nendawo lapho kulunywe khona. Susa noma yini eqinile ezungeze ingxenye yomzimba elunywe ukuze ugweme ukulimala uma kwenzeka ukuvuvukala.

Ithimba labaholi abasezindlunkulu, elihlanganisa inani elilinganayo labesifazane nabesilisa, lizosebenza ngokubambisana namahhovisi esifunda kanye nezwe e-WHO. Amalungu amasha eqembu labaholi abasezindlunkulu: uDkt Jeremy Farrar uzoba uSosayensi Oyinhloko weWHO kusukela ngomhlaka-8 kuNhlaba 2023. Ukuqokwa kukaDkt Farrar bekumenyezelwe ngaphambilini ngoZibandlela 2022. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Farrar uzobheka iSigaba Sezesayensi, ahlanganise ochwepheshe kanye namanethiwekhi amahle kakhulu kwezesayensi kanye nokusungula okuvela emhlabeni wonke ukuze aqondise, athuthukise futhi alethe izinqubomgomo nezinsiza zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubantu abazidinga kakhulu. Ngaphambi kokujoyina iWHO uDkt Farrar wayenguMqondisi we-Wellcome Trust.

Imizamo yokuvimbela ukuzibulala idinga ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwemikhakha eminingi, okuhlanganisa ezempilo, ezemfundo, ezemisebenzi, ezolimo, ezamabhizinisi, ezobulungiswa, ezomthetho, ezokuvikela, ezombusazwe kanye nabezindaba. Ukuvimbela ukuzibulala ngokuvamile akubhekelelwa ngokwanele ngenxa yokucwaswa kanye nokuntuleka kokuqwashisa ngokuthi ukuzibulala kuyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi. Imiphakathi nayo idlala indima ebalulekile ekuvimbeleni ukuzibulala. Ithuluzi lokusebenza lokuzibandakanya komphakathi leWHO liqondisa imiphakathi ekuboneni izinto eziza kuqala kanye nasekusebenziseni imisebenzi ngokuvumelana nezimo zendawo. Impendulo yeWHO: Ukuphuthuma kokuthatha isinyathelo sokuvimbela ukuzibulala kuye kwaqashelwa futhi kwabekwa eqhulwini emazingeni aphakeme kakhulu.

UDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO, uthe, "I-WHO iyaziqhenya ngokuba noRenée Fleming noPretty Yende abajoyina njengeNxusa Lezobuciko Nezempilo. Ithalente labo elingenakuqhathaniswa, ukuzinikela kwezobuciko, nokuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo kanye nenhlalakahle kubenza babe amanxusa afanele kule ndaba ebalulekile. Ukuzibandakanya kwabo kuzogqugquzela abantu ngabanye, imiphakathi kanye nabenzi bezinqubomgomo ukuthi babone futhi basebenzise amandla aguqulayo ezobuciko ekuphishekeleni impilo engcono yabo bonke. "UFleming uletha ubuchwepheshe obuningi endimeni yakhe entsha. Uthakazelise izethameli emhlabeni wonke ngezwi lakhe elikhazimulayo lesoprano nobuciko obuphoqayo.

qinisekisa ukuthi amazwe ahlomele kangcono ukubhekana nokwanda okungazelelwe kwezidingo zokuvuselela okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusizayo ngenxa yezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo; qinisekisa ukuthi abantu ababekwe eceleni kanye nabasengozini bayakwazi ukuthola izinsiza zokuvuselela ezingabizi, ezisezingeni elifanele kanye nezinsiza zokuvuselela okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusizayo; gwema izindleko eziphezulu ezingaphandle kwekhokhelo kubantu ukuze bafinyelele ezinsizeni zokuvuselela kanye nobuchwepheshe obusizayo obungabangela ubunzima bezezimali; futhi ubhekane nezinga lamanje elinganele labasebenzi bokuvuselela ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Isinqumo sibala uhla lwezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe uNobhala weWHO njengalezi:

UDkt Ihekweazu uneziqu zobudokotela, ngokukhethekile njengesazi sezifo ezithathelwanayo, kanye neziqu zobungcweti kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Michael Ryan uzoqhubeka njengoMqondisi Omkhulu woHlelo lweZimo eziphuthumayo Zezempilo lweWHO. UDkt Ryan ubelokhu ephatha izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo kuWHO eminyakeni engama-25 edlule futhi muva nje uhole ukusabela kwezimo eziphuthumayo kweWHO kubhubhane lweCOVID-19. Uhola ukusabela kweWHO ekuqubukeni kwezifo, izinkinga zobuntu kanye nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zomphakathi. UDkt Ryan uyilungu elisungula iGlobal Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN), esize ukusabela kumakhulu okuqubuka kwezifo emhlabeni wonke.

Eminyakeni yamuva nje, izinsimbi zamalungelo abantu emhlabeni wonke bezilokhu zisetshenziswa kakhulu ukusekela nokuthuthukisa izimangalo zomthetho ngabanye kanye nemiphakathi yonke ukuze ohulumeni bezwe baqinisekise inhlonipho, ukuvikelwa kanye nokugcwaliseka kwamalungelo abo ezempilo yocansi kanye nokuzala (Cook et al., 2003). Izincazelo ezisebenzayo nohlaka lohlelo olwethulwe lapha lusekelwe emalungelweni abantu aqashelwa emhlabeni wonke futhi lunikeza indlela esekelwe emalungelweni ekuhleleni kwezempilo yocansi. Izinto eziyinhloko zomqondo zempilo yocansi zibhalwe ngezansi. Izinto ezibalulekile zomqondo zempilo yocansi Uma zibukwa ngendlela ephelele futhi ezinhle:

Esimweni somphakathi, i-sepsis ivame ukuvela njengokuwohloka kwezokwelapha kwezifo ezivamile nezingavinjelwa. I-sepsis futhi ivame ukubangelwa izifo ezitholakala ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okungesinye sezigameko ezimbi ezivame kakhulu ngesikhathi sokulethwa kokunakekelwa futhi zithinta amakhulu ezigidi zeziguli emhlabeni wonke minyaka yonke. Uma i-sepsis iba khona ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ngesikhathi noma ngemva kokubeletha, noma ngemva kokukhipha isisu, kubizwa ngokuthi i-sepsis kamama. I-sepsis ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa ibizwa ngokuthi i-neonatal sepsis. Naphezu kokuthi ingavinjelwa kakhulu, i-sepsis kamama kanye neyosanda kuzalwa iyaqhubeka nokuba imbangela enkulu yokufa kwabesifazane abakhulelwe kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa.

Sebenzisa ukuvikela ilanga okubanzi okungenani okungu-15 SPF - okungcono kakhulu okuphezulu - bese uphinde usebenzise njalo ngemva kwamahora amabili. Gwema izibani zelanga kanye nezindawo zokubanda, njengoba zaziwa ngokulimaza isikhumba kanye namehlo. Ukuchayeka kwezingane kuUV kufanele kuncishiswe ngokucophelela ngoba zisesimweni esishintshashintshayo sokukhula futhi ngenxa yalokho zisengozini enkulu yokusongelwa indawo ezungezile kunabantu abadala. Imisebenzi eminingi ebalulekile efana nesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ezifweni ayithuthuki ngokugcwele lapho zizalwa, futhi izindawo ezingaphephile zingaphazamisa ukukhula kwazo okujwayelekile. Impendulo yeWHO: I-WHO isebenza namazwe angamalungu kanye nabalingani ukuze kwandiswe ukuqonda komphakathi ngemiphumela yokuchayeka ngokweqile emisebeni ye-ultraviolet.

I-Trachoma itholakala ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlwempu kakhulu nezasemaphandleni kakhulu e-Afrika, eCentral naseNingizimu Melika, e-Asia, eNtshonalanga Pacific naseMiddle East. Isifunda seWHO sase-Afrika sithinteke ngokungenakulinganiswa yi-trachoma nabantu abayizigidi eziyi-105 abahlala ezindaweni ezisengozini, okumelela u-84% womthwalo we-trachoma emhlabeni jikelele. I-Trachoma iyimbangela ehamba phambili yokutheleleka ngokuphathelene nobumpumputhe emhlabeni wonke. Lesi sifo sibangelwa ukutheleleka ngebhaktheriya i-Chlamydia trachomatis. Ukutheleleka kudluliselwa kusuka kumuntu kuya kumuntu ngeminwe engcolile, ama-fomites kanye nezimpukane ezithintene nokukhishwa kwamehlo noma ikhala lomuntu othelelekile.

Ukuhamba kanye nezempilo Uhlolojikelele: Ukuhamba emazweni angaphandle kungaletha izingozi ezihlukahlukene empilweni, kuye ngezici zombili zomhambi kanye nohambo. Abahambi bangase bahlangabezane nezinguquko ezingalindelekile futhi ezibalulekile endaweni ephakeme, umswakama, amagciwane, kanye namazinga okushisa, okungaholela empilweni engeyinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingozi ezinkulu zempilo zingase zivele ezindaweni lapho indawo yokuhlala ingeyekhwalithi, inhlanzeko kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle kunganele, izinsizakalo zezokwelapha zingathuthuki kahle futhi amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali. Ukuhamba emazweni angaphandle kuyanda, njengoba izigidi zabantu zihamba ngenxa yezinjongo zomsebenzi, ezenhlalo, zokuzijabulisa kanye nezenhlalakahle unyaka ngamunye.

Ekugcineni, kungase kubangele ubuhlungu obukhulu bomzimba noma ukungakhululeki, okwenza kube lula ukudideka ngomkhuhlane noma ubuthi bokudla. Ezinganeni, i-sepsis ingase ivezwe ngokuphefumula ngokushesha kakhulu, ukuquleka, isikhumba esikhanyayo, ukucobeka noma ubunzima bokuvuka noma ukuzwa kubanda ngokungajwayelekile lapho uthintwa. Ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-5, kungase kubangele ubunzima bokudla, ukuhlanza ngokuphindaphindiwe noma ukuntula ukuchama. Ukusola i-sepsis nokwenza ngokushesha kubalulekile ekuqashelweni nasekuxilongweni kusenesikhathi. Ukwelashwa: Ukuhlonza izimpawu kusenesikhathi kanye nokusungulwa ngesikhathi sokulawulwa okufanele kwezokwelapha kuyizici ezibalulekile zokunciphisa ingozi kanye nomthelela we-sepsis.

"UPretty Yende uhlabe umxhwele izethameli ngezwi lakhe elimangalisayo kanye nokusebenza ngendlela emangalisayo. Njengomculi we-soprano onokuqonda okujulile kwamandla omculo, ubonise ukuzibophezela kwakhe ekusebenziseni ithalente lakhe ukuze athuthukise umphakathi. Uthando lukaYende lokwabelana ngezici zokuphulukisa zomculo kanye nokuzinikela kwakhe ezindabeni zomphakathi kuhambisana ngokuphelele ne-ajenda yeWHO yezobuciko nezempilo. U-Yende uthe, "Ngijabule kakhulu ukuqokwa njengeNxusa leWHO lezobuciko nezempilo. Ngithemba ukusiza ekusunguleni isisekelo sokuqhubeka kophenyo ngokuphathelene nezobuciko njengesithako esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni inhlalakahle yethu ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, nangokwezenhlalo.

Nakuba ezinye izifunda zithinteke kakhulu, ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kusongela inqubekelaphambili yezempilo kuwo wonke amazwe. Ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu ekunakekelweni kwezinsana ezisanda kuzalwa kungasindisa izigidi zemindeni ebuhlungwini. Kudingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuvinjelwe ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okuzophinde kuthuthukise inqubekelaphambili ekunciphiseni ukubeletha kanye nokufa komama. Ngokubambisana lezi zindlela ezimbili zokuvimbela nokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi zizokhiqiza abantu abanempilo kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kulethe intuthuko kwezomnotho nakwezenhlalo. Isizukulwane sethu esilandelayo sincike kithi sonke ukuthi senze manje - utshalomali lungase lungabi luncane kodwa imbuyiselo kulokhu kutshalwa kwezimali izoba nkulu kuwo wonke amazwe"

Abantu bangase futhi babe nezinkinga zokopha ezingaholela ekopheni okubulalayo noma ukwehluleka kwezinso okungenakuguqulwa. Ukucekelwa phansi okukhulu kwezicubu zendawo nakho kungenzeka, okungaholela ekukhubazekeni unomphela ngisho nasekunqunyweni kwezitho zomzimba. Izingane zisengozini enkulu yemiphumela emibi ngenxa yobuningi bomzimba obuphansi kunabantu abadala. Ukufa okuningi kanye nemiphumela emibi evela ekulunyweni yizinyoka kungavinjelwa ngokuphelele ngokwenza izidakamizwa eziphephile neziphumelelayo zokulwa nezinye zitholakale kabanzi futhi zifinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziyingozi kakhulu. Izidakamizwa eziphezulu zezinyoka zokulwa nezinye ziwukuphela kwendlela ephumelelayo yokuvimbela noma ukubuyisela emuva imiphumela eminingi enobuthi yokulunywa yizinyoka.

Ama-helminthiases adluliselwa emhlabathini Uhlolojikelele: Izifo ezithathelwana ngomhlabathi (STH) ziphakathi kwezifo ezivame kakhulu emhlabeni wonke futhi zithinta imiphakathi empofu kakhulu futhi ehluphekile kakhulu. Zidluliselwa ngamaqanda akhona emathunjini abantu nawo angcolisa inhlabathi ezindaweni lapho ukukhucululwa kwendle kungatheni khona. Izinhlobo eziyinhloko ezithelela abantu yi-roundworm (Ascaris lumbricoides), i-whipworm (Trichuris trichiura) kanye nama-hookworm (Necator americanus kanye ne-Ancylostoma duodenale). Izikelemu zamathumbu zikhiqiza izinhlobonhlobo zezimpawu ezihlanganisa ukubonakaliswa kwamathumbu (isifo sohudo, isisu esibuhlungu), ukungaphila kahle okuvamile kanye nobuthakathaka.

Inkinga eqhubekayo evimbela ukufinyelela ekwelashweni okuphephile, okusebenzayo kobuthi ezifundeni eziningi, futhi ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, kuyisici esisodwa esinomthelela ekuthambekeleni ekufuneni usizo ngokusebenzisa imithi yesintu. Izimpawu: Ukulunywa noma ukufuthwa kobuthi bezinyoka ezinobuthi kungabangela izimo eziphuthumayo zezokwelapha ezibucayi kanye nezibucayi. Ukufuthwa ubuthi obubangelwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinyoka kungabangela izimpawu ezahlukene, ezinye ezibucayi kakhulu kunezinye. Lokhu kwenza ukulungiselela ubuthi obufanele kube yinkinga eqhubekayo. Ukufuthwa ubuthi kungabangela ukukhubazeka okunzima okungase kuvimbele ukuphefumula, okwenza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokushesha kubaluleke kakhulu.

Ukuqokwa kungenziwa ngabaphathi bezempilo kuzwelonke zeZwe Eliyilungu leWHO kanye nanoma yimuphi umuntu owayethole imiklomelo. Esigabeni sayo se-152 ngoMasingana 2023, iBhodi Eliphethe likhombe abawinile bemiklomelo yowezi-2023, ngesisekelo seziphakamiso ezenziwe amapaneli akhethekile okukhetha umklomelo ngamunye. Abawinile abayisikhombisa bakhethelwe ukugubha indima yabo eyingqayizivele kanye negalelo lezempilo yomphakathi emazweni abo nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bavela ezifundeni ezine zeWHO - zaseMelika, iMpumalanga-Mediterranean, iNingizimu-Mpumalanga ye-Asia kanye neNtshonalanga Pacific. Abawinile abahlanu ngabantu ngabanye, futhi abathathu phakathi kwabo ngabesifazane.

izinhlelo zokuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa ezikoleni, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okuphila kanye nezenhlalo; izindlela zokwelapha nabantu abasengozini enkulu, kanye nezindlela zomphakathi kanye nezinga lomphakathi njengokunciphisa ukufinyelela kanye nokusetshenziswa kabi kotshwala kanye nezibhamu, izindawo ezithile kanye namaphoyisa aqondiswe ezinkingeni, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha, kanye nokunciphisa ubumpofu. I-WHO kanye nabalingani banciphisa ubudlova bentsha ngezinhlelo ezisiza ukuhlonza, ukulinganisa kanye nokusabela enkingeni, lezi zihlanganisa: ukuthuthukisa iphakheji lezinhlelo zokuvimbela udlame ezikoleni; ukudonsela ukunaka ebukhulwini bobudlova bentsha kanye nesidingo sokuvimbela;

Kodwa-ke, imininingo etholakalayo ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abayizigidi ezi-4.5-5.4 balunywa izinyoka minyaka yonke. Kulokhu, izigidi eziyi-1.8-2.7 ziba nokugula kwezokwelapha futhi abangu-81 000 ukuya ku-138 000 babulawa yizinkinga. Amaqembu asengozini enkulu ahlanganisa abasebenzi bezolimo basemaphandleni, abelusi, abadobi, abazingeli, izingane ezisebenzayo, abantu abahlala ezindlini ezakhiwe kabi nalabo abangakwazi ukuthola imfundo nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukugula kanye nokushona kwabantu kwenzeka kaningi kakhulu phakathi kwentsha futhi izingane zihlushwa ukufa kwamacala aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abesifazane babhekana nezithiyo ezengeziwe zokuthola usizo lwezokwelapha kwamanye amasiko futhi abesifazane abakhulelwe basengozini enkulu.

Lokhu kwelashwa kuzoholela ekwelapheni okuphelele kwezokwelapha ku-95% wamacala kodwa iziguli kufanele ziphinde zihlolwe emasontweni ama-4 ngemva kokuthola ama-antibiotic. Ukubuyekezwa kwemibhalo yomlando kusukela ngeminyaka yawo-1950 kukhombisa ukuthi amazwe angaphezu kwama-90 nezindawo kwakugcwele ama-yaws. Amazwe angu-14 kuphela kumazwe angu-90 nezindawo anemininingo yakamuva ngama-yaws ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lokuqapha olujwayelekile; kodwa-ke, lezi zibalo zingase zibe inkomba nje yokuba khona kwesifo hhayi ubukhulu baso obugcwele. EGhana, ePapua New Guinea naseSolomon Islands kubikwa izigameko ezingaphezu kuka-10 000 ngonyaka. I-Ecuador ne-India kubonakala sengathi ziphazamise ukudluliselwa.

Umhlangano ucele ukuthi kwenziwe uhlelo lokusebenza ngokubonisana nabantu bomdabu; ukuthi iWHO inikeze ukwesekwa kuMazwe angamaLungu, ngesicelo, sokuthuthukisa impilo yomdabu; nokuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yabantu bomdabu kufakwe ekuthuthukisweni koHlelo Lomsebenzi Jikelele Lweshumi Nane lweWHO. Esinqumweni esifanayo, i-Health Assembly yanxusa amazwe angamalungu ukuthi, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, athuthukise ulwazi ngesimo sezempilo sabantu bomdabu, ngemvume yabo yamahhala, yangaphambilini kanye nolwazi; ukuthuthukisa, ukuxhasa ngezimali kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zezempilo zikazwelonke, amasu noma ezinye izinyathelo zabantu bomdabu;

UDkt Nakatani uneziqu zobudokotela kanye nePhD kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Razia Pendse uzoba yiChef de Cabinet kusukela ngomhlaka-4 kuNhlaba 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Pendse uzohola Ihhovisi Lomqondisi-Jikelele, asize ukuqhuba okubalulekile kanye nezinhlelo Zenhlangano, futhi azoqinisekisa ukuqondanisa eqenjini lobuholi beWHO kanye nakuwo wonke amazinga amathathu eWHO. UDkt Pendse ubesebenza njengoMqondisi Wezifo Zabantu Abaphilile kanye Nezingathathelwana eHhovisi Lesifunda leWHO eNingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia futhi phambilini wayenguMmeleli weWHO eSri Lanka. UDkt Pendse uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu zobungcweti kwezempilo yomphakathi.

ukukhuthaza ukuheha, ukuqeqesha, ukuqasha kanye nokugcina Abantu Bomdabu njengabasebenzi bezempilo abacabangela ulwazi lwesintu kanye nemikhuba. Idokhumenti ehlobene: A76/A/CONF./1 - Ezempilo Zabantu Bomdabu Isinqumo sokuqala sokusheshisa isinyathelo ekuvimbeleni ukugwilizaIzihambeli eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisithupha Nesithupha zavumelana nesisombululo sokusheshisa isinyathelo ekuvimbeleni ukugwiliza emhlabeni jikelele. Isinqumo sicela Amazwe Angamalungu ukuthi ahlole isimo sawo sokugwiliza kuzwelonke futhi athuthukise futhi asebenzise izinhlelo zokuvimbela ukugwiliza ezimbonini eziningi. Ukugwiliza kubangela ukufa kwabantu abangama-236 000 minyaka yonke.

ukushicilela umbiko oyisisekelo ngasekupheleni kuka-2026 onolwazi mayelana nomthamo wamaZwe angamaLungu wokuphendula ezidingweni zokuvuselelwa; ukuthuthukisa okuhlosiwe nezinkomba zokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngezinsizakalo zokuvuselela ngo-2030; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zihlukaniswa kuWHO ukuze kusekelwe amaZwe angamaLungu ekusebenziseni isiqondiso sezobuchwepheshe kanye nezinsiza; nokusekela amaZwe angamaLungu ukuthi ahlanganise ukuvuselelwa kanye nobuchwepheshe bokusiza ekulungeleni izimo eziphuthumayo kanye nohlelo lokusabela. UNobhala weWHO uzobika ngenqubekelaphambili ekusetshenzisweni kwalesi sinqumo kuMhlangano weZempilo ngo-2026, 2028 no-2030.

Ukugqugquzela ukufinyelela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza zeT&CM ekulethweni kwezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuzinakekela ngokwezempilo. Impendulo yeWHO: Umbiko womhlaba wonke weWHO ngokuphathelene nemithi yendabuko kanye neyengeziwe ka-2019 wasungulwa ukuze kubhekwane nesikhala esikukuthembekile, okunokwethenjelwa kanye nedatha esemthethweni evela kuMazwe Angamalungu emkhakheni weT&CM. Lo mbiko ubukeza inqubekelaphambili yomhlaba wonke kuT&CM emashumini amabili eminyaka edlule futhi usekelwe eminikelweni evela ku-179 Member States WHO. Inikeza ulwazi olubalulekile kubenzi benqubomgomo, ochwepheshe bezempilo kanye nomphakathi ukuze bazuze kumnikelo ongaba khona weT&CM kwezempilo kanye nenhlalakahle.

Impilo yezocansi Uhlolojikelele: Impilo yezocansi ibalulekile empilweni kanye nasenhlalakahleni yabantu ngabanye, imibhangqwana kanye nemindeni, kanye nasekuthuthukisweni kwezenhlalo kanye nezomnotho kwemiphakathi kanye namazwe. Impilo yezocansi, uma ibukwa ngendlela eqinisekisa, idinga indlela enhle nenenhlonipho ngocansi kanye nobudlelwano bobulili, kanye nethuba lokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho kocansi okujabulisayo nokuphephile, ngaphandle kokuphoqelelwa, ukucwaswa kanye nobudlova. Ikhono labesilisa nabesifazane lokuthola impilo yezocansi kanye nenhlalakahle lincike kulokhu: ukufinyelela kulwazi olunzulu, oluseqophelweni eliphezulu mayelana nocansi kanye nobulili;

Izimpawu: Isepsis iyisimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha futhi idinga ukunakekelwa ngokushesha ukuze kuvinjelwe ezinye izinkinga noma ukufa. Ingase iveze izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezihlukahlukene ngezikhathi ezithile, ezinye zazo ezingase zibangele ukungaziwa kahle nezinye izimo. Ukutheleleka nge-septic kungase kubangele imfiva, kodwa futhi kungase kubangele izinga lokushisa eliphansi lomzimba, ukubanda kakhulu kanye nokuthuthumela. Kungase kube nobunzima bokuphefumula noma ukuphefumula ngokushesha, kanye nokunyuka kokushaya kwenhliziyo, noma okuphambene nalokho ukushaya kwenhliziyo okubuthakathaka kanye nomfutho wegazi ophansi. Kungase kubangele ukuphuma komchamo okuphansi, kanye nesikhumba esinombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, esinamabala noma esikhanyiswe ngendlela engajwayelekile, kanye nesimo sengqondo esishintshile.

Isineke sisakazwa sisuka kumuntu siye komunye ngamaconsi asulelayo ngesikhathi sokuthintana eduze nabantu abanaleli gciwane abanezimpawu zalesi sifo, noma kwezinye izimo ngezingubo ezingcolile kanye nemibhede. Inesikhathi sokufukamela sezinsuku eziyi-7-17 ngemva kokuchayeka futhi isithelelana kuphela uma imfiva isikhona. Abantu bahlala betheleleka kuze kube yilapho izilonda zokugcina ziwela. Isineke sasibulala abantu abangafika ku-30%. Ikhadi lokuhlonza isineke leWHO. Impendulo yeWHO: Isikhathi kusukela ekuqothulweni siye sachazwa yimpikiswano ende futhi eyinkimbinkimbi egxile ekubhujisweni kwamasheya okugcina asele evariola virus.

Izimiso Eziqondisayo ziphoqelela ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu kwabanikelayo kanye nabamukelayo. Ukubhekwa okusobala kweziphathimandla zezempilo ngokuphathelene nemisebenzi yokunikela kanye nokufakelwa kwezitho zomzimba nakho kubalulekile ukuze kwandiswe ukwethenjwa komphakathi ohlelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isinqumo sokuba umnikeli ngokuvamile sisekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi umnikelo ekutholakaleni kwezinsiza zokufakelwa zezitho zomzimba ungase ngelinye ilanga uzuzise izidingo zezempilo zomndeni womnikeli. Uma sikulungele ukufakelwa kufanele sidinge eyodwa, khona-ke kufanele sikulungele ukunikeza Izimiso Zokuziphatha: Izimiso Eziqondisayo zeWHO Zeseli Lomuntu, Izicubu Zomzimba Nokufakelwa Kwezitho Zomzimba

Kunezinyathelo ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuvimbela i-sepsis: Ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa kwama-microbial kanye nokutheleleka ngokuvimbela ukutheleleka okuphenduka i-sepsis Ngaphakathi emphakathini, ukuvimbela i-sepsis kusizwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlanzeka eziphumelelayo, ukuthuthukisa ukuhlanzeka kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi kanye nokutholakala, ukuhlinzeka ngokufinyelela emithini yokugoma, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasengozini enkulu, kanye nokudla okufanele, okuhlanganisa ukuncelisa ibele izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ukuvimbela ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kuncike ezinhlelweni zokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka (IPC), izindlela zokuhlanzeka eziphumelelayo, kanye nemishini ehlanzekile, esebenza kahle.

Ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi manje sekuyimbangela ehamba phambili yokushona kwezingane, okubalelwa ngaphezu kweyodwa kweziyisi-5 zazo zonke izingane ezishona ngaphambi kokuba zibe neminyaka emi-5 ubudala. Abasinda ngaphambi kwesikhathi bangabhekana nemiphumela yempilo yokuphila konke, kanye namathuba akhulayo okukhubazeka nokubambezeleka kokukhula. Izikhala zokusinda ngokwesifunda, imali engenayo, uhlanga Ukwakha umbiko oyingqophamlando ngesihloko ngo-2012, lo mbiko osha ovela “eminyakeni eyishumi” unikeza umbono ophelele ngokubhebhetheka kokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanye nomthelela wako omkhulu kwabesifazane, imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nezomnotho. Ngokuvamile, lapho kuzalwa khona izingane kunquma ukuthi ziyasinda yini.

I-WHO inxusa ohulumeni ukuthi bayeke ukuxhasa ngezimali izitshalo zikagwayi ezisongela impilo Ngosuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lokungabambi Uguwayi, iWHO inxusa ohulumeni ukuthi bayeke ukuxhasa ukulima ugwayi futhi basekele izitshalo ezisimeme ezingondla izigidi. "Ugwayi ubangela ukufa kwabantu abayizigidi eziyi-8 ngonyaka, kodwa ohulumeni emhlabeni wonke basebenzisa izigidi ukusekela amapulazi kagwayi," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. "Ngokukhetha ukutshala ukudla esikhundleni sikagwayi, sibeka impilo kuqala, silondoloze imvelo, futhi siqinise ukuvikeleka kokudla kubo bonke." Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-300 emhlabeni wonke babhekene nokuntuleka kokudla okunamandla.

Isibonelo, ukunukubezeka komoya kulinganiselwa ekutheni kunomthelela ekuzalweni ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwezingane eziyizigidi eziyi-6 unyaka ngamunye. Cishe ingane eyodwa kweziyishumi ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi izalwa emazweni ayi-10 abuthaka kakhulu athintwe yizinkinga zobuntu, ngokusho kokuhlaziywa okusha embikweni. Izingozi zempilo kamama, njengokukhulelwa kwentsha kanye ne-pre-eclampsia, zihlobene kakhulu nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo zocansi kanye nokuzala, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela umndeni ngendlela efanele, nokunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kanye nangesikhathi sokuzalwa. I-Ajenda yesenzo: ukutshalwa kwezimali okwengeziwe kwezwe kanye nokushisekela okuholwa abazali

Kunezinhlobo ezi-3 zemijikelezo yokudlulisela: I-Sylvatic (noma ihlathi) i-yellow fever isakazeka lapho izinkawu zilunywa omiyane basendle abadlulisela igciwane kwezinye izinkawu nakubantu. I-Intermediary yellow fever isakazeka lapho omiyane abahlala ekhaya bethelela kokubili izinkawu nabantu. Lolu uhlobo oluvame kakhulu lokuqubuka kwezifo e-Afrika. I-yellow fever yasemadolobheni ingabangela izifo eziwumshayabhuqe ezinkulu lapho abantu abathelelekile bethula igciwane ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi kanye nasezindaweni ezinonamba enkulu yomiyane nalapho abantu bengenawo amandla okuzivikela. Ngezikhathi ezithile, abahambi abathelelekile bathumela amacala emazweni angenayo i-yellow fever.

Labo abangenwe yileli gciwane kodwa abangaguli (okwamanje) nalesi sifo abakwazi ukusidlulisela. Abantu abatheleleke ngebhaktheriya yeTB basengozini yokugula ngeTB ngo-5-10% impilo yabo yonke. Labo abanamasosha omzimba abuthakathaka, njengabantu abaphila neHIV, ukungondleki noma isifo sikashukela, noma abantu abasebenzisa ugwayi, basengozini enkulu yokugula. Izimpawu: Izimpawu ezivamile zesifo seTB zihlanganisa: Ukukhwehlela isikhathi eside, Ubuhlungu besifuba, Ubuthakathaka noma ukukhathala, Ukuncipha, Imfiva, Ukujuluka ebusuku Ngokuvamile, lezi zimpawu zizoba mnene izinyanga eziningi, ngaleyo ndlela ziholele ekubambezelekeni kokufuna ukunakekelwa kanye nokwandisa ingozi yokusabalalisa ukutheleleka kwabanye.

Ubumpofu, izimo eziphansi zezenhlalo nezomnotho kanye nenhlanzeko yomuntu siqu kwenza kube lula ukusabalala kwe-yaws. Nakuba kunezimo ezingaphezu kuka-80 000 ze-yaws unyaka ngamunye, ochwepheshe bakholelwa ukuthi lesi sifo singalawulwa futhi ekugcineni siqedwe ngenxa yezizathu eziningana. Okokuqala, kwenzeka kuphela kubantu, hhayi ezilwaneni, okwenza ukulawula kube lula kakhulu. Kulula futhi ukwelapha ngemithi etholakala kalula futhi isivele iqedwe kwamanye amazwe, kuhlanganise ne-India. Amaphakethe asele okutheleleka nge-yaws, nakuba ngokuvamile ezindaweni ezikude, kusho ukuthi mancane amathuba okusabalala ngokubhekwa okufanele kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula.

Ifilimu ehambayo inemininingwane ngemiphumela lokhu okube nayo ekuthuthukisweni kwakhe kwezemfundo kanye nomsebenzi owenziwe yinhlangano yendawo engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ukuze igqamise lolu daba futhi ithathe izinyathelo zokuvimbela ubuthi bomthofu emphakathini othintekile. I-Tetanus Uhlolojikelele: I-Tetanus iyisifo esibucayi esithathelwana ngokuchayeka kuma-spores ebhaktheriya, i-Clostridium tetani, ehlala enhlabathini, amathe, uthuli nomquba. Amagciwane angangena emzimbeni ngokunqunywa okujulile, amanxeba noma ukusha okuthinta isimiso sezinzwa. Ukutheleleka kuholela ekunciphiseni imisipha ebuhlungu, ikakhulukazi umhlathi kanye nomhlathi womzimba, futhi ngokuvamile kwaziwa ngokuthi “i-lockjaw”. Abantu bayo yonke iminyaka yobudala bangathola i-tetanus kodwa lesi sifo sivame kakhulu futhi sibucayi ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa kanye nonina lapho umama engavikelekile ku-tetanus ngomgomo, i-tetanus toxoid.

Kubuye kulimaze impilo yezomnotho neyenhlalo yemindeni yabo, imiphakathi, kanye namazwe. Nakuba abanye besifazane besengozini kakhulu kunabanye, ubudlova bungenzeka kunoma yimuphi umuntu wesifazane, kunoma yiliphi izwe - kungakhathaliseki isiko, inkolo noma isimo sezomnotho. Ukungalingani ngokobulili okuhlanganisa izindinganiso zobulili eziyingozi kuyizimbangela eziyinhloko zobudlova obubhekiswe kwabesifazane. Ubudlova bungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabesifazane ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, ngokocansi, nangokuphathelene nokuzala. Kuhlotshaniswa nengozi eyengeziwe yokulimala, ingcindezi, ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo, ukukhulelwa okungahleliwe, izifo ezithathelana ngobulili, iHIV kanye nezinye izinkinga eziningi zempilo.

Imisebe ye-Ultraviolet Uhlolojikelele: Imisebe ye-Ultraviolet (UV) ihlanganisa ubude bamagagasi obungu-100-400 nm, okuyimvamisa ephakeme nobude bamagagasi obuphansi kunokukhanya okubonakalayo. Imisebe ye-UV ivela ngokwemvelo elangeni, kodwa futhi ingadalwa yimithombo yokwenziwa esetshenziswa embonini, kwezentengiselwano kanye nasekuzijabuliseni. Isifunda se-UV sihlanganisa ubude bamagagasi obungu-100-400 nm futhi sihlukaniswe ngamabhande amathathu: i-UVA (315-400 nm) UVB (280-315 nm) UVC (100-280 nm). Njengoba ukukhanya kwelanga kudlula emkhathini, yonke i-UVC kanye cishe no-90% wemisebe ye-UVB ifakwa yi-ozone, umhwamuko wamanzi, umoyampilo kanye ne-carbon dioxide.

Ezimweni ezingavamile, ukutheleleka kungabangelwa ukuphuza ubisi olungapasteurized oluvela ezimbuzini, ezimvwini noma ezinkomeni. Abantu bangathintana namakokonyana ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yangaphandle ezindaweni ezinamahlathi kuze kufike endaweni ephakeme ngamamitha angaba ngu-2000. Akukho ukudluliselwa okuqondile komuntu kumuntu. Izimpawu: Izifo eziningi zihlala zingenazimpawu. Uma kungokugula komtholampilo, isikhathi sokufukamela se-encephalitis ethwalwa amakokonyana sithatha izinsuku ezi-2-28 (ngokuvamile izinsuku eziyi-7-14) futhi silandelwa izinsuku ezi-1-8 zezimpawu ezijwayelekile zokubanda, njengokukhathala, ikhanda elibuhlungu kanye nokungaphatheki kahle, ngokuvamile kuhlangene nomkhuhlane ongu-≥38 °C.

Kodwa-ke, kusekusheshe kakhulu ukunikeza impendulo ecacile ngomthelela wesikhathi eside wamaHTP kanye/noma ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi we-elekthronikhi. Umthelela: Abantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-1.3 emhlabeni wonke basebenzisa imikhiqizo kagwayi, u-80% wabo basemazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi nendawo. Ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi kunomthelela ebuphofini ngokudlulisa imali esetshenziswa emakhaya kuzidingo eziyisisekelo, njengokudla nendawo yokuhlala, kuya kutshwala. Lokhu kuziphatha kokusebenzisa imali kunzima ukukunqanda ngoba ugwayi ulutha kakhulu. Futhi kubangela ukushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanye nokukhubazeka kwabantu abadala abasebenza ngempumelelo emakhaya ngaleyo ndlela kuholele ekunciphiseni imali engenayo yasendlini kanye nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.

Ukulungela okuphumelelayo kuncike ekuhleleni okuqinile kanye nasekusebenzeni okuhlanganisiwe. Ukuzibophezela ngokuhlanganyela kulezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo kuzobona inqubekelaphambili ifinyelelwa ngoZibandlela wezi-2025 njengoba kuzochazwa ku (Ukulungela Nokumelana Nezingozi Ezivelayo (PRET) uhlaka lokuqapha: Ukubuyekeza izinhlelo zokulungiselela eziqinisekisa izenzo eziza kuqala kanye nalezo ezicabangele okufundwe ezenzakalweni ezedlule. Ukuqaphela ubungozi obubangelwa amagciwane okuphefumula, ukuhlela ubhubhane lwamagciwane okuphefumula ngokusekelwe ezingqikithini ezikhonjwe kuPRET Module #1: Ukuhlela Ubhubhane Lwamagciwane Okuphefumula kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu

Ukukhavwa kwezempilo kuyo yonke indawo Uhlolojikelele: Ukukhavwa kwezempilo kuyo yonke indawo (UHC) kusho ukuthi bonke abantu bayakwazi ukuthola uhla oluphelele lwezinsiza zezempilo ezisezingeni abazidingayo, ngesikhathi nendawo abazidinga kuyo, ngaphandle kobunzima bezezimali. Ihlanganisa ukuqhubeka okugcwele kwezinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile, kusukela ekukhuthazeni impilo kuya ekuvimbeleni, ekwelashweni, ekubuyiseleni esimweni nasekunakekelweni kwe-palliative. Ukuze kufezeke lesi sithembiso, amazwe adinga ukuba nezinhlelo zezempilo eziqinile, ezisebenza kahle futhi ezilinganayo ezigxile emiphakathini ayisebenzelayo. Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo (PHC) kuyindlela ephumelela kakhulu futhi engabizi kakhulu yokufika lapho.

"Ngethemba ukuthi le Memorandum of Understanding izothuthukisa ukubambisana phakathi kweRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea kanye neWHO ukuze kuqiniswe amandla okukhiqiza amaLMICs," kusho uMnu Hwang Seunghyun uMqondisi Jikelele, iGlobal Vaccine Hub Office eMnyangweni Wezempilo kanye Nezenhlalakahle waseRepublic of Korea. Ngokufanayo, iWHO iqinisa uhlelo lokulawula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi kanye nokuphepha kwemikhiqizo yezempilo. Ama-ejensi anamandla okulawula nawo azothuthukisa ukuzethemba emikhiqizweni ekhiqizwa endaweni kanye nokulwa nokwaziswa okungelona iqiniso kanye nokutholakala kwemithi esezingeni eliphansi noma engamanga.

Imisebe ye-UVA ayithinteki kangako umkhathi. Ngakho-ke, imisebe ye-UV efinyelela ebusweni bomhlaba yakhiwe kakhulu yi-UVA enengxenye encane ye-UVB. Inani lemisebe ye-UV evela elangeni elishaya ubuso bomhlaba lincike ezicini eziningana, ezihlanganisa ukuphakama kwelanga esibhakabhakeni, ububanzi, ukumbozwa amafu, ukuphakama, ubukhulu besendlalelo se-ozone nokubonakala komhlaba. Ukuncipha kwesendlalelo se-ozone ngenxa yokunukubezeka okwenziwa abantu kwandisa inani le-UVA ne-UVB elifinyelela ebusweni. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela empilweni yabantu, izilwane, izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle kanye nezitshalo.

Impilo yasemadolobheni Uhlolojikelele: Ukufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kungenye yezindlela ezihamba phambili zomhlaba wonke zekhulu le-21 ezinomthelela omkhulu kwezempilo. Abantu abangaphezu kuka-55% bomhlaba bahlala ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni - isilinganiso okulindeleke ukuthi sikhuphuke sifike ku-68% ngowezi-2050. Njengoba ukukhula kwasemadolobheni okuzayo kuzokwenzeka emazweni asathuthuka, umhlaba namuhla unethuba eliyingqayizivele lokuqondisa ukufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nezinye izitayela ezinkulu zokuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha ngendlela evikela futhi ithuthukise impilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ngoba impilo kanye nenhlalakahle yezakhamuzi mhlawumbe iyimpahla ebaluleke kakhulu yedolobha.

Bhalisa kanye ukuze uthole imithombo yezindaba ukufinyelela kumtapo wezithombe weWHO ngokuchofoza “ukubhaliswa kwemidiya” kuleli khasi. Uma unemibuzo ephathelene nezithombe zeWHO thumela i-imeyili [i-imeyili ivikelwe] Okuqoshiwe kokusakazwa kwevidiyo nokunye okuqukethwe kwabezindaba kuzotholakala ukuze abezindaba bakulande kuCanto. Uma unemibuzo ephathelene nokudluliswa kwevidiyo bukhoma sicela uthumele i-imeyili [i-imeyili ivikelwe]. Imithombo yezokuxhumana WHO izohlinzeka ngezibuyekezo ezivamile ezivela kuMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke nge-Twitter – landela @WHO kanye ne-hashtag #WHA76. Landela amanye ama-akhawunti e-WHO ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze uthole izibuyekezo ezivela ku-#WHA76: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube

Uma ingelashwa, isyphilis ihlala iminyaka eminingi futhi ihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene. Ukudluliselwa ngokocansi kuvame ukwenzeka phakathi nezigaba zokuqala, okungukuthi, kuze kube yiminyaka emi-2 ngemva kokutheleleka. Phakathi nesigaba sokuqala (isifuba esiyinhloko), esihlala ngokwesilinganiso izinsuku ezingama-21, isilonda esisodwa, esingabuhlungu, esivame ukuba nzima futhi esiyindilinga (isilonda) sibonakala endaweni yokugonywa (ukuthintana), ngokuvamile esithweni sangasese, esibondeni noma emgodleni (kodwa kungase futhi kube yizitho zangasese ezingezona ezesifazane) futhi kungase kungaqashelwa. Ichancre iyaphola ngokwelashwa noma ngaphandle kokwelashwa phakathi kwamasonto ama-3 kuya kwayi-10. Uma ingelashwa, lesi sifo siqhubekela esigabeni sesibili.

Okusemqoka kulo msebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukulingana kuzolungela ubhubhane olulandelayo ndawonye. Kudingeka isinyathelo somphakathi wonke ukuze kwenziwe inqubekelaphambili echazwe kulolu Bizo Lokwenza. Ngakho-ke ukuqaliswa kufanele kuqinise ukuqina kwemiphakathi; ukugcina, ukusekela, nokwakha ezinhlelweni ezijwayelekile; futhi kusebenzise amandla amakhulu okuzilungiselela kanye nokusabela ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lolu Bizo Lokwenza lwakhishwa ku-Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats (PRET): Umhlangano Womhlaba Wonke Wezifo Ezibangela Izifo Ezisabekayo Zesikhathi Esizayo owawubanjwe ngomhlaka-24-26 kuMbasa 2023 eGeneva, eSwitzerland.

Abahambi bangase futhi bavezwe ezifweni eziningi ezithathelwanayo, futhi eziningi zazo zingavinjelwa ngokugoma. Nokho, zikhona ezinye izifo ezithathelwanayo, ezihlanganisa ezinye eziyingozi kakhulu, okungekho migomo yazo ekhona. Izindawo lapho indawo yokuhlala, inhlanzeko kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi kuyizinga eliphezulu kubeka izingozi ezimbalwa ezibucayi empilweni yabahambi. Lapho lezi zinsiza zinganikezwanga khona, abahambi kufanele bathathe izinyathelo eziqinile zokugwema ukugula. Izixwayiso zohambo ezivela emithonjeni kahulumeni kufanele zithathwe ngokungathi sína.

Nokho, lesi sifo singasakazeka kalula ezweni elisha kuphela uma kunezinhlobo zomiyane ezikwazi ukusidlulisela, izimo zezulu ezithile, kanye nendawo yokugcina izilwane edingekayo ukuze igcinwe. Izimpawu: I-Yellow fever ingavela ngezimpawu eziningi kanye nobukhulu. Uma usungenwe yi-virus ye-yellow fever, isebenza emzimbeni izinsuku ezi-3 ukuya kweziyi-6. Abantu abaningi abanazo izimpawu, kodwa uma zenzeka, ezivame kakhulu umkhuhlane, ubuhlungu bemisipha obunezinhlungu zomhlane ezibonakalayo, ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukungabi nesifiso sokudla, kanye nesicanucanu noma ukuhlanza. Ezimweni eziningi, izimpawu ziyanyamalala ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-4.

Udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni Uhlolojikelele: Udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni luhlanganisa zonke izinhlobo zodlame olubhekiswe kubantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18. Ezinsaneni nasezinganeni ezincane, ubudlova buhlanganisa ikakhulukazi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane (okungukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokocansi nangokomzwelo kanye nokunganakwa) ezandleni zabazali kanye nabanye abantu abanegunya. Abafana namantombazane basengozini efanayo yokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba nangokomzwelo kanye nokunganakwa, futhi amantombazane asengozini enkulu yokuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi. Njengoba izingane zifika ebusheni, ubudlova bozakwabo kanye nobudlova bomlingani osondelene naye, ngaphezu kokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kuba kuvame kakhulu.

Izimo ezinzima kakhulu zingadidaniswa nomalaleveva onzima, i-leptospirosis, i-viral hepatitis (ikakhulukazi izinhlobo ezinamandla), eminye imfiva yokopha, ukutheleleka ngamanye ama-flaviviruses (njenge-dengue haemorrhagic fever) kanye nobuthi. Ukuhlolwa kwe-Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) egazini kanye nomchamo ngezinye izikhathi kungathola igciwane ezigabeni zokuqala zesifo. Ezigabeni zakamuva, ukuhlolwa kokuhlonza amasosha omzimba kuyadingeka (IgM). Ukwelashwa: Izifo ze-Yellow fever zingabangela ukugula okungathi sína futhi zingabulala ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu. Ukwelashwa okusekelayo kusenesikhathi ezibhedlela kungathuthukisa amazinga okusinda.

Ukwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwababambiqhaza ekuhleleni ukulungela ubhubhane ngokusebenzisa ukuhlanganisa nokubambisana okuhleliwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezilinganayo; ukwenza izivivinyo ngokuhlanganyela; kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nemikhuba emihle, izinselele, kanye namathuba. Ukuzinikela ekutshalweni kwezimali okuqhubekayo, ukuxhasa ngezimali kanye nokuqapha ukulungela ubhubhane ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekubhekaneni nezikhala ezikhonjwe phakathi nobhubhane olwedlule kanye nobhubhane. Ukusabela kobhubhane lweCOVID-19 kubonise lokho okungafinyelelwa ngokuzibophezela kwezombusazwe, ukubandakanyeka komphakathi kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali.

Ubuhlungu bamathambo kanye nezilonda zamathambo nakho kungenzeka. Isigaba sesibili asithathelani futhi ngokuvamile sibonakala eminyakeni emihlanu ngemva kokutheleleka. Sibonakala ngemiphumela ekhubazayo yempumulo, amathambo kanye ne-palmar/plantar hyperkeratosis (ukukhuluphala). Ngemva kokuxilongwa kwendawo okusekelwe kulezi zimpawu, lesi sifo singaqinisekiswa ngokuhlola isampula esivela esikhumbeni ngaphansi kohlobo olukhethekile lwemicroscope (ukuhlolwa kwendawo emnyama). Ukuhlolwa kwegazi akuvamile ukusetshenziswa ngoba i-yaws ihlobene kakhulu nebhaktheriya ebangela isifo sesifuba futhi lezi zifo ezimbili zizobonisa umphumela ofanayo.

Uhlaka luphakamisa ukusebenzisana eduze nemikhakha engaphandle komkhakha wezempilo ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe impilo. Isebenza njengesiqondiso kubo bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bahlanganyele ngendlela ehambisanayo futhi ehlanganisiwe ngenhloso efanayo: ukukhuthaza impilo yabantu kanye neplanethi ngendlela esimeme futhi elinganayo. ukukhuthaza impilo yabantu kanye neplanethi ngendlela esimeme futhi elinganayo. Umhlangano ucela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi abike ngokuqaliswa kohlaka lomhlaba wonke ngo-2024, 2026 no-2031. Idokhumenti ehlobene: A76/7 Add.2 - Inhlalakahle kanye nokukhuthazwa kwezempilo

Ukungenelela kokuzinakekela kunganikeza izinketho eziwusizo, ezengeziwe ezikhungweni zezempilo ezijwayelekile noma ezisekelwe ezisebenzini zezempilo, njengengxenye yohlelo lwezempilo olusekelayo. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sobhubhane olufana neCOVID-19, lapho izinyathelo zokuzihlukanisa kanye nokuzihlukanisa ngokomzimba zenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu ukuthola izinsiza zabo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezijwayelekile kanye nemithi futhi izinhlelo zezempilo zikazwelonke zingaphazamiseka. I-WHO ifaka ukungenelela kokuzinakekela njengezenzo ezibalulekile ekuqondisweni kokusebenza ekulondolozeni izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile zomongo weCOVID-19.

Ukwelashwa Imithi enconywe yiWHO - i-albendazole (400 mg) kanye ne-mebendazole (500 mg) - iyasebenza, ayibizi futhi kulula ukuyinikeza abasebenzi abangewona abezokwelapha (isb. othisha). Baye bahlolwa kabanzi ngokuphathelene nokuphepha futhi baye basetshenziswa ezigidini zabantu abanemiphumela emibi embalwa. Kokubili i-albendazole kanye ne-mebendazole kunikelwa ngayo eminyangweni kazwelonke yezempilo ngeWHO kuwo wonke amazwe anezifo ezithile ukuze kwelashwe zonke izingane ezineminyaka yobudala yesikole. Ivermectin yokulawula i-S. stercoralis kulindeleke ukuthi itholakale ngentengo efinyelelekayo kusukela ngo-2021.

Ukubambisana Kwamantombazane Nokuvimbela Udlame. Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ukuhlukunyezwa nokunganakwa okwenzeka ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 ubudala. Kuhlanganisa zonke izinhlobo zokuphathwa kabi ngokomzimba kanye/noma ngokomzwelo, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, ukunganakwa, ukunganaki kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezentengiselwano noma okunye, okuholela ekulimaleni kwangempela noma okungenzeka empilweni yengane, ukusinda, ukukhula noma isithunzi esimweni sobudlelwano bomthwalo wemfanelo, ukwethembana noma amandla. Ukuchayeka ebudloveni bomlingani osondelene naye ngezinye izikhathi kufakwa njengendlela yokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane.

Ukwelashwa: Okwamanje awukho umuthi wokugomela i-yaws. Imfundo yezempilo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwenhlanzeko yomuntu siqu kuyindlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuvimbela. Ama-antibiotic amabili angasetshenziselwa ukwelapha i-yaws. Umthamo owodwa womlomo we-azithromycin (30 mg/kg, okungenani u-2 g) kungukwelashwa okunconyiwe. I-Benzathine penicillin (umthamo owodwa we-intramuscular) kumayunithi ayizigidi eziyi-0.6 (izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kweyi-10) namayunithi ayizigidi eziyi-1.2 (abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kweyi-10) kungasetshenziselwa iziguli okusolwa ukuthi zihlulekile ukwelashwa ngemva kwe-azithromycin, noma iziguli ezingakwazi ukwelashwa nge-azithromycin.

Ukugunyazwa kwabezindaba kwe-WHA76 kuzophathwa yiNhlangano Yezizwe eGeneva. Bhalisa nge-Indico. Lokhu kuhlala kuphakathi kokuphawuleka kakhulu kanye nempumelelo ejulile yezempilo yomphakathi emlandweni. Izimpawu: Izimpawu zokuqala zesimungumungwane zihlanganisa imfiva enkulu, ukukhathala kanye nobuhlungu obukhulu bomhlane, futhi ngokuvamile, ubuhlungu besisu kanye nokuhlanza. Ezinsukwini ezimbili kuya kwezingu-3 kamuva igciwane likhiqiza ukuqubuka okubonakalayo okunezinduna ezigcwele uketshezi olucacile, olugcwaliswa kamuva ngesikulu futhi ekugcineni lube nesikhumba esomile bese siwela phansi. Ukuqubuka kuqala ebusweni nasezandleni, bese kusabalala kuwo wonke umzimba. Izilonda zikhula ezilaphini zomlomo kanye nasekhala futhi zibe yisilonda ngokushesha ngemva kokwakheka.

Umuthi wokugomela i-yellow fever uphephile futhi awubizi, futhi umthamo owodwa unikeza ukugonywa impilo yonke ngokumelene nalesi sifo. Abantu abasinda ekuthelelekeni nge-yellow fever nabo bavikelekile impilo yabo yonke. Funda kabanzi mayelana nomuthi wokugomela i-yellow fever. Ukulawulwa komiyane nakho kungasiza ekuvimbeleni i-yellow fever futhi kubalulekile ezimweni lapho ukugonywa kuphansi noma umuthi wokugoma ungatholakali ngokushesha. Ukulawulwa komiyane kuhlanganisa ukuqeda izindawo lapho omiyane bengazalela khona futhi babulale omiyane abadala kanye nezibungu ngokusebenzisa izibulali-zinambuzane ezindaweni ezinobuningi obuphezulu bomiyane.

Amamodeli asikisela ukuthi umuntu udinga ukutheleleka okungaphezu kuka-150 impilo yakhe yonke ukuze abe nezinkinga zobumpumputhe ze-trachoma. I-trachoma ivamile kwabanye babantu abampofu kakhulu emhlabeni, abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya nezikude futhi abangakwazi ukuthola amanzi, ukukhucululwa kwendle kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngendlela efanele. I-Afrika iyizwekazi elithinteke kakhulu, kodwa futhi linemizamo yokulawula esakazekile kakhulu. Lesi sifo sitholakala naseMelika Ephakathi neseNingizimu, e-Asia, e-Australia naseMpumalanga Ephakathi. Kusukela ngomhla ziyisi-2 kuMasingana 2020, amazwe ayi-13 abike ukuthi afinyelele imigomo yokuqeda.

Izimpawu ezijwayelekile zihlanganisa ukukhishwa kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane noma isitho sangasese sowesilisa kanye nokusha ngokuphathelene nokuchama. Izinsana zomama abanaleli gciwane zingathola i-neonatal conjunctivitis (amehlo abomvu) ngenxa yokuchayeka ezifweni ezithathelana ngocansi ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Izifo ze-rectal kanye ne-pharyngeal zingaba yi-asymptomatic. Isifo sesifo sofuba: Isifo sofuba sivame ukungabi nezimpawu, lapho kuvela izimpawu, isifo sofuba sokuqala sibonakala njengesilonda esisodwa, esingabuhlungu. Isifo sofuba sesibili singabonakala njengezilonda ezivamile ezithinta isikhumba, ulwelwesi lwezindlala kanye ne-lymph-node okuhlanganisa ukuqubuka okujwayelekile ezandleni kanye nasezinyaweni.

I-UAE neWHO iletha izinsiza zokwelapha ezibucayi eSudan. I-United Arab Emirates (UAE) kanye neNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba ilethe amathani angama-30 ezinsiza zokwelapha eziphuthumayo eSudan namuhla. Indiza ethwele izinsiza zokwelapha ukulimala, ukuhlinzwa okuphuthumayo, kanye nemithi ebalulekile yafika ePort Sudan Airport ekuseni kakhulu. Ukuthunyelwa, okubalwa ku-US$ 444 000, kungokokuqala iWHO ikwazile ukukuletha ngendiza eSudan selokhu kwaqubuka ingxabano. I-WHO yasabalalisa izinsiza ezikhungweni zezempilo ngaphambi kokwanda kwengxabano.

Emadodeni, i-urogenital schistosomiasis ingabangela ukugula kwama-seminal vesicles, iprostate, nezinye izitho zomzimba. Lesi sifo singase futhi sibe neminye imiphumela yesikhathi eside engenakuguqulwa, ehlanganisa ukungabatholi abantwana. Imiphumela yezomnotho kanye nezempilo ye-schistosomiasis ibalulekile futhi lesi sifo sikhubaza kakhulu kunokubulala. Ezinganeni, i-schistosomiasis ingabangela i-anaemia, ukungakhuli kahle kanye nekhono elincishisiwe lokufunda, nakuba imiphumela ivame ukuguquka ngokwelashwa. Ukwelashwa: I-Praziquantel iyindlela yokwelapha enconyiwe ngokumelene nazo zonke izinhlobo ze-schistosomiasis.

Naphezu kwenqubekelaphambili eminingi umhlaba oye wayenza eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, asizange senze inqubekelaphambili ekwehliseni inani lezingane ezincane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma ukugwema ingozi yokufa kwazo. Inani liyabhubhisa. Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni komama abakhulelwe kanye nezinsana ezibelethwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izingane ziqala ukuphila ngendlela enempilo futhi zikhule ngendlela efanele.” UHelga Fogstad, uMqondisi Omkhulu, PMNCH “Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kugcizelela ukuthi kungani kufanele sikhuphule ukutshalwa kwezimali kanye nokuziphendulela ngokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi - imbangela enkulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni yokufa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu.

Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha - Ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke: 30 kuNhlaba 2023 Umhlangano waminyaka yonke weWHO uphela ngesivumelwano sokuxhasa ngezimali, kanye nohlu lwezihloko zezempilo Umhlangano wezempilo weWHO wama-76 uvalwe namuhla, njengoba ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi, okuhlanganisa isayensi yokuziphatha; ukuthenga okuhle kakhulu kwezifo ezingathathelani; ukuxilonga; ukukhubazeka; ukuvimbela ukugwiliza; ukunakekelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, okubucayi nokusebenza; izakhamzimba zokudla; impilo yomdabu; ukuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka; impilo kamama nengane; umoyampilo wezokwelapha; ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo; impilo yabangenandawo kanye nabafuduki;

Ngokombiko wakamuva weWorld malaria, oshicilelwe ngoZibandlela wezi-2022, bekunabantu abasha abalinganiselwa ezigidini ezingama-247 abanomalaleveva ngowezi-2021. Isifunda seWHO sase-Afrika siyaqhubeka nokuthwala umthwalo osindayo walesi sifo - okubalelwa ku-95% wazo zonke izigameko zikamalaleveva (izigidi ezingama-234) kanye no-96% wabo bonke abashonile (593 000) ngowezi-2021. Cishe u-80% wokufa kukamalaleveva esifundeni sase-Afrika kwakuphakathi kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu. Amasu namathuluzi amasha Amazwe enze inqubekelaphambili ethile ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zikamalaleveva kubantu abasengozini enkulu.

UDkt Anshu Banerjee, uMqondisi weMaternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health and Ageing kuWHO “Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi kulezi zingane ezincane kakhulu, ezisengozini kakhulu kanye nemindeni yazo kubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yezingane kanye nokusinda. Kudingeka futhi inqubekelaphambili ukuze kusizwe ukuvimbela ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi - lokhu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu wesifazane kufanele akwazi ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngaphambi nangesikhathi sokukhulelwa ukuze kutholakale futhi kulawulwe izingozi.” USteven Lauwerier, uMqondisi weZempilo (a.i.), UNICEF “Ngemva kokushona ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuba umzila wokulahlekelwa kanye nokudabuka.

Isifo sesithuthwane sesibili sibonakala ngokuqubuka okungahluka kakhulu futhi kulingisa ezinye izimo ezithathelwanayo noma ezingathathelwana, kodwa ngokuvamile kuthinta izandla kanye nezinyawo. Ukuqubuka akulumlisi futhi kungaba kuncane ngokwanele ukuthi kunganakwa. Ezindaweni ezifudumele nezinomswakama zomzimba, njenge-anus kanye ne-labia, izilonda ezinkulu ezimhlophe noma ezimpunga eziphakamayo zingase zivele endaweni yesilonda sokuqala (i-condyloma lata). Izimpawu nezimpawu zesifo sesibili ziyaphela ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngisho nangaphandle kokwelashwa. Ngaphandle kokwelashwa, isigaba esifihlekile siyaqala.

amaqanda adliwa emithonjeni yamanzi engcolile; amaqanda adliwa yizingane ezidlala emhlabathini ongcolile bese zifaka izandla zazo emlonyeni ngaphandle kokuwageza. Izimpawu: Ukugula kuhlobene nenani lezikelemu ezifihliwe. Abantu abanezifo zokuqina kokukhanya (izikelemu ezimbalwa) ngokuvamile abahlushwa yileli gciwane. Izifo ezinzima kakhulu zingabangela izimpawu ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa ukubonakaliswa kwamathumbu (isifo sohudo kanye nobuhlungu besisu), ukungondleki, ukungaphilisi kahle ngokujwayelekile kanye nobuthakathaka, kanye nokungakhuli kahle kanye nokukhula ngokomzimba.

Amaphesenti amancane eziguli angena esigabeni sesibili, esinobuthi kakhulu kungakapheli amahora angama-24 ngemva kokululama ezimpawu zokuqala. Imfiva ephezulu iyabuya futhi izinhlelo eziningana zomzimba ziyathinteka, ngokuvamile isibindi nezinso. Kulesi sigaba, abantu kungenzeka babe ne-jaundice (ukuba nombala ophuzi kwesikhumba namehlo, yingakho igama elithi yellow fever), umchamo omnyama, nobuhlungu besisu ngokuphalaza. Ukopha kungenzeka emlonyeni, ekhaleni, emehlweni, noma esiswini. Ingxenye yalezi ziguli iyafa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7-10. I-Yellow fever kunzima ukuyihlola, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezigaba zokuqala.

Isinqumo sinxusa Amazwe Angamalungu ukuthi athuthukise izinqubomgomo zokunikezwa kwezakhamzimba ekudleni kanye nokwengeza izakhamzimba, futhi acabangele izindlela zokuqinisa izindlela zokuxhasa ngezimali kanye nokuqapha. Isinqumo savunywa ngaphansi kwesambulela soMbiko we-United Nations Decade of Action on Nutrition (2016-2025). Idokhumenti ehlobene: EB152/CONF./5 Ukusheshisa imizamo yokuvimbela ukushoda kwezakhamzimba kanye nemiphumela yako, okuhlanganisa i-spina bifida kanye nezinye iziphambeko zethubhu yezinzwa, ngokusebenzisa ukunikezwa kokudla okuphephile futhi okusebenzayo okunezakhamzimba Amalinki ahlobene

Uhlaka olusha, olwenziwe ngokuhlanganyela yiWHO kanye ne-UN-Habitat, ukuze kuqondiswe abaholi bamadolobha ekulawuleni umalaleveva wasemadolobheni. Ithuluzi elisha lokusiza amazwe ukuthi ahlole izinhlelo zawo zokuqapha umalaleveva futhi ahlukanise izindawo zokutshala imali. I-WHO iphinde yenyusa ukubonakala, ukuguquguquka kanye nokufinyelela kuzincomo zayo zikamalaleveva. Imihlahlandlela ehlanganisiwe yeWHO yokulawula umalaleveva manje isiyatholakala ngamapulatifomu amabili edijithali: iMAGICapp kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lwe-“Malaria Toolkit”. I-WHO ikhuthaza amazwe ukuthi enze izincomo zibe yizilungiselelo zesifo sendawo ukuze kube nomthelela omkhulu.

Izindlela zokuxhasa ngezimali izinhlelo zesenzo sikazwelonke (amaNAP) ngokumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane ngokuhlela isabelomali esihlangene semikhakha eminingi, uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi amaNAP amaningi ahlala engaxhaswa ngezimali. Izincomo ezifakwe kulo mbiko zingashintsha indlela amazwe abheka futhi axhase ngayo ezempilo. I-WHO icela abenzi benqubomgomo, umphakathi, namalungu emiphakathi yezempilo nezomnotho ukuthi bacabangele ngokugcwele izincomo futhi bazisebenzise njengekhampasi yokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezakhiwo ezintsha zezomnotho ezingasihambisa endleleni yokwenza impilo yabo bonke ibe ngokoqobo.

Ama-yaws (Ama-treponematoses aqubukayo) Uhlolojikelele: Ama-yaws yisifo esingamahlalakhona sesikhumba esibonakala ngama-papillomas (izinduna ezingewona umdlavuza) kanye nezilonda. Sibangelwa ibhaktheriya iTreponema pallidum subspecies pertenue, engeqenjini elifanayo lamabhaktheriya abangela isyphilis ye-venereal. Ama-yaws athinta kakhulu izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-15 ezihlala emiphakathini empofu ezindaweni ezifudumele, ezinomswakama kanye namahlathi ashisayo e-Afrika, e-Asia, eLatin America kanye naseziqhingini zasePacific. Iningi labantu abathintekile lihlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kude nezinsiza zezempilo.

Phakathi kwalokhu, umbiko usho izibonelo eziningana, okuhlanganisa: Isikhungo sobuchwepheshe be-mRNA eNingizimu Afrika: uhlelo oluqhutshwa ngamanani oluzama ukuthola izinto ezintsha, ezezimali kanye namandla afanele ngaphambi kwesikhathi; Ukutshalwa kwezimali komphakathi eBrazil endaweni eyinkimbinkimbi yezimboni zezempilo esebenzela inhlalakahle yomphakathi; Amabhange entuthuko yesifunda njengabagqugquzeli bezinguquko eNingizimu Yomhlaba; I-Wellbeing Economy Alliance - umfelandawonye wohulumeni abaningana kanye nezinye izinhlangano ezingaphezu kuka-600 ezisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziguqule izinhlelo zezomnotho ekusebenzeleni impilo;

Impilo yabesifazane Uhlolojikelele: Ukuba yindoda noma owesifazane kunomthelela omkhulu empilweni, ngenxa yokwehluka kokubili kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nobulili. Impilo yabesifazane kanye namantombazane iyakhathaza ikakhulukazi ngoba, emiphakathini eminingi, bayahlupheka ngenxa yobandlululo olusekelwe ezicini zezenhlalo nezamasiko. Isibonelo, abesifazane kanye namantombazane babhekene nokuba sengozini eyengeziwe yeHIV/AIDS. Ezinye zezici zezenhlalo nezamasiko ezivimbela abesifazane kanye namantombazane ukuthi bazuze ezinsizeni zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu futhi bathole izinga lempilo elingcono kakhulu zihlanganisa:

Funda kabanzi mayelana nesinqumo somsebenzi weWHO wokunikeza ukudla okunomsoco Amazwe Angamalungu avuma izinyathelo zokulwa nemithi esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe Ngomhla zingama-27 kuNhlaba, i-World Health Assembly yamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha yagunyaza isinqumo sokwenza ukubuyekezwa okuzimele kweMember State Mechanism (MSM) yezigameko, imithi esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe, kuqiniswa ucingo lukaMqondisi-Jikelele lukaMasingana 2023 lokwanda kokuqapha kanye nokwenza okuthile kule ndawo ebalulekile. Ukubuyekezwa kuzoqalwa emhlanganweni olandelayo wekomidi eliqondisayo leMSM kamuva ngo-2023.

Bagcizelela ukubaluleka kokwakha amandla kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi emahhovisi esifunda, kanye nokwakha indawo yokugcina ubufakazi kanye nokusebenzisana phakathi kwemikhakha, okuhlanganisa nezemfundo kanye nomkhakha ozimele. Amadokhumenti ahlobene: EB152(23) - Izifundo zokuziphatha zezempilo ezingcono EB152/25 - Izifundo zokuziphatha zezempilo ezingcono, Umbiko nguMqondisi Jikelele Izifundo Zokuziphatha Zokwenza Ngcono Impilo Izinto ezingenhla kwaxoxwa ngazo njengengxenye yedokhumenti A76/7 Rev.1 - Umbiko ohlanganisiwe nguMqondisi Jikelele.

Imizamo kagesi yasemakhaya yaba negalelo kulokhu kuthuthuka, kodwa kusekhona igebe elikhulu ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Ngo-2021, abantu abayizigidi ezingama-567 e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara babengenawo ugesi, okubalelwa ngaphezu kuka-80% wabantu bomhlaba abangakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo. Ukuntuleka kokufinyelela esifundeni kwahlala kucishe kufane nango-2010. Umhlaba usalokhu ungakatholi ukufinyelela kokupheka okuhlanzekile ngowezi-2030. Abantu abafinyelela ezigidini eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.3 basasebenzisa amafutha kanye nobuchwepheshe obunukubeza umoya ekuphekeni, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara nase-Asia.

Okwamanje awukho umuthi oqondile wokulwa negciwane we-yellow fever, kodwa ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kokwelapha ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, imfiva, kanye nokungasebenzi kahle kwesibindi nezinso kuthuthukisa imiphumela. Izifo ezihlobene namagciwane zingelashwa ngemithi elwa namagciwane. Iziguli zidinga ukuhlala ngaphansi kwamanethi omiyane emini ukuze zinciphise ingozi yokusabalala kwabanye ngokulunywa omiyane. Ukugoma kuyisinyathelo esisodwa esibaluleke kakhulu sokuvimbela i-yellow fever. Ukuvimbela ukuqubuka kungatholakala kuphela uma iningi labantu ligonyiwe.

Amatafula asezindaweni zokudlela aqhutshwa nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sokudla kwasemini kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo eGumbini XVIII. Le micimbi izosingatha izingxoxo phakathi kwezihambeli zomhlangano, ama-ejensi abambisene nawo, abamele umphakathi kanye nochwepheshe beWHO mayelana nezinto eziza kuqala kwezempilo yomphakathi. Imihlangano iqala ngomhlaka-22-27 kuNhlaba, kusukela ngo-13:00 kuya ku-14:15 CEST futhi ingalandelwa ku-inthanethi. Njengomzimba wokuthatha izinqumo ophakeme weWHO, i-Health Assembly ibeka inqubomgomo yeNhlangano futhi ivume isabelomali sayo. I-WHA ibanjwe yizihambeli ezivela kuwo wonke amazwe angamalungu eWHO angu-194.

Uma ingelashwa, isyphilis ihlala iminyaka eminingi futhi idlula ezigabeni ezahlukene. Ukwelashwa kwesyphilis kwenziwa ngepenicillin benzathine, ngemithamo eyi-1 ukuya kweyi-3 kuye ngesigaba sesifo. Ipenicillin kuphela engavimbela isyphilis esizalwa nayo. Ukwelashwa ngepenicillin kuye kwaphazanyiswa ukushoda kwe-benzathine penicillin ngezikhathi ezithile futhi isikhathi eside emazweni amaningi, okuhlanganisa amazwe anamaholo aphezulu, aphansi kanye naphakathi nendawo. Izimpawu: Abantu abaningi abane-syphilis abanazo izimpawu noma abaziboni.

Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (STIs) Uhlolojikelele: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (STIs) zisakazwa kakhulu ngokuthintana ngokocansi okungavikelekile. Ezinye izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi zingadluliselwa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, sokubeletha kanye nokuncelisa ibele nangegazi elinegciwane noma imikhiqizo yegazi. Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi zinomthelela omkhulu empilweni. Uma zingelashwa, zingaholela emiphumeleni emibi kakhulu ehlanganisa isifo sezinzwa kanye nesifo senhliziyo, ukungabatholi abantwana, ukukhulelwa ngaphandle kwesibeletho, ukubeletha, kanye nengozi eyengeziwe yeHuman Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).

Ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokuhlolwa kokuxilonga nakho kuyatholakala futhi kunganikeza imiphumela ngaphansi kwemizuzu engu-20, kube lula ukuqala ukwelashwa ngokushesha. I-WHO incoma ukuthi isyphilis yelashwe ngepenicillin (benzathine penicillin G) ngomjovo owodwa noma emithathu, kuye ngesigaba sesifo. I-WHO inemihlahlandlela yokwelashwa eningiliziwe yesyphilis, kanye neyodwa ngokuqondile yokuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwesyphilis ekukhulelweni. Isifo sesayphilis esizalwa naso Okwamanje azikho izivivinyo zokuxilonga zesayphilis esizalwa naso.

Ukufakelwa kwezitho zomzimba Uhlolojikelele: Ukufakelwa kwezinhlayiya zomuntu, izicubu zomzimba kanye nezitho zomzimba Ukufakelwa kwezinhlayiya zomuntu, izicubu zomzimba noma izitho zomzimba kusindisa izimpilo eziningi futhi kubuyisele imisebenzi ebalulekile lapho kungekho ezinye izindlela eziphumelelayo ezikhona. Eminyakeni engama-50, ukufakelwa kwezitho zomzimba sekube umkhuba ophumelelayo emhlabeni wonke. Nokho, kunomehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamazwe ekufinyeleleni ekufakweni okufanele kanye nasezingeni lokuphepha, ikhwalithi, ukusebenza ngendlela efanele kokunikela kanye nokufakelwa kwamangqamuzana omuntu, izicubu zomzimba kanye nezitho zomzimba.

Ukulunywa yinyoka envenoming Uhlolojikelele: Ukulunywa yinyoka envenoming yisifo esisongela ukuphila esibangelwa ubuthi obutholakala ngokulunywa yinyoka enobuthi. Ukulunywa kungabangelwa futhi ukufuthwa ubuthi emehlweni yizinhlobo ezithile zezinyoka ezinekhono lokuthululela ushevu njengesinyathelo sokuzivikela. Imizamo edlule enganele yokulawula ukulunywa yinyoka envenoming iye yakhiqiza idatha ye-epidemiological ehlukanisiwe, enganembile. Izisulu eziningi azihambeli izikhungo zezempilo noma izibhedlela futhi esikhundleni salokho zithembele ekwelashweni kwendabuko.

Uqaphele ukuthi abalusi ababehanjiswe ngaphambilini ngokukhishwa kwe-cowpox abazange bakhishwe yisifo sofuba futhi babonise ukuthi ukugonywa okufanayo kungasetshenziswa ukuvimbela isifo sofuba kwabanye abantu. I-World Health Organization yethula uhlelo oluqinisiwe lokuqeda isifo sofuba ngo-1967. Ukugonywa okusabalele kanye nokubhekwa kwenziwa emhlabeni wonke iminyaka eminingana. Icala lokugcina elaziwayo lemvelo laliseSomalia ngo-1977. Ngo-1980 iWHO yamemezela ukuthi isifo sofuba siqediwe – okuwukuphela kwesifo esithathelwanayo esazuza lo mehluko.

Ugwayi Uhlolojikelele: I-nicotine equkethwe ugwayi ilutha kakhulu futhi ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi kuyisici esiyingozi kakhulu sezifo zenhliziyo kanye nemithambo yegazi kanye nezifo zokuphefumula, izinhlobo ezingaphezu kuka-20 ezahlukene noma izinhlobo ezincane zomdlavuza, nezinye izimo eziningi zempilo ezikhubazayo. Minyaka yonke, abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-8 babulawa ukubhema ugwayi. Ukufa okuningi okuhlobene nogwayi kwenzeka emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi, okuvame ukuba yizisulu zokuphazamiseka okukhulu komkhakha kagwayi nokumaketha. Ugwayi ungabulala futhi abantu abangabhemi.

Inkambo yemithi yeTB inikezwa isiguli ngolwazi, ukubhekwa nokusekelwa yisisebenzi sezempilo noma umvolontiya oqeqeshiwe. Ngaphandle kwalolo sizo, ukunamathela ekwelashweni kungaba nzima. Uma ukwelashwa kungaqediwe ngendlela efanele, lesi sifo singaba yimithi emelana nemithi futhi singasabalala. Endabeni yokutheleleka ngeTB (lapho isiguli sitholakala sinebhaktheriya yeTB kodwa singaguli), ukwelashwa kokuvimbela iTB kunganikezwa ukuze kunqandwe ukuqala kwesifo. Lokhu kwelashwa kusebenzisa imithi efanayo isikhathi esifushane.

ubudlelwano bamandla obungalingani phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane; izinkambiso zomphakathi ezinciphisa imfundo kanye namathuba emisebenzi ekhokhelwayo; ukugxila kuphela ezindimeni zabesifazane zokuzala; kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okungase kube khona noma kwangempela kobudlova obungokomzimba, bobulili kanye nobungokomzwelo. Nakuba ubumpofu buyisithiyo esibalulekile emiphumeleni emihle yezempilo kubo bobabili abesilisa kanye nabesifazane, ubumpofu buvame ukuletha umthwalo omkhulu empilweni yabesifazane kanye namantombazane ngenxa, isibonelo, yezindlela zokupha ukudla (ukuphelelwa ukudla okunomsoco) kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamafutha okupheka angaphephile (COPD).

Uma umhlinzeki wezokunakekelwa kwempilo esola ukuthi isiguli sinesifo se-TB, bazothumela isiguli ukuyohlolwa. Endabeni yesifo se-TB samaphaphu okusolwayo, iziguli zizocelwa ukuthi zinikeze isampula yamaphaphu ukuze zihlolwe amagciwane e-TB. Ngesifo se-TB esingeyona amaphaphu, amasampula oketshezi lomzimba oluthintekile kanye nezicubu zomzimba angahlolwa. I-WHO incoma ukuhlolwa okusheshayo kwezamangqamuzana njengokuhlolwa kokuqala kwabantu ababonisa izimpawu neziqalo ze-TB. Amanye amathuluzi okuxilonga angahlanganisa i-sputum smear microscopy kanye ne-X-ray yesifuba.

I-WHO imemezela abawinile be-4th Health for All Film Festival amafilimu amafushane awine ama-7, okushiwo okukhethekile okungu-4 okuvela kumajaji I-World Health Organization imemezele ukukhethwa ngokusemthethweni kwamafilimu anqobile alo nyaka ku-4th Annual Health for All Film Festival, ebibanjelwe eNdlunkulu yeWHO, eGeneva. Umcimbi, owahanjelwa mathupha kanye naku-inthanethi ngabalingisi, abakhiqizi kanye nabantu abavelele emphakathini, wabona amafilimu anqobile ememezwa ezigabeni eziyisikhombisa ezihlukene, kuyilapho amafilimu amane athola ukushiwo ngokukhethekile emajerini.

Abanikezwe imiklomelo namuhla baveza lokho kuthanda kwabo. Izindaba zabo ezihlanganisiwe kanye nempumelelo yabo zibonisa ukuthi umhlaba usuthuthuke kangakanani ngokuphathelene nokubambisana emazingeni omhlaba, esifunda kanye nezwe ukuze kuqiniswe ukulungela izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo, ukusabela kanye nokuqina. Laba sosayensi abavelele bazoqhubeka nokusikhuthaza nsuku zonke, wanezela. Umkhosi wemiklomelo uyingxenye yeseshini yokuvula esezingeni eliphezulu yoMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba wama-76 obanjwe ngeSonto zingama-21 kuNhlaba 2023 eGeneva.

I-FSME-Immun ne-Encepur, ekhiqizwa e-Austria naseJalimane ngokulandelana, futhi esekelwe ezinhlotsheni zaseYurophu zaleli gciwane; kanye ne-TBE-Moscow ne-EnceVir, ekhiqizwa eRussian Federation futhi esekelwe ezinhlotsheni zaseMpumalanga Ekude. Imithi yokugoma emi-4 ibhekwa njengephephile futhi esebenza ngendlela efanele. Ezindaweni lapho lesi sifo sivame kakhulu, iWHO incoma ukuthi kunikezwe imithi yokugoma kuwo wonke amaqembu eminyaka yobudala, kuhlanganise nezingane. Amathikithi nawo adlulisela iBorreliosis (isifo saseLyme), okuyisifo esibangelwa amagciwane.

Ngomhlaka-16-17 Mashi 2023, iTAG-CO-VAC yaphinde yahlangana eMuscat, e-Oman. Inhloso yomhlangano yayiyizinto ezimbili: ukubuyekeza ubufakazi ngokusebenza kwemigomo ebuyekeziwe yeCOVID-19 efaka izinhlobo zozalo ze-Omicron njengomthamo wokugqugquzela; kanye nokusungula imigqa yesikhathi yokunconywa kokwakhiwa komgomo weCOVID-19 ngowezi-2023. Ubufakazi obubuyekezwe yiTAG-CO-VAC ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwemigomo ebuyekeziwe yeCOVID-19 efaka izinhlobo zozalo ze-Omicron kwakuhlanganisa:

I-Trachoma ingaqedwa njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi kusetshenziswa isu le-SAFE, elihlanganisa: Ukuhlinzwa ukuze kwelashwe i-trachomatous trichiasis, isigaba esiyimpumputhe salesi sifo; Imithi elwa namagciwane ukuze kususwe ukutheleleka, ikakhulukazi ukuphathwa kwezidakamizwa eziningi ze-antibiotic azithromycin, enikelwa ngumenzi ezinhlelweni zikazwelonke nge-International Trachoma Initiative; Ukuhlanzeka kobuso; kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwendawo ezungezile, ikakhulukazi ukufinyelela okungcono emanzini kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle.

Ukwelashwa: I-Trachoma ingavinjelwa ngokunciphisa izici eziyingozi zendawo ezungezile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa inhlanzeko enganele, imizi enabantu abaningi, ukungafinyeleli ngokwanele emanzini kanye nokungafinyeleli ngokwanele kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezindlu zangasese. Izifo ngokuvamile ziqala zisencane futhi zikhula kancane futhi zibe mfushane ngokuphathelene nobudala obandayo. Izifo zivame ukutholakala emndenini kanye nokuthintana nabanye abanesifo esisebenzayo. Ukutheleleka ngokuphindaphindiwe kubangela izimpawu ezibucayi kakhulu zesifo.

I-SDG3 GAP ichaza indlela ama-ejensi ayi-13 asayinile azothatha ngayo izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, akhe ekubambisaneni okuphumelelayo okukhona, futhi ahlanganise ngokuhlanganyela ukweseka kwawo mayelana nezinhlelo zikazwelonke namasu aphethwe futhi aqondiswa izwe. Abasayinile kuSDG3 GAP yiGavi, iVaccine Alliance; IGlobal Financing Facility for Women, Children and Adolescents (GFF); IGlobal Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (Global Fund); International Labour Organization (ILO);

Ukuvimbela: Abantu bangazivikela emikhazeni ngokugqoka izingubo ezifanele, okuhlanganisa amabhulukwe amade nezicathulo ezivaliwe, lapho behamba ngezinyawo noma bekhempa emazweni noma ezindaweni ezisengozini. Umzimba wonke kufanele uhlolwe nsuku zonke futhi kususwe imikhaza esincanyaswayo ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka. Ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo yobisi engapasteurized nakho kufanele kugwenywe kulezo zindawo. Ukugonywa kunikeza isivikelo esisebenza ngempumelelo kakhulu. Njengamanje, kunemithi yokugoma emi-4 esetshenziswa kabanzi eqinisekisa ikhwalithi:

ISchistosomiasis (Bilharzia) Uhlolojikelele: ISchistosomiasis yisifo sobumpofu esiholela ekuguleni okungamahlalakhona. Ukutheleleka kwenzeka lapho abantu bethintana namanzi ahlanzekile agcwele izinhlobo zezibungu (cercariae) zama-parasitic blood flukes, aziwa ngokuthi ama-schistosomes. Izikelemu ezincane ezindala zihlala emithanjeni ekhipha umgudu womchamo kanye namathumbu. Iningi lamaqanda abalala kuwo livaleleke ezicutshini futhi ukusabela komzimba kuwo kungabangela umonakalo omkhulu.

Ucwaningo lwegciwane leVariola kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinyathelo zokulwa nokuhlela imihlangano yaminyaka yonke yeWHO Advisory Committee on Variola Virus Research (ACVVR) ukuxhumanisa ukubuyekezwa kweziphakamiso zocwaningo zokusebenza negciwane levariola ngokusebenzisa i-ACVVR ukuphatha ubudlelwano nezindawo ezimbili zokugcina igciwane levariola (okubuye kube Izikhungo Zokubambisana zeWHO) ukurekhoda, ukucubungula kanye nokubheka izicelo ezivela kubacwaningi zevariola virus DNA kusuka ezindaweni ezi-2 ngaphansi kwemithetho ethile

UDkt Nahya Salim, eTanzania: Ukuzele Ngokushesha Umlobi Ohlanganyelwe kanye nohola kuzwelonke weNewborn Essential Solutions and Technologies 360 (NEST360) “Manje asisekho isizathu sokuthula. Manje sesinamadivayisi nolwazi lokushintsha imiphumela yezingane zethu ezisanda kuzalwa ezisengozini kakhulu. I-Taeniasis kanye ne-cysticercosis Uhlolojikelele: Ukutheleleka nge-tapeworm iTaenia solium kungaholela ezimweni ezimbili ezihlukene: itaeniasis kanye ne-cysticercosis. I-Taeniasis ukutheleleka kwamathumbu nge-tapeworm futhi kwenzeka lapho umuntu edla inyama yengulube eluhlaza noma engaphekiwe kahle, enegciwane. I-Taeniasis ayinamthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Nokho, amaqanda e-tapeworm adlula emathunjini omthwali we-tapeworm futhi uma kungekho ukukhucululwa kwendle okufanele kungangcolisa indawo ezungezile.

Impilo yocansi imayelana nenhlalakahle, hhayi nje ukungabi khona kwezifo. Impilo yocansi ihlanganisa inhlonipho, ukuphepha kanye nokukhululeka ekubandlululweni kanye nasebudloveni. Impilo yocansi incike ekugcwalisekeni kwamalungelo athile abantu. Impilo yocansi isebenza kuyo yonke impilo yomuntu, hhayi kuphela kulabo abaseminyakeni yokuzala, kodwa futhi nakubo bobabili abasha kanye nabadala. Impilo yocansi ibonakala ngezinhlobonhlobo zobulili kanye nezindlela zokuveza ubulili.

I-Trachoma Uhlolojikelele: I-Trachoma iyisifo samehlo futhi iyimbangela ehamba phambili yokutheleleka kobumpumputhe emhlabeni wonke. Ibangelwa ibhaktheriya ye-intracellular ebizwa ngokuthi i-Chlamydia trachomatis. Ukutheleleka kudluliselwa kusuka kumuntu kuya kumuntu ngokudluliselwa ngokuqondile noma okungaqondile kokukhishwa kwamehlo kanye nekhala kwabantu abanaleli gciwane; ukudluliselwa okungaqondile kuhlanganisa ukuthuthwa emzimbeni wezinhlobo zezimpukane. Izingane ezifunda enkulisa zinegciwane eliyinhloko.

I-Yellow fever Uhlolojikelele: I-Yellow fever yisifo esivela kumagciwane esidluliselwa kubantu ngokulunywa omiyane abanaleli gciwane. Ithambekele ezifweni eziwumshayabhuqe futhi ingavinjelwa ngomgomo. Lomiyane obhatazayo usana usana ubelela eduze kwezindlu (ezasendlini), emahlathini noma emahlathini (asendle), noma kuzo zombili izindawo zokuhlala (ezingaphandle kwezindlu). I-Yellow fever iyisifo esinomthelela omkhulu, esisongela kakhulu, esinobungozi bokusabalala emhlabeni wonke, esimele usongo olungaba khona ekuvikelekeni kwezempilo emhlabeni jikelele.

Abantu abanokutheleleka ngeTB ababonisi izimpawu zeTB. Ukuze kutholakale ukutheleleka ngeTB, abahlinzeki bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo bazohlola iziguli ezisengozini ukuze kugwenywe iTB esebenzayo, futhi bangase basebenzise ukuhlolwa kwesikhumba noma kwegazi ukuze bahlole ukutheleleka ngeTB. Zihlotshaniswa nokucwaswa, udlame lwasekhaya, futhi zithinta izinga lempilo. Iningi lezifo ezithathelana ngocansi alinazo izimpawu. Uma zikhona izimpawu ezivamile zezifo ezithathelana ngocansi ukuphuma kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane noma umchamo, isilonda esithweni sangasese kanye nobuhlungu besisu. Izifo ezithathelana ngocansi ezivame kakhulu futhi ezingalapheki yi-trichomonas, i-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea kanye ne-syphilis. Ukumelana nama-antimicrobial okwandayo ngokushesha kuyingozi ekhulayo ye-gonorrhoea engelapheki.

Izimpawu: Kunezigaba ezimbili zokutheleleka nge-yaws. Isigaba sokuqala yilapho isiguli sithathelana futhi singasabalalisa lesi sifo kwabanye. Kulesi sigaba, ipapule (isilonda esingeyona umdlavuza, esikhula ngaphandle) sikhula endaweni yokutheleleka. Le papule igcwele izinto eziphilayo futhi ingaqhubeka izinyanga ezi-3-6 ilandelwe ukuphulukiswa ngokwemvelo. Ngaphandle kokwelashwa, lokhu kulandelwa izilonda zesikhumba ezisabalele emzimbeni.
