Dr Balkhy yana ba da jagoranci na fasaha da siyasa don rage nauyin kiwon lafiya da tattalin arziƙi na juriyar magani, gami da haɗin gwiwar ɓangarori da yawa tare da Hukumar Abinci da Noma, Hukumar Kula da Lafiyar Dabbobi ta Duniya, da Shirin Kula da Muhalli na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya. Kafin shiga WHO, Dr Balkhy ya kasance Babban Daraktan Kariya da Kariya a Ma'aikatar Tsaro ta Saudi Arabiya.

Ƙin jinin magungunan ƙwayoyin cuta (AMR) ga magungunan ƙwayoyin cuta da ake amfani da su wajen magance cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i, musamman cutar malusen, ya ƙaru sosai a cikin 'yan shekarun nan kuma ya rage nasarar samun sakamakon magani. Sakamakon daga Shirin Sa ido kan Gonococcal AMR (GASP) na yanzu ya nuna yanayin yawan ƙin jinin quinolone, ƙaruwar ƙin jinin azithromycin da ƙaruwar ƙin jinin ƙwayoyin cuta masu tsayi. Bayyanar raguwar saurin kamuwa da cutar malusen ga ƙwayoyin cuta masu tsayi, tare da tabbatar da matakan juriya ga penicillins, sulphonamides, tetracyclines, quinolones da macrolides sun sa cutar malusen ta zama ƙwayar cuta mai jurewa magunguna da yawa. AMR ga sauran STIs, kodayake ba ta da yawa, shi ma ya wanzu, wanda ya sa rigakafi da magani na gaggawa suke da mahimmanci. Don magance STIs yadda ya kamata yana da mahimmanci a ɗauki magungunan ƙwayoyin cuta masu dacewa, tare da daidai yawan magani da tsawon lokaci don takamaiman STI don tabbatar da isasshen magani ko warkewa, da kuma hana ci gaban juriyar ƙwayoyin cuta.

A cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya mai ƙarfi, muna haɓaka tasirin kiwon lafiyar jama'a zuwa ga kula da lafiya ga kowa ta hanyar tattaunawa kan manufofi don tsarin nan gaba da kuma tallafi na dabaru don inganta aiki. Wannan aikin yana samun goyon baya daga jagoranci da yarjejeniya; bayanai, bincike da ƙirƙira; da jagoranci a fannin diflomasiyya, bayar da shawarwari, daidaito tsakanin mata da maza, daidaito a harkar lafiya da haƙƙin ɗan adam, ayyukan ɓangarori da yawa, da kuɗi. Ajandar 2030 don SDGs Aikin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ya dace da Manufofin Cigaba Mai Ɗorewa (SDG) manufa 3.8, wanda ke mai da hankali kan cimma kula da kiwon lafiya na duniya, gami da kariya daga haɗarin kuɗi, samun ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya da samun ingantattun magunguna da alluran rigakafi ga kowa. A duniya, ci gaba zuwa ga kula da kiwon lafiya na duniya ƙalubale ne. Ci gaba a cikin kula da sabis ya tsaya yayin da yawan mutanen da ke fuskantar matsalolin kashe kuɗin kiwon lafiya na ci gaba da ƙaruwa.

A shekarar 2021, ƙasashe 139 masu ƙarfin tattalin arziƙi da matsakaita sun cimma wannan ƙudirin, amma ƙasashe 56 ba za su cimma burin ENAP ba a shekarar 2030 idan ba a ƙara ƙoƙari ba. Idan aka ci gaba da tafiya a halin yanzu, jarirai miliyan 15.9 za su kasance matattu; kusan rabin waɗannan (miliyan 7.7, 48%) za su faru ne a yankin Saharar Afirka. Abubuwan da ke haddasa: Tare da ingantaccen kiwon lafiya a duk lokacin daukar ciki da haihuwa, yawancin mace-macen jarirai za a iya kare su. Manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da mace-macen jarirai sun haɗa da matsalolin da ke da alaƙa da ciki da haihuwa, tsawon lokacin ɗaukar ciki, cututtukan uwa kamar zazzaɓin cizon sauro, cutar sanqarau da cutar HIV, yanayin uwa musamman hawan jini, da ciwon sukari, da ƙuntatawar girman jariri (lokacin da jaririn da ba a haifa ba ba zai iya cimma ƙarfinsa ba saboda haka ya fi ƙanƙanta fiye da yadda ya kamata ya kasance). Rashin lafiyar da ake haifar mutum da ita tana da alhakin ƙasa da kashi 10% na mace-macen jarirai da aka ruwaito a ƙasa a cikin ƙasashe masu ƙarfin tattalin arziƙi kuma ba a san ainihin rabo a cikin ƙananan ƙasashe ba saboda ƙuntatawa a cikin bincike.

Ana iya kare cin zarafin yara. Kariya da mayar da martani ga cin zarafin yara na buƙatar ƙoƙari don magance haɗari da abubuwan kariya a duk matakan haɗari guda huɗu masu alaƙa da juna (mutum, dangantaka, al'umma, al'umma). Ƙudurin Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya na Mayu 2016 ya amince da shirin WHO na duniya na farko na ɗaukar mataki kan ƙarfafa rawar da tsarin kiwon lafiya ke takawa a cikin martani na ƙasa da ƙasa don magance cin zarafin mutane, musamman ma mata da 'yan mata, da kuma yara. A A cewar wannan shirin, WHO tare da haɗin gwiwar ƙasashe mambobi da sauran abokan hulɗa, sun himmatu wajen: Sa ido kan girman duniya da halayen cin zarafin yara da tallafawa ƙoƙarin ƙasa don yin rubuce-rubuce da auna irin wannan tashin hankali. Kula da tsarin bayanai na lantarki wanda ke taƙaita bayanan kimiyya game da nauyi, abubuwan haɗari da sakamakon cin zarafin yara, da shaidar da za a iya kare ta.

An samar da shi ta hanyar tsari mai cike da haɗin kai wanda SIDS ke jagoranta, sanarwar ta nuna cewa NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa ba za a iya magance su yadda ya kamata ba tare da magance matsalar canjin yanayi ba. "Matakan da za a ɗauka don yanayinmu, lafiya mai kyau, da walwala ya dogara ne da gyarawa da sake tsara kuɗaɗen duniya don buɗe biliyoyin kuɗi, yayin da ake rage azabtarwa ga ƙasashe masu tasowa don biyan bashin su", in ji Mai Girma Mia Amor Mottley, Firayim Ministan Barbados. "Samar da kuɗi don daidaitawa da rage tasirin canjin yanayi a cikin ƙasashe masu rauni shima yana da mahimmanci, tare da cututtukan da ba a iya kamuwa da su da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa." "Kalubalen da ƙananan ƙasashe masu tasowa ke fuskanta suna da alaƙa da juna kuma suna da fannoni da yawa. Canjin yanayi, lalacewar muhalli, rashin daidaiton zamantakewa da tattalin arziki, da kuma yanayin kasuwanci na lafiya suna ƙara nauyin NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, "in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO.

Babu wata ƙasa da wannan al'amarin bai shafa ba, kuma Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta samu rahoton magungunan da ba su da inganci ko na jabu, da alluran rigakafi da kuma gwaje-gwajen cututtuka daga dukkan yankunan duniya. Duka magungunan da aka ƙirƙira da waɗanda aka ƙirƙira za a iya ƙaryata su, wanda ya fara daga kayayyaki masu tsada sosai don magance cutar kansa zuwa kayayyaki masu arha sosai don magance ciwo. Ƙasashen da ke ƙarƙashin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya sun amince da wata cikakkiyar dabarar duniya da aka mayar da hankali kan rigakafi, ganowa da kuma mayar da martani don samun damar samun ingantattun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya. Tasiri: Kayayyakin magunguna marasa inganci da na jabu suna haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga duka mutum da ke shan magani da kuma iyalai, manyan al'umma, tsarin kiwon lafiya da sarkar samar da kayayyaki. Lokacin da magunguna ba suyi yadda ya kamata ba, za su iya kasa magance ko hana cuta, su ba da gudummawa ga juriyar ƙwayoyin cuta, ɓarnatar da albarkatu masu mahimmanci da haifar da rashin amincewa da magunguna da rashin amincewa da masu ba da kiwon lafiya.

Farfesa Petro Terblanche, Babban Daraktan Afrigen ya ce: "Dukkanin ƙungiyar Afrigen suna farin cikin cimma wannan muhimmin ci gaba tare da kammala dandalin fasahar mRNA. Wannan dandalin yana cikin ƙarshen ƙarshen ƙirƙirar rigakafin mRNA da kayan aikin samarwa, inda ƙwayar rigakafin mRNA Hub Covid 19 mai neman AfriVac 2121 a halin yanzu yana cikin matakin haɓakawa. A cikin watanni 18 da suka gabata, Afrigen ya sami canji mai ban mamaki tare da goyon bayan cibiyar haɗin gwiwa da masu ba da shawara da wannan Shirin ya ba da damar. Mun haɓaka ƙarfinmu da ikonmu don saduwa da mafi girman ƙa'idodin ci gaban rigakafin mRNA, da kuma cimma burin gina ƙarfin ci gaba a cikin LMICs don samar da alluran rigakafin mRNA. Afrigen ta sami nasarar kafa tsarin samar da rigakafin COVID-19 a ƙarƙashin gwaji na ɗakin gwaje-gwaje kuma a halin yanzu tana haɓaka wannan tsari zuwa matakin da ya dace don samar da rukunin rigakafin da za a yi amfani da su a cikin gwaji na asibiti na Mataki na I/ II zuwa ƙa'idodin GMP.

Mace-macen jariri Gamsashshen bayani: Jaririn da ya mutu bayan makonni 28 na ɗaukar ciki, amma kafin ko lokacin haihuwa, ana ɗaukarsa a matsayin mace-macen jariri. Akwai kusan mace-macen jarirai miliyan 2 a kowace shekara - ɗaya a kowane dakika 16. Fiye da kashi 40% na dukkan mace-macen jarirai na faruwa ne yayin haihuwa - asarar da za a iya kauce mata ta hanyar ingantaccen kulawa da girmamawa yayin haihuwa, gami da sa ido akai-akai da samun kulawar gaggawa a lokacin da ake buƙata. Fuskantar mace-macen jariri yayin ɗaukar ciki ko haihuwa bala'i ne da ba a magance shi sosai a cikin shirye-shiryen duniya ba, manufofi da shirye-shiryen da aka ba da kuɗi. Akwai tsadar tunani, musamman ga mata da iyalansu, kamar damuwa na uwa, sakamakon kuɗi da tasirin tattalin arziki, da kuma wariya da abin ƙyama. A shekarar 2014, Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da Shirin Kowace Jariri (ENAP), wanda ya haɗa da manufa ta duniya na 12 ko ƙasa da haka na mace-macen jariri na uku (kwanan) a kowace 1,000 da aka haifa a kowace ƙasa nan da shekarar 2030.

Duk da haka, ƙiyasin IRENA ya nuna cewa kuɗaɗen da ake samu daga ƙasashen waje don tallafawa tsaftataccen makamashi a ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga suna raguwa tun kafin ɓarkewar annobar COVID-19 kuma tallafin yana iyakance ga ƙananan ƙasashe. Don cimma burin SDG 7 da tabbatar da cewa mutane sun amfana sosai daga fa'idodin zamantakewar tattalin arziƙi na sauyawa zuwa makamashi mai ɗorewa, ya zama dole a sake fasalin tsarin kuɗaɗen jama'a na duniya da kuma bayyana sabbin damarmaki don buɗe saka hannun jari. Rahoton ya kuma gano cewa yawan bashi da hauhawar farashin makamashi suna taɓarɓarewa ga damar samun damar samun tsaftataccen girki da wutar lantarki. Ƙiyasin na yanzu ya ƙiyasta cewa mutane biliyan 1.9 za su kasance ba tare da tsaftataccen girki ba kuma miliyan 660 ba tare da samun damar samun wutar lantarki ba a shekarar 2030 idan ba mu ɗauki ƙarin mataki ba kuma mu ci gaba da ƙoƙarinmu na yanzu. Waɗannan giɓi za su iya yin mummunan tasiri ga lafiyar mutanenmu masu rauni da saurin canjin yanayi.

Shekaru goma da suka gabata sun kuma ga ƙaruwar fafutukar al'umma kan haihuwar da ba ta kai lokaci ba da kuma rigakafin haihuwar matattu, wanda hanyoyin sadarwa na iyaye, ƙwararrun likitoci, masana ilimi, ƙungiyoyin fararen hula, da sauransu ke jagoranta. A duk faɗin duniya, ƙungiyoyi don iyalan da abin ya shafa na haihuwar da ba ta kai lokaci ba sun kasance a sahun gaba wajen ba da shawara don samun ingantaccen kulawa da canjin manufofi da tallafawa sauran iyalai. Har zuwa taron lafiyar mata da jarirai na duniya, a Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu daga 8-11 ga Mayu, WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA da PMNCH suna kira da a ɗauki waɗannan matakan don inganta kulawa ga mata da jarirai da rage haɗarin haihuwar da ba ta kai lokaci ba: Ƙara saka hannun jari: Haɗa albarkatun ƙasa da na ƙasa don inganta lafiyar uwa da jarirai, tabbatar da cewa an samar da ingantaccen kulawa a lokacin da ake buƙata. Saurin aiwatarwa: Cimma burin ƙasa don ci gaba ta hanyar aiwatar da tsare-tsaren ƙasa don kula da uwa da jarirai.

Manufar ta haɗa da samun damar samun wutar lantarki ga kowa da kowa da kuma tsaftataccen girki, ninka matakan ingantaccen aiki na tarihi, da kuma ƙara yawan rabon da ake samu na makamashi mai sabuntawa a cikin haɗin makamashi na duniya. Samun wannan burin zai yi tasiri sosai ga lafiyar mutane da walwala, yana taimakawa wajen kare su daga haɗarin muhalli da zamantakewa kamar gurɓatar iska, da faɗaɗa samun kulawar kiwon lafiya na farko da ayyuka. Bugu na 2023 na bin diddigin SDG 7: Rahoton Ci Gaban Makamashi ya yi gargaɗi cewa ƙoƙarin da ake yi yanzu bai isa ba don cimma SDG 7 a kan lokaci. An sami wasu ci gaba a kan takamaiman abubuwan ajandar SDG 7 - misali, ƙaruwar yawan amfani da makamashi mai sabuntawa a ɓangaren wutar lantarki - amma ci gaban bai isa ba don cimma burin da aka sa a cikin SDGs. Ana sa ran rikicin makamashi na duniya zai ƙarfafa amfani da makamashi mai sabuntawa da inganta ingancin makamashi tare da wasu manufofin gwamnati da ke nuni da ƙara saka hannun jari.

Kowace ƙasa tana da hanyoyi daban-daban don cimma UHC da kuma yanke shawarar abin da za a rufe dangane da buƙatun al'ummarsu da albarkatun da ke hannunsu. Zuba jari a cikin PHC yana tabbatar da cewa an gano duk waɗannan buƙatun, an ba su fifiko kuma an magance su ta hanyar haɗin kai; cewa akwai ƙwararrun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da kayan aiki; kuma cewa dukkan ɓangarorin al'umma suna ba da gudummawa don fuskantar abubuwan muhalli da zamantakewar tattalin arziƙi waɗanda ke shafar lafiya da walwala, gami da shiryawa, amsawa da murmurewa daga gaggawa. Amsar WHO: A matsayin tushen UHC, WHO ta ba da shawarar sake daidaita tsarin kiwon lafiya ta amfani da tsarin kula da lafiya na farko (PHC). Samun UHC shi ne babban fifiko na WHO, tare da burin ƙarin mutane biliyan 1 da za su amfana daga tsarin kiwon lafiya na duniya nan da shekarar 2025. A ƙasashen da ke da raunin tsarin kiwon lafiya, muna mai da hankali kan taimakon fasaha don gina cibiyoyin ƙasa da isar da sabis don cike giɓi mai mahimmanci a cikin gaggawa.

Wannan shi ne shekara ta huɗu da bikin fim ɗin kuma gasar ba ta yi ƙasa da tsanani ba, tare da wasu fina-finai guda 93 da aka zaɓa waɗanda suka shafi batutuwa da suka haɗa da damuwa da damuwa har zuwa tasirin sauyin yanayi a kan lafiya, da kuma ƙalubalen kiwon lafiyar mutane masu buƙata ta musamman. An yanke hukunci a kan fina-finai ta hanyar kwamitin ƙwararru, masu zane-zane da masu fafutuka, ciki har da shahararrun 'yan wasan kwaikwayo, Sharon Stone da Alfonso Herrera, mai zane-zane, Sherrie Silver, mai fafutukar sauyin yanayi, Sophia Kianni da ƴar jarida, Adelle Onyango. Sun haɗu da manyan jami'an Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ma'aikatan Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya. Babban Daraktan Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ya ce, "Bikin Fina-Finan Lafiya ga Kowa ya kawo fuskar ɗan adam ga aikin kimiyya na WHO," in ji Darakta Janar na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Sauraron muryoyin mutanen da matsalolin kiwon lafiya suka shafa hanya ce mai ƙarfi don wayar da kan jama'a da inganta fahimtarmu game da abubuwan da mutane ke fuskanta kuma wannan zai iya taimaka mana ci gaba zuwa ga lafiya ga kowa."

Ƙananan tsibirai sun amince da tsarin ɗaukar mataki kan cututtukan da ba a ɗauka ba da kuma lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa A yau, an ƙaddamar da sanarwar Bridgetown na 2023 kan cututtukan da ba a ɗauka ba (NCDs) da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, don magance wasu daga cikin cututtukan da suka fi kisa a cikin Ƙananan Tsibirai Masu Tasowa (SIDS), waɗanda ke cikin haɗari musamman. Sanarwar ita ce babbar sakamakon taron ministocin SIDS kan cututtukan da ba a ɗauka ba (NCDs) da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda ya gudana daga 14 zuwa 16 ga Yuni, wanda Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), Hukumar Lafiya ta Pan American (PAHO) da Gwamnatin Barbados suka shirya. SIDS suna shafar cututtukan da ba a ɗauka ba (NCDs) - wanda ke haifar da kashi 74% na dukkan mace-mace a duniya - saboda dogaro da abincin da aka shigo da su, tasirin kasuwanci da rikicin yanayi. Wani sabon rahoton WHO ya nuna cewa 8 daga cikin ƙasashe 15 da ke da haɗarin mutuwa da wuri daga cututtukan zuciya, kansa, ciwon sukari, ko cututtukan numfashi na kullum sune SIDS.

Wannan ya fi cigaban da aka samu na 1.2% a shekarun da suka gabata. Duk da haka, yawan cigaban da aka samu na yawan amfani da makamashi ya ragu a shekarun baya-bayan nan kuma ya sauka zuwa 0.6% a shekarar 2020. Wannan ya sa ta zama mafi munin shekarar cigaban yawan amfani da makamashi tun bayan rikicin kuɗi na duniya, duk da cewa yawanci saboda ƙuntatawa da ke da alaƙa da annoba, wanda zai iya nuna koma baya na wucin gadi kawai. Cigaban da ake samu na shekara-shekara har zuwa 2030 dole ne ya kai kimanin 3.4% don cimma burin SDG na 7.3. Tsarin kuɗi na duniya don tallafawa tsaftataccen makamashi a ƙasashe masu tasowa ya kai dalar Amurka biliyan 10.8 a shekarar 2021, ƙasa da kashi 35% na matsakaicin 2010-2019 da kusan kashi 40% na ƙoli na 2017 na dalar Amurka biliyan 26.4. A shekarar 2021, ƙasashe 19 sun karɓi kashi 80% na alƙawurran. Za a gabatar da rahoton ga manyan masu yanke shawara a wani taron ƙaddamarwa na musamman a ranar 11 ga Yuli 2023 a Babban Taron Siyasa (HLPF) kan Cigaba Mai Ɗorewa, kafin taron SDG na biyu a watan Satumbar 2023 a New York.

Sabbin sakamakon binciken sun nuna cewa tsarin kiwon lafiya ya fara farfaɗowa daga annobar. Bayan shekaru uku na annobar COVID-19, tsarin kiwon lafiya a ƙasashe ya fara nuna manyan alamun farfadowar tsarin kiwon lafiya, a cewar rahoton wucin gadi na WHO kan " zagaye na huɗu na binciken bugun jini na duniya kan ci gaba da ayyukan kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun yayin annobar COVID-19: Nuwamba 2022 zuwa Janairu 2023". Zuwa farkon shekarar 2023, ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton fuskantar raguwar katsewa a cikin isar da ayyukan kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun, amma sun nuna buƙatar saka hannun jari a farfadowa da ƙarfafa juriya a nan gaba. Daga cikin ƙasashe 139 da suka amsa zagaye na huɗu na binciken bugun jini na WHO, ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton ci gaba da katsewa a kusan kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na ayyukan a matsakaita. A cikin ƙasashe 84 inda nazarin yanayin zai yiwu, yawan ayyukan da aka katse ya ragu a matsakaita daga 56% a watan Yuli-Satumba 2020 zuwa 23% a watan Nuwamba 2022 zuwa Janairu 2023.

Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, ƙasashe mambobi, da abokan hulɗa suna aiki tare don ganowa da aiwatar da ayyuka masu mahimmanci don ƙarfafa shirye-shiryen ƙasa, yanki, da na duniya don annoba da barazanar cututtuka masu yaɗuwa. Mun fahimci rawar da al'ummomi da dukkan ɓangarori ke takawa, da kuma buƙatar daidaitawa da ci gaba da ƙarfafawa don kawo ƙarshen zagayen tsoro da watsi da abin da ya zama ruwan dare a cikin shirye-shiryen annoba da martani. Mun tuna darussan daga annoba da annoba da suka gabata, musamman waɗanda ƙwayoyin cuta na numfashi ke haifarwa. Waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta suna da kuma za su ci gaba da haifar da babbar barazana ga duniya tare da yuwuwar haifar da mummunan rashin lafiya da mutuwa, mamaye tsarin kiwon lafiya, da kawar da tattalin arziƙin duniya, da kuma ƙara rashin daidaito, wanda ya wanzu a cikin samun kayan aikin don hana annoba da kula da lafiya ga dukkan mutane. Wannan kira ne na aiki don hanzarta shirye-shiryen annoba da barazanar da ke tasowa a duniya.

Yanayin amfani ya bambanta sosai a ƙasashe masu irin wannan arziƙin; ba ya dace da buƙatar magani, kamar yadda ƙiyasin adadin kwanakin da mutane ke fama da ciwo ko fama da matsanancin numfashi ga mutanen da ke fama da rashin lafiya mai tsanani. Wannan bayanan ya yi daidai da na Hukumar Lancet ta 2018 wanda ya bayyana rashin samun magungunan rage raɗaɗi a matsayin 'ɗaya daga cikin mafi munin, ɓoyayyen rashin daidaito a cikin kiwon lafiyar duniya' tare da kaso 10% na ƙasashe masu arziki da ke da kaso 90% na rarraba morphine-equivalent opioids. 'Barin mutane cikin ciwo yayin da magunguna masu inganci suke samuwa don magance ciwo, musamman a cikin yanayin kulawar ƙarshen rayuwa, ya kamata ya zama babban abin damuwa ga masu tsara manufofi,' in ji Dr Yukiko Nakatani, Mataimakin Darakta Janar na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya don Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya. 'Dole ne mu gaggauta ba da shawara don samun damar samun maganin morphine cikin aminci da kan lokaci ga waɗanda ke buƙatar magani ta hanyar daidaitaccen tsari, a ko'ina.'

Waɗannan kuɗaɗen suna tallafawa gudanar da Hub a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma abokan hulɗa a duk faɗin duniya. Mun yi imani da mahimmancin gina ƙarfin a matakin gida da na yanki. "Mista Martin Seychell, Mataimakin Babban Daraktan Hukumar Tarayyar Turai, ya ce. "EC ta riga ta ba da gudummawar Euro miliyan 40 don kafa cibiyar canja fasahar mRNA kuma kwanan nan ta sanya hannu kan wani tallafi tare da EIB na Euro miliyan 15,5 don sauƙaƙe faɗaɗa ƙarfin samar da alluran rigakafi. Wannan wani ɓangare ne na saka hannun jari gaba ɗaya a ƙarƙashin dabarun EU Global Gateway, inda aka tattara sama da Euro biliyan 1 a ƙarƙashin Team Europe Initiative on Manufacturing health products. Yanzu yana da mahimmanci musamman don magance yiwuwar tsari da buƙatu, don tabbatar da ba wai kawai samar da alluran rigakafi mafi inganci a duk yankuna na duniya ba, har ma da saurin samun damar daidaito ga waɗannan alluran rigakafin. "

Amfani da kayan amfanin gida na gargajiya yana nufin cewa gidaje suna kashe har sa'o'i 40 a mako suna tara itace da kuma dafa abinci, wanda hakan ke hana mata yin aiki ko shiga cikin hukumomin yanke shawara na gida da yara daga zuwa makaranta. A ƙiyasin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na shekarar 2019, mace-mace miliyan 3.2 a kowace shekara ana danganta su ne da gurɓatar iska da ake samu a cikin gida ta hanyar amfani da makamashi mai gurɓata da fasahohin dafa abinci. Amfani da wutar lantarki mai sabuntawa a cikin amfani da duniya ya karu daga 26.3% a shekarar 2019 zuwa 28.2% a shekarar 2020, mafi girman ƙaruwa na shekara guda tun farkon bin diddigin ci gaban SDGs. Ƙoƙarin ƙara rabon makamashi mai sabuntawa a cikin dumama da sufuri, wanda ke wakiltar fiye da kashi uku cikin huɗu na amfani da makamashi na duniya, ya kasance ba a cimma burin ba don cimma burin yanayi na 1.5oC. Ƙarfin makamashi - ma'aunin yawan makamashi da tattalin arzikin duniya ke amfani da shi a kowace dala ta GDP - ya inganta daga 2010 zuwa 2020 da 1.8% a kowace shekara.

Duk matafiya dole ne su shirya don haɗarin lafiya iri-iri da za su iya fuskanta a wuraren da ba su sani ba kafin, lokacin da kuma bayan sun yi tafiya. Mutanen da suke shirin tafiya su nemi shawara a kan haɗurran da za su iya faruwa a wuraren da suka zaɓa kuma su fahimci yadda za su kare lafiyarsu da rage haɗarin kamuwa da cuta. Tsarawa a gaba, matakan kariya da suka dace da kuma kiyayewa na iya kare lafiyar matafiya, da rage haɗarin haɗari da kamuwa da cuta. Duk da cewa aikin likita da masana harkar tafiye-tafiye za su iya ba da taimako mai yawa da shawarwari masu kyau, ya zama nauyin matafiyi ne ya nemi bayanai, ya fahimci haɗurran da ke tattare da su kuma ya ɗauki matakan da suka dace don kare lafiyarsu yayin da suke tafiya. Haɗari: Lokacin da ake ƙiyasta haɗarin lafiya na tafiye-tafiye na ƙasa da ƙasa, matafiya da ƙwararrun masana kiwon lafiya suyi la'akari da waɗannan mahimman abubuwan:

Bugu da ƙari, cibiyoyin biyu da suka samu lambar yabo ta 2023 mata ne suka jagoranci su. Wanda suka ci kyautar kyautar lafiya ta Sasakawa ta 2023: Cibiyar Nick Simons daga Nepal, da Farfesa Vichai Tienthavorn daga Thailand Cibiyar Nick Simons ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta da ke da nufin inganta kiwon lafiya a yankunan karkara na Nepal. Yin aiki kafada da kafada da Ma'aikatar Lafiya da Jama'a na Nepal, Cibiyar ta horar da ƙwararrun likitoci 7000 (kamar ungozoma da mataimakan magunguna) a yankunan karkara, waɗanda yanzu ke ba da ayyukan da ake buƙata ga al'ummomin cikin gida a lokacin da babu isassun likitoci da ƙwararru. Cibiyar ta samar da kayan aiki masu mahimmanci da samar da ƙarin ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya don rage ƙarancin ƙwararrun likitoci a asibitoci 44, kuma sun tallafawa ƙirƙirar tsarin aiki don ingantaccen ayyuka a asibitoci fiye da 100 na karkara.

A shekarar 2019 kaɗai, mutane 92 622 sun sami maganin tiyata don cutar trachoma mai ci gaba kuma an yi wa mutane miliyan 95.2 maganin rigakafi. Duk da waɗannan nasarorin, cutar ta kasance babbar damuwa ga lafiyar jama'a, tare da asarar dalar Amurka biliyan 8 a kowace shekara saboda makanta da nakasar gani. Alamomi: Kamuwa da cuta yana da alaƙa da canje-canje masu raɗaɗi a cikin conjunctiva da aka sani da "active trachoma". Tsarin garkuwar jiki na mutum na iya kawar da cutar sau ɗaya kawai, amma a cikin al'ummomin da ke fama da cutar, sake dawowar ƙwayar cutar yana faruwa akai-akai. Bayan shekaru da yawa na maimaita cutar trachoma mai ci gaba, cikin idon ido na iya zama mai raɗaɗi sosai (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) wanda zai juya ciki kuma ya sa gashin ido ya shafa da ƙwayar ido (trachomatous trichiasis), wanda ke haifar da ciwo koyaushe da rashin juriya; wannan da sauran canje-canje na ido na iya haifar da ciwon ido.

Cututtuka marasa yaɗuwa kamar cututtukan zuciya, bugun jini, asma, ciwon daji, ciwon siga da damuwa; da tashin hankali da raunuka, gami da raunin ababen hawa. Amsar WHO: Duk da ƙalubalen da suke fuskanta, birane na iya samar da dama don ingantacciyar lafiya, muhalli mai tsabta da kuma ayyukan sauyin yanayi. Dole ne tsare-tsaren birane masu ƙarfi su ba da fifiko ga kiwon lafiya, saboda yana da mahimmanci don haɓaka kyawawan rayuwar birane, gina ƙwararrun ma'aikata, ƙirƙirar al'ummomi masu ƙarfi da ƙarfi, ba da damar motsi, inganta hulɗar zamantakewa da kare mutane masu rauni. Hanyar WHO ga lafiyar birane tana mai da hankali kan ingantaccen iska, ruwa da tsafta, da sauran abubuwan da ke haifar da muhalli; tsarin birane masu lafiya; muhalli mai lafiya da mara shan taba; motsi mai aminci da lafiya; hana tashin hankali da raunuka; inganta tsarin abinci mai kyau da abinci; kula da muhalli na cututtukan da ke yaɗuwa; da shirye-shiryen birane don gaggawa.

A cutar (cysticercosis), lokacin ɗaukar cutar ya bambanta, kuma mutanen da suka kamu da cutar na iya zama ba tare da nuna alamun cutar ba har tsawon shekaru. A wasu yankunan da cutar ta fi yawa, mutanen da suka kamu da cutar na iya samun alamun bayyanar cutar (ƙaramin ƙuraje ko ƙuraje masu ƙarfi waɗanda za a iya gano su ta hanyar taɓawa) a ƙarƙashin fata. Cutar (neurocysticercosis) tana da alaƙa da alamomi da alamomi daban-daban dangane da yawa, girma, mataki da kuma wurin canje-canjen cututtuka da kuma martanin rigakafi na mai gida da kuma ƙwayar halittar ƙwayar cutar, amma kuma tana iya zama ba tare da alamun cutar ba. Alamun cutar na iya haɗawa da ciwon kai mai naci, makanta, farfaɗiya (farfaɗiya idan suna maimaituwa), cutar ƙwaƙwalwa mai naci, cutar sanqarau, cutar mantau da kuma alamun da ciwuka ke haifarwa da ke mamaye wuraren tsarin juyayi na tsakiya. Magani: Maganin cutar ta (taeniasis) ta hanyar (Taenia solium) yana da mahimmanci don hana cutar (neurocysticercosis) kuma a matsayin kayan aiki don taimakawa wajen sarrafawa ko dakatar da zagayen yaɗuwar ƙwayar cutar.

Wannan tsarin, wanda ake amfani da shi a duk wasu wurare, yana taimakawa wajen cike giɓin da ke tsakanin samun daidaito a harkar lafiya a wajen kula da mata da yara. A haɗin guiwa da gwamnatin ƙasar Philippines da kuma ƙasashe 17 a yankin yammacin Pacific na WHO, ta taka rawa wajen bunƙasa gangamin First Embrace domin kula da jarirai da wuri, wanda ya ƙunshi tsarin da WHO ta ba da shawara da kuma tsarin da ba shi da tsada. Sheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah ya samu lambar yabo ta WHO a fannin bincike a harkar lafiya ga tsofaffi da kuma a fannin inganta lafiya a shekarar 2023. 'Yan baya-bayan nan: Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka Masu Naci da Marasa Yaɗuwa ta Ƙasa daga China; da Dr Abla Mehio Sibai daga Lebanon Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka Masu Naci da Marasa Yaɗuwa ta Ƙasa, wani ɓangare na Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka ta Ƙasar Sin (China CDC), ta karɓi bakuncin sashen da ke mai da hankali kan lafiyar tsofaffi tun 2013.

Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya za ta ci gaba da haɓakawa da kuma yaɗa jagoranci kan wasu cututtuka na musamman kamar yadda ake buƙata. Ƙaddamar da shirin yana faruwa ne a ranar ƙarshe na tarurruka tare da sama da mutane 120 da ke wakiltar ƙasashe mambobi, abokan hulɗa, da sakatariyar WHO, don bayyana hanyar ci gaba don PRET, gami da haɓaka tsarin aiwatarwa na duniya don shirye-shiryen annobar cutar numfashi. Matakin farko na shirin PRET ya mai da hankali kan ƙwayoyin cuta masu cutar numfashi, gami da mura, ƙwayoyin cuta na coronavirus, da ƙwayar cutar numfashi ta syncytial. Ganin annobar COVID-19 da ke gudana da kuma yiwuwar barazanar cutar mura, wannan matakin zai ba wa ƙasashe damar yin nazari mai mahimmanci, gwaji, da sabunta ƙoƙarin su na shirin annobar numfashi don tabbatar da cewa suna da ƙarfin aiki da damar da suke da ita. Ana ci gaba da aiwatar da tsari don gano rukunin ƙwayoyin cuta na gaba, kamar arboviruses, da za a magance su a ƙarƙashin wannan shirin.

Bayan ƙwarewar muryarta, Fleming ta kasance mai goyon bayan bincike a ɓangaren fasaha da lafiya. Gabatarwarta a duniya tare da masana kimiyya da ƙwararru, rawar da take takawa a manyan ayyuka, da alaƙarta da WHO sun nuna himmarta wajen amfani da ikon canji na fasaha don inganta al'umma. "Ina farin ciki da cewa babbar hukumar lafiya ta duniya tana fahimtar tasirin fasaha a cikin kiwon lafiya, kuma ina matuƙar alfahari da aka ba ni alhakin yaɗa wannan saƙon", in ji Fleming. "Kowace rana, ci gaba a kimiyyar ƙwaƙwalwa da binciken asibiti suna bayyana ƙarin fa'idodi game da magungunan fasaha, gogewa, da ilimi, tare da tasiri ga jin daɗin rayuwar ɗan adam. Duk da haka, mun fara fahimtar ƙarfin wannan aikin ne kawai, kuma ina fatan faɗaɗa wayar da kai da samun dama a matsayin Jakadan Alheri na WHO.

Bayan ya inganta shigar al'umma cikin kulawar asibiti sama da shekaru 20, Dr Jorge Francisco Meneses ya kafa kwamitocin al'umma da suka mai da hankali kan aminci da gamsuwa na marasa lafiya, danginsu da al'umma. Ganin kyakkyawan tasirin aikinsa wajen inganta ingancin kula da marasa lafiya, samfurin ɗabi'a da kula da marasa lafiya da ya tsara an ƙara shi a matakin ƙasa. A yau, a matsayin mai kula da asibitoci na Guatemala, ya tsara wani shiri don inganta ingancin ayyuka ga marasa lafiyar asibiti da danginsu. Dr Meneses kwanan nan ya tsara wani sabon shiri na gwaji a yankin Guatemala ta Kudu don gina cibiyar sadarwa ta farko ta kasa na ayyukan kiwon lafiya, tare da mai da hankali kan al'ummomin da ba a kula da su ba. Aikinsa ya haifar da amincewa da dabarun ƙasa na haɗa hanyoyin sadarwa na kiwon lafiya, na farko a Amurka ta Tsakiya.

Wannan taron ministocin ya zo a wani lokaci na musamman kuma zai zama mabuɗin don ƙara ƙarfin murya da buƙatun SIDS, kawo NCDs da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa zuwa gaba a jerin abubuwan da muke fifiko, in ji Dr Jarbas Barbosa, Daraktan PAHO, da Daraktan Yankin WHO na Amurka. "Don gina kan wannan ci gaba, dole ne mu ɗauki mataki yanzu. PAHO a shirye take don tallafawa da saurin aiwatar da ayyukan a yankinmu, gami da sanya kulawa ga waɗannan yanayin cikin ayyukan kiwon lafiya na farko da kuma amfani da sabbin abubuwa kamar kayan aikin kiwon lafiya na zamani. Kasashen SIDS suna da tarihin jagorantar yanke shawara na duniya; yarjejeniyar Port of Spain da SAMOA sun share fagen farkon sanarwar siyasa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kan NCDs a shekarar 2018. Taron da Sanarwar za su ba da bayani da kuma tsara manyan tarurrukan Majalisar Dinkin Duniya masu zuwa kan kiwon lafiya na duniya a watan Satumbar 2023 da kuma kan NCDs a shekarar 2025.

Annobar COVID-19 da sauran matsalolin lafiya sun nuna cewa ƙasashe suna buƙatar kasancewa a shirye don magance barazanar cututtuka masu yaɗuwa, tare da shirye-shiryen shiri a hannu da ingantaccen haɗin kai da haɗin gwiwa tare da wasu ɓangarori kamar aikin gona. "Shiryawa, rigakafi, da ayyukan martani ba za su zama lardin ɓangaren kiwon lafiya kaɗai ba", in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Kamar yadda gaggawar kiwon lafiya ke da tasiri a ɓangarori da yawa, haka shirye-shiryenmu da ƙoƙarinmu na amsawa ya shafi ɓangarori, ƙwarewa da ƙwayoyin cuta. Yana da mahimmanci, cewa haɗin kan al'umma da daidaito sune cibiyar ƙoƙarinmu, musamman ga waɗancan al'ummomin da aka ware kuma suka fi fuskantar haɗari. PRET wani ci gaba ne a tsarin WHO na shirye-shiryen annoba ta hanyar amfani da tsarin hanyar yaɗuwa, maimakon mai da hankali kan wasu cututtuka.

Kafin shiga Wellcome a 2013 Dr Farrar ya shafe shekaru 17 a matsayin Daraktan Ƙungiyar Binciken Asibiti a Asibitin Cututtukan Tropical a Vietnam inda binciken sa ya shafi lafiyar duniya tare da mai da hankali kan cututtuka masu saurin yaɗuwa. Dr Farrar likita ne mai bincike tare da digiri na likitanci da PhD. Dr Ailan Li zai zama Mataimakin Darakta Janar na Kula da Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya, Jama'a Masu Lafiya daga 8 ga Mayu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Li zai sa ido kan ƙoƙarin Ƙungiyar don inganta ingantacciyar lafiya da walwala ta hanyar shiga tsakani da suka shafi muhalli, zamantakewa, da yanayin tattalin arziƙi na lafiya, gami da canjin yanayi, sarrafa taba, amincin sinadarai, amincin hanya, tsarin abinci da abinci mai gina jiki, motsa jiki, gurɓatar iska da haske, ta hanyar tsarin Kiwon Lafiya ɗaya. Dr Li ya kasance wakilin WHO zuwa Masarautar Kambodiya tun 15 ga Yuli 2019.

Cin zarafin yaro yana da tasiri mai yawa na nan da nan da na dogon lokaci. Bayan mutuwa, rauni na zahiri da nakasa, tashin hankali na iya haifar da damuwa wanda ke lalata ci gaban ƙwaƙwalwa da lalata tsarin juyayi da rigakafi. Wannan kuma yana da alaƙa da jinkirin ci gaban ƙwaƙwalwa, rashin yin kyau a makaranta da barin makaranta, matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, ƙoƙarin kashe kansa, ƙaruwar halayen haɗari na kiwon lafiya, sake cin zarafi da kuma tayar da tashin hankali. Labari mai daɗi shi ne cewa za a iya hana cin zarafin yaro ta hanyar shiga tsakani da ke tallafawa iyaye da masu kula da su, inganta ɗabi'u da ɗabi'un da ba na tashin hankali ba, samar da ilimi da horar da ƙwarewar rayuwa, ƙarfafa kuɗin shiga na iyalai da tsaro na tattalin arziƙi, bayar da amsa mai inganci da ayyukan tallafi, ƙirƙira da kuma kiyaye muhallin lafiya ga yara, da aiwatar da dokoki da tilasta dokoki game da cin zarafin yara. WHO, tare da haɗin gwiwar wasu abokan hulɗa:

Misali, ayyukan kiwon lafiya masu tsabta za su iya samar da fa'idodin lafiyar marasa lafiya da ma'aikata tare da adana makamashi, rage haɗarin yanayi da samar da tanadi mai ɗorewa. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta himmatu wajen neman ci gaba mai ɗorewa a duk ayyukanta don taimakawa kare mutanen gobe daga haɗarin lafiya mai girma na yau. Tasiri: Yawancin dabarun ci gaba mai ɗorewa na iya ba da gagarumar nasara ga lafiya, yanayi da muhalli, kuma ana iya ganin fa'idodin kusan nan da nan. Misali, yawancin manufofin kiwon lafiya da ci gaba za a iya cimma su a lokaci guda ta hanyar magance gurɓatar iska, wanda ke da alhakin kimanin mutuwar mutane miliyan 7 a kowace shekara. Gurbatattun hayaƙi sun haɗa da gurɓatattun yanayi masu ƙarfi na ɗan gajeren lokaci (SLCPs) - musamman maƙarƙashiya mai duhu, ozone da methane - waɗanda suke da illa ga lafiya amma suna da ɗan gajeren rayuwar yanayi.

Haɗin gwiwar duniya a cikin sa ido kan ƙwayoyin halittar da ke haifar da cututtuka ya kasance mai mahimmanci yayin da duniya ke yaƙi da COVID-19 tare, in ji Dr Rajiv J. Shah, Shugaban Gidauniyar Rockefeller. IPSN ya gina kan wannan ƙwarewar ta hanyar ƙirƙirar dandali mai ƙarfi ga abokan tarayya a duk ɓangarori da kan iyakoki don musayar ilimi, kayan aiki, da ayyuka don tabbatar da cewa rigakafin cutar da mayar da martani ya zama mai ƙirƙira da ƙarfi a nan gaba. Duk da ƙaruwar da aka samu kwanan nan a cikin ƙarfin ƙwayoyin halitta a cikin ƙasashe sakamakon annobar COVID-19, da yawa har yanzu ba su da ingantattun tsare-tsare don tattarawa da nazarin samfura ko amfani da waɗannan bayanan don jagorantar yanke shawara kan kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Babu isasshen raba bayanai, ayyuka, da ƙirƙira don gina ingantaccen tsarin sa ido kan lafiyar duniya. Kasafin kuɗi da ya ƙaru a lokacin annobar, wanda ke ba da damar gina ƙarfin gaggawa, yanzu ana rage shi, har ma a cikin ƙasashe masu arziki.

Tsarin ya sanya kyakkyawan hangen nesa: nan da shekarar 2030, duk wanda ke samun ko samar da kiwon lafiya yana cikin aminci daga cututtukan da ke da alaƙa. Manufofinta guda uku sune: don hana kamuwa da cuta a cikin kiwon lafiya; Aiki don tabbatar da shirye-shiryen IPC suna nan kuma ana aiwatar da su; da kuma daidaita ayyukan IPC tare da wasu yankuna da ɓangarori. Tsarin ya mai da hankali kan duk wani saiti inda ake ba da kiwon lafiya, a duk faɗin tsarin kiwon lafiya; ya dogara ne akan ƙa'idar tsabta da aminci a matsayin muhimmin ɓangare na haƙƙin kiwon lafiya, wanda ke daidaito, kuma wanda ya kamata ya tabbatar da lissafi da ɗorewa. Za a cika dabarun IPC na duniya, kuma a yi amfani da shi tare da, wani shirin aiki na duniya da ke da alaƙa da tsarin sa ido, wanda za a haɓaka a cikin 2023-2024. Takaddar da ke da alaƙa EB152/9 - Tsohon tsarin duniya kan rigakafi da sarrafa cututtuka, Rahoton taƙaitaccen rahoton Babban Darakta.

Babbar taba tare da dukkan masu samar da kayan taba suna fafutukar tabbatar da cewa an boye haɗarin kayayyakinsu, amma muna fafutukar mayar da martani: A shekarar 2003, ƙasashe mambobin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya sun amince da yarjejeniyar Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya kan Kula da Tabar (WHO FCTC), yarjejeniyar kiwon lafiyar jama'a kaɗai a ƙarƙashin kulawar Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya. Tunda 2005, tana da ƙungiyoyi 181. Don taimakawa ƙasashe aiwatar da WHO FCTC, WHO ta gabatar da MPOWER, wani tsari na matakan fasaha da albarkatu, kowannensu ya dace da aƙalla wani tanadi na WHO FCTC. MPOWER yana gina ikon ƙasashe don aiwatar da matakan 6 don rage buƙatun kayayyakin taba: sa ido kan amfani da taba da tsare-tsaren rigakafi, kare mutane daga amfani da taba, bayar da taimako don barin amfani da taba, gargaɗi game da haɗarin taba, tilasta hana tallan taba, tallatawa da tallafawa da ƙara haraji a kan taba.

Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙaddamar da wani sabon shiri don inganta shirin yaƙi da annoba don taimakawa ƙasashe su shirya da kyau don annoba a nan gaba, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙaddamar da wani sabon shiri a yau wanda ke ba da jagora kan tsari mai ɗorewa don magance duk wata cuta mai karya numfashi kamar mura ko ƙwayar cutar korona. Sabon Shirin Shirye-shiryen da Juriya don Barazanar da ke Faruwa, ko PRET, ya haɗa da sabbin kayan aiki da hanyoyin da za a yi amfani da su don koyo tare da aiki tare da aka kafa yayin annobar COVID-19 da sauran gaggawa na kiwon lafiyar jama'a na kwanan nan. Ta hanyar shirin, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya za ta yi amfani da hanyar hanyar yaɗa cuta don jagorantar ƙasashe wajen tsara annoba, ganin cewa ƙarfi da damar da yawa sun zama gama gari a tsakanin rukunin ƙwayoyin cuta. PRET tana amsa kiran don jagoranci na fasaha da tallafi don haɓakawa da ƙarfafa shiri da martani, kamar yadda aka zayyana a cikin ƙudurorin Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya.

Farfesa Piot ya taka rawa wajen gano cutar Ebola a baya, da kuma dakatar da ɓarkewar cutar na farko, tare da shiga cikin binciken annoba. Ya jagoranci wasu manyan shirye-shirye, ya yi aiki a matsayin mai ba da shawara mai yawa, ciki har da COVID-19, kuma ya sami lambobin yabo da yawa. Farfesa Piot shi ne mai ba da shawara na musamman ga Shugaban EC, Farfesa na Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya kuma tsohon Daraktan Makarantar Kula da Tsafta da Magunguna ta London. "Waɗannan fitattun mutane suna nuna sadaukarwa na tsawon rayuwa, ba da shawara ba tare da jinkiri ba, jajircewa ga daidaito, da kuma sadaukar da kai ga ɗan adam da lafiyar mutane", in ji Darakta Janar na WHO, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "A lokacin da ake fuskantar matsalolin gaggawa da yawa, rikice-rikice, da rikice-rikice, mun fahimci cewa jagoranci a cikin kiwon lafiyar jama'a da kimiyya sun fi mahimmanci fiye da kowane lokaci don ci gaban kiwon lafiyar duniya.

A halin yanzu sama da hekta miliyan 3 na ƙasa a cikin ƙasashe sama da 120 ana amfani da su don noman taba mai kisa, har ma a ƙasashen da mutane ke fama da yunwa. Wani sabon rahoton WHO, "Noma abinci, ba taba ba", ya nuna illolin noman taba da fa'idodin canzawa zuwa noman abinci mai ɗorewa ga manoma, al'ummomi, tattalin arziƙi, muhalli, da duniya baki ɗaya. Rahoton ya kuma fallasa masana'antar taba don kama manoma a cikin mummunan tsarin bashi, yaɗa noman taba ta hanyar wuce gona da iri da fa'idodin tattalin arziƙinta da kuma yin kira ta hanyar ƙungiyoyin gona. Noman taba yana haifar da cututtuka ga manoma da kansu kuma sama da ma'aikatan yara miliyan 1 ana ƙiyasta suna aiki a gonakin taba, suna rasa damar samun ilimi. "Taba ba kawai babbar barazana ce ga rashin abinci ba, amma lafiya gaba ɗaya, gami da lafiyar manoman taba.

Muna so mu zayyana manyan rukunai guda uku na nasarorin da aka samu: Na farko, bincike mai inganci ta hanyar HRP yana da tasiri mai ma'ana kan manufofin kiwon lafiyar jama'a, ƙa'idoji, da aiki a duk duniya don magance buƙatun da ke tasowa na al'ummomi daban-daban. Na biyu, HRP, musamman ta hanyar HRP Alliance, ya ƙarfafa cibiyoyin bincike a cikin gida da na duniya, kuma, ya ba da damar masu bincike da yawa su sami ƙwarewar bincike wanda ke tabbatar da cewa bincike mai inganci na SRHR zai iya ci gaba, kuma tabbas ya ƙaru, a nan gaba. Na uku, a cikin duniyar da ke fama da rikici, rikici da ƙaruwar juriya ga daidaiton jinsi, HRP ya sauƙaƙe tabbatar da haƙƙoƙin mata da 'yan mata da kuma mutane masu rauni. HRP ya kasance babban kayan aiki a cikin tsarin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya don bincike a cikin haihuwar ɗan adam kuma ya ci gaba da kasancewa jagora na musamman a cikin lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa na duniya.

Dr Jérôme Salomon zai zama Mataimakin Darakta Janar na Tsarin Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya, Cututtuka Masu Yaɗuwa da Marasa Yaɗuwa daga 17 ga Afrilu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Salomon zai kula da babban ɓangaren shirye-shiryen fasaha da suka shafi cutar HIV, cutar hanta, cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i, tarin fuka, zazzaɓin cizon sauro, cututtukan da aka yi watsi da su, cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa, cututtukan amfani da ƙwayoyi, da cututtukan da ba a ɗauka ba kamar cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyin jini, ciwon sukari, cututtukan numfashi na kullum da ciwon daji. Dr Salomon ya kasance Darakta Janar na Lafiya a Ma'aikatar Lafiya da Rigakafi ta Faransa. Ya kasance memba na Hukumar Zartarwa ta WHO kafin nadin sa kuma yana da ƙwarewa sosai a cikin kula da tsarin kiwon lafiya, cututtuka masu yaɗuwa da lafiyar jama'a ta duniya. Dr Salomon yana da digiri na likitanci, digiri na biyu a cikin kiwon lafiyar jama'a da PhD a cikin ilimin cututtuka.

Kayan magunguna marasa inganci da na jabu Gamsashshen bayani: Har mutane biliyan biyu a faɗin duniya ba sa samun magunguna da alluran rigakafi da na'urorin kiwon lafiya da suka haɗa da gwaje-gwajen cututtuka da sauran kayayyakin kiwon lafiya, wanda hakan ke haifar da wani gurbi wanda yawanci ana cike shi da kayayyaki marasa inganci da na jabu. Wannan matsalar tana ƙaruwa yayin da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki a duniya suka zama masu rikitarwa, ma'ana kayayyakin da aka ƙera a ƙasa ɗaya za a iya shirya su a ƙasa ta biyu kuma a rarraba su a kan iyakoki don tallatawa ko sayarwa ga masu amfani a ƙasa ta uku. Ci gaban kasuwancin intanet shi ma yana ba da gudummawa ga wannan yanayin ta hanyar sauƙaƙa sayen magunguna ta intanet, sau da yawa daga hanyoyin da ba a ba da izini ba. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta gano wannan matsalar a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin ƙalubalen kiwon lafiya na gaggawa na shekaru goma masu zuwa, saboda fiye da ɗaya cikin goma na magunguna a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaicin kuɗi an ƙiyasta cewa ba su da inganci ko na jabu.

Dole ne mu kare al'umma ta gaba ta hanyar yin aiki yanzu. Zuba jari a cikin hanyoyin samar da makamashi mai tsafta da sabuntawa don tallafawa samun makamashi na duniya shi ne yadda za mu iya kawo canji na gaske. Tsabtataccen fasahar girki a gidaje da ingantaccen wutar lantarki a cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya na iya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen kare lafiyar al'ummominmu masu rauni. Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya Game da rahoton Hukumar Kula da SDG 7, Hukumar Kula da Makamashi ta Duniya (IEA), Hukumar Kula da Makamashi Mai Sabuntawa ta Duniya (IRENA), Sashen Kididdiga na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya (UNSD), Bankin Duniya, da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) da nufin samar wa al'ummar duniya da dashboard na duniya don yin rijistar ci gaba kan samun makamashi, ingancin makamashi, makamashi mai sabuntawa da haɗin gwiwar duniya don ciyar da SDG 7 gaba.

Ta hanyar shirin Trachoma na duniya, maganin riga-kafi na azithromycin da kamfanin Pfizer ya bayar don kawar da shirin aiwatar da dabarun SAFE. Benin ta haɗa ayyukan kawar da cutar trachoma tare da waɗanda aka aiwatar a kan sauran cututtukan da aka yi watsi da su (NTDs), a ƙarƙashin inuwar Shirin Ƙasa don Cututtuka Masu Yaɗuwa. Cutar Trachoma ita ce NTD ta uku da za a kawar a Benin, bayan dracunculiasis (a shekarar 2009) da gambiense human African trypanosomiasis (a shekarar 2021). Mali ta gudanar da tasirin cutar trachoma da binciken sa ido da kuma gabatar da ayyukan don cimma burin kawar da cutar, duk da ƙalubalen tsaro a yankunan arewacin ƙasar da rikice-rikicen zamantakewar siyasa a cikin 'yan shekarun nan. Cutar Trachoma ita ce NTD ta farko da za a kawar a Mali, wanda yanzu ya shiga rukunin duniya na ƙasashe 47 da suka kawar da aƙalla NTD guda ɗaya.

NCDs ̶ barazana ce ga lafiya da ke ƙaruwa a kowanne lokaci ga al'ummomi masu zuwa Duk da ci gaban da aka samu a lafiya gaba ɗaya, yawan mace-macen da NCDs ke haddasawa a kowacce shekara ya ƙaru a kowanne lokaci kuma a yanzu yana ɗauke da kusan kashi uku cikin huɗu na dukkan rayukan da aka rasa a kowacce shekara. Idan wannan yanayin ya ci gaba, NCDs za su ƙirji kusan kashi 86% na mace-macen da ake samu a kowacce shekara har zuwa tsakiyar ƙarni; a sakamakon haka, kusan kashi 77 cikin ɗari na waɗannan za su kasance saboda NCDs - kusan ƙarin kashi 90% a cikin adadi tun daga shekarar 2019. Rashin ci gaba yana buƙatar hanzarta ƙarin abubuwan da ke faruwa na kwanan nan suna nuna alamun raguwa a cikin adadin shekara-shekara (ARR) ga yawancin alamomi. Misali, yawan mace-macen mata masu juna biyu a duniya yana buƙatar raguwa da kashi 11.6% a kowacce shekara tsakanin 2021 da 2030 don cimma burin SDG. Haka kuma, raguwar cutar tarin fuka daga 2015 zuwa 2021 ya kasance kashi ɗaya cikin biyar ne kawai na hanyar zuwa ƙirƙirar ƙirƙira ta 2025 na dabarun kawo ƙarshen tarin fuka na WHO.

Ayyukan kula da kai don kiwon lafiya Gamsashshen bayani: Kula da kai shi ne ikon mutane, iyalai da al'ummomi don inganta kiwon lafiya, hana cututtuka, kiyaye lafiya, da magance rashin lafiya da nakasa tare da ko ba tare da tallafin ma'aikacin kiwon lafiya ba. A halin yanzu mutane biliyan 3.6 - rabin duniya - ba su da damar samun ayyukan kiwon lafiya masu mahimmanci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da shawarar ayyukan kula da kai ga kowace ƙasa da yanayin tattalin arziƙi, a matsayin hanya mai mahimmanci don isa ga kiwon lafiya na duniya, inganta kiwon lafiya, kiyaye duniya lafiya, da kuma yi wa marasa galihu hidima. Kula da kai yana gane mutane a matsayin wakilai masu aiki a cikin kula da lafiyarsu, a cikin yankunan da suka haɗa da inganta kiwon lafiya; rigakafin cututtuka da sarrafawa; maganin kai; samar da kulawa ga mutane masu dogaro, da gyarawa, gami da kulawa mai sauƙi. Ayyukan kula da kai sun dogara ne da shaida, ingantattun kayan aikin da ke tallafawa kula da kai.

Daga baya ya taimaka wajen tsara ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyin magance cutar da kuma shirya alluran rigakafin cutar Ebola. Ya yi aiki tuƙuru don gina ƙarfin kimiyya na Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo, inda ya kafa cibiyoyin bincike da yawa a ƙasar, kuma ya taka muhimmiyar rawa tare da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya wajen yaƙi da cututtuka masu yaɗuwa. Farfesa Piot daga ƙasar Belgium an yaba masa saboda gagarumin jagorancinsa wajen magance cutar HIV/AIDS da sauran manyan ƙalubalen kiwon lafiya na duniya. Ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen ƙaddamar da manyan shirye-shiryen kiwon lafiya na duniya kamar UNAIDS, da Asusun Tallafin Duniya, da sauran waɗanda suka inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duniya. A ƙarƙashin jagorancinsa, UNAIDS ta zama babbar mai ba da shawara ga matakin duniya game da cutar AIDS, kuma tana jagorantar gyare-gyaren Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta hanyar haɗa ƙungiyoyi 10 daban-daban na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya.

Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta taya ƙasashen Benin da Mali murnar kawar da cutar ta trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar al'umma. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta tabbatar da ƙasashen Benin da Mali a matsayin waɗanda suka kawar da cutar ta trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar al'umma, wanda hakan ya sa suka zama ƙasashe na biyar da na shida a yankin Afirka na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya da suka cimma wannan gagarumin nasarar. Ƙasashen da a baya suka samu tabbatar da kawar da cutar ta trachoma daga Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya su ne Ghana (Yuni 2018), Gambia (Afrilu 2021), Togo (Mayu 2022) da Malawi (Satumba 2022). "Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta taya hukumomin lafiya na ƙasashen Benin da Mali da kuma ƙungiyoyin haɗin gwiwarsu na duniya da na cikin gida murna saboda waɗannan nasarorin", in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya. "Bayan nasarar Benin da Mali, cutar ta trachoma ta ci gaba da zama annoba a ƙasashe 23 a yankin Afirka na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, wanda hakan ya kawo mu kusa da burin kawar da cutar ta trachoma da aka sanya a cikin tsarin hanyar kawar da cututtukan da aka yi watsi da su a shekarar 2021-2030."

Taron abokan hulɗar ya gudana ne a ƙarshen wani babban tsari na bita a cikin Sashen Kula da Cututtukan da Aka Yi watsi da su na WHO. A cikin watanni huɗu da suka gabata, WHO ta saurari gudummawa da shaidu daga dukkan abokan hulɗarta da masu ruwa da tsaki, don tabbatar da cewa ita kanta ta ƙunshi ƙimomin lissafi, nuna gaskiya da daidaito da take so da buƙata. Waɗannan ƙimomin sun haɗa da tabbatar da cewa an sake sanya NTDs a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya na duniya. Mahalarta taron sun yi maraba da jaddadawa kan mahimman rawar da al'ummar NTD za su iya kuma dole ne su taka wajen ba da gudummawa ga ƙalubale masu yawa kamar Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya, Kiwon Lafiya ɗaya da kuma ƙaruwar barazanar canjin yanayi na duniya. Wakilan da suka halarta da kansu sun kuma sami damar jin daɗin baje kolin da aka keɓe ga cututtukan da aka yi watsi da su a hedkwatar WHO.

Samun wutar lantarki da tsaftataccen girki har yanzu suna nuna manyan bambance-bambance na yanki kuma ya kamata su zama abin da za a mayar da hankali a kai don tabbatar da cewa ba a bar kowa a baya ba. Ana buƙatar saka hannun jari don isa ga ƙasashen da ba su da ci gaba sosai da kuma yankin Saharar Afirka don tabbatar da ci gaba mai daidaito zuwa Manufa ta 7. Stefan Schweinfest, Ƙungiyar Ƙididdiga ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya. Duk da cewa an samu raguwa a cikin saurin wutar lantarki a duniya, yawan mutanen da ba su da wutar lantarki kusan ya ragu da rabi a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata, daga biliyan 1.1 a shekarar 2010 zuwa miliyan 675 a shekarar 2021. Duk da haka, dole ne a sanya ƙarin ƙoƙari da matakan gaggawa don tabbatar da cewa ba a bar mutanen da suka fi talauci da wahalar isa ba. Don isa ga samun dama ga duniya baki ɗaya nan da shekarar 2030, dole ne al'ummar ci gaba su haɓaka saka hannun jari mai tsafta da tallafin manufofi. Guangzhe Chen, Mataimakin Shugaban Kasa na Kayayyakin more Rayuwa, Bankin Duniya

Kyautar ta karrama nasarorin da suka samu a rayuwarsu a fannin kiwon lafiyar al'umma. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum daga Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo (DRC) ana yabonsa ne saboda ƙirkirarsa, jagoranci da kuma gudunmawar da ya bayar ga kula da magance cututtuka irin su cutar Ebola. Ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo, yankin Afirka, da kuma al'ummar duniya. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum shi ne Darakta Janar na Cibiyar Nazarin Kimiyyar Kula da Lafiya ta DRC a Kinshasa, cikakken Farfesa na Microbiology a Jami'ar Kinshasa Medical School kuma shugaban farko na Kwalejin Kimiyya ta Kongo. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum na daga cikin tawagar da ta gano cutar Ebola ta Zaïre a lokacin da aka fara samun rahoton ɓarkewar cutar a 1976, a lardin Equateur, DRC ta Tsakiya.

Sabbin kayayyakin kiwon lafiya na zamani da ake haɓakawa suna da nufin taimakawa mutane a ko'ina su samu ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya cikin sauri kuma yadda ya kamata. Dangane da Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya na EU da dabarun WHO na duniya kan kiwon lafiya na zamani, shirin ya biyo bayan yarjejeniyar 30 ga Nuwamba 2022 tsakanin Kwamishina Kyriakides da Dr Tedros don haɓaka haɗin gwiwa kan batutuwan kiwon lafiya na duniya. Wannan yana ƙara ƙarfafa ingantaccen tsarin da ke da alaƙa da WHO a cikin zuciyarsa, wanda ke samun ƙarfi daga EU mai ƙarfi. Wannan haɗin gwiwar wani muhimmin mataki ne na shirin ayyukan dijital na Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya na EU. Ta hanyar amfani da kyawawan ayyukan Turai muna ba da gudummawa ga ƙa'idojin kiwon lafiya na zamani da haɗin gwiwa a duniya don amfanin waɗanda suka fi buƙata. Hakanan misali ne mai ƙarfi na yadda daidaituwa tsakanin EU da WHO zai iya samar da ingantacciyar lafiya ga kowa, a cikin EU da kuma a duk faɗin duniya.

Sabuwar ƙuduri don hanzarta ƙoƙarin ƙara sinadaran gina jiki a abinci Wakilan sun amince da ƙuduri kan ƙara himma don hana ƙarancin sinadaran gina jiki ta hanyar ingantaccen abinci. Ƙarancin bitamin da sinadaran ma'adanai, musamman na folate, baƙin ƙarfe, bitamin A, da zinc, yana shafar kashi 50% na dukkan yara masu zuwa makaranta da kuma kashi 67% na dukkan mata masu haihuwa a duniya. Ƙarancin sinadaran gina jiki na iya haifar da mummunan sakamako, ciki har da spina bifida da sauran matsalolin ƙwayar halitta. Babban girman ƙara sinadaran gina jiki a abinci wani ɓangare ne na mafita. Ta hanyar ƙara muhimman bitamin da sinadaran ma'adanai ga abinci da kayan ƙamshi, kamar fulawar alkama da masara, shinkafa, man girki da gishiri daidai da tsarin amfani da ƙasa da ƙarancin su, ƙasashe za su iya gyarawa da kuma ƙara hana ƙarancin sinadaran gina jiki.

Baya ga mummunan tasirin taba a kan lafiya, jimillar kuɗin tattalin arziƙin shan taba (daga kashe kuɗin kiwon lafiya da asarar yawan aiki tare) an ƙiyasta su kusan dalar Amurka tiriliyan 1.4 a kowace shekara, kwatankwacin kaso 1.8% na babban kuɗin cikin gida na shekara-shekara (GDP). Kusan kaso 40% na wannan kuɗin ya faru ne a ƙasashe masu tasowa, wanda ke nuna babban nauyin da waɗannan ƙasashe ke fama da shi. Ana amfani da harajin taba a wani ɓangare don magance wannan tasirin kuma ana ganin su a matsayin hanya mafi tsada don dakatar da amfani da taba, musamman a tsakanin matasa da mutanen da ke da ƙarancin kuɗi. Ƙarin haraji wanda ke ƙara farashin taba da kaso 10% yana rage yawan amfani da taba da kusan kaso 4% a cikin ƙasashe masu yawan kuɗi da kusan kaso 5% a cikin ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaicin kuɗi. Amsar WHO: Girman wannan bala'i na ɗan adam da tattalin arziƙi abin mamaki ne, amma kuma ana iya kare shi.

Aukuwar wutar daji tana ƙara ta'azzara ta fuskar yawan kadada da aka ƙona, tsawon lokaci da tsananin, kuma suna iya kawo cikas ga harkokin sufuri, sadarwa, samar da ruwa, da wutar lantarki da iskar gas. Tasiri: Wutar daji da ke ƙonewa kusa da wuraren da ake da yawan jama'a na iya yin babban tasiri ga muhalli, dukiya, dabbobi da mace-mace da rashin lafiyar mutane dangane da girman, saurin da kuma kusanci da wutar, da kuma ko jama'a sun sami gargaɗin tafiya. Hayakin wutar daji wani cakuda ne na gurɓataccen iska wanda ƙwayoyin cuta (PM) shi ne babban barazanar lafiyar jama'a. PM2.5 daga hayaƙin wutar daji yana da alaƙa da mutuwar da ba ta kai ga lokaci ba a cikin jama'a gaba ɗaya, kuma yana iya haifar da tsananta cututtukan huhu, zuciya, ƙwaƙwalwa / tsarin juyayi, fata, hanji, ƙoda, idanu, hanci da hanta. Hakanan an nuna cewa yana haifar da nakasa da ƙwaƙwalwa.

A nasa jawabin rufewa, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO, ya lura cewa "ƙarin gudummawar da aka tantance da kuma zagayen saka hannun jari sun kasance na tarihi kuma babban ci gaba ne." Ya yi magana game da shekara mai zuwa, tare da manyan tarurruka kan kiwon lafiya na duniya, tarin fuka da shirye-shiryen annoba da martani a Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na wannan shekarar. Ya yi nuni da ci gaba da tattaunawa kan yarjejeniyar annoba da gyare-gyare ga Dokokin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya a matsayin damar da ba a taɓa gani ba - "tsararraki" don koyo daga kuskuren annobar COVID-19 da tabbatar da cewa ba a maimaita su ba. Wakilai kuma sun sami damar ji daga tsohon ma'aikacin WHO Gwen Carnelley, wanda ya cika shekara 100 a wannan shekarar, wanda ya fara aiki tare da WHO a 1949, shekara guda bayan da aka kafa WHO shekaru 75 da suka gabata. Bidiyon Rufe Taron Lafiya na Duniya na 76.

Kafin wannan matsayin, Dr Li ya yi aiki a matsayin Daraktan Gaggawa na Yanki na Shirin Gaggawa na Lafiya na WHO a Ofishin Yankin WHO na Yammacin Pacific. Dr Li yana da digiri na likitanci da digiri a kimiyyar zamantakewar lafiya. Dr Yukiko Nakatani zai zama Mataimakin Darakta Janar don Samun Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya daga 2 ga Mayu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Nakatani zai sa ido kan ci gaba da aiwatar da ƙa'idoji da manufofin WHO don tabbatar da samun daidaito ga ingantattun magunguna, alluran rigakafi da bincike ga dukkan al'ummomi a ko'ina, gami da rigakafi da mayar da martani ga annoba. Dr Nakatani yana aiki a matsayin Daraktan Sashen Kula da Cutar Kansa da Cututtuka na Ma'aikatar Lafiya ta Japan, Aiki da Jin Dadin Jama'a kuma a matsayin Mashawarci na Fasaha ga Ministan Jiha na Aikin Rigakafin COVID-19 a Japan.

Marubutan sun yi kira ga al'ummar duniya da masu tsara dokoki da su kiyaye nasarorin da aka samu wajen cimma SDG 7, don ci gaba da gyare-gyare, da kuma ci gaba da mai da hankali kan ƙasashe masu rauni da ke buƙatar tallafi mafi yawa. An ambaci: "Rikicin makamashi da mamayar Rasha ta haifar a Ukraine na ci gaba da yin tasiri sosai ga mutane a duk faɗin duniya. Tsadar makamashi ya shafi waɗanda suka fi rauni, musamman waɗanda ke cikin ƙasashe masu tasowa. Yayin da sauyin makamashi mai tsafta ke tafiya da sauri fiye da yadda mutane da yawa ke tsammani, har yanzu akwai babban aiki da ake buƙata don isar da ɗorewa, amintacce da sauƙin samun damar samun ayyukan makamashi na zamani ga biliyoyin mutanen da ke rayuwa ba tare da shi ba. Nasarar sauyin makamashi ya dogara ne da ingantattun manufofi da ƙirƙira na fasaha haɗe da babban haɗin gwiwar saka hannun jari.

A matsayinta na mai jagorantar da kuma tsara ayyukan lafiya na duniya, babu wani abokin aiki da ya fi Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) wajen ciyar da aikin da muka fara a EU gaba da kuma ci gaba da samar da hanyoyin samar da lafiya ta intanet a duniya, in ji Stella Kyriakides, Kwamishinar Lafiya da Kula da Ingancin Abinci. Wannan haɗin gwiwar zai haɗa da haɗin kai sosai wajen bunƙasa, sarrafawa da kuma aiwatar da tsarin GDHCN na WHO, wanda zai amfana daga ƙwarewar fasaha da Hukumar Tarayyar Turai ke da ita a fannin. Mataki na farko shi ne tabbatar da cewa takaddun shaida na intanet na EU na yanzu sun ci gaba da aiki yadda ya kamata. Tare da ƙasashe 80 da yankuna da aka haɗa da EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate, EU ta samar da tsari na duniya. Takardar shaidar EU ba wai kawai ta kasance wani muhimmin kayan aiki ba ne wajen yaƙi da annobar, amma kuma ta sauƙaƙa tafiye-tafiye da yawon buɗe ido na ƙasa da ƙasa.

Haɗin guiwa a cikin gida yana da mahimmanci ga ci gaba a duniya game da SDGs masu alaƙa da kiwon lafiya. Rahoton ci gaba na yau da hukumomi 13 da suka sanya hannu a kan Shirin Ayyukan Duniya don Rayuwa Lafiya da Jin Daɗin Kowa (SDG3 GAP) suka saki. Rahoton mai taken "Me ya yi aiki? Me bai yi ba? Menene na gaba?" ya nuna shekaru huɗu na haɗin gwiwa da manyan hukumomin duniya da yawa da ke nuna abin da ya yi aiki da abin da bai yi ba wajen ƙarfafa haɗin gwiwa da tallafi don hanzarta ci gaban ƙasa zuwa ga Manufofin Ci Gaban Mai Ɗorewa (SDGs) masu alaƙa da kiwon lafiya. A wannan shekarar an yi bikin rabin shekarar SDGs, amma duniya tana baya wajen cimma burin duniya. Tun lokacin da aka ƙaddamar da shi a shekarar 2019, SDG3 GAP ya ba da damar ƙirƙirar sabbin tsarin haɗin gwiwa tsakanin hukumomin da suka sanya hannu a cikin mahimman fannoni kamar kuɗaɗe mai ɗorewa da kula da lafiya na farko da sauransu.

Mutanen da suke da buƙatun lafiya suna "barin baya cikin ciwo" ya bayyana sabon rahoto Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta wallafa wani sabon rahoto kan samun damar amfani da maganin (morphine) don amfanin likita, wanda ya bayyana yadda rabon maganin (morphine) a duniya, a matsayin magani mai mahimmanci, ba daidai ba ne kuma ba ya biyan buƙatun likita. Rahoton, mai taken "An bar su a baya cikin ciwo", ya nuna matsalolin da ake samu wajen samun wannan magani mai mahimmanci kuma ya ba da shawarwari don inganta samun damar yin amfani da shi ta hanyar daidaitaccen tsari. Duk da cewa maganin (morphine) magani ne mai inganci kuma mai rahusa don rage ciwo mai tsanani, wanda aka lissafa tun 1977 a cikin jerin farko na jerin muhimman magunguna na WHO, bambancin da ke cikin samun dama a ƙasashe yana da yawa. Akwai bambanci mai ninki 5 zuwa 63 a cikin ƙiyasin yawan amfani da maganin (morphine) tsakanin ƙasashe masu samun kuɗi da ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi.

Abubuwan da suke da alaƙa da shekarun uwa da kuma yin amfani da taba suma za su iya ƙara haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan mata masu juna biyu da kuma haihuwar mace. Za a iya hana haihuwar mace ta hanyar tsarin iyali don kauce wa ɗaukar ciki da ba a so, ingantacciyar lafiya da abinci mai gina jiki kafin da lokacin ɗaukar ciki, inganci da kulawa da haihuwa da kuma haihuwa da suka haɗa da isassun ƙwararrun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya ciki har da ungozoma. Yin maganin cutar sifilis a lokacin ɗaukar ciki zai iya kare kimanin mace-macen jarirai 200,000, yayin da sa ido kan bugun zuciya da sa ido kan haihuwa da kuma gaggawar shiga tsakani lokacin da ake buƙata suna da mahimmanci don hana mace-macen jarirai 832,000 a lokacin haihuwa da rage mace-macen jarirai. Haihuwar mace tana da alaƙa da mummunan yanayin zamantakewa da tattalin arziƙi na lafiya. Dole ne a haɗa rigakafi da kulawa mai amsawa a duk faɗin ci gaba da kula da lafiyar uwa, da kuma bayan haka.

Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion 2023 award laureate: Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma daga Bahrain Baya ga kasancewa Babban Jami'in Hukumar Kula da Lafiya ta Ƙasa ta Bahrain, Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma ta riƙe mukamai daban-daban na jagoranci a cikin gwamnati da cibiyoyin ilimi a ƙasarta. Dr Al Jalahma ta taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen haɓaka dabaru da tsare-tsare da yawa na ƙasa da na yanki a fagen kiwon lafiya na farko, lafiyar yara da matasa, cututtuka masu naci da maganin shan taba. A matsayinta na yanzu, Dr Al Jalahma ta jagoranci manyan shirye-shirye masu nasara, kamar tsarin ba da izini na ƙasa don cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya, canjin dijital na Hukumar Kula da Lafiya ta Ƙasa, da kuma shirye-shirye da yawa da ke haifar da haɓaka da ƙwarewa a ɓangaren kiwon lafiya.

Rahoton Landmark ya zayyana hanyar da za a bi don sake tsara tattalin arziƙi don samar da kiwon lafiya ga kowa da kowa. A rahoton farko na irin wannan, Majalisar WHO kan Tattalin Arziki na Lafiya ga Kowa da Kowa ta zayyana wata sabuwar hanya mai ƙarfi don sake tsara tattalin arziƙi don samar da abin da ke da mahimmanci - kiwon lafiya ga kowa da kowa. Majalisar, wacce Babban Daraktan WHO Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ya kirkira a watan Nuwambar 2020 don mayar da martani ga annobar COVID-19, kuma Farfesa Mariana Mazzucato ke jagoranta, ta kashe shekaru biyu da suka gabata tana sake tunani game da tattalin arziƙi daga mahangar kiwon lafiya ga kowa da kowa, da kuma tura ƙa'idar cewa lafiyar ɗan adam da na duniya dole ne su kasance a zuciyar yadda muke tsara tsarin zamantakewarmu, kiwon lafiya da tattalin arziƙi da kuma manufofi. Majalisar ta gabatar da sabon labari mai ƙarfi wanda ke da tushe a cikin sabon hikimar tattalin arziƙi don sake tsara tattalin arziƙi don samar da kiwon lafiya ga kowa da kowa a cikin jigogi huɗu masu alaƙa da juna:

(1) wallafa nazarin binciken annoba na ƙiyasin cikakkiyar ingancin rigakafin BA.1- ko BA.4/5 da ke ɗauke da bivalent mRNA da ake amfani da su a matsayin ƙarin yawa a kan alamun cuta da cuta mai tsanani; (2) bayanan ɗakin gwaje-gwaje game da girma da faɗin martani na rigakafi na tsakani da ke adawa da bambance-bambancen SARS-CoV-2 na baya da ke yawo wanda BA.1- ko BA.4/5- ke ɗauke da alluran mRNA, idan aka kwatanta da alluran rigakafin ƙwayar cuta na tushen, da ake amfani da su a matsayin ƙarin yawa; da (3) nazarin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje da bayanan lura a kan martanin ƙwaƙwalwar rigakafi don tantance tasirin maimaita bayyanar sinadarin antigen a kan rigakafin da kariya. Za a iya samun ƙarin cikakkun bayanai game da shaidar da TAG-CO-VAC ta duba a cikin haɗin da ke biye. Dangane da nazarin bayanan da aka bayyana a sama, TAG-CO-VAC ta kammala:

Manufar dabarun ita ce tallafawa ƙasashe mambobin ƙungiyar wajen samar da tsare-tsare masu inganci da aiwatar da tsare-tsaren da za su ƙarfafa rawar da magungunan gargajiya ke takawa wajen kiyaye lafiyar al'umma. Magance ƙalubalen, amsa buƙatun da ƙasashe mambobin ƙungiyar suka gano da kuma gina kan aikin da aka yi a ƙarƙashin dabarun magungunan gargajiya na WHO: 2002-2005, dabarun da aka sabunta na lokacin 2014-2023 ya ba da hankali fiye da wanda ya gabace shi wajen ba da fifiko ga ayyukan kiwon lafiya da tsarin kiwon lafiya, gami da magungunan gargajiya da na ƙarin magani, ayyuka da masu aikatawa. Manufofin dabarun sune: Don gina tushen ilimi don kula da T&CM ta hanyar manufofin ƙasa masu dacewa; Don ƙarfafa ingancin tabbatarwa, aminci, amfani da inganci na T&CM ta hanyar daidaita kayayyaki, ayyuka da masu aikatawa;

A wani mataki na gaba ɗaya, Afrigen zai ci gaba da gudanar da horo da kuma tura fasaha ga abokan hulɗa. Masu ba da kuɗin suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen tallafawa Shirin tare da jimillar kuɗi har zuwa yau a dalar Amurka miliyan 117 kuma Faransa ita ce ta fara ba da kuɗin aikin canja fasahar mRNA. Wakilai daga Hukumar Tarayyar Turai, Belgium, Jamus, da kuma Norway, Kanada, Tarayyar Afirka, Afirka ta Kudu, da Gidauniyar ELMA sun halarci taron. Caroline Delany, Darakta Janar na GlobalAffairs Canada na Kudancin da Gabashin Afirka ya ce: "Kanada ta sake tabbatar da ci gaba da goyon bayan Shirin Canja Fasahar mRNA kuma muna farin cikin sanar da ƙarin gudummawar dalar Kanada miliyan 15 a taron yau. Wannan ya kawo jimillar gudummawar Kanada zuwa Shirin har dalar Kanada miliyan 45.

Ana buƙatar ɗaukar matakin gaggawa don magance tsaikon ci gaba a kan abubuwan da suka shafi lafiya. Manufofin Cigaba Mai Ɗorewa WHO tana fitar da sabon rahoton ƙididdigar lafiya na shekara-shekara na 2023 tare da sabbin ƙididdiga kan tasirin cutar ta COVID-19 da sabbin ƙididdiga kan ci gaban da aka samu a kan manufofin ci gaba mai ɗorewa (SDGs). Rahoton tare da bayanai har zuwa 2022 ya jaddada tsayawar ci gaban kiwon lafiya a kan mahimman alamun kiwon lafiya a cikin 'yan shekarun nan idan aka kwatanta da yanayin da aka gani a lokacin 2000-2015. Hakanan yana faɗakar da mu game da haɗarin da ke ƙaruwa na cututtukan da ba a iya ɗauka (NCDs) da canjin yanayi, kuma yana kira da a haɗa kai da ƙarfafa martani. Kudin COVID-19 a cikin rayukan da aka rasa da ci gaban kiwon lafiya Rahoton ya rubuta sabbin ƙididdiga kan yawan cutar a kan lafiyar duniya, yana ba da gudummawa ga ci gaba da raguwar ci gaba zuwa ga SDGs.

An gabatar da lambar yabo ga gagarumar gudunmawa ga lafiyar al'umma a yayin taron lafiya na duniya karo na saba'in da shida. A yayin wani bikin da aka yi a taron lafiya na duniya karo na saba'in da shida a Geneva, an gabatar da lambobin yabo ga mutane da cibiyoyi daga ko'ina cikin duniya saboda gagarumar gudunmawar da suka bayar ga lafiyar al'umma. "Lambar yabo ta lafiyar al'umma ta shekarar 2023 ta karrama mutanen da suka ba da gudummawa mai mahimmanci ga lafiyar duniya, kuma waɗanda aikinsu ya wuce neman aikin yau da kullun", in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "A lokacin da duniya ke fuskantar ƙalubale da yawa, kowannensu abin ƙarfafawa ne da tunatarwa game da ci gaban da za a iya samu don inganta lafiya da walwala ga kowa da kowa." An aika da kiraye-kirayen gabatar da 'yan takara don kowace kyauta a kowace shekara bayan rufe taron lafiya na duniya.

Ma'ana: WHO ta fara aiki a fannin lafiyar jima'i tun aƙalla 1974, lokacin da kwamitin ƙwararru ya yi shawarwari wanda ya haifar da wallafa rahoton fasaha mai taken "Ilimi da magani a cikin jima'i na ɗan adam" (WHO, 1975). Farawa a 2000, Hukumar Lafiya ta Amurka (PAHO) da WHO sun haɗu da ƙwararrun masu ba da shawara don nazarin ma'ana da kuma gano zaɓuɓɓukan shirye-shirye. Ƙarshen waɗannan tarurrukan shi ne Tattaunawa na Fasaha a 2002, inda aka samar da ma'anoni masu aiki na mahimman kalmomin da ke da alaƙa da lafiyar jima'i a ƙasa. Jima'i: Jima'i yana nufin halayen halitta waɗanda ke bayyana mutane a matsayin mata ko maza. Yayin da waɗannan nau'ikan halayen halitta ba sa ware juna, kamar yadda akwai mutane da suke da duka biyun, suna bambance mutane a matsayin maza da mata.

Taron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya karo na saba'in da shida - Sabuntawa na yau da kullun: 27 ga Mayu 2023 Dabarun duniya na farko kan rigakafi da sarrafa kamuwa da cutaTaron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ya amince a yau kan dabarun duniya na farko kan rigakafi da sarrafa kamuwa da cuta (IPC), wanda ke gina kusan shekaru ashirin na ƙoƙarin da WHO da abokan hulɗa ke jagoranta. Dabarun suna ba wa ƙasashe mambobi jagoranci don rage haɗarin ci gaba da kamuwa da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da kiwon lafiya (HAIs), gami da waɗanda ke nuna juriyar ƙwayoyin cuta. HAIs suna daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi faruwa a cikin yanayin isar da sabis na kiwon lafiya. Cutar ta COVID-19 da manyan ɓarkewar cututtuka na baya-bayan nan kamar cutar Ebola, cutar numfashi ta Gabas ta Tsakiya da cutar kwayar cutar Sudan sun bayyana a fili gibin da ke cikin shirye-shiryen IPC a duk ƙasashe.

Ina godiya ga WHO da suka share hanya don sabon bincike da samar da dandalin su na duniya don yaɗa kalmar da samar da bincike kan alaƙar zane-zane da kiwon lafiya. "Ina fatan duk yiwuwar yin aiki mai mahimmanci a ƙasata ta Afirka ta Kudu da kuma duniya baki ɗaya don kyakkyawar gobe mai ƙoshin lafiya," in ji Yende. Nadin Fleming da Yende ya jaddada alaƙar da ke tsakanin zane-zane da kiwon lafiya. Shiga cikin ayyukan kirkira, kamar kiɗa, zane-zane, da rawa, suna tasiri ga lafiyar jiki, tunani, jin daɗin zamantakewa, da kuma ingancin rayuwa gaba ɗaya. Ta hanyar rawar da suke takawa a matsayin Jakadun Alheri, Fleming da Yende za su inganta haɗin gwiwar zane-zane a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya, su ba da shawara don samun damar yin amfani da fasahar kirkira, da kuma tabbatar da mahimmancin bayyana fasaha wajen inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duniya.

Cutar sanqarau da ke faruwa yayin ɗaukar ciki ko a cikin makonni 6 na ƙarshen ciki ana kiranta da sanqarau na uwa, yayin da sanqarau da ke faruwa a cikin kwanaki 28 na farko na rayuwa ana kiranta da sanqarau na jarirai. Cutar ta kasance babbar matsalar lafiyar al'umma a ɓangarori da yawa na duniya, amma musamman a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi ko gundumomi, inda yawan rigakafin yake ƙasa kuma al'adun haihuwa marasa tsafta sun zama ruwan dare. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙiyasta cewa a shekarar 2018 (shekarar da aka samu ƙiyasi na baya-bayan nan), jarirai 25 000 sun mutu daga sanqarau na jarirai, raguwar kashi 88% daga halin da ake ciki a shekarar 2000. Alamomi: Kusan dukkanin cututtukan sanqarau suna faruwa ne a cikin mutanen da ba a taɓa yi musu rigakafi ba ko a cikin manya waɗanda ba su ci gaba da yin ƙarin rigakafin ba. Alamomi da alamun cutar sanqarau suna bayyana a kowane lokaci daga kwanaki 3 zuwa 21 bayan ƙwayar cutar sanqarau ta shiga jiki ta hanyar rauni.

Manyan nade-naden shugabanci da aka yi don jagorantar tsare-tsaren WHO da shirye-shiryen sa Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta naɗa sabbin manyan mutane biyar a cikin tawagar shugabancinta da ke Geneva. Sabbin nade-naden sun biyo bayan sake nadin Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus zuwa wa'adinsa na biyu na shekaru biyar a matsayin Darakta Janar. An haɗa dukkanin tawagar shugabanci don daidaitawa da abubuwan da Hukumar ke fifitawa na shekaru biyar masu zuwa kuma za su yi aiki kafada da kafada da Darakta Janar don ciyar da waɗannan abubuwan gaba da kuma ajandar canji mai cike da buri na WHO. Don hanzarta ci gaba kan aiwatar da Babban Shirin Aiki na 13 na WHO (GPW13), da cimma burinta na biliyan uku da kuma manufofin ci gaba mai ɗorewa da suka shafi kiwon lafiya, aikin WHO na shekaru biyar masu zuwa ya mai da hankali kan abubuwa biyar masu muhimmanci:

Taron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya karo na saba'in da shida zai maida hankali ne kan "ceton rayuka, inganta lafiya ga kowa da kowa" yayin da WHO ta cika shekaru 75. Yayin da duniya ke fuskantar matsalolin kiwon lafiya da na agaji, taron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya karo na saba'in da shida zai maida hankali ne kan ciyar da lafiya gaba ga kowa da kowa. Taron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na wannan shekarar zai ƙayyade makomar Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya nan gaba da kuma nan gaba, farawa da kasafin kuɗin shirye-shirye na shekaru biyu masu zuwa, manyan shawarwari game da ci gaba da tallafawa Hukumar da canje-canje da aka sanya don inganta hanyoyin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya da kuma lissafin aiki. Wakilai za su kuma yi shawarwari game da muhimmiyar rawar da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ke takawa a Tsarin Gaggawa na Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya. Abubuwan da suka faru na waɗannan batutuwan shi ne bikin cika shekaru 75 na ƙungiyar, tare da manyan nasarorin da ta samu na kiwon lafiya na duniya tun lokacin da aka kafa Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya a 1948.

Duk da haka, annobar ta sanya alamomi da yawa da suka shafi kiwon lafiya a baya kuma sun ba da gudummawa ga rashin daidaito wajen samun ingantaccen kiwon lafiya, allurar rigakafi na yau da kullun da kariya ta kuɗi. A sakamakon haka, an juyar da yanayin ci gaba a cutar cizon sauro da tarin fuka, kuma mutane ƙalilan ne aka yi wa maganin cututtukan da aka yi watsi da su. "Ƙididdigar Lafiya ta Duniya ita ce binciken shekara-shekara na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya kan yanayin lafiyar duniya. Rahoton ya aika da saƙo mai ban tsoro game da barazanar cututtukan da ba sa yaɗuwa, waɗanda ke ɗaukar nauyi mai yawa da ƙaruwa a kan rayuka, rayuwa, tsarin kiwon lafiya, al'ummomi, tattalin arziƙi da al'ummomi," in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Rahoton ya yi kira da a ƙara yawan saka hannun jari a harkar kiwon lafiya da tsarin kiwon lafiya don dawowa kan hanya zuwa Manufofin Ci Gaban Mai Ɗorewa."

Jima'i: ba za a iya bayyana lafiyar jima'i ba, ko fahimta ko yin aiki ba tare da yin la'akari da jima'i ba, wanda ke haifar da muhimman halaye da sakamako masu alaƙa da lafiyar jima'i. Ma'anar aiki na jima'i ita ce: "...wani muhimmin bangare na kasancewa ɗan adam a duk tsawon rayuwa ya haɗa da jima'i, asalin jinsi da matsayi, yanayin jima'i, sha'awa, jin daɗi, kusanci da haifuwa. Ana samun jima'i da bayyana shi a cikin tunani, mafarki, sha'awa, imani, halaye, ƙimomi, halaye, ayyuka, matsayi da alaƙa. Yayin da jima'i zai iya haɗawa da duk waɗannan ɓangarorin, ba koyaushe ake samun ko bayyana su ba. Jima'i yana tasiri ta hanyar hulɗar halitta, ilimin halin ɗan adam, zamantakewa, tattalin arziki, siyasa, al'adu, doka, tarihi, addini da kuma abubuwan ruhaniya. (WHO, 2006a)

Tallafawa ƙasashe wajen bunƙasa shirye-shiryen sa ido na ƙasa ko na yanki don sinadarin kyamikal da ake damuwa da shi. Tsarin duniya ya ba da shawarar manyan hanyoyi guda shida waɗanda suka maida hankali kan: Kula da lafiya na duniya, daidaitattun tattalin arziki, kare duniya, tsarin kare zamantakewa, tsarin dijital don ba da damar kiwon lafiya, da auna da sa ido kan walwala.

Cututtuka ba sa mutunta iyakoki: barazanar cuta a wata ƙasa ma barazana ce ga wasu. Muna fatan yin aiki tare da mambobin IPSN don cimma burinmu na kare cututtuka da ceton rayuka. IPSN za ta magance waɗannan ƙalubalen ta hanyar hanyar sadarwa ta duniya, haɗa yankuna da hanyoyin sadarwa na musamman na cututtuka, don gina tsarin haɗin gwiwa don gano, rigakafi da mayar da martani ga barazanar cututtuka. Mambobi za su yi aiki tare a cikin ƙungiyoyi masu sadaukarwa da ke mai da hankali kan ƙalubale na musamman, wanda ke samun tallafi ta hanyar IPSN don haɓaka ra'ayoyi da ayyuka a cikin ƙwayoyin halittar ƙwayoyin cuta.

Manyan shawarwarin sun haɗa da: Muna buƙatar kimantawa da auna abubuwan da suke da mahimmanci - bunƙasar ɗan adam da na duniya - maimakon neman ci gaban tattalin arziƙi da haɓaka GDP ba tare da la'akari da sakamakon ba. Don cimma lafiya ga kowa, dole ne gwamnatoci su sake tunani da sake fasalin tattalin arziƙi bisa ga jin daɗin zamantakewa da na duniya, wanda sabbin ma'auni ke jagoranta. Ana buƙatar sake fasalin tsarin ƙasa da na duniya don ba da kuɗi ga kiwon lafiya, don haka kashe kuɗi a kan kiwon lafiya ana ɗaukarsa a matsayin saka hannun jari na dogon lokaci. Isar da Lafiya ga Kowa zai buƙaci ƙarin kuɗi, da kuma ƙarin kuɗi mai inganci. Ƙirƙira na buƙatar ƙwaƙwalwa ta gama gari - ba wai 'ya'yan wani kamfani ko hukumar gwamnati kaɗai ba. Amma sai dai idan an sarrafa ƙirkira don amfanin kowa, mutane da yawa za su kasance a ware daga amfaninta.

Matsayin mambobin da ke cikin babban ofishin jagorancin: Dr Samira Asma za ta ci gaba a matsayin Mataimakiyar Babban Darakta Janar don Bayanai, Nazari da Isar da Sako don Tasiri. Dr Asma tana kula da wani ɓangare wanda ke tabbatar da cewa bayanan kiwon lafiya abin dogaro ne kuma ana iya samunsu, kuma ana amfani da su don inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duk duniya, gami da bin diddigin da hanzarta ci gaba zuwa ga manufofin biliyan uku da kuma Manufofin Ci Gaban Lafiya masu ɗorewa. Kafin shiga WHO a shekarar 2018, Dr Asma ta riƙe mukaman jagoranci a Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka da Kariya ta Amurka (CDC) sama da shekaru ashirin. Tana da digiri na biyu a fannin tiyatar hakora da digiri na biyu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Dr Bruce Aylward an naɗa Mataimakin Babban Darakta Janar na Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya, Sashen Tsarin Rayuwa tun daga 4 ga Mayu 2023.

Shahararrun masu fasaha Renée Fleming da Pretty Yende an nada su a matsayin Jakadun WHO na Al'adu da Lafiya WHO na farin cikin sanar da nadin shahararrun masu fasaha Renée Fleming da Pretty Yende a matsayin Jakadun Al'adu da Lafiya. An yi wannan sanarwa mai daraja a matsayin wani ɓangare na bikin cika shekaru 75 na WHO a yayin taron Lafiya na Duniya na saba'in da shida a ranar 22 ga Mayu 2023. Renée Fleming, ɗaya daga cikin mawaƙa da aka fi girmamawa a wannan lokacin, da Pretty Yende, wata soprano mai ban mamaki da aka sani da rawar da take takawa, an zaɓe su ne saboda nasarorin da suka samu na fasaha da kuma ba da shawara don inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya ta hanyar kirkira. A ranar 8 ga Afrilu 2023, Fleming da Yende sun yi waƙoƙi na musamman mai taken Healing Arts, wanda aka sadaukar domin bikin cika shekaru 75 na WHO a Geneva, Switzerland.

Maida hankali kan ayyuka; magungunan gargajiya, da kuma aikin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) wajen amsa ɗimbin buƙatun gaggawa yayin da suke aiki tare da ƙasashe mambobin ƙungiyar don su kasance cikin shiri sosai don fuskantar sababbin matsaloli. A farkon ranar, wakilai a cikin kwamitin A sun amince da lura da tsarin da za a bi don samar da shirin kiwon lafiya da zaman lafiya na duniya (tare da ɗan canji a suna daga "Shirin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya don Zaman Lafiya"), kuma sun nemi Babban Darakta Janar ya ba da rahoto kan ci gaban da aka samu wajen ƙarfafa tsarin. A cikin taron, a matsayin mataki na ƙarshe na amincewa da taron, wakilai sun amince da ƙuduri da yanke shawara na kwamitocin biyu, kuma sun amince da rahotonsu. Wannan ya haɗa da amincewa da kasafin kuɗi na 2024-25, da ƙarin kashi 20% na ƙimar gudummawar da aka tantance. Shugabannin kwamitin da wakilai daga yankuna biyu sun yi magana don nuna godiya ga aikin da ci gaban wannan Majalisar.

IPSN tana da ra'ayin duniya inda kowace ƙasa ke da damar samun daidaito ga ƙarfin ci gaba don tsarin jerin kwayoyin halitta da nazari a matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin sa ido kan lafiyar jama'a. Tana da niyyar ƙirƙirar hanyar sadarwa ta duniya mai tallafawa da ke sa ido kan kwayoyin halitta waɗanda ke haɓaka da hanzarta aikin membobinta don haɓaka samun dama da daidaito. IPSN ta ƙunshi manyan hukumomi guda uku waɗanda ke haɗa nau'ikan masu ruwa da tsaki daban-daban, wanda Sakatariyar WHO Pandemic Hub ke tallafawa. Abokan hulɗa suna haɗin gwiwa a cikin Ƙungiyoyin Ayyuka (COPs) don magance ƙalubalen gama gari, da nufin haɓaka jituwa da ƙirƙira a cikin kwayoyin halittar ƙwayoyin cuta. A cikin Country Scale-Up Accelerator (CSUA), masu ruwa da tsaki suna aiki tare don daidaita ƙoƙari da ba da damar musayar Kudancin Kudu don haɓaka ƙarfin ƙasa.

Wani fim ɗin da ya ci nasara, daga Bangladesh, ya nuna wani ƙaramin yaro wanda ya kamu da gubar dalma daga wata masana'anta ta gida.
